Chapter 1301: Xuanhuang Wind Calamity Tribulation

“This formation…”

“Who exactly is it?!” The Holy Emperor was both shocked and furious.

The Immortal Ancestor, the Heavenly Doctor, and even the Xuan Immortal Ark beyond the starry sky were clearly not the ones who laid this formation.

In this star sea, who else could possibly possess such power, enough to deploy a grand formation that even made him feel alarmed and fearful?

And what exactly was that Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, who had descended not long ago yet never shown himself, doing?

Countless thoughts instantly appeared in the Holy Emperor’s mind.

Outside the starry sky, the golden needles still streamed in endlessly.

Interweaving illusion and reality, dense and swift.

The Holy Emperor had already been unable to block all of these golden needles, and now he had also sensed that the Xuanhuang Realm seemed to have inexplicably fallen into crisis.

Yet the Heavenly Doctor seemed completely unaware of this.

“Heavenly Doctor! Xuanhuang Realm!” Left with no other choice, the Holy Emperor roared a warning toward the outer starry sky.

The endless rain of golden needles seemed to pause slightly, but it still did not cease.

However, compared to before, the positions where the golden needles fell upon the Xuanhuang lands had changed somewhat.

It seemed the Heavenly Doctor had also perceived the hidden changes within the Xuanhuang Realm and was likewise attempting to reverse them through formation methods.

But…

“Useless!”

The Holy Emperor could see that it had only slightly delayed the arrival of the drastic transformation.

That invisible, unknown formation was still in the process of descending.

The instinctive warning from his spiritual perception caused the Holy Emperor to begin feeling inexplicable dread. Forcing down the unease in his heart, his thoughts raced rapidly, and in the end he decided to temporarily ignore the Heavenly Doctor’s golden needles and first return to the Xuanhuang Realm.

“Find the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable!” the Holy Emperor’s voice echoed throughout.

At present, throughout Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth, golden needles covered the land. The overwhelming majority of living beings had fallen into slumber.

Tianyang, who had previously blocked the Immortal Ancestor, now had a body already ruined beyond recognition.

Yet he still stood firmly in front of the Immortal Ancestor.

However, the Immortal Ancestor had also gradually sensed the crisis the Xuanhuang Realm was about to face, and the movements of his hands slowly came to a halt. Otherwise, Tianyang’s immortal puppet body might have been completely destroyed.

A vast divine sense swept across the Xuanhuang Realm again and again, yet they could not find the trace of that Great Celestial Venerable at all.

“Ruomu! Earth Veins! Stone Tablet!”

The Holy Emperor attempted to communicate with them through the connection of the source power essence network.

Yet they all seemed to have collectively vanished, and none responded.

The Xuanhuang Realm before him was like a pot of water about to slowly be brought to a boil.

The Holy Emperor could only helplessly watch all this happen, unable to find the source of heat boiling the water.

In the sky, the Immortal Ancestor’s phantom suddenly manifested, dispersing all the clouds. With a colossal dharma form overlooking Xuanhuang, his gaze burned like torches, sweeping back and forth.

Upon the earth, rays of golden light continuously erupted from the golden needles, spreading outward in all directions. In each interval between flashes, the needle pulses had already circled the Xuanhuang Realm once.

This strange phenomenon was the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor joining forces to search heaven and earth.

Determined to locate the hidden mastermind.

But an unbelievable scene occurred.

The joint effort of two Supreme cultivators, the strongest beings in the star sea, lasted nearly half a day, yet they still failed to find even the slightest clue.

As if the mastermind simply did not exist at all.

…

While the three strongest beings in the star sea gathered together yet remained completely at a loss.

Beneath Tongyan Prefecture.

The secret chamber that had originally been carved out, only about ten feet square, had now transformed into endless void.

At the boundary of the void lay the location of the ritual originally used to enter the Fallen Immortal Realm. It was now shrouded in an indescribably mysterious force.

It was precisely the existence that drove all cultivators mad upon seeing it: immortal spiritual qi.

Immortal spiritual qi, like flowing streams, like faint threads of light, circled around the ritual.

Opening up endless void.

The Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable whom the Immortal Ancestor, Holy Emperor, and Heavenly Doctor were desperately searching for, along with the mastermind behind all this upheaval, were right here.

Needless to say, the Li Fan here was merely a divine sense clone. Even if Li Fan’s true body arrived personally, with his current strength, he still could not manipulate immortal spiritual qi.

He could not even touch or comprehend it, at most only gaze upon it to satisfy longing.

And the reason immortal spiritual qi could merge into the immortal formation deduced by the Final Dissociation Disc…

Within the void, Sun Tianci still maintained the same posture he had before entering the Fallen Immortal Realm trial.

Two completely opposing auras surged from his body simultaneously, one sacred, the other demonic and soaring to the heavens.

Although the sacred aura was far stronger than the sinister demonic aura.

Faced with the overwhelming advance of the monstrous demonic aura, the sacred aura only retreated again and again. Even though a slight eruption would be enough to completely sweep away the relentlessly entangling demonic aura, Sun Tianci never did so.

His brows were tightly furrowed, sorrow on his face.

“Fortunately, I left a contingency beforehand…”

Sensing the Wu Ninglu he had released wreaking havoc within Sun Tianci’s sea of consciousness, Li Fan coldly snorted inwardly.

Countless demonic thoughts continuously gnawed at Sun Tianci. At the same time, they all roared vicious curses.

“I carried you for three years before giving birth to you. How did you treat me?”

“Not only did you steal the Spirit of Heaven and Earth of my Dao Integration, you even watched me die with your own eyes!”

“What a wonderful son for your mother!”

“Everything you have now was stolen from me! From the very beginning, you should never have lived!”

“Come! Kill me again! Let me truly perish in body and soul!”

…

Faced with his mother’s vengeance, Sun Tianci chose silent endurance.

He naturally sensed that his mother was devouring his strength, but this was precisely what he wanted.

In Sun Tianci’s perception, although Wu Ninglu had split into countless demonic thoughts, they were merely chaotic consciousnesses filled with madness and destructive intent. If the central target sustaining her desire for vengeance, namely himself, ceased to exist, then it would not take long before these demonic thoughts completely dissipated between heaven and earth.

And if that happened…

Then from that moment onward, Sun Tianci would truly never see his mother again.

Having possessed memories since childhood, having personally witnessed on the day of his birth how he had “killed” his biological mother, and having always carried deep guilt, Sun Tianci this time intended to save her.

In Sun Tianci’s perception, as those demonic thoughts devoured more of his energy, their chaos gradually lessened. As long as he continued feeding them more, his mother would eventually become completely calm.

Though it appeared as though he were cutting his own flesh to repay his mother, the reality was far less exaggerated.

After all, the power of a Great Celestial Venerable was like a boundless ocean, vast beyond limits.

Compared to that, his mother’s countless demonic thoughts were merely a school of fish in the sea.

It would simply require some time for Sun Tianci to complete this feeding process.

Naturally, Sun Tianci was aware of all the drastic changes occurring in the Xuanhuang Realm.

That Heavenly Mandate Holy Emperor, the Dharma-Transmitter Immortal Ancestor, and finally the countless golden needles. Even this newly inherited Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable found them extremely troublesome.

But duty demanded that he save the Xuanhuang Realm.

To speak honestly, doing so alone would be somewhat difficult.

But fortunately, he had his master’s assistance.

When he underwent one trial after another in the Fallen Immortal Realm, trials based on the stories he had heard since childhood, and after he saw his master’s true appearance before being sent into the Fallen Immortal Realm, how could Sun Tianci still fail to understand the true identity of his mysterious master?

It was precisely a remnant obsession left behind after the fall of the previous Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, Su Bai.

Because of an obsession to save the Xuanhuang Realm hidden within fate itself, it had attached itself to him.

From childhood, it had trained and taught him, and in the end helped him inherit the position of Great Celestial Venerable.

Although his master had never stated any of this explicitly, Sun Tianci had pieced together this conclusion himself from the many details in his daily interactions with his master, as well as from his experiences while inheriting the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable’s position in the Fallen Immortal Realm.

After all, aside from the previous Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, who else could know the details, and even the answers, of the inheritance trials so clearly?

He had only just inherited the position, and a vast flood of chaotic memories still filled his mind, with no time yet to sort through them.

Yet his master was already skillfully using immortal spiritual qi to set up formations...

Sun Tianci could not help but recall what his master had said to him just moments earlier.

That was when he had successfully inherited the position of Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable and awakened from the Fallen Immortal Realm.

His master looked at him with satisfaction.

“You truly did not disappoint me, good child.”

Then he instructed him earnestly.

“Ten thousand years have passed. The Xuanhuang Realm is no longer the Xuanhuang Realm it once was. Since the Immortal Path has been severed and the Immortal Realm no longer exists, from this day onward, the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable should only be the Great Celestial Venerable of the Xuanhuang Realm, not the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable of the Immortal Realm...”

“Now that the Xuanhuang Realm is the only pure land within the star sea, outsiders all covet it greedily. Since you have inherited this position, you must shoulder the responsibilities of the Great Celestial Venerable and protect Xuanhuang.”

“Immortal Ancestor, the Heavenly Doctor, the Xuan Immortal Ark... perhaps only that Holy Emperor stands with us.”

“The time left to us is too short. You have only just inherited the position. Even dealing with the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor will likely be beyond your strength...”

“The only chance to turn defeat into victory lies in the world-protecting grand formation from back then.”

At once, some vague memories surfaced in Sun Tianci’s mind.

“Master, you mean...”

“After inheriting the Great Celestial Venerable position, you should have also inherited the immortal spiritual qi released after detonating the immortal artifacts?” Li Fan asked.

“Correct.” Sun Tianci nodded.

His master was merely a remnant soul, and so many years had passed. Some memory loss was entirely normal. The fact that he knew about the Great Celestial Venerable’s legacy only further proved his identity.

After receiving Sun Tianci’s confirmation, Li Fan looked toward the Xuanhuang Realm below, his eyes flickering.

“The world-protecting grand formation has been abandoned for ten thousand years. During that time, it was also repaired by the Xuantian Sect...”

“But even so, if it is activated, it can successfully keep these invaders outside. It may even be possible to kill them.”

“One only needs to use a small amount of that immortal spiritual qi, like this, and this...”

The formation diagrams Sun Tianci received from Li Fan awakened fragments of his inherited memories.

The traces of the formation in the images matched almost perfectly, except, just as his master said, some parts had changed slightly over time.

The immortal formation was infinitely profound. Sun Tianci, who had only just successfully inherited the position of Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, was far from being able to fully master it.

Just as he was about to think further, Sun Tianci already sensed that the Immortal Ancestor had returned to the Xuanhuang Realm. It seemed he was searching for his whereabouts.

Sun Tianci’s heart tightened.

This Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor was no weaker than himself. That was, if those few immortal artifacts were not used.

But within the Xuanhuang Realm, immortal artifacts could not be used lightly.

Especially since he was still unfamiliar with the use of the four immortal artifacts inherited from the Celestial Venerable’s legacy. If a single mistake caused harm to the Xuanhuang Realm...that would be an unforgivable sin.

With the situation urgent, Sun Tianci followed his master’s suggestion and decided to activate the ancient world-protecting grand formation to deal with the Immortal Ancestor.

Because of his nearly absolute trust in his master, and because his own formation mastery was weak, whatever Li Fan said, Sun Tianci did exactly that.

Originally, everything progressed smoothly.

Unexpectedly, just as the formation was about to take preliminary shape, his mother, who had already died, suddenly appeared in Sun Tianci’s sea of consciousness for some unknown reason.

Transforming into countless demonic souls, burning with the flames of vengeance, she instantly drowned Sun Tianci’s mind.

That familiar and incomparably intimate aura, that face which had existed only in memory and dreams, had now become a vengeful spirit demanding his life.

Sun Tianci’s mind immediately fell into chaos.

Li Fan seemed to notice something wrong with Sun Tianci and urgently transmitted a stern warning.

“This is your own karma, your own inner tribulation. You must resolve it yourself.”

“Although you were born in Dao Integration, you incurred a blood debt because of it. The fear and unease it brought you cannot be calmed, even with the Immortal Heart Mantra.”

“It has always been hidden deep within your heart, growing alongside you. Now that you have inherited the position of Great Celestial Venerable and received a vast ocean of power, it has also transformed and finally manifested. However, for you, this is also a rare opportunity. If you can resolve this heart demon now, then from this day onward, you will have no weaknesses...”

While rapidly warning Sun Tianci, Li Fan continued.

“As for the changes in the formation, simply continue following what I say. Focus on dealing with your inner tribulation.”

One must know that Sun Tianci was, after all, still a child not even ten years old.

Though fate and opportunity had converged upon him, allowing him to successfully inherit the position of Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, when facing the birth mother he had longed for day and night, emotional turmoil was unavoidable.

Li Fan’s years of uninterrupted teaching and conditioning also caused Sun Tianci to subconsciously obey his commands.

Thus, a terrifying immortal formation built upon the foundation of the Xuanhuang world-protecting grand formation slowly took shape.

Sun Tianci, who provided the immortal spiritual qi, remained completely unaware.

After seeing the Heavenly Doctor use golden needles to forcibly interrupt and restore the Xuanhuang Realm’s fusion progress, he became even more determined to deploy the immortal formation.

Li Fan split his attention, his eyes filled with obsession as he watched the immortal formation nearing completion.

There were no dark thoughts of slaughter or destruction in his heart.

Only awe and admiration at witnessing the Great Dao.

“This is what a true formation is.”

“What I deduced still has subtle differences from what exists in reality.”

“I want to see whether the likes of the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor can survive within this immortal formation...”

As the saying goes, spilled water cannot be gathered again.

Once this formation was completed, even if Sun Tianci, as the power source, discovered the truth and wanted to stop it, he would be powerless.

Only Li Fan, as the one deploying the formation, could make slight adjustments during the activation process.

But even he could not reverse the process.

Li Fan sensed the Immortal Ancestor and the others still searching for his whereabouts within the Xuanhuang Realm, and coldly snorted inwardly.

He stood ready to activate the formation at any moment.

...

After searching several times without result, the Holy Emperor released the Dao One spiritual energy he had absorbed back into the Xuanhuang world.

He contemplated a solution.

The unease in the Holy Emperor’s heart had already reached its peak.

And Immortal Ancestor was the same.

In the end, as if having made up his mind.

Immortal Ancestor’s figure briefly vanished for a moment, then reappeared.

His expression was solemn, and in his hand was an ancient bronze mirror.

The Holy Emperor’s pupils contracted slightly. From that mirror, he sensed a faint trace of immortal spiritual aura.

“The true body of the Tianxuan Mirror?”

Immortal Ancestor threw the Tianxuan Mirror high into the sky. The ancient bronze mirror expanded with the wind. In an instant, its illusory mirror body had already enveloped the entire Xuanhuang Realm.

The heavens were no longer visible. Instead, the mirror surface covered everyone’s heads.

Beneath the Tianxuan Mirror, even the Holy Emperor felt as though he had been completely seen through.

Instinctively, starlight enveloped him, shielding him from the Tianxuan Mirror’s gaze.

One black and one white, two lines intertwined and emerged from the Tianxuan Mirror’s surface.

They extended infinitely, instantly encompassing the Xuanhuang Realm.

Then came the continuous sweeping of black and white lines.

The black and white lines swept across, merging into the Xuanhuang world. Within the Tianxuan Mirror surface above, the scenery of the Xuanhuang Realm also gradually appeared.

Not only the mountains, rivers, lakes, and seas, but also the countless living beings within it.

Only the Holy Emperor, Immortal Ancestor, and others like them did not appear within it. However, as the black and white lines continued sweeping, the Holy Emperor’s figure ultimately began to slowly appear within the Tianxuan Mirror as well.

The Holy Emperor raised his head and looked at his blurry reflection within the mirror. For some reason, he felt that the figure in the mirror was subtly different from his real self.

The Xuanhuang Realm seemed to fall into stillness.

Waiting for the Tianxuan Mirror’s search results.

Only the Heavenly Doctor’s golden needles did not stop. They moved across the Xuanhuang land, seemingly intending to completely restore the Xuanhuang Realm to how it had been before the great war.

The scenes within the Tianxuan Mirror became clearer and clearer.

Many locations were ruled out.

Immortal Ancestor had already begun searching the remaining regions.

The Holy Emperor was doing the same.

Former enemies had, at this moment, once again reached a tacit cooperation.

Because regardless of whether what followed would evolve toward the Xuanhuang Realm or the Heavenly Law Realm, the existence of this world beneath their feet was the prerequisite for everything.

Just as Li Fan’s hiding place beneath Tongyan Prefecture was about to be exposed.

A figure quietly appeared outside the Great Qi small world, without anyone noticing.

Within the void, the Holy Emperor had laid layer upon layer of formations.

And what had been sealed by the Holy Emperor and carefully placed there was...

The ruins of the First Origin Sect, carrying the Obliterating Wind Calamity and the Great Mage’s skeletal remains.

As well as a faceless stone statue.

That figure was another of Li Fan’s divine sense clones.

After separating from the simulated personality of the Boundless Mirror and using the Final Derivation Law Jade to deduce a Dao Integration cultivation method, causing turmoil within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, this divine sense clone had hidden itself ever since.

Quietly waiting for an opportunity.

And now, he had finally gotten his chance.

“After planning so carefully for so long, how could I allow interference at the final moment.”

“Come back here for me...”

Facing the obstruction of layer upon layer of formations, Li Fan’s clone ignored them all completely.

He directly flashed into the interior of the formation.

At the same time.

The Holy Emperor within the Xuanhuang Realm underwent a drastic change in expression.

He had already sensed that figure silently appearing outside the Great Qi small world.

That inexplicable familiarity made his heart tremble violently.

No longer caring about anything else, starlight pierced through the heavens and descended directly into the Great Qi Holy Dynasty.

Then it rapidly fled toward the void outside.

But it was already too late.

A moment earlier, Li Fan’s divine sense clone had already instantly broken all the formations.

The items placed on both sides consequently gathered together.

The clone self-detonated, leaving not even the slightest trace behind.

Using the final power of the clone’s explosion, he violently hurled the faceless stone statue toward the First Origin Sect ruins.

Just as the stone statue was about to collide with the First Origin Sect ruins, the clone’s remaining consciousness transformed into a sharp sword.

It slashed directly toward the faceless stone statue’s head.

Boom. Boom. Boom.

Although it appeared to be nothing more than an utterly ordinary stone statue.

The moment the clone sword collided with the stone statue, it was as though some power instantly descended.

It did not stop this desecration of the stone statue, seeming only to cast a distant, casual glance.

But precisely because of this action, it alarmed what had been lurking within the First Origin Sect ruins...

The Obliterating Wind Calamity.

The existence that had descended into the stone statue vanished in an instant.

But that terrifying Obliterating Wind Calamity did not stop because of it.

A storm slowly formed in the void outside the Great Qi small world.

The Holy Emperor arrived one step too late.

The storm had already swallowed the entire First Origin Sect ruins. Even the horrifying energy fluctuations blowing from afar made this Supreme Realm powerhouse feel endless danger.

Like a weak mortal facing a world-destroying catastrophe.

There was nothing he could do except watch helplessly.

Cold sweat dripped down his forehead, but the Holy Emperor quickly regained clarity.

Without holding anything back, he mobilized all of the golden source power, attempting to stop the spread of the Obliterating Wind Calamity.

At the same time, countless Rift Whales emerged from the Holy Dynasty.

They severed the section of void containing the wind calamity from the Great Qi Holy Dynasty.

Source power essence, infinitely close to true immortal power, was utterly fragile before this Obliterating Wind Calamity.

It collapsed at the slightest touch.

The Holy Emperor could not retreat, and could only continue doing his utmost to use source power essence to try to block the Obliterating Wind Calamity.

A streak of white light likewise intercepted the spreading obliterating wind calamity.

The newcomer wore a tall crown and long beard, holding a bronze mirror. It was none other than the Immortal Ancestor.

The Immortal Ancestor’s expression was uglier than ever before, no longer calm.

And the Tianxuan Mirror in his hand seemed to have seen some exceedingly terrifying existence, flashing continuously in warning.

The Holy Emperor transmitted to the Immortal Ancestor the scene he had just sensed, of the First Origin Sect ruins being triggered.

The Immortal Ancestor said little, merely controlling the Tianxuan Mirror to emit streams of ancient green radiance, attempting to seal the Obliterating Wind Calamity.

The two Supreme beings worked together, yet still could not completely block the Obliterating Wind Calamity.

This terrifying Wind Calamity seemed capable of devouring everything.

Even the void itself was among the things it sought to obliterate.

Following the gaps in the Immortal Ancestor’s sacred law defensive line, the Wind Calamity surged like a great tidal wave, swallowing everything in its path.

It advanced toward the Xuanhuang Realm.

If the Wind Calamity were allowed to erupt within the Xuanhuang Realm, then all living beings within it, including the Xuanhuang Realm itself, would likely be destroyed by this calamity from the Immortal Realm.

At this moment, several golden needles suddenly arrived from afar. Like divine pillars stabilizing the sea, they formed an indestructible embankment, firmly blocking the escaped remnants of the Obliterating Wind Calamity.

The Wind Calamity howled, and the golden needles’ radiance dimmed.

Soon, the embankment collapsed, and the wind calamity continued surging forward.

But before long, countless more golden needles arrived.

Forming an unbroken series of wind-breaking embankments, obstructing the advance of the terrifying wind calamity.

An elderly man with compassionate eyes appeared in the void along with the arrival of the golden needles.

As though treating some difficult illness, the old man’s expression was solemn as he continuously placed needles.

At the same time, he continuously sent out streams of light that fell into the Obliterating Wind Calamity ahead.

From afar, the Holy Emperor saw that those streaks of light seemed to be extremely ancient objects.

The aura attached to them was silent, cold, and extinguished. After they fell into the Wind Calamity, they seemed to attract its concentration and assault.

Thus forming one small vortex after another.

The appearance of these vortices absorbed most of the Obliterating Wind Calamity’s energy.

As a result, this terrifying disaster that had erupted in the void outside the Great Qi Small World showed signs of gradually weakening.

The compassionate old man showed no sign of relief because of this, and instead became even more cautious.

The golden needles in his hands continued without pause, shooting forth one after another.

Completely sealing those vortices.

With a slight exertion of force in his hand, accompanied by a pulling motion, the Wind Calamity vortices were captured along the golden threads by the old man.

He slightly opened his mouth and actually swallowed the golden needle seals containing the Obliterating Wind Calamity directly into his stomach.

The Immortal Ancestor seemed already accustomed to this.

But the Holy Emperor revealed a shocked expression.

It seemed this Heavenly Doctor’s strength surpassed both him and the Immortal Ancestor.

In the Heavenly Doctor’s eyes, it seemed there was nothing but the Wind Calamity.

He completely ignored the Immortal Ancestor and the Holy Emperor.

One golden needle after another descended, slowly sealing all the obliterating wind calamity and swallowing it into his stomach.

Such an action was absolutely not an easy matter even for the Heavenly Doctor.

Every so often, he had to pause briefly to rest.

Fortunately, with the combined efforts of the three Supreme beings, they finally managed to eliminate this world-destroying calamity in its infancy.

Looking at the void that had become peaceful once more, the somewhat exhausted Holy Emperor still felt lingering fear.

If this Obliterating Calamity had erupted directly within the Xuanhuang Realm rather than in the void, they might not have been able to save it in time.

Just as the Holy Emperor was thinking this, he suddenly noticed that although the disaster had been resolved, both the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor still stood in the void with grave expressions.

The direction they were looking toward was neither the Xuanhuang Realm nor the Holy Emperor.

But rather...

A faint, indistinct phantom of a Dao child that had appeared at some unknown time.

The Dao child stood quietly with closed eyes.

It seemed as though the others present did not exist in his eyes.

Yet the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor faced him as if confronting a great enemy.

"The Grand Mage of Heavenly Capital?"

The Holy Emperor felt a chill of shock in his heart.

He thought of the Grand Mage’s skeletal remains within the First Origin Sect ruins, which had now completely vanished within the Obliterating Wind Calamity.

He had not expected...

That it would actually cause the rumored Grand Mage of Heavenly Capital to appear.

The Grand Mage’s realm had already transcended the limits of the current star sea.

It surpassed the so-called Supreme beings.

Yet with merely a phantom standing there, the Holy Emperor could not determine whether it was real or false.

Judging from the expressions on the Immortal Ancestor’s and Heavenly Doctor’s faces, even they were deeply shaken by this suddenly appearing Grand Mage.

The Grand Mage did not move, and the three Supreme beings also did not dare move rashly.

For a time, they were locked in stalemate.

But the Holy Emperor could sense that in the nearby Xuanhuang Realm, the progress of the gradually forming formation was still continuing.

Just as the Holy Emperor resolved to ignore the Grand Mage before him and return to the Xuanhuang Realm to continue searching for the mastermind behind the scenes, A voice suddenly came from the Grand Mage’s phantom.

The three Supreme beings all felt their minds tense and listened carefully.

"The Dao is ancient. Xin is completely extinguished."

"Practice through thought cultivation, connect the intent, and advance toward the divine."

"..."

At first hearing, it seemed utterly incomprehensible and nonsensical.

But the longer he listened, the Holy Emperor suddenly felt a trace of understanding flash through his heart.

This was actually an immortal art formula.

Chapter 1302: Returning To Void, Ultimately Reverting To Truth

“A thousand lines of soul shifting, a hundred bends of spirit turning.”

“Blameless.”

...

The phantom continued transmitting the Dao.

It was not through sound or divine sense transmission, but directly resonated within everyone's minds.

Even the Holy Emperor, the Immortal Ancestor, and the Heavenly Doctor, all of whom were deeply concerned about the fate of the Xuanhuang Realm, found their minds uncontrollably immersed in the immortal art being imparted by the Dao child.

Only after the entire immortal art had been recited, when the Dao child phantom became blurred once more and its voice turned faint and intermittent, did the three awaken from their trance, drenched in cold sweat.

They exchanged glances, then with perfect tacit understanding retreated backward, distancing themselves from the Dao child phantom.

The phantom did not stop them, as if it had already fulfilled its mission, allowing the three to leave freely.

The voice of transmission grew weaker and weaker.

In the end, together with the Dao child phantom, it vanished mysteriously into the void.

Seeing this scene, all three wore highly complicated expressions.

They pondered the reason for the phantom's sudden appearance to transmit the Dao, only to gradually disappear afterward.

At the same time, they were also reflecting upon the immortal art they had just heard. Immortal arts were unlike mortal cultivation methods, being exceedingly difficult and obscure.

Especially since the Dao child phantom had merely recited the contents directly, without offering any explanation whatsoever.

Although the Holy Emperor and the other two possessed comprehension that could be considered the peak of the mortal world, fully understanding an immortal art in such a short time was still somewhat beyond them. They could only grasp a rough outline.

"This is not a cultivation method, but a technique for avoiding calamity. It also seems to contain fragments of records concerning the Immortal Realm..."

The Holy Emperor's thoughts raced, but his movements did not pause as he turned and returned to the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Immortal Ancestor followed closely behind.

As for the Heavenly Doctor, he had vanished at some unknown moment.

The Holy Emperor casually glanced toward Daoyuan Prefecture of the Xuanhuang Realm, yet did not sense any sign of Heavenly Capital awakening.

"The Xuanhuang Realm is on the verge of total destruction, yet that place remains unmoved."

"And yet just now, it actively manifested..."

"Was it because of the obliterating wind calamity?"

Though countless questions filled his mind, now was ultimately not the time to investigate deeply.

These thoughts passed in an instant, and the Holy Emperor refocused his attention on the Xuanhuang Realm's current condition.

Outside the Xuanhuang Realm, another endless rain of golden needles descended.

However, the power dissipating after the golden needles struck the ground had undergone subtle changes compared to before. With a single glance, the Holy Emperor discerned some clues. If the earlier needles had been like a powerful medicine administered during a critical illness, then the current ones were like restorative treatment after recovery from a serious disease. The power of the golden needles had become far gentler and more soothing.

Hidden thunder rumbled, fine rain fell continuously.

It resembled the awakening of insects in spring, when all things revived and flourished.

The turbulent Xuanhuang Realm was actually displaying a scene full of vitality. If not for the hidden, faintly discernible aura of a grand formation lurking in secret.

Truly worthy of the title Heavenly Doctor. In such a short time, relying solely on golden needles, he had forcibly reversed the already merging Xuanhuang worlds and restored them to their original state. The Xuanhuang heaven and earth returned to their former appearance. Even more remarkably, heaven and earth themselves had not suffered any injury because of it.

To heal heaven as one heals a person, with golden needles reversing life and death. Reaching such a realm required not merely immense cultivation and strength, but also a profound understanding of the essence of the world.

As a fellow Supreme being, one who had once regarded himself as the incarnation of the Heavenly Dao and possessed an incomparably close connection with heaven and earth, the Holy Emperor knew clearly that he absolutely could not achieve what the Heavenly Doctor had done.

"But even someone like the Heavenly Doctor still cannot find the mastermind behind all this..."

The Holy Emperor's heart grew unbearably heavy.

Ever since returning from the void outside Great Qi, the Xuanhuang Realm had felt increasingly ominous to him.

Previously, it had been like water heating in a pot.

Now, it was only a hair's breadth from boiling.

A qualitative transformation could occur at any moment.

The Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor had sensed it as well, and no longer held back, finally revealing their true methods.

In the Heavenly Cities of every prefecture, where statues of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor had originally stood, regardless of whether the statues still existed, gigantic illusory figures of the Immortal Ancestor now appeared amid waves of spatial trembling, replacing them.

Like points of light igniting one after another, they shone across more than half of the Xuanhuang Realm's body. On the Five Elders Association's side, five points of different colors lit up simultaneously.

Six colors linked together into lines.

Like the meridians of the Xuanhuang Realm, radiating brilliant light in broad daylight.

"Seal the soul."

"Substitute for the world."

The Heavenly Doctor's incomparably cold voice echoed throughout heaven and earth.

The Immortal Ancestor's figure once more expanded to fill heaven and earth.

The Heavenly Doctor faintly appeared atop the Immortal Ancestor's colossal form.

Then, in his right hand, he held a seven-colored needle.

With solemn expression, he pierced it into the Baihui acupoint atop the Immortal Ancestor's head.

The Immortal Ancestor's immense form instantly erupted with dazzling seven-colored radiance.

Then, as if dissolving, it transformed into streams of flowing light that flew downward into the continuously flashing Xuanhuang meridians.

Silently, the seven-colored radiance completed one full circulation the instant it entered the Xuanhuang meridians.

After a brief moment of stillness, the seven-colored light began circulating through the meridians once more.

"Seal the soul and substitute for the world?"

"This is the Heavenly Doctor temporarily sealing the Immortal Ancestor's soul and guiding it into the Xuanhuang heaven and earth, achieving a temporary substitution of body for heaven?"

Watching this scene from afar, the Holy Emperor was profoundly shaken.

Having once merged with heaven himself, the Holy Emperor understood exactly how difficult such a feat truly was.

Not to mention an entire world, even seizing the body of a single cultivator was no simple matter.

The Xuanhuang Realm not only possessed Heavenly Dao consciousness, but because it existed outside the Immortal Ruins in a uniquely dangerous environment where extinction could come at any moment, that consciousness was extraordinarily active.

Not long ago, someone had even inherited the position of Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

With so many reinforcing factors, the Heavenly Doctor and the Immortal Ancestor working together could still forcibly suppress and seal the Xuanhuang Realm's fundamental consciousness, replacing it with themselves...

"Even if the Xuanhuang Realm's Heavenly Dao is unaware of the current crisis, once the Immortal Ancestor replaces it and inspects matters personally, he will absolutely be able to locate the hidden grand formation."

This method of suppressing the world's origin would certainly inflict tremendous damage upon the Xuanhuang Realm.

But with crisis at hand, there was no room to care about such things.

The Holy Emperor waited solemnly for the Immortal Ancestor's discovery.

When the seven-colored light had circulated through the Xuanhuang meridians for more than three thousand six hundred cycles, the circulation suddenly halted.

At one location, it was as though the meridians had been blocked by something, erupting with black baleful energy that shot into the heavens.

The Heavenly Doctor abruptly opened his eyes.

A trace of killing intent, exceedingly rare in his compassionate gaze, emerged.

Nine golden needles streaked forward like lines, instantly flying toward the locked location.

At the same time, the Holy Emperor reacted as well.

His figure flashed, appearing together with the nine golden needles.

The surrounding land had already been reduced to nothingness by the earlier eruption of black energy.

Revealing the deeply hidden void below. Within that void, two figures stood, one seated and one standing.

The seated one appeared no larger than a seven or eight year old child, brows tightly furrowed.

The standing figure's face could not be seen clearly.

Yet when facing the Heavenly Doctor's golden needles and the utterly enraged Holy Emperor, that figure displayed not the slightest fear.

Only complete calm.

"This familiar feeling again..."

The Holy Emperor felt as though he had fallen into an abyss, his heart turning ice cold.

In a daze, the rapidly descending golden needles seemed to slow down.

The Holy Emperor seemed to see that figure below, and slowly uttered a single phrase.

"Immortal Descent..."

"All Things Return to Void!"

Boom!

An invisible storm erupted instantly.

The Heavenly Doctor's nine golden needles were blown apart in an instant, scattered in all directions.

The rapidly fleeing Holy Emperor was like someone slamming headfirst into a wall. It was far worse than merely seeing stars. His body and soul nearly collapsed outright. Fortunately, starlight surged forth and barely repaired the Holy Emperor's injuries.

Even with a constant replenishment of source power essence, the Holy Emperor, despite being in the Supreme Realm, could only barely maintain survival within this surrounding environment of chaotic violence.

The void concealing the mastermind had already vanished from sight. He could no longer even see the entire Xuanhuang Realm.

It was like a terrifying sandstorm, blotting out the heavens and covering the earth as it surged endlessly.

Everything in existence was engulfed within it.

The Heavenly Doctor's nine golden needles had long since been scattered to unknown places under the violent storm.

The auras of the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor could no longer be detected.

The only thing that could be sensed was endless chaos all around.

The Holy Emperor's mind fell into momentary blankness, after which incomparable grief and fury surged from his heart.

Even without witnessing it with his own eyes, he knew that the Xuanhuang Realm was being torn apart inch by inch within this horrifying grand formation.

Everything was beyond saving.

"Bastard! Bastard! Bastard!"

The Holy Emperor lost all composure, cursing madly.

Ignoring his own safety, he charged recklessly through the chaotic storm, trying to find that familiar yet unfamiliar mastermind behind everything.

But the only response he received was the ever-growing merciless storm.

...

Once immortal power had been transformed through the immortal formation into a void storm that destroyed everything, the destruction of the Xuanhuang Realm had already become inevitable.

This land where countless worlds had fused together, the only remaining paradise in the Darkest Star Sea, was now being rapidly devoured by this world-ending storm.

At the center of the formation, Sun Tianci, who had previously been trying to awaken his mother, no longer had the luxury of caring about her curses.

He jolted upright, staring at the Xuanhuang Realm, which had become riddled with devastation in the blink of an eye, completely stunned.

"Mas... Master?"

Only after quite a while did Sun Tianci manage to call out with difficulty.

However, the master who had always responded in the past, the seemingly omnipotent master, never appeared again.

As the Xuanhuang Realm stood on the brink of total destruction, Sun Tianci not only felt the power he had just inherited from the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable rapidly draining away, but because of this catastrophic dereliction of duty, the backlash of the Great Celestial Venerable also descended in an instant.

A nameless fire suddenly ignited within Sun Tianci's heart.

There was no pain at all. Sun Tianci only felt that his very existence was being burned away by the flames.

Within his sea of consciousness, his mother, who had previously ignored everything happening outside and done nothing but viciously curse him, gradually seemed to forget his existence.

She slowly fell silent, staring blankly into space.

"Tianci, Tianci..."

"Tianci... who is that?"

Countless demonic thoughts transformed into wisps of green smoke and vanished without a trace.

In the end, only Wu Ninglu's original appearance remained, blankly staring at the empty surroundings.

A tear inexplicably fell from the corner of her eye.

Wu Ninglu and Sun Tianci perished together within the heart-burning fire of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

At the center of the immortal formation, Li Fan's clone slowly revealed himself.

He frowned slightly, sensing that he seemed to have forgotten the existence of certain people.

But after running a deduction and confirming that they were merely insignificant pawns who had helped complete the immortal formation, he shook his head slightly and paid them no further attention.

Instead, he focused his attention on the few figures still struggling within the immortal formation.

...

Yin Shangren and Xu Ke, not long after escaping from the Museum of Divine Treasures, witnessed the successive earth-shaking changes within the Xuanhuang Realm.

While they were still marveling in shock, a world-ending storm suddenly descended.

Though the two of them could absolutely be considered powerful figures within the Xuanhuang Realm,before this world-ending immortal formation, they could only await death in despair.

Had it not been for Mr. Bai's skull that they carried protecting them, they would likely have already perished.

The chaotic storm grew increasingly violent.

The protective power emanating from Mister Bai's skull was also gradually weakening.

They likely would not survive much longer.

Yet at the brink of death, Xu Ke and Yin Shangren, unlike other living beings, were not filled with fear.

White-haired Xu Ke held Mr. Bai's skull in his arms, staring blankly in a daze.

"I should have died long ago. I merely lingered on for Mr. Bai's mission. Now, being able to be buried together with Mr. Bai can be considered a fitting death..."

Yin Shangren, meanwhile, gazed calmly ahead at the storm, with a faint trace of madness in his eyes.

"I was already a specter of the world, an existence that died once before. I wonder what will happen if I die once again?"

The only response was the endlessly howling invisible wind.

Yin Shangren and Xu Ke were slowly completely swallowed by the chaotic storm.

Even the skull in their hands was on the verge of collapse.

Just before the skull disappeared into the storm, a flicker of light flashed, and it vanished without a trace.

...

Countless golden needles revolved in orbit, forming a solid protective shell, attempting to resist the storm's erosion.

It was indeed somewhat effective, but under the increasingly violent storm, the golden protective light inevitably began to dim.

The Heavenly Doctor swept his gaze across the surroundings, seemingly somewhat dazed.

As though he had suddenly lost the goal he had struggled toward for so long, he stood frozen for a moment.

But very quickly, his gaze turned gloomy once more.

One hand extended beyond the golden protective barrier, drawing in a strand of the immortal formation's world-ending storm.

The Heavenly Doctor's hand turned into nothingness within the storm.

But at the same time, a storm seemed to begin raging within the Heavenly Doctor's own eyes.

...

The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor recovered from his Manifestation of Heaven and Earth form.

When the world-ending immortal formation activated, he had been temporarily possessing and replacing the Xuanhuang Realm through the Soul Sealing World Substitution Method. Therefore, when the world-ending storm erupted across every corner of the Xuanhuang Realm, it was almost equivalent to him facing this unimaginably terrifying catastrophe directly.

Although this storm seemed somewhat inferior to the obliterating wind calamity he had seen before, there was no doubt that this was genuine immortal power manifested.

And the obliterating wind calamity had merely been a tiny remnant of power.

The original obliterating wind calamity naturally possessed destructive power far exceeding the immortal formation storm.

But the immortal formation catastrophe currently erupting within the Xuanhuang Realm vastly surpassed the obliterating wind calamity countless times over.

Even the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor, despite being in the Supreme Realm, was as helpless as an ordinary mortal within it.

The severely injured Immortal Ancestor's body slowly dissolved.

The Tianxuan Mirror he carried fell powerlessly.

The Tianxuan Mirror emitted a faint dim green light, flickering uncertainly, as though it might be completely extinguished at any moment.

A transparent figure emerged from the dissolving shell of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor.

It somewhat resembled the Immortal Ancestor, yet was subtly different.

The transparent figure seemed to possess extremely strong resistance against the immortal formation's annihilation storm. Even with its eyes closed in slumber, it was enough to temporarily remain unharmed by the storm.

...

Within the territory of the Five Elders Association.

At the very moment the immortal formation erupted, the overwhelming majority of living beings were reduced to ashes.

But it was as if an unseen dark cloud had always hung over the Five Elders Association's territory. Even after the Xuanhuang Realm disappeared, that dark cloud still remained.

It even sheltered the countless lives that had vanished within the immortal formation.

...

Within the White Mist Barrier.

"Finally out."

With the combined efforts of everyone aboard the Xuan Immortal Ark, they finally unraveled the mysteries of the Life and Death Reversal Great Formation.

Having found the formation core, the Immortal Ark successfully broke free from the formation.

However, before they could even go trouble the Immortal Ancestor... the world extermination Immortal Formation had already descended.

The Xuan Immortal Ark, upon which everyone depended for survival, swayed endlessly like duckweed caught in a storm.

The outer shell of the Immortal Ark, protected by countless restrictions, rapidly disintegrated like melting ice and snow.

"Quick! Use the True Immortal seal script. Fight immortal with immortal!"

The elders of the Immortal Ark cried out in unison.

However, these were ultimately only crude imitations, not genuine True Immortal power.

The fluctuations caused by the True Immortal seal script merely caused the Immortal Formation storm to tremble slightly.

Then it was instead swallowed by the Immortal Formation.

Becoming energy that further strengthened the Immortal Formation storm.

Amid the agonized wails of regret from everyone aboard, the Xuan Immortal Ark was reduced to ashes.

"The destructive power of using True Immortal seal script is indeed immense. But until now, no True Immortal seal script related to protection has ever been found. When calamity descends, even the Xuan Immortal Ark, which could restrain the two Supreme Elders, is this utterly fragile..."

Holy Embryo Li Fan did not resist.

He merely quietly watched as his body dissolved within the chaos storm.

...

As the only pure land within the Darkest Star Sea, the Xuanhuang Realm undoubtedly concealed countless secrets.

Yet at this very moment, the formation [Immortal Descent, All Things Return to Void] truly resembled an incomparably violent storm.

Ruthlessly tearing away every secret that had been shrouded beneath it.

Within the core of the Immortal Formation, Li Fan's divine sense incarnation focused intently on everything happening inside the formation.

After all, the formation's power source was not provided by him.

He could not clearly observe the full panorama within the formation.

But he only needed to pay attention to those energy nodes within the formation undergoing violent fluctuations.

Those were all existences that, in order to survive, revealed everything about themselves without reservation and struggled against the Immortal Formation storm.

Li Fan suddenly recalled the scene from when he first witnessed the Crimson Flame Burning Sea.

The Congyun Sea had been completely evaporated, and countless living beings had perished.

Yet it had also exposed those secrets deeply buried and hidden beneath the seabed.

At that time, he had merely been a tiny Qi Condensation cultivator, yet had been able to grasp the hidden secrets of the Congyun Sea in full detail.

Now, watching the Xuanhuang Realm, as wave after wave of energy fluctuations emerged, with some existences even exceeding his expectations, he could not help but gain enlightenment.

"It seems the principles are always interconnected."

"Secrets often reveal themselves only after extermination."

Li Fan's divine sense incarnation fell into contemplation, unconsciously stroking a flawless and crystal clear skull in his hand.

"What a pity. This is not my true body, so there is no resonance whatsoever."

"The Tianxuan Mirror still seems to retain its own spiritual consciousness, but I cannot seize it..."

Just as Li Fan's divine sense thoughts were racing, recording every scene before him, as the observer who had activated the formation, he suddenly discovered something extremely abnormal.

The extermination Immortal Formation, which had already devoured most of the Xuanhuang Realm and should have only grown more violent, continuing to spread outward into the void...was now, for some unknown reason, showing signs of the storm gradually dying down.

"??!!"

By all logic, this should have been utterly impossible.

Unless...

some existence had stopped this storm.

An intense sense of crisis instantly surged within Li Fan's heart.

Not only within his divine sense incarnation, but also within his true body.

"The All Things Return to Void Immortal Formation, along with the Tianxuan Mirror's double protection..."

"Even a True Immortal should not be able to stop my return to [Truth]."

Li Fan, who had once successfully returned to truth even before a True Immortal in the Immortal Ruins, was not frightened by the fear in his heart.

Instead, after calm analysis, he made his decision.

After all, the only one near the Xuanhuang Realm capable of stopping the Immortal Formation's expansion should be that one...

Li Fan thought to himself.

His speculation was soon confirmed.

A figure suddenly appeared at the center of the Immortal Formation.

The raging storm around it gradually calmed the moment it approached.

Within the chaos storm, all living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm sank into ruin.

Yet the appearance of this figure was like a great sun descending from heaven, illuminating the darkness once more.

It was so striking.

So utterly incompatible with everything around it.

That the instant it appeared within the Immortal Formation, Li Fan's divine sense incarnation had already noticed its existence.

Li Fan was not unfamiliar with this figure.

He had even met it once before.

It was precisely that True Immortal seated outside the Xuanhuang Realm, meditating with closed eyes upon the Dao.

However, unlike the almost skeletal appearance he had seen upon the land of the Immortal Ruins, the True Immortal appearing now did not seem to have descended in person.

It was merely the manifestation of a phantom.

Not only had its form become full and complete once more, even the shackles binding its body were nowhere to be seen.

The True Immortal’s gaze swept across the immortal formation, and he frowned slightly.

He slowly extended his palm.

The world-exterminating storm that had been raging and howling gradually gathered into his hand.

The Immortal Formation sensed this existence that sought to destroy it, and its defenses were activated. Within the chaos, human-shaped phantoms manifested one after another.

They were formed from the power of the immortal formation, yet bore the appearances of the Xuanhuang Realm’s living beings who had previously died beneath the formation.

With fierce light in their eyes, fearless of death, they surged toward the True Immortal.

Like rolling tidal waves, mixed with the exterminating power of the immortal formation.

The True Immortal’s figure did not move in the slightest, and his posture remained completely unchanged.

All the immortal formation power that attempted to approach him was absorbed into the True Immortal’s palm without the slightest resistance.

No visible energy gathered, but the True Immortal’s figure seemed to become somewhat more solid.

As the True Immortal continuously absorbed it, the immortal power driving the All Things Return to Void Grand Formation rapidly drained away.

All of it fell into his palm.

Within the grand formation, the chaotic storm gradually subsided.

The Heavenly Doctor, the Holy Emperor, and the other survivors were initially confused.

But without exception, moments later, all their gazes focused upon the True Immortal’s figure.

As if it were only natural, they could not look away.

The Xuanhuang Realm survivors trembled.

No explanation was needed, because the moment they saw the True Immortal’s figure, they already understood the other party’s identity.

After ten thousand years since the Immortal Path had been severed, a True Immortal had returned to the world.

Without exception, the survivors all bowed their heads, expressing reverence toward the True Immortal.

The True Immortal’s figure did not speak, as if searching for something.

At this moment, the Holy Emperor finally reacted.

The fury in his heart blazed fiercely, temporarily offsetting the True Immortal’s innate suppression.

Even though the Xuanhuang Realm had already transformed into void, he immediately pointed toward the direction of the immortal formation’s core that he had previously discovered.

The True Immortal’s gaze instantly fell upon the void where Li Fan's divine sense incarnation was located.

The last remaining immortal power surrounding the immortal formation drained away at high speed. Under the True Immortal’s gaze, Li Fan's divine sense incarnation, whose thoughts had nearly frozen into complete stillness, was reactivated in an instant under the control of his true body.

He was just about to self-destruct and return through [Truth].

However, Li Fan's divine sense incarnation saw a scene that he could not comprehend at all.

As a result, he halted the process of returning through [Truth].

“This…”

“How is this possible?”

The True Immortal’s phantom was staring at Li Fan's divine sense incarnation at the immortal formation core.

And while no one else could detect it, it was slowly approaching.

By the time Li Fan's divine sense incarnation, positioned at the immortal formation core with a complete panoramic view, noticed that figure’s existence, it had already silently arrived behind the True Immortal’s figure.

“Meow~”

As if it had finally encountered prey it had waited for a very long time, Cat Treasure, who was always lazy and lethargic, let out an extremely excited cry.

It leapt upward and landed upon the True Immortal’s shoulder.

The True Immortal’s figure was utterly stunned, staring at the suddenly appearing adorable creature on his shoulder.

Cat Treasure opened its beautiful eyes wide and stared fixedly at the True Immortal’s figure.

The expression on the True Immortal’s face slowly changed from astonishment to terror.

“Meow~”

Cat Treasure cried out once more, then slightly opened its mouth.

In an instant, it swallowed the True Immortal’s figure whole.

And then...

Cat Treasure raised its head and looked beyond the Xuanhuang void, toward the True Immortal’s True Body seated within the Immortal Ruins.

Its body bent like a drawn bow, then it leapt upward.

Its figure vanished.

The next moment, it appeared beside the True Immortal within the Immortal Ruins.

Boom!

The entire Darkest Star Sea trembled slightly.

And the sound of something collapsing came from an unimaginably distant place.

In the Holy Emperor’s mind, the scene he had just witnessed replayed blankly.

No matter what, he could not connect the Cat Treasure that could effortlessly devour the True Immortal’s figure with the same Cat Treasure that usually loved sleeping lazily on his shoulder.

Cat Treasure had been accidentally fished up from the Fishing Pond by one of the Holy Dynasty’s citizens.

Although it possessed many miraculous abilities, the Holy Emperor had never imagined that the prey Cat Treasure truly sought would actually be...

A True Immortal?!

The Holy Emperor was incomparably shocked.

And all the Xuanhuang survivors present, regardless of cultivation level, wore expressions of utter disbelief.

“Was Cat Treasure fished up by the Fishing Pond...”

“Or did Cat Treasure voluntarily take the bait by following the True Immortal’s perception?”

“The fisher is also fished...”

The Holy Emperor felt ice cold throughout his heart.

“Even a True Immortal would end up like this...”

“Then Beyond the High Wall, what exactly...”

Not only the Holy Emperor, but at this moment, after the initial shock, all the Xuanhuang survivors felt an uncontrollable fear rise in their hearts.

A fear even greater than the destruction of the world.

...

Li Fan was naturally also deeply shaken.

But having gone through many reincarnations, he had already formed a certain psychological estimate of Cat Treasure’s miraculous nature.

He was the first to react, looking toward Cat Treasure’s destination, the Immortal Ruins not far away.

Observation there seemed to be blocked.

However, what Li Fan could sense was...

The pulling force of the Immortal Ruins was disappearing.

Boom!

The Darkest Star Sea trembled once again.

Continuous crashing sounds rang out one after another. Quite a few survivors had managed to endure and escape the world-exterminating immortal formation.

Yet before this vast and overwhelming force, they were reduced to ashes.

“[Truth]!”

Within the Derivation Law Jade space, Li Fan’s true body did not hesitate in the slightest as he silently recited in his heart.

Chapter 1303: Looking Back And Reviewing

Three years anchored, atop Jieli Mountain Peak.

Li Fan, who had been sitting in meditation and deep thought, suddenly opened his eyes.

His mind had been disturbed, and he could no longer maintain calm.

Letting out a long breath, he slowly stood and walked out of the wooden cabin.

He came to the cliffside and gazed into the distant sea of clouds. Mountain winds surged in waves, making his robes flap loudly.

Only after nearly half a day did Li Fan’s state of mind gradually return to peace.

Over these past three years, this scene had not happened for the first time.

Unlike before.

When Li Fan successfully used [Truth] and came back to one year after his anchor point this time, the experiences of the previous reincarnation still continued to deeply affect him.

It was not the passive influence of falling into the True Immortal’s net. Rather, the problem lay in Li Fan’s own mentality.

Even with the protection of the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra, he could not escape it.

Whenever he sank into concentration for long, from the depths of his mind, the image would uncontrollably emerge.

In endless darkness, Cat Treasure leaping upward, then swallowing the figure of the True Immortal from the Immortal Ruins.

Cold sweat would instantly drench him, and his mind would fall into chaos.

He could no longer maintain a tranquil state.

“Cat Treasure, Cat Treasure…”

Li Fan’s gaze flickered as he repeatedly muttered those two words.

Cat Treasure clearly possessed three abilities: item replication, lifeform simulation, and marrow cleansing.

Yet when it had first been fished out from the Fishing Pond, it had only been of white quality.

The Fishing Pond was faintly the creation of an nameless True Immortal who had already comprehended the Dao of Fishing.

And something capable of deceiving the Fishing Pond, how could it possibly be simple?

Cat Treasure feeding on source power essence also further demonstrated its extraordinary nature.

Only, whether it was the Holy Emperor acting as a chess piece, or Li Fan who considered himself the chess player, neither had anticipated...

That Cat Treasure would be such a terrifying creation.

Where immortal power reached, it was as though a True Immortal had personally descended.

Even though it was not the True Body, merely a projection, it had still suppressed the Immortal Descent, All Things Return to Void grand formation that had shattered the Xuanhuang Realm with a casual movement.

In stark contrast were the three Supreme experts of the star sea.

Even exhausting all their strength, they could only barely survive within the Immortal Formation.

The gap between Supreme cultivators and True Immortals could not be measured by reason.

And Cat Treasure, which could swallow a True Immortal projection in a single bite...

Its true strength was impossible to imagine.

In the previous life, Li Fan used [Truth] at the moment the suction force of the Immortal Ruins vanished, the High Wall collapsed, and the Star Sea fell into turmoil.

His instinct to survive had allowed him, after the initial shock, to temporarily suppress the fear in his heart.

Only in this life did he finally come back to his senses.

And feel overwhelming lingering fear.

He had once faced a True Immortal from the Immortal Ruins directly.

Even if it had been through a clone, even if [Truth] carried many side effects afterward, Li Fan had still successfully returned.

So when the True Immortal descended in the previous life, Li Fan had remained shocked but composed, merely maintaining vigilance instead of immediately using [Truth].

His purpose had been to pry more secrets about True Immortals.

He never expected...

That the descent of the True Immortal would reveal Cat Treasure’s true nature.

The True Immortal from the Immortal Ruins, capable of destroying the Xuanhuang Realm with a single glance, had not even been able to react before being swallowed in one bite by Cat Treasure.

If Cat Treasure had set its sights on Li Fan, how could he possibly have survived?

A hundred lifetimes of planning had nearly vanished in an instant, condemning him to eternal ruin.

How could that not fill Li Fan with lingering fear?

“I originally thought I had already been cautious enough.”

“I believed I had basically probed the depths of the Xuanhuang Realm. That from here onward, there would be far less to fear. I did not expect that beyond the High Wall, I would receive such a tremendous shock…”

Ignoring the still flickering [Truth] inheritance option prompts before his eyes, Li Fan returned to the wooden cabin.

Inside the room were wooden cats carved from timber, filling every corner. Their forms varied, vivid and lifelike.

Yet all of them were incomplete half-finished products, missing limbs, making it impossible to see the cat’s original appearance from the sculptures.

These had all been personally carved by Li Fan over the past three years.

Without using spiritual energy, made entirely by hand.

Li Fan stared at them for a moment, then selected another suitable block of wood and picked up the carving file resting nearby.

He began carving patiently.

Li Fan was using this method of recreating Cat Treasure through wood carving to directly confront the deepest fear in his heart, in hopes of eliminating Cat Treasure’s influence over him.

It had indeed shown some effect.

Compared to three years ago, the frequency with which Li Fan awoke from nightmares of Cat Treasure had greatly decreased.

However, Li Fan clearly knew that if he wished to truly resolve this “heart demon,” it would still require a long period of time.

And so he took this opportunity to carefully review and reflect.

At the final moment of the previous life, the Star Sea had fallen into turmoil.

The impact from the collapse of the High Wall caused many of the powerful cultivators who had survived within the world-exterminating immortal formation to be unable to withstand it, turning to ash.

At that time, Li Fan’s divine sense clone, positioned at the core of the immortal formation and borrowing the formation’s remaining power, had faintly sensed something.

The turbulence in the Star Sea had not been caused entirely by the collapse of the High Wall.

There was also the reason of some existence descending abruptly. Like a massive boulder plunging into a deep pool, it splashed up countless waves. In the already turbulent Darkest Star Sea, it stirred wave after monstrous wave.

This was a major upheaval in the Darkest Star Sea, one that had not appeared in the ten thousand years since the Immortal Path was severed.

Amid such chaos and danger, because of his decisiveness and vigilance, Li Fan had indeed successfully returned through [Truth].

But the scenes he experienced during [Truth] were different from before.

This was also the deeper reason why, over the past three years, Li Fan had never truly been able to calm his mind.

Under normal circumstances, the scene during [Truth] would be that the surrounding world dimmed, as if covered by a layer of misty water, making everything indistinct. Once [Truth] activated, all images would freeze, shatter, and fly into his mind.

When facing overwhelmingly powerful threats, such as when the True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins destroyed the Xuanhuang Realm with a single glance, or when the Faceless True Immortal tracked him down, these terrifying existences could move within the frozen scenes surrounding [Truth]. However, they moved very slowly, as if the inside and outside of [Truth] belonged to different spacetime layers.

But the [Truth] scene Li Fan experienced in his previous life was completely different.

The scene outside [Truth] seemed unaffected and remained frozen as usual. However, the surrounding images, as if wrapped in mist, flickered from time to time. Brightness fluctuated uncertainly, like an old television losing its signal.

At that moment, Li Fan’s thoughts were almost completely blank.

He had absolutely no means of resistance. Like someone awaiting judgment, he could only wait for his final fate to descend.

Fortunately.

[Truth] ultimately activated successfully, and Li Fan once again returned to Anchor Year 1.

When that incomparably familiar scenery appeared before his eyes, Li Fan nearly collapsed from exhaustion, cold sweat pouring down his body.

Thinking of this, the file in Li Fan’s hand slipped, and the originally perfect little wooden cat carving was instantly ruined.

Li Fan tossed it aside, then took out another block of wood and began carving again.

He cast aside all distracting thoughts from his mind and focused with utmost seriousness.

When a statue highly resembling Cat Treasure, but missing both ears, finally took shape, Li Fan felt his heart calm considerably once more.

He began reviewing the experiences of his previous life.

The greatest gain from that previous life was naturally learning of Cat Treasure’s existence and gaining a concrete understanding of what lay beyond the High Wall.

In the past, Li Fan had even planned that, if given the chance, he might use the legacy left behind by Mr. Bai to cross the High Wall. But for now, he had temporarily abandoned that thought.

Although what lay beyond the High Wall was terrifying, its actual impact on Li Fan at present was not particularly great.

After all, judging from Cat Treasure’s behavior, the only beings truly worthy of its notice were existences at the True Immortal level.

Li Fan was still far too far from the True Immortal realm.

Because he was too weak, there was no need for needless anxiety.

As for the origins of the terrifying and awe-inspiring Cat Treasure, based on the experiences of his previous life, Li Fan had two guesses.

First, Cat Treasure might originally have been a creation of the Nameless Immortal who created the Fishing Pond.

It might even be an extension of that Nameless Immortal’s power.

The Fishing Pond and Cat Treasure likely were not unique, nor limited to a single location.

Their mission would be to search the world for surviving True Immortals.

Once traces of them were found, the Nameless Immortal would descend and devour them.

Just like the fate of those Fish Kings Li Fan saw in the Fish Stabilize Pond of the Congyun Sea back then.

But there was one problem with this theory.

Things were devoured because they had value.

The Fish Kings were divided and consumed because they had been nourished by the spiritual energy of the cultivators participating in the fish competition. To the other Fish Kings, they were supreme nourishment.

But for an Nameless Immortal who had already comprehended a Dao path and transcended existence, ordinary True Immortals seemingly held no value worth devouring.

“Unless the true targets are True Immortals like the one from the Immortal Ruins, those who have comprehended the Dao for ten thousand years and are on the verge of advancing. In that case, it might be possible to seize their understanding of the Dao and possess a second, or even more, Dao paths…”

True Immortals were already unimaginably distant. As for the Nameless True Immortal, there was even less information available.

Li Fan could only make reasonable deductions based on his previous understanding of how things worked.

Besides the possibility that Cat Treasure was an extension of the Nameless True Immortal, there was a second guess.

The reason Cat Treasure appeared inside the Fishing Pond was because its true target was the Nameless Immortal who entered the Dao through fishing.

The Fishing Pond plundered treasures from the starry sky. After sensing its power, Cat Treasure disguised itself as prey, willingly taking the bait and entering the Fishing Pond. Its goal was to find the Nameless Immortal behind the Fishing Pond.

As the saying goes, the fisher may also become the one being fished.

However, while idly waiting for prey to take the bait, it happened to discover another True Immortal. That counted as an unexpected delight.

Judging from Cat Treasure’s expression at the end of the previous life, it did not seem picky.

It was equally delighted by the appearance of the True Immortal from the Immortal Ruins.

What the second theory implied was far more terrifying than the first.

After all, Li Fan had long since known of the Nameless Immortal’s existence.

The Nameless Immortal realm is still above the True Immortal. Instantly killing a True Immortal would naturally be within reason.

But if the second speculation is true...

Then it would mean Cat Treasure is very likely only a vanguard.

A hunter deployed by a civilization beyond the High Wall, specifically used to hunt True Immortals, or even Nameless True Immortals.

Li Fan recalled the scene from the end of the previous life, when Cat Treasure leapt upward and headed toward the Immortal Ruins.

“I could not sense the specific situation inside. But the gradual disappearance of the Immortal Ruins’ suction force already proves certain facts.”

“There were no fluctuations from any battle at all...”

“The True Immortal within the Immortal Ruins likely did not manage much resistance before being captured.”

The reason Li Fan used the word captured rather than perished...

Was because he had clearly sensed the process of the Immortal Ruins’ suction slowly disappearing.

It was as if the source of that suction was being slowly dragged into a swamp, gradually vanishing.

Rather than the suction instantly disappearing the moment the True Immortal perished.

“If this speculation is true, then the collapse of worlds beyond the High Wall and the turmoil in the Star Sea are proof that the force behind Cat Treasure descended in order to capture True Immortals.”

“To be able to create something like Cat Treasure, that force beyond the High Wall must have developed to an unimaginable level.”

“Capturing True Immortals must be profitable.”

“If a True Immortal has any value, first would be immortal spiritual qi, second would be the Dao of the True Immortal itself...”

As Li Fan thought, he placed another newly carved little wooden cat statue in position.

His heart grew calm once again.

After the fear was dispelled, some thoughts surfaced in Li Fan’s mind.

“Thinking about it carefully, Cat Treasure’s discovery is not entirely bad news for me.”

“Unlike before, when if a True Immortal descended, I could only flee in disgrace by returning to [Truth].”

Li Fan’s gaze flickered.

“The only thing I need to watch out for is the exposure of [Truth].”

“From the scenes experienced during the final [Truth] in the previous life, the civilization behind Cat Treasure actually possesses power sufficient to affect [Truth].”

“It is not something like True Immortal power directly acting on me, thereby affecting the activation of [Truth].”

“It truly affected [Truth] itself.”

“Even if it was only slight fluctuations in the scenes of [Truth]...”

“If I want to borrow Cat Treasure’s power, then using clones becomes unavoidable.”

At this thought, Li Fan could not help but frown slightly.

In the previous life, his main body remained unmoving within the Derivation Law Jade space.

He split off many separate individuals, plotting in secret.

The Holy Emperor clone, the Holy Embryo, multiple divine sense incarnations...

Although no major overall problems occurred, subtle loss of control still appeared.

For example, the Holy Emperor clone displayed relatively strong moral principles. Although those had been settings Li Fan forcibly imposed during the clone’s creation, they eventually created an irreconcilable contradiction with the main body. Later, he directly and completely severed contact with the main body.

As a result, the main body’s perception was cut off. Some details of the battle against the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor remained unknown because of this.

Another example was the divine sense incarnations, whose mental stability was even worse than the main body or clones. Their emotional fluctuations were sometimes far too intense, completely contrary to the main body.

Although Li Fan could completely control every word and action of the divine sense incarnations, he could not fully eliminate this mental instability.

Aside from the factor that divine sense incarnations were merely strands of divine sense and inherently too weak...

Li Fan had also vaguely realized the fundamental reason why the divine sense incarnations from the previous life were so emotionally unstable.

It was precisely the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra.

First, the Holy Embryo transmitted the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra to the Qingxuan Army guarding the Chizha Abyss.

Then the Holy Emperor bestowed the Immortal Heart Mantra upon the Great Qi Imperial Guard.

The number of living beings cultivating this method together exceeded one hundred thousand.

At first, Li Fan did not think broadly spreading the Immortal Heart Mantra would have any effect on him.

But reality proved him wrong.

Ever since he stepped onto the immortal path, the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra had accompanied him all the way.

With cultivation that had already fused into instinct, it had gradually become faintly integrated with his very being.

After he spread it outward, the effect of the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra in maintaining mental stability was correspondingly affected.
