Chapter 1304: Return To [Truth] Truly Changes

Li Fan originally should have been unable to embark onto the path of cultivation.

Back when he traveled from Great Xuan to Liuli Island, merely the hurdle of removing the immortal-mortal miasma within his body had almost completely severed his path to cultivation.

Fortunately, with the dual support of the Xuanhuang Clear Heart Mantra and the Spiritual Pool of Body Purification, he was finally able to begin true cultivation.

And at the moment he shed the miasma throughout his body, the Xuanhuang Clear Heart Mantra officially transformed into the Xuanhuang Heart Refining Mantra.

The Xuanhuang Mantra thus became his alternative Dao Foundation, accompanying him throughout his entire cultivation life.

As Li Fan’s cultivation grew higher, the Xuanhuang Mantra Dao Foundation expanded alongside it. Like pillars, they became an important part supporting Li Fan’s cultivation.

And in the previous life, after Li Fan spread the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra on a large scale, the consequence was that these Dao Foundation pillars...

Became weakened because they were divided among too many.

His true body’s Dao Foundation was not solely the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra, but also [Truth], as well as the experience and knowledge accumulated through a hundred lifetimes of reincarnation. Therefore, the impact on him was negligible.

But the negative effects caused by this extraction were naturally amplified in clones and divine sense incarnations. The weaker the separated body, the more severe the effect.

It was not only Li Fan who was affected by the widespread transmission of the Immortal Heart Mantra.

This could be seen from the performance of the Qingxuan Army and the Great Qi Imperial Guard, both of whom cultivated the Immortal Heart Mantra in the previous life, during the great war.

They barely managed to remain calm in crisis, but compared to the orthodox Immortal Heart Mantra’s effect of enduring a thousand lifetimes of calamities while the immortal heart remains unchanged, they fell far too short.

The difference became even clearer after Li Fan returned to this life through [Truth] and alone monopolized the Immortal Heart Mantra.

“Techniques cannot be cultivated simultaneously...”

“It seems this is not merely the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm suppressing abrupt evolution among cultivators. Rather, it is some tradition originating from the Immortal Realm, deeply branded into the depths of the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“Hm, perhaps this is not solely related to techniques being impossible to cultivate simultaneously. It may also be closely tied to the office of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.”

Without question, the Immortal Heart Mantra that Mr. Bai passed down to the world to offset and reverse the power of the Xuanhuang inverse principle had its origin in the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

The Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, appointed by the Immortal Realm, wielded immortal artifacts and supervised Xuanhuang.

Within the Xuanhuang Realm, he possessed supreme authority.

However, becoming this Great Celestial Venerable of the Immortal Realm was far from easy.

Not only was there a colleague known as the Watcher secretly restraining him, but inheriting the office of Great Celestial Venerable also meant inheriting the restrictions and punishments imposed by the Immortal Realm upon the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

Only after [Truth] brought him back to this life and Li Fan reviewed matters did he remember Sun Tianci, who had been burned to ashes by heart fire.

“Even though the Immortal Path is now severed, the Immortal Realm’s countermeasures still remain effective.”

“The Immortal Heart Mantra’s inability to spread on a massive scale is likely one of the many restrictions the Immortal Realm imposed upon the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.”

Li Fan then recalled what happened after Sun Tianci successfully inherited the office in the previous life.

“The Great Sun Golden Bell, the Vast Void Azure Lamp, the Purple Qi Dreamweaving Shuttle, the Primordial Five Elements Wheel.”

These four were the only immortal artifacts remaining among the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable’s inheritance.

There was also a condensed mass of immortal spiritual qi, originating from those immortal artifacts that Mr. Bai had detonated.

“After completing the trial of the Fallen Immortal Realm, there is still a probationary period before truly becoming the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.”

“Before the Immortal Path was severed, this probationary period was actually the time spent waiting for review and appointment from the Immortal Realm.”

“After the Immortal Path was severed, appointment from the Immortal Realm became empty talk. However, according to the procedures established by the Immortal Realm, if there was no response within three years, the review automatically passed. Generally speaking, unless one encountered something like Sun Tianci did, such as the destruction of the Xuanhuang Realm, then simply waiting quietly for time to pass would grant the full authority of the Great Celestial Venerable.”

“And before that...”

The immortal artifacts within the Great Celestial Venerable’s inheritance could not be used at all. This was also one reason why Sun Tianci in the previous life was so easily persuaded by Li Fan’s divine sense incarnation.

Faced with the threatening Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor, the newly inherited Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable simply lacked the power to resist.

“According to Sun Tianci, none of these immortal artifacts bestowed by the upper realm contain artifact spirits. The lower realm Xuanhuang Celestial Venerable lacks immortal spiritual qi, and can only rely on the restrictions left behind by the Immortal Realm, consuming the immortal artifacts’ own energy to activate them.”

“In a sense, they are completely disposable consumables. By the time Mr. Bai gathered them one by one, these immortal artifacts had already been used countless times. Exactly how much power remains is hard to say.”

“But they are immortal artifacts after all. Leaving them buried deep within the Fallen Immortal Realm unused would be nothing less than letting treasures gather dust. In this life, I still must retrieve them. Not to mention that pure mass of immortal spiritual qi.”

Only after personally using immortal spiritual qi to establish the world extermination immortal formation did Li Fan truly understand the strength and transcendence of immortals.

Within his sea of consciousness, the Final Dissociation Disc emitted unusual seven colored radiance.

Within that glow, a true immortal formation was being continuously deduced without pause.

Immortal formation birth, immortal formation operation, immortal formation destruction.

During the world extermination process of the All Things Return to Void Formation in the previous life, the Final Dissociation Disc had collected abundant formation data. It was as if it had truly undergone a transformation between immortal and mortal. Now it could spontaneously deduce immortal formations according to Li Fan’s needs, just as it once deduced mortal formations.

Even though the deduction speed was extremely slow, and the burden on the Dissociation Disc was tremendous.

Under the orderly management of the Dissociation Disc’s simulated personality, it would not affect Li Fan’s normal cultivation.

At present, the main direction of the Final Dissociation Disc’s immortal formation deductions was immortal formation downgrading.

The goal was to slightly reduce formation power in exchange for allowing lower grade energy sources to activate it.

Immortals and mortals were fundamentally different. Li Fan had no means of creating immortal spiritual qi on a large scale. Even if he obtained some from the Great Celestial Venerable inheritance, it would still be insufficient to support his plans in this life.

But source power essence, infinitely close to immortal spiritual power, was for Li Fan practically inexhaustible.

If he could make immortal formations operate using source power essence, it would save him tremendous trouble.

Even if the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor returned to the Xuanhuang Realm, he could easily control the situation.

There would be no need to painstakingly create a Holy Emperor clone to confront them.

Within the world extermination immortal formation of the previous life, Li Fan had already seen clearly the true strength of the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor.

With those established power benchmarks, he could create immortal formations with confidence.

“As long as I do not drive them into a desperate corner, with an immortal formation as leverage, getting them to sit down and have a proper discussion should not be difficult.”

Li Fan recalled the transparent figure that appeared after the Immortal Ancestor’s body was annihilated.

At the time, the world-exterminating storm had been too chaotic. He had not been able to see clearly.

But he had vaguely sensed a familiar aura from that transparent figure.

“If I get the chance in this life, perhaps I can verify it.”

When a True Immortal descends, everything in the Xuanhuang Realm is like ants.

Cat Treasure made one leap, and even the phantom of a True Immortal was no meal on its plate.

The gap between the Xuanhuang Realm and beyond the High Wall was obvious.

But that did not mean everything within the Xuanhuang Realm had become worthless.

When Li Fan had been merely a mortal Grand Preceptor, the gap between him and Xuanhuang Longevity Immortal realm was no different from the current gap between the Xuanhuang Realm and beyond the High Wall.

Yet after one hundred and twenty six lifetimes of reincarnation, the once mortal Grand Preceptor had become someone who could use Xuanhuang Longevity Immortal as a chess piece.

So what if beyond the High Wall could hunt True Immortals?

Give Li Fan another one hundred and twenty six lifetimes, and perhaps he too could use True Immortals as chess pieces.

However, beyond the High Wall remained completely unknown territory to Li Fan for now.

And with his current strength, he still could not set foot there.

So everything still had to proceed step by step, according to plan.

...

As he pondered this, Li Fan completed another carving of Cat Treasure.

Sweeping over the area with his divine sense, he confirmed that over the past three years, he had completed carving 9,999 wooden statues.

They filled the wooden hut, further compressing the already cramped space.

A wisp of flame suddenly rose from Li Fan's fingertip, and he flicked it toward the pile of Cat Treasure wooden carvings.

Boom!

The flame surged violently, instantly transforming into a blazing inferno.

Yet it only burned the Cat Treasure wooden carvings and did not spread throughout the wooden hut.

The wooden carvings vanished within the flames, with no black smoke, not even ashes.

In the blink of an eye, all 9,999 wooden statues were swallowed by the fire, completely disappearing from the world.

As if they had never existed at all.

Li Fan quietly watched the great fire slowly die out.

The countless reflections of Cat Treasure in his eyes gradually disappeared along with the fading flames.

After standing motionless for a long time, Li Fan shifted his gaze.

He looked toward the [Truth] panel.

Light flickered and danced, reflecting those incomparably familiar characters.

...

[This simulation has ended]

[You may choose one of the following options to retain:

One item currently possessed by yourself during this simulation.

,

Your cultivation realm during this simulation.

,

The simulated memories of one person closely related to yourself during this simulation. These memories can be inherited by that person.

,

Abandon the above choices to accelerate the charging progress.]

,

After this passage of text, which he no longer knew how many times he had seen, there was now an entirely new prompt.

Li Fan's gaze narrowed slightly.

[New interfering variables detected. An additional retention choice may be selected for this simulation.]

Compared to the previous text, this line was somewhat different.

Instead, it was exactly like the final scene [Truth] displayed in the previous life.

Flickering unsteadily, with a much faster flashing frequency than the normal [Truth] notifications.

And being able to choose two items to retain was something unprecedented.

"New interfering variables..."

Having already waited for three years, Li Fan was in no hurry.

Just like before, he did not make a choice immediately.

Instead, he began thinking with extreme caution, carefully contemplating this line from [Truth].

Ever since discovering that it could devour wonders of heaven and earth and Cave Heaven worlds to increase [Truth]'s anchor charging progress, Li Fan had understood that [Truth] seemed to grow through something akin to feeding, by devouring objects useful to it.

Wonders of heaven and earth, Cave Heaven worlds, Eternal Remnant Wills, even Li Fan's own experiences...

All of these were among the objects that interested [Truth].

Of course, once [Truth] devoured something, it would never be interested in it again.

So Li Fan was certain that even if he encountered forces beyond the High Wall again in this life, if there were no other substantive gains, [Truth]'s extra reward would not appear again.

Li Fan did not particularly care about this additional selection opportunity.

If he truly wanted it, at worst he could simply reincarnate one more time to obtain it.

What Li Fan truly cared about was [Truth]'s attitude.

Without exception, only when [Truth] genuinely gained some benefit would it provide a reward in return.

Yet this time, merely sensing these so called new interfering variables had caused [Truth] to generously grant an extra reward...

In Li Fan's view, this sudden generosity was nothing less than temptation.

Guiding and enticing Li Fan to explore beyond the High Wall.

It unquestionably indicated that beyond the High Wall, there absolutely existed objects that [Truth] was extremely interested in, or perhaps found immensely useful.

As the fundamental trump card behind all his growth until now, if [Truth] could undergo some kind of change, Li Fan would undoubtedly be the greatest beneficiary.

So how could he not be tempted?

But just as with his previous decision, beyond the High Wall lay dangers at every step, requiring long term planning.

"With only myself, setting foot beyond the High Wall is truly difficult."

"But the Xuanhuang Realm has already proven its potential through many reincarnations."

"If I can enlist the help of the countless living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm, things will undoubtedly be much easier."

The first step in leaving the Darkest Star Sea was gaining the ability to cross the High Wall.

Just achieving that prerequisite alone would likely require many attempts.

After all, the High Wall had trapped the living beings of the Darkest Star Sea for ten thousand years. Mr. Bai's plan to cross it by detonating immortal spiritual qi was merely speculation.

As for the rumors in the star sea about the Heavenly Sword Sect, the demon race, and even the Ten Great Immortal Sects having once crossed worlds and departed, there was no substantial evidence proving they had succeeded.

If one were to say that during these ten thousand years, with the Immortal Path severed and the High Wall standing tall, some force within the Darkest Star Sea had truly crossed it...

Then perhaps there was only...

[Shang Immortal Ark].

Li Fan's eyes flashed with the shocked expression of the Holy Embryo from the previous life when hearing this matter from Ai Tianjue.

"They intend to pilot the Shang Immortal Ark and crash into the High Wall, attempting to break out of this star sea." Ai Tianjue's tone was strange.

After the initial shock, the Holy Embryo could not help but ask, "Then did the Shang Immortal Ark succeed?"

Ai Tianjue remained silent for a long time before finally speaking with a complicated expression, "If they had not succeeded, why would the Xuan Immortal Ark have treated the words [Shang Immortal Ark] as a taboo for a thousand years?"

"They... succeeded?" The Holy Embryo was endlessly shocked, his heart trembling.

"The Xuan Immortal Ark and Shang Immortal Ark were originally one entity. Whether they were completely destroyed in the collision or successfully escaped, there would naturally be some awareness."

"The Shang Immortal Ark still exists, and it is beyond the High Wall." Ai Tianjue sighed.

"It is precisely because of the Shang Immortal Ark's success that our Xuan Immortal Ark clearly understood that the power of [Immortal] may be the only way to escape this Darkest Star Sea. But even when the star sea was flourishing, searching for immortal artifacts was already exceedingly difficult. Let alone after the collapse of the star sea."

"Fortunately, after the great calamity, the entire ruined star sea became filled with remnants of the power of True Immortal seal script. That was when our Xuan Immortal Ark began researching this power."

...

All that had happened within the Xuan Immortal Ark flashed through Li Fan’s mind.

“The Shang Immortal Ark still exists. It lies beyond the High Wall.”

Li Fan repeatedly savored this sentence.

He did not believe that, in the life before, under such a desperate life-and-death situation, Ai Tianjue would still have deceived him.

So the Shang Immortal Ark’s escape should be true.

“There is still a mutual connection between the Xuan Immortal Ark and the Shang Immortal Ark.”

“If a method to cross the High Wall can be found, then by relying on this connection, one can travel to the Shang Immortal Ark.”

“With the Shang Immortal Ark as a bridgehead, establishing a foothold beyond the High Wall should become much easier.”

Because of the original split, the Xuan Immortal Ark possessed no records that could help in crossing the High Wall.

What held value within the Xuan Immortal Ark should be the secret archive known as the Immortal Compendium of Hundred Tales, as well as its research into True Immortal seal script.

“Xuanhuang. Immortal Ark.”

“With the power of these two worlds, forge a bridge across the High Wall.”

“Then drive the countless beings of Xuanhuang to scout the road ahead for me.”

A vague plan gradually took shape in Li Fan’s heart.

With this goal as the endpoint of the current phase, there was still much Li Fan needed to do.

First, increase his own strength.

Even if he would one day have an immortal formation protecting him, Soul Transformation cultivation under the Xuanhuang cycle of birth and change would still be far too inadequate. Li Fan urgently needed greater strength to face the Immortal Ancestor, the Heavenly Doctor, True Immortals, and even the forces beyond the High Wall.

The battle in the previous life between the Holy Emperor, the Immortal Ancestor, and the Heavenly Doctor had already shown him the path ahead.

Someone like the Holy Emperor, borrowing the fortune of the Holy Dynasty and the favor of heaven, was ultimately inferior to the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor, whose great power belonged wholly to themselves. Although both had reached the upper limit that this star sea could endure, it was obvious that the actual combat strength of the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor far surpassed that of the Holy Emperor.

“I am still constrained by the Immortal Ancestor’s New Method. Cultivating directly within the star sea may not necessarily suit me.”

“The most practical method…”

Li Fan’s eyes flickered.

“Immortal power spreads, Xuanhuang ascends. Let the Immortal Spirit of Heaven and Earth merge with my soul and body.”

In the previous life, the Holy Emperor’s imitation of heaven and earth, and the New Method he taught to all living beings, indeed seemed to point directly toward the Great Dao.

Using the Foundation Establishment through Oneelf, Primordial Unity Golden Core, Corporeal Nascent Soul, Consciousness Soul Transformation, Star Sea Dao Integration...

And finally, Dao Resonance Longevity.

Merely thinking about it stirred one’s blood.

During the first three years of this life, whenever Li Fan recalled it, he always felt its mysteries were boundless.

But the same problem remained.

Though the New Method was excellent, it was only theoretically viable. In fact, there was not yet a single cultivator in the world who had truly cultivated according to the New Method up to the Primordial Unity Golden Core realm.

Li Fan possessed the supreme treasure [Truth]. Even the very first step, using Oneself for Foundation Establishment, was as difficult as ascending the heavens.

Not to mention the higher realms that followed.

By comparison, the Immortal Ancestor’s path suited Li Fan far better.

Previously, New Method cultivators lamented, “Before us, the path to immortality lies ahead, yet it cannot be trodden. for the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor stands above” because in the Xuanhuang Realm of that time, the upper limit of New Method cultivators had already been fixed.

Even the Longevity Immortal realm, across the entire Darkest Star Sea, could hardly stir any waves.

But times were now different.

After thousands of years of uninterrupted labor by the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor, the current Xuanhuang Realm could be said to have gathered all the surviving essence of the remnant worlds within the star sea.

Not only had its scale expanded dozens of times, but in the previous life, under the stimulation of immortal spiritual qi, Li Fan had also seen the vast vitality hidden deep within every prefecture, poised but not yet unleashed.

As the future homeland in the Heavenly Doctor’s plan, the Xuanhuang Realm’s potential had never truly been fully awakened.

The current Xuanhuang Realm’s Dao Integration was indeed limited in strength. But after the Xuanhuang Realm’s future ascension, that might no longer be the case.

“The student surpasses the master. Ice comes from water, yet is colder than water,” Li Fan softly murmured.

“Who says the Grand Preceptor’s authority must necessarily be inferior to the Emperor’s?”

Once the Xuanhuang Realm was nourished by True Immortal qi, as it ascended, the laws of heaven and earth, and everything born within the world, would undergo transformation as well.

Li Fan had watched this process with absolute clarity in the previous life.

“And that was with the overwhelming majority of immortal qi being used on the Grand Formation, All Things Return to Void. If all that immortal qi were instead fed back into catalyzing the Xuanhuang Realm itself, then the Immortal Spirit of Heaven and Earth born from it would surely be unprecedentedly powerful…”

“By using that for Dao Integration, I might even be able to wield immortal qi.” Li Fan silently deduced.

Before Li Fan, every cultivator of the Xuanhuang Realm, aside from the Immortal Ancestor, had been feeding on the flesh and blood of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Their cultivation and foundations were all built upon the Xuanhuang Realm itself.

No matter how thoroughly they tempered the principles of heaven and earth, they could never exceed the upper limit of power the Xuanhuang Realm itself could provide.

What Li Fan intended to do was first force the upper limit of Xuanhuang to skyrocket, and only then carry out Dao Integration.

“Perhaps the uncontrolled ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm could even shake the very foundation of the Immortal Ancestor...” Li Fan’s gaze shifted slightly as he deduced something.

It was still that earlier prison metaphor.

The Longevity Immortal cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm had dismantled the prison’s support beams and replaced them with themselves, integrating into the prison.

What Li Fan intended to do was expand the prison itself.

After increasing its scale severalfold, only then would he carry out the act of replacement.

The Longevity Immortal indeed possessed near-complete control over the old prison. But if the prison’s size suddenly expanded several times over...

Then he would face the risk of losing control of the Xuanhuang Realm.

“This plan has another advantage.”

“Based on my understanding of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, as long as I do not reveal even the slightest intention of using the Immortal Spirit of Heaven and Earth for Dao Integration, it will not regard me as an enemy. It may even secretly assist me.”

“After all, I would be helping it complete its ascension.”

“And only with the assistance of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao can I conceal everything from the Immortal Ancestor and Heavenly Doctor outside the starry sky without anyone noticing.”

“By the time they realize something is wrong and try to return, the immortal formation laid in advance will be enough to stop them.”

Li Fan pondered his plan for a while, then nodded slightly.

Aside from raising his own cultivation realm, there were also external means to enhance his combat strength.

For example, True Immortal seal script characters.

In his previous life aboard the Xuan Immortal Ark, Li Fan had comprehended five entirely new True Immortal seal script characters.

Although they were not complete True Immortal seal script characters, but imitations reconstructed by the Immortal Ark cultivators.

They were still more than sufficient to deal with the Star Sea Supreme Beings.

In truth, Li Fan’s greatest harvest regarding True Immortal seal script characters in his previous life had not come from the Xuan Immortal Ark.

It had come from the Derivation Law Jade.

The True Immortal seal script character within the Derivation Law Jade’s memories was different from the pure destructive force permeating the star sea.

A thought stirred in Li Fan’s mind, and he flashed beyond Jieli Mountain, above the sea of clouds.

Although he only possessed Foundation Establishment cultivation, with his physical strength and spiritual energy condensed.

He used his hand as a brush and completed it in a single stroke.

An incomparably profound character collapsed the very moment it appeared.

This was because Foundation Establishment cultivation was insufficient to support the display of its true might.

But at the very instant this True Immortal seal script character appeared in the world.

A sudden clap of thunder rang out across the Great Xuan small world.

There were no dark storm clouds, yet rain began to fall, covering the entire small world.

It was originally the depths of winter, but under the nourishment of the rain, it gradually became as warm as spring.

Li Fan even sensed faint traces of spiritual energy emerging within heaven and earth, from some unknown source.

This was different from the artificial creation produced through Dao One Insects.

Although this spiritual energy was thin, it was naturally evolved by the small world itself.

Li Fan stood high above the ninth heavens, watching the changes of vitality within the Great Xuan small world under the rain.

What surprised him even more was that the world consciousness of the Great Xuan small world seemed to be in the process of gestation.

Because there had been no spiritual energy, Great Xuan previously had no Heavenly Dao consciousness at all. Or rather, Great Xuan’s Heavenly Dao consciousness had been so weak that even Li Fan could not detect it.

Yet under this casually written True Immortal seal script character from Li Fan, the Great Xuan small world had undergone changes in just a few days that might otherwise have required tens of thousands of years to accumulate.

“Where exactly does this power of evolution come from?”

Li Fan’s gaze swept across the Great Xuan world, yet he could not find its source.

“There is no forceful acceleration, no overdrawing of the small world’s potential.”

“It seems to arise from nothing…”

“This perhaps can be called [Creation].”

Li Fan froze slightly.

That True Immortal seal script character surfaced once more in his mind.

“Creation…”

He repeated those two words continuously in his heart.

That True Immortal seal script character suddenly seemed to come alive, moving and shifting of its own accord.

Becoming slightly different from what it had been in his memory.

Yet it was still far from its true form.

“Creation!”

A sharp light flashed in Li Fan’s eyes.

An irresistible urge surged within him, the desire to continue probing the mysteries of Creation.

But very quickly, Li Fan remembered something, and clarity returned to his eyes.

He directly suppressed that greed.

“It can be used.”

“But attempting to comprehend it…”

“May bring unknown danger.”

A trace of understanding flashed through Li Fan’s mind.

This True Immortal seal script character, possibly called Creation, was clearly even more precious than characters such as Chaos and Hunger. In the Derivation Law Jade’s memories, even True Immortals had fought fiercely to seize it.

Even though the Immortal Path was severed, Li Fan could not guarantee whether somewhere in the star sea. A True Immortal might still be comprehending this Dao.

Whoever had ultimately seized the Dao of Creation and made it their own during the great war among the True Immortals, their strength could well be imagined.

A mere High Wall might not necessarily be able to stop them.

After witnessing the great horrors beyond the High Wall in the star sea, Li Fan had become increasingly cautious.

Even against a hypothetical enemy who most likely did not even exist, Li Fan held no trace of wishful thinking.

“If, during the Xuanhuang Realm’s transformation, it were also supplemented with the power of Creation…”

Li Fan looked down at the Great Xuan small world currently undergoing heaven shaking transformation, and before his eyes seemed to appear the Xuanhuang of the near future.

If True Immortal seal script characters represented the limit of external power Li Fan could borrow.

Then the limit of Li Fan’s own divine abilities still lay with [Truth].

“When the true becomes false, the false also becomes true.”

Aside from using it to create the all purpose existence known as Simulated Personality, an almost omnipotent artifact spirit.

What moved Li Fan even more was the transformation between truth and falsehood.

At this moment, he had not yet inherited his cultivation.

Yet within Li Fan’s sea of consciousness appeared the Soul Transformation cultivation he had once possessed, cultivated using the life transformation changes of heaven and earth during the destruction of the Xuanhuang Realm as material.

He silently recalled and comprehended it.

As if that cultivation had never disappeared with the activation of [Truth].

Standing motionless in midair, an unknown amount of time passed.

Suddenly, Li Fan opened his eyes.

An immensely powerful aura abruptly descended upon him.

The Great Xuan small world seemed to sense something, and heaven and earth trembled because of it.

But the abnormal phenomenon lasted for only an instant.

Very quickly, the disturbance vanished.

The clouds were light, the wind was gentle, and everything seemed as if nothing had ever happened.

Li Fan, however, revealed a faint smile.

Chapter 1305: The White Ring Descends Into The Mortal World

“When the real is treated as false, the false also becomes real.”

“The transformations between truth and falsehood contain endless mysteries.”

Li Fan recited these words in his heart once again, overflowing with joy.

Although it lasted for only an instant, he had indeed forcibly "manifested" his Soul Transformation cultivation from his previous life out of nothing.

However, this was his first attempt at using this great divine ability.

After that instant of success, the transformed cultivation vanished in a flash like a dream bubble or illusion.

Li Fan was not discouraged in the slightest. Instead, he was still filled with delight.

Creating something from absolute nothingness, even the legendary True Immortals might not necessarily be capable of such a feat.

Yet through the insights gained from repeatedly simulating with [Truth], he had preliminarily achieved it.

As the saying goes, the beginning is always the hardest. With this first success, using this divine ability would surely become more and more familiar in the future.

“It is not just my own cultivation.”

“The things I once experienced, the items I once possessed, and even...”

“Different people, the Xuanhuang Realm, the Darkest Star Sea, and even everything beyond the High Wall. One day, all of them may be recreated by a single thought of mine.”

Li Fan stood above the sea of clouds, savoring the sensation of using the transformation between truth and falsehood, his emotions surging.

Only after a long while did he emerge from his state of enlightenment.

He looked toward the inheritance options on the [Truth] panel and first chose to inherit cultivation.

The same phenomenon occurred once more. The skies of Great Xuan rumbled endlessly.

This was the disturbance caused by Li Fan’s Soul Transformation cultivation being invisibly infused into this small world.

However, compared to the previous life when he inherited cultivation, the Great Xuan small world of this life had already undergone world evolution because of the Creation True Immortal seal script character, so it did not show signs of being unable to bear the burden.

Only dark clouds gathered, with countless strange phenomena appearing.

“Hah...”

As the familiar power of cultivation returned to his body, Li Fan let out a long breath.

Next, his gaze fixed upon the second inheritance option.

The cultivation inheritance choice had already dimmed, leaving only options 1, 3, and 4.

Without hesitation, Li Fan chose to inherit items.

All the items he had possessed in his previous life, including his clones and divine sense incarnations, instantly appeared in Li Fan’s mind.

Waiting for him to choose.

His gaze swept over them briefly. After pondering for a moment, it finally settled upon an ordinary looking white ring.

Before this white ring had been fished up, the Holy Emperor had not yet completely severed himself from Li Fan’s original body, so it was likewise considered an item Li Fan had once possessed.

After confirming his selection, light flickered in his hand, eventually condensing into a plain white ring.

It felt slightly cold to the touch. Sweeping over it with divine sense revealed no spiritual energy fluctuations whatsoever.

Perhaps because it had been manifested through [Truth], there was no need for refinement or ownership recognition. The moment Li Fan held the white ring, he naturally felt that he could use it freely.

And others could not seize it from him.

Li Fan looked at the name displayed for the white ring on the [Truth] panel.

[Descends into Mortal World].

He stroked the white ring while murmuring those three words, while internally contemplating its proper method of use.

“Go.”

Li Fan threw the white ring toward Jieli Mountain below.

With a thought, the white ring expanded with the wind, instantly enveloping the entire mountain peak.

Then it descended.

When the white ring touched the ground, the mountain it had encircled began to disintegrate inch by inch before Li Fan’s eyes, vanishing completely.

It transformed into spiritual energy, dispersing into the heavens and earth of Great Xuan.

The several thousand zhang tall Jieli Mountain simply disappeared into thin air.

The countless living creatures dwelling upon the mountain suddenly lost their footing and plummeted from the sky uncontrollably. If not for the spiritual energy released by the white ring’s decomposition of Jieli Mountain holding them aloft, the place would have become hell in an instant.

Now perhaps this area could be called the Jieli Circle instead.

The land looked as though an enormous blade had shaved away an entire section, smooth as a mirror.

Having lost their home, the creatures of Jieli Mountain fled wildly in instinctive terror.

Before long, the once vibrant Jieli Mountain had become a forbidden zone of life.

Li Fan took a deep breath and absorbed all the spiritual energy produced by the decomposition.

This amount of spiritual energy was less than a drop in the ocean for his current self. His real purpose was to analyze whether the spiritual energy produced by Descends into Mortal World differed from ordinary heaven and earth spiritual energy.

After careful examination, Li Fan reached a conclusion.

There was no difference whatsoever.

In fact, this spiritual energy gave Li Fan an extremely familiar feeling, as though it had naturally originated from the Great Xuan small world itself.

“Clearly, this is matter being decomposed and converted into energy. Yet on the [Truth] panel, its name is Descends into Mortal World.”

“Descends into Mortal World...”

“Perhaps this is actually a punitive treasure specifically meant to target immortal artifacts.”

Li Fan suddenly gained insight.

“In the previous life, the Holy Emperor clone never had the chance to test it further. In this life, perhaps I can use those quasi-immortal artifacts in the Xuanhuang Realm to verify my theory.”

Putting away the white ring, Li Fan looked downward.

In broad daylight, Jieli Mountain had vanished into thin air.

To ordinary mortals, this was undoubtedly a terrifying and unimaginable event.

Believing it to be divine punishment from heaven, the mortals beneath Jieli Mountain had already spontaneously begun organizing sacrificial rites in panic.

Not daring to approach the enormous circular area on the ground, they could only pray from outside its boundary.

As expected, Li Fan saw among them Sun Erlang and Wang Xuanba, his former disciples.

With a flick of his finger, a figure descended from the sky into the mortal world.

Its appearance bore seven tenths resemblance to Li Fan, but with long beard and white hair. In terms of attire, it somewhat resembled the Immortal Ancestor.

“Look, an immortal.”

The common people all dropped to their knees.

The figure waved a hand, and the kneeling mortals all stood back up.

The figure sat suspended in the air, murmuring words as it began preaching the Dao to the surrounding mortals.

The faint spiritual energy born from the world evolution of the Great Xuan small world was all drawn toward this preaching figure.

A visible vortex formed above the Jieli Circle.

Li Fan casually used this spiritual energy to set up a formation. Before long, a miniature formation designed to purge the miasma from mortal bodies had taken shape.

Under the combined effects of the preaching figure and the formation, In less than the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, some of the mortals listening below had already completed the removal of their miasma.

Sun Erlang and Wang Xuanba were naturally among them.

Within the Jieli Circle, the earth rumbled, and the locations where these living beings who had completed the first step of cultivation stood began to flow like water.

After gathering them together in one place, the ground slowly rose and swelled upward.

As a result, these people moved a little closer to the Immortal Master preaching the Dao above.

The figure preached the Dao for a full seven days.

During those seven days, the positions of those present who successfully drew qi into their bodies and reached the Qi Condensation stage continued to rise upward.

They gradually formed clearly separated tiers of steps.

After seven days, the figure transformed into a streak of light and flew away. At the same time, a single thought flashed through the minds of all the cultivators present.

The Immortal Master would continue preaching the Dao one month later.

Everyone was greatly shaken.

Even the dullest among them realized that this was a heaven-sent opportunity.

Thus, news of the Immortal Master preaching the Dao spread like wildfire. At a terrifying speed, it spread throughout Great Xuan.

And within the Jieli Circle, everyone also discovered the various wondrous mysteries of this [Dao Lecture Platform].

Dao Lecture Platform was the respectful name the mortals listening to the Immortal Master’s teachings gave to the Jieli Circle. Inside it, people were divided into different tiers according to their individual cultivation levels. The higher one’s cultivation, the higher the place where one sat.

Each person’s position was fixed and could neither be exchanged nor seized.

While seated within the Dao Lecture Platform, even after the Immortal Master’s figure had disappeared, one could still close their eyes and give rise to all kinds of mysterious insights.

At the highest level of the Dao Lecture Platform, one could vaguely see a glowing platform floating above.

Upon that platform, the names of cultivation techniques seemed to be engraved one after another.

While seated on the Dao Lecture Platform, with a single thought, one could understand the specific details of these cultivation techniques.

Each cultivator could choose one technique to cultivate on their own.

Once someone completed their selection, the name of that cultivation technique would disappear from the glowing platform. It would transform into a streak of light and enter the selected cultivator’s sea of consciousness.

Sun Erlang and Wang Xuanba stared at the thousands upon thousands of cultivation technique names until they were almost dazzled.

“Erlang, which one do you think I should choose?” Wang Xuanba asked while scratching his head.

“There is no need to rush. There are so many cultivation techniques, take your time choosing. Even if people from other places hear the news and rush here, it will take at least several days. But once you make a choice, if you want to change it, you will have to wait until the next major realm, so you must be cautious,” Sun Erlang analyzed calmly without even blinking.

...

Above the Dao Lecture Platform.

The preaching figure had actually never left. It had merely concealed itself so the people below could not discover it.

All of the cultivation techniques here had been obtained from the little girl Derivation Law Jade from the previous life.

The Derivation Law Jade had used simulated personalities to slack off.

And the cultivation techniques deduced by those simulated personalities had naturally been recorded by Li Fan.

At the anchor point of Year 3, these cultivation techniques had not yet been deduced by the Derivation Law Jade, so there was no need to worry about alerting the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance Protectorate Hall.

The stockpile accumulated by the Derivation Law Jade in the previous life was enough for Li Fan to use for a very long time.

“In this life, I shall become the Teacher of Heaven and Earth.”

“I shall spread the Dao across Xuanhuang, beginning from Great Xuan.”

The Immortal Ancestor shadow sitting cross-legged in the air looked at the countless living beings rushing over from all across Great Xuan and thought this to himself.

He controlled the spiritual qi circulation of the Dao Lecture Platform, expanding the range of the white circle on the ground once more.

...

The shadow silently preached the Dao, igniting the first sparks of becoming the Teacher of Heaven and Earth.

Meanwhile, Li Fan’s true body arrived deep beneath Great Xuan.

Since his plan in this life was to use the Spirit of Heaven and Earth of the Super Xuanhuang Realm to achieve Dao Integration, he naturally had to stimulate the Xuanhuang Realm’s potential to its absolute limit.

Aside from factors such as immortal spiritual qi, the hidden powers of the remnant worlds, and the Creation Immortal Character.

Driving the affiliated small worlds to return to Xuanhuang and achieving the unification of all worlds could also serve as a major source of support.

After all, no matter how small the mosquito, it is still meat.

Especially after Li Fan used the True Immortal seal script character [Creation] to first bring about the sublimation and transformation of each small world, the return of all worlds would undoubtedly be a considerable source of nourishment for the Xuanhuang Realm.

After all, the stronger the Xuanhuang Realm became in the future, the stronger the Spirit of Heaven and Earth it would nurture.

And that would be even more advantageous for Li Fan.

“The subsidiary worlds were pushed away by the World-Rift Whales, and after several thousand years of evolution, they have already drifted far from the Xuanhuang main world. They are only connected to the Xuanhuang Realm through long and narrow void passages.”

“If I want to push them into merging with the Xuanhuang Realm once more, the first thing I must do is reactivate those severed connections.”

Li Fan closed his eyes, and within his sea of consciousness appeared the image of the Great Xuan small world and the Xuanhuang light sphere.

Great Xuan seemed like a drifting speck of light floating outside, flickering uncertainly, neither fully near nor truly distant.

With a movement of thought, the grand formation rose. Vast spiritual energy surged from Li Fan’s body, rushing endlessly beneath the earth and spreading across every corner of Great Xuan.

And from Li Fan’s perspective, lines of formation runes began to materialize.

Using the formation as a blade, he continuously transformed the Great Xuan small world.

Without anyone being able to detect it, the small world slowly moved through the void toward the Xuanhuang Realm.

Undoing all the efforts of countless World-Rift Whales over thousands of years.

Just before colliding with the Xuanhuang Realm, the Great Xuan small world finally came to a halt.

Formation tendrils slowly emerged from the world itself, silently attaching themselves to the Xuanhuang main world.

Just like a fetus receiving nourishment from its mother through the placenta, the transformation process of the Great Xuan small world instantly accelerated many times over.

When selecting the point of attachment, Li Fan had deliberately altered the connection point between the Great Xuan small world and the Xuanhuang main world.

He did not choose the Congyun Sea, but instead changed it to Shilin Prefecture.

This was to avoid triggering a stress response from the Xuanhuang Realm.

Compared to the vast Xuanhuang main world, the size of the Great Xuan small world was practically negligible.

Thus, Great Xuan’s attachment had not yet attracted the attention of the Xuanhuang Realm.

And because of this, Li Fan’s plan proceeded smoothly.

Threadlike formation rune lines, so faint as to be almost undetectable, slowly entered the Xuanhuang Realm through Great Xuan’s tendrils.

While tightening the connection between the Great Xuan small world and Xuanhuang, they also silently transferred a portion of a massive grand formation into the Xuanhuang Realm.

It was merely an incomplete formation structure. Before it was formally activated, even Li Fan himself would find it difficult to detect.

“The day All Worlds return will be the day this formation is completed.”

What Li Fan was laying down this time was naturally not the All Things Return to Void Grand Formation.

Rather, it was a Grand Formation meant to capture the future Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth that would be born.

This was what it meant to prepare against future dangers.

After the birth of the Super Xuanhuang Realm, the very first Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth it nurtured would be Li Fan’s future Dao Integration target.

Through a series of guided manipulations, he would continuously increase the difficulty of the heavenly duty it would be required to carry out.

The more strength Xuanhuang borrowed, the stronger the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth would become.

To ensure absolute certainty, and to achieve successful Dao Integration as quickly as possible, this preemptively prepared immortal formation was of utmost importance.

“Among the Spirits of Heaven and Earth, the strongest has always been the phantom of the successive Great Celestial Venerables. The Spirits of Heaven and Earth are all gathered upon its body. That single entity alone is equivalent to the combined Spirits of Heaven and Earth of more than half the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“In the 115th life, Heavenly Dao Bai was already able to slightly resist Immortal Ancestor. In this life, after all the comprehensive enhancements I have applied, it should be able to reach the limit of the star sea.”

“If my research into immortal spiritual qi makes further breakthroughs, it may even be possible to achieve the Half-Immortal Realm…”

“The only thing I need to consider is that the phantom of the Great Celestial Venerable may still carry traces of the Immortal Realm from the past. While devouring it, I must remain cautious and on guard.”

Recalling the strange influence Heavenly Dao Bai had once exerted on his mind, Li Fan silently contemplated.

As the forward base for transmitting the Dao into Xuanhuang, and as the template for the formations of the other small worlds in the future, Li Fan was especially meticulous in constructing Great Xuan’s infiltration formation.

In the previous life, the Heavenly Doctor and Immortal Ancestor had once joined forces to use the technique [Sealing Soul Substituting World].

This proved that the two had already reached an incomparably meticulous degree of control over the Xuanhuang Realm.

If the infiltration formation tendrils of the small world were discovered by them, and the two returned from the starry sky, Li Fan’s plan would be thrown into disorder.

Li Fan raised his head, his eyes piercing through the earth and reaching directly into Great Xuan’s sky.

As if pierced by a sharp arrow, a seven colored vortex appeared in the heavenly dome. Among all living beings in Great Xuan, only Li Fan could perceive it.

And within that seven colored vortex, the sleeping world consciousness resembled an infant.

Fearing that any rough movement might disturb it, Li Fan extremely carefully separated a strand of divine sense, slipping inside and drawing near.

Then he devoted himself to sensing it.

In an instant, the winds and clouds of the Great Xuan world, the rising and falling tides, the blooming and withering flowers, all phenomena of the world appeared one by one before Li Fan’s eyes.

It was as if these changes were happening upon his own body.

As the connection deepened, beyond natural phenomena, the joy, anger, sorrow, fear, birth, aging, sickness, and death of Great Xuan’s living beings also began appearing within Li Fan’s mind.

Feeling everything as the Heavenly Dao.

For the overwhelming majority of cultivators, this would be an exceedingly rare opportunity. If they immersed themselves within it, quietly comprehending, understanding a heaven shaking divine ability would be no difficult matter.

Yet Li Fan deliberately withdrew from this state of enlightenment.

Maintaining a condition of half wakefulness and half Dao comprehension.

“Simulated Creation, Diverse Forms of Sentient Beings!”

With a movement of his mind, a half transparent figure of Li Fan immediately appeared within the starry vortex of Great Xuan’s heavenly dome.

He poured all the comprehension gained from Great Xuan’s Heavenly Dao into it.

The half transparent figure gradually transformed, as if returning to childhood, changing from the appearance of a middle aged man into a wailing infant newly born.

Yet the infant’s actions remained as seasoned as an adult’s.

Approaching the deeply sleeping Great Xuan Heavenly Dao consciousness, it rushed forward and fiercely covered it.

Replacing it entirely.

The Great Xuan small world instantly fell into violent upheaval.

The earth shook and mountains trembled. Scar like cracks spread across the sky from the central starry vortex.

Within Li Fan’s sea of consciousness, the Final Dissociation Disc temporarily halted its deductions regarding immortal formation downgrading and instead devoted its full power to calculating the compatibility of the Great Xuan simulated persona.

After the constant refinement of the Simulated Creation, Diverse Forms of Sentient Beings formation, the flickering transparent infant finally stabilized.

“Substitute the world!”

Deep underground, Li Fan gathered a golden needle in his hand.

Then he shot it toward the simulated Great Xuan Heavenly Dao in the sky.

Directly into the point between its brows.

The half transparent infant instinctively let out a faint cry. The first cry of heaven, the silent sound of the Great Dao. No one in the world could hear it, yet in an instant it spread throughout the entire Great Xuan small world.

From weak to strong, growing ever more piercing. Then finally becoming inaudible.

And within the crying of this simulated Great Xuan persona, the strange phenomena of the world slowly faded, returning to their original calm.

The wounds in the sky and the vortex healed, yet Li Fan could sense that the simulated persona had replaced the newly born Great Xuan Heavenly Dao.

Or rather, simulated heavenly nature would be a more accurate term.

The newly born Great Xuan Heavenly Dao consciousness had not been destroyed by Li Fan. It had merely been forcibly suppressed and sealed into slumber.

All of the Heavenly Dao consciousness’s gradual growth would be absorbed and synchronized into the simulated heavenly nature, ensuring the proper operation of Great Xuan’s Heavenly Dao.

Like nourishment used to cultivate and strengthen the simulated heavenly nature, once it became fully capable of handling the Great Xuan small world’s Heavenly Dao operations, it would completely devour the original Heavenly Dao consciousness that had remained asleep since birth.

Completing a true transformation.

Li Fan carefully sensed the operation of Great Xuan’s simulated heavenly nature.

The simulated heavenly nature was his creation, and all information it received could naturally also be sensed by him.

The current situation was as if a Heavenly Dao clone was constantly helping him comprehend the Dao.

Although it was only a small world’s Heavenly Dao, its advantage lay in being endless, accumulating little by little.

And moreover…

“This is my first attempt, so the method was somewhat crude. “But with this experience, performing Sealing Soul Substituting World on the other small worlds should go much more smoothly.”

Compared to the traditional world substitution method recorded in the Heavenly Doctor’s Mending Heaven Record, Li Fan’s improved version used simulated heavenly nature.

Originating from his insights into False Becomes True and Great Xuan’s ancient world protecting immortal formation Nine Star Red Bead, this simulation technique was likely something only Li Fan in the entire world could perform.

The simulated heavenly nature did not truly possess independent thought. It merely operated mechanically and obeyed its creator absolutely. This made it far easier to control.

More importantly, there were thousands of small worlds within the Xuanhuang Realm. With the original Sealing Soul Substituting World Technique, merely finding cultivator souls capable of matching the Heavenly Dao consciousnesses of all those worlds would already require immense effort. Now, Li Fan alone could solve the issue.

And no matter how many small worlds he controlled, there was no risk of losing control.

An exquisite and sinister plan was born in Li Fan’s heart in an instant.

As he gradually tasted the benefits of comprehending False Becomes True, Li Fan increasingly felt that this transformation between falsehood and reality, more than any specific cultivation method, was the true source of his fundamental power.

“It is just unfortunate that this Dao is far too profound. Even after a hundred reincarnations, I have only understood a small portion. And this False Becomes True Dao is limited to me, who possesses [Truth]. Others cannot even use it for reference.”

To dig deeper into its true mysteries, the most important thing was actually…

Fortuitous opportunity.

Or, to put it more plainly, it depended on the mood of [Truth].

In the previous life, after [Truth] came into contact with the so called new interference variable, Li Fan discovered that his comprehension of the transformation between False Becomes True had clearly become much easier.

Although his own talent and comprehension had not changed, it was as if the distance had become shorter, making it easier to touch upon it. Its profound mystery truly reached such a level.

“Narrating the Dao, projection...” Li Fan recalled the various remarks from the Holy Emperor’s preaching of Dao in the previous life, as well as various statements made by little girl Derivation Law Jade. His eyes narrowed as countless speculations surged through his mind.

...

In the blink of an eye, it was already Anchor Year 8. The Dao Lecture Platform had expanded from its initial scale to a radius of five hundred li. Even so, people from across the world seeking the Dao and a master still arrived in an endless stream.

On this day, the Holy Master’s phantom held a horsetail whisk and gave it a gentle wave.

The Dao Lecture Platform, spanning a hundred li in radius, actually seemed to become the center of the world under the gaze of the masses. The surrounding mountains and plains, rivers and lakes, seas and streams, all revolved and flowed around the Dao Lecture Platform.

The countless living beings within the platform remained seated without moving, yet traveled a thousand li in a single day.

In less than half a day, the Dao Lecture Platform carried millions of disciples and became the center of the Great Xuan world.

At this moment, the highest step of the Dao Lecture Platform already represented the Great Perfection of the Golden Core realm.

Three people sat upon that platform, overlooking the Great Xuan masses below, who were growing ever farther away.

All three were disciples under the Holy Master and addressed one another as fellow disciples.

It is said that the cultivators within are all immersed in dreams, while reality is basically left undefended...”

After discussing it together, the three reached a consensus.

They then bid farewell to the Holy Master, left Great Xuan, and headed toward the location of Carefree Paradise.

Li Fan’s phantom upon the Dao Lecture Platform cast a faint glance at them.

Yet the words of Dao transmission from his mouth never ceased.

This Dao Lecture Platform had now become the center of Great Xuan.

Over the past few years, under the manipulation of the simulated heavenly nature, the power of formations had flowed silently without pause. Like a gigantic refining vessel, it reflected and engraved every living being listening to the Dao within it into a silver white orb.

Its principle was based on the Xuanhuang Nine Star Red Pearl Li Fan had previously seen. Although it still could not fully record all information about living beings, it could already synchronously project all of their experiences into the silver white orb, recording and preserving them.

Like a gigantic eye, it stared tightly at the living beings within the Dao Lecture Platform. No matter how far they ran, they could not escape its surveillance.

This monitoring acted only upon the living beings themselves. Therefore, it could not be detected by external forces. It was not limited to their experiences in reality. Even their dreams and hallucinations could not escape its reflection.

“The mortal masses, once seen, cannot escape.”

“Teacher of heaven and earth, teacher of all living beings.”

The voice of the transmitting figure echoed throughout the Great Xuan small world, lingering endlessly.

...

Meanwhile.

Li Fan’s true body arrived alone at the small world where the You Clan had gathered.

He did not directly make a move to capture them, but instead hid in the shadows and observed their lives.

Highly regular, and very simple.

Eating, praying, martial training, reproduction, sleeping.

“The bloodline of the first Great Celestial Venerable. Even though the Xuantian Sect has long since perished, the shackles placed upon them have never changed.” Li Fan’s eyes revealed emotion.

Under the constant pursuit of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, the number of surviving You Clan members continued to decrease daily. Without outside intervention, they would likely ultimately be unable to escape extinction.

Li Fan’s appearance here this time was not to raise them in a flesh and blood factory as he had in the previous life. He had another plan.

Flesh and blood transformation could indeed provide a large number of You Clan members, allowing the acquisition of vast amounts of source power essence.

But Li Fan was even more curious about the reason for the birth of source power essence.

All were living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm, so why could the prayers of the You Clansmen generate source power essence, a force approaching immortal power, while the prayers of mortals, or even cultivators, could at most condense into forces such as fortune or faith?

What exactly was this so called Great Celestial Venerable bloodline?

In the previous life, Wang Xuanba had failed to refine this supposed special bloodline even from over ten thousand You Clan members. Li Fan then knew he had chosen the wrong method.

Since refinement would not work...

Then he would try ancestral reversion.

Li Fan split off a strand of divine sense and used the Immortal Ark Dao Pill technique to possess the body of the physically strongest man among the current group of You Clansmen.

After briefly adapting to the body and conducting an inspection, he found no abnormalities within it.

But this was within Li Fan’s expectations.

He simply used this You Clan body during daily prayers to perceive the generation and destination of source power essence.

An ordinary You Clansmen would certainly be unable to do this. Even if they could briefly call upon the power of darkness, it was only due to bloodline instinct and the inheritance of ten thousand years.

But Li Fan was different.

After living in the body of a You Clansmen for more than half a year, through over a hundred prayers and patient, meticulous observation, Li Fan finally detected the method by which the power of darkness was generated.

At a certain instant during prayer, part of the body and soul activated something within the body that resembled a formation.

Through its transformation, a metamorphosis was completed.

That trace vanished in an instant. After completing the transformation, it completely concealed itself within the flesh and blood of the You Clansmen. If Li Fan had not possessed a special sensitivity to this subtle energy, he likely would have missed it as well.

The trace that generated the golden source power essence was actually extremely similar to the sensation Li Fan experienced when using divine abilities related to False Becomes True.

"It is not the transformation between falsehood and truth. But it is a remnant of a power with extraordinarily similar fluctuations."

Having discovered this secret, Li Fan was deeply shaken.

Suppressing the shock in his heart, Li Fan conducted repeated verifications.

His intuition had not been wrong.

Within the bodies of the You Clansmen, the force that produced source power essence was indeed a trace of great power similar to the transformation between falsehood and truth of Return to True.

After the initial shock, Li Fan gradually calmed down.

His thoughts moved rapidly as he analyzed point by point.

"When the true becomes false, the false also becomes true. The reason [Truth] can return to [Truth], and no matter how events unfold, always bring me back to the anchored one year point, is because it involves..."

"The Dao of truth and falsehood."

"In the span of a single thought, countless worlds are born and destroyed. This Dao of truth and falsehood is clearly far beyond any Dao path I have encountered thus far."

"And that trace within the bodies of the You Clansmen can transform mortals into immortals..."

"Though it may not necessarily be qualified to contend directly against [Truth], whatever created the uniqueness of the You Clan members... or rather, the first generation Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, is absolutely an extraordinary existence."

Countless thoughts flashed through Li Fan's mind in an instant.

"[Truth] is within my body, fused as one with me."

"As for that treasure, it has likely long disappeared along with the vanishing of the Immortal Realm." Having vaguely glimpsed traces of a supreme treasure yet only being able to imagine it, Li Fan could not help but feel endless regret.

"Looking at it this way, the birth of the first Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable likely involved some kind of mission, or perhaps a conspiracy."

Now that he understood the origin of source power essence, Li Fan next attempted to reproduce it.

Naturally, a trace of a supreme treasure that transcended all current mortal methods was absolutely not something that could be reproduced through ordinary means.

Otherwise, the Xuantian King back then, and the current Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, would not have remained dependent on these You Clansmen for obtaining the power of darkness.

The Xuantian King was astonishingly talented, and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had inherited ten thousand years of the Xuanhuang Realm's legacy.

Yet both had been helpless before this...

But Li Fan was different.

He possessed a method that surpassed even that mysterious trace.

False Becomes True.

The top-down overriding authority made reproducing it possible.

Even though in his initial attempts, Li Fan failed every single time without exception.

But Li Fan could still distinguish between a truly impossible path and merely lacking sufficient power.

Not only was he not discouraged, he instead became more excited with every failure.

If he could realize his conjecture, then the applications of the False Becomes True divine ability could be expanded infinitely.

Reproducing the trace of that unknown supreme treasure was vastly more difficult than fabricating the Heavenly Dao consciousness of a small world.

The only comforting thing, and the reason Li Fan persisted without giving up, was that the trace was fixed and unchanging.

Unlike the Heavenly Dao of a world, which was constantly changing and flowing.

Every failure brought him one step closer to success.

To gain more chances at success, the body Li Fan had possessed also spent far more time in prayer than the other You Clansmen.

Naturally, this was noticed by the You Clan chief, whose eyes revealed satisfaction.

On this day, Li Fan had already failed more than five million times.

After continuously using the power of False Becomes True, Li Fan discovered that the charging progress of [Truth] had unprecedentedly dropped from one hundred percent back down to eighty percent.

Slightly alarmed, Li Fan decided to temporarily stop his attempts and wait until [Truth] finished recharging before continuing.

Fortunately, the small world inhabited by the You Clan would not encounter any danger at this point in time.

Just as Li Fan was pondering, the You Clan chief summoned him.

Among the You Clansmen, they did not address one another by name. Instead, they distinguished each other according to their ranking order during prayer, using numerical designations.

Li Fan arrived at the cave where the clan chief resided.

After offering some encouragement, the clan chief said that the great Dark Sea had witnessed Li Fan's efforts during this period and had decided to bestow a blessing.

Li Fan put on an appearance of fanatical excitement as he waited for the so-called blessing to descend.

Secretly, he had already prepared to sever the connection with his divine sense clone at any moment.

The danger he had anticipated did not occur.

When the blessing ritual conducted by the You Clan chief reached halfway, in Li Fan's perception, the Dark Sea suddenly descended.

It descended from the heavens, pouring endless power of darkness into his body.

The body infusion process lasted only for an instant.

A moment later, "light" reappeared, and the Dark Sea vanished.

Even the power of darkness that had been infused into his body seemed like nothing more than an illusion, disappearing without a trace.

But the You Clan chief appeared utterly exhausted, as though he had aged greatly. With extreme solemnity, he instructed:

"From this day onward, you bear the mission of the You Clan. Continue maintaining a devout heart, and do not betray the trust of the great Dark Sea."

Speaking in guttural sounds and using gestures, he conveyed these words.

Li Fan nodded to indicate understanding, then waited until the next day, after his body had adapted to the blessing. During the process of praying to the Dark Sea, he once again began careful observation.

Buzz...

The power of darkness was born from nothing. It tore through space and flew toward the Dark Sea.

This time, Li Fan discovered that the life force and divine sense power disappearing from within his body had increased by a small amount.

Moreover, that trace became slightly deeper because of it.

After millions of observations, Li Fan immediately locked onto that change.

"There is hope!"

Li Fan disregarded the toll the prayers were taking on this body.

He devoted himself entirely to the process of praying, observing, and attempting to reproduce it.

Another half year passed. He had already changed from a robust young man into a frail, trembling old man.

The rate at which his life was draining was several times faster than that of the other You Clansmen.

The You Clansmen were not frightened by the strange transformation happening to Li Fan. Instead, they all displayed incomparable reverence.

Li Fan paid no attention to these You Clansmen.

He no longer even cared much about the words of the You Clan chief.

He vaguely sensed in his heart that the mission for which he had possessed this You Clansman body was about to be completed.

With his life nearing its end, Li Fan took trembling steps and walked into the prayer cave for the final time.

He knelt down with utmost sincerity and prayed from the depths of his heart.

Perhaps because it sensed that the flame of life in this body was about to be extinguished.

This time, when that mysterious trace drew away life force, it did not proceed according to the fixed amount it had always taken before.

Instead, it swept away all the remaining energy within the shell, transforming it into dark power.

However...

It was precisely because of this extra sliver that when the trace appeared, it became heavier than before.

From Li Fan's withered body, which had completely burned itself out, a soaring aura suddenly erupted.

It was like a raging fire that had abruptly ignited, radiating an incomparably intense presence.

"I found you!"

His eyes shone brightly. Even though his body soon melted like a candle, that brightness did not diminish in the slightest.

"This trace..."

This strand of Li Fan's divine sense dissipated together with the You Clansman body.

Its mission had also been completed.

Not far away, Li Fan, who had been secretly lying in wait the entire time, used his hand as a pen and moved rapidly through the air.

Wherever his fingertip passed, it seemed as though no traces were left behind.

Yet it also seemed like a sharp blade had sliced through, cutting faint marks into space itself.

His strokes flowed like dragons and serpents, continuously circling.

The symbol Li Fan was drawing became increasingly complex.

Its scale was even greater than the immortal formation currently being deduced by the Final Dissociation Disc.

Sweat faintly dripped from Li Fan's forehead.

A trace of shock flashed through his eyes.

He had merely seized that fleeting moment of inspiration and continued writing.

Yet this unknown symbol seemed endless, as though it contained within it the great principles of the entire world's Dao.

It simply could not be fully written.

Li Fan vaguely felt the illusion of chasing a mountain until the horse died from exhaustion.

What he was doing at this moment was like making a rubbing of an unknown existence based on the trace he had observed.

Even if he could not restore the object's original form, he could at least glimpse its reflected imprint.

However...

The level of this unknown supreme treasure had clearly exceeded Li Fan's capabilities.

Feeling the faint trembling within his true body's form, Li Fan ultimately let out a long sigh and abruptly released his hand.

The symbol that had nearly taken shape completely dissipated between heaven and earth.

When Li Fan tried to raise his hand and write it once more, he discovered that the remnants of that trace had also vanished from his mind.

"Opportunity cannot be missed. Opportunity cannot be missed."

Li Fan vaguely understood in his heart that in this life, he would only have this one chance.

Once lost, it would be lost forever.

Even if he possessed other You Clansmen again and repeated the process of prayer, observation, and reproduction, he would never again see any clue of that mysterious character.

"Fortunately, I can start over in my next life."

"I just wonder whether this forgotten memory can be recovered through [Truth]."

Li Fan looked at the already fully charged progress of [Truth], pondered slightly, then gently shook his head.

Even if he could preserve the memory of the mysterious symbol, without sufficient strength, he still would not be able to reproduce even its imprint.

"Dao Integration. After achieving Dao Integration with the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth of this super Xuanhuang Realm in this life, that should be enough to succeed."

Recalling the earlier situation where he had been just one step away from success, Li Fan silently thought to himself.

Although this attempt had failed, Li Fan had not gained nothing.

He had failed to retain the complete symbol, but he still had some impression of its fine structure.

"Whether applied to Immortal Formations or True Immortal seal script characters, it seems capable of bringing a certain degree of improvement."

"What exactly is this mysterious symbol?"

Li Fan's expression was somewhat dazed.

This contact with a power beyond immortals had given him a much deeper understanding of [Truth].
