Chapter 1307: Bestowing The Dao Of The Star Sea

“Immortal inscribers use True Immortal seal script characters to depict the pathways of the Immortal Dao. However, even the pathways of the Immortal Dao have distinctions in rank.”

“Like the ones I saw before, Hunger, Chaos, Solitude, Return, they are probably only the most basic. That True Immortal seal script character that likely represents Creation is clearly above them.”

“And the Dao pathway represented by this trace hidden within the bodies of the You Clan…”

“The transformation between immortal and mortal surpasses even so called Creation.”

“And [Truth]…”

Li Fan took a deep breath and forcibly calmed his emotions.

Even though he had already used [Truth] one hundred and twenty five times, personally experiencing each time the majestic power of resetting all things in the world within a single thought, and knowing that [Truth] stood above nearly everything he currently knew.

At the end of the previous life, however, the process of [Truth] had been interfered with by an unknown variable. Added to that was the terrifying power displayed by Cat Treasure, that creation from beyond the wall, which inevitably caused a trace of doubt in Li Fan’s heart regarding the upper limit of [Truth]. As he gradually came into contact with the forces beyond the wall in the future, would [Truth] still be as invincible as it had been in the Darkest Star Sea?

This discovery gave Li Fan reassurance.

The limits of [Truth] were far more unfathomable than he had imagined.

“The laws of the Xuanhuang Realm can be viewed as a downward projection of the laws of the Darkest Star Sea. And the laws of the Darkest Star Sea are likewise a downward projection of the laws of the Immortal Realm.”

“And [Truth] stands almost above everything. Through this top down reflection, in theory, it can use the transformation of False Becomes True to replicate out of nothing anything I come into contact with.”

“As long as my strength and comprehension are sufficient.”

Li Fan recalled the sensation from when he had just written that mysterious trace and pondered thoughtfully.

“And this is only the transformation of False Becomes True. [Truth] is not merely False Becomes True.”

“There is also the previous True Becomes False.”

With that thought, Li Fan casually drew over a circular stone nearby. Staring fixedly at it, he attempted to directly erase its existence through True Becomes False.

But during every [Truth] process, the originally real surrounding world always seemed to be shrouded in white mist, indistinct and impossible to see clearly. Therefore, Li Fan could not know exactly how the process of True Becomes False was accomplished.

“Perhaps when [Truth] occurs in this life, I can try actively dispersing the surrounding mist.” This thought arose in Li Fan’s mind.

“If I gain some insight into this Dao, then relying on the supreme authority of [Truth], I might even directly cross an entire major realm and casually erase opponents…”

As his thoughts stirred, Li Fan organized the remnants in his memory of the mysterious symbols he had observed over the past year while possessing members of the You Clan.

Then he handed them over to the Final Dissociation Disc for classification and application.

Handling two tasks involving Immortal formations at the same time inevitably caused the Final Dissociation Disc’s efficiency to drop considerably.

“It seems it is time to upgrade the Final Dissociation Disc again. Purely relying on sublimation triggered by Immortal formation data will ultimately still be constrained by mortal limitations.”

“The nine initial Dissociation Discs of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance can already be said to be completely different objects from the one in my hands. The help they can provide is negligible. To fully transform into an Immortal artifact Final Dissociation Disc, it will ultimately require Immortal spiritual qi…”

Li Fan pressed his slightly aching brow from the overload of work. After relaxing, he looked toward the You Clan here.

They did not feel sorrow because of the death of the person Li Fan had possessed.

They were even especially excited because of that person’s sacrifice for the great Nether Dark Sea.

Seeing how devout the You Clan were, Li Fan was deeply moved. With a wave of his hand, he instantly drew them all into his body and temporarily suppressed them.

After returning to the Great Qi small world, he would provide them with the best living conditions, allowing them to remain in Great Qi for the rest of their lives and pray peacefully.

“This small world cannot be wasted either.”

The small world where the You Clan resided was even weaker than Great Xuan. Naturally, it had not given birth to a Heavenly Dao consciousness.

This made Li Fan’s actions much easier.

He created an simulated heavenly nature, directly replacing the Heavenly Dao to maintain the normal operation of this small world.

Then he repeated the same method, silently grafting it into the main Xuanhuang world.

Practice made perfect, and this time the Heavenly Doctor technique proceeded very smoothly.

With one more small world Heavenly Dao clone, strands of insight surged in his mind like rolling waves. Even though the rank was insufficient, this large quantity of Dao comprehension inspiration could still provide Li Fan with some tangible enlightenment.

“These Heavenly Dao insights are useless to me, but for other cultivators, they would be something rarely encountered even once in a lifetime.” After returning to Great Xuan and settling the You Clan, converting more than half of them in faith.

Li Fan looked at the densely packed cultivators seated upon the preaching platform in central Great Xuan, and his thoughts stirred.

Buzz.

A new platform appeared out of thin air.

It was positioned beneath the cultivation method catalogue platform and above the disciples.

The platform was carved with all the scenery, all living beings, and all things of the world. Yet it resembled a living organism, constantly shifting, vivid and lifelike.

If one looked closely and was fortunate enough, one might occasionally discover seven colored flashes within the stone carvings.

Those were the insights from the simulated heavenly nature that Li Fan had no use for.

If cultivators on the lecture platform were fortunate enough to comprehend them, it would not be difficult for their cultivation to advance by leaps and bounds, or even for them to comprehend divine abilities unique to themselves.

“All living beings on the lecture platform are under my surveillance. Their inspiration is my inspiration.”

“Although their realms are low, the sparks of thought, magnified countless times, are still brilliant. Even if only one in ten thousand provides inspiration to me, with the number of cultivators on this lecture platform, accumulated over time, it would still be a considerable treasure.”

“Moreover, if necessary, I can use the lecture platform to manipulate the thoughts of the cultivators upon it, making them help me comprehend things together…”

Inside the lecture platform, a silver white orb resembling an eye continuously absorbed mental inspiration from the different living beings above it.

It gradually became somewhat eerie, as if coming alive, constantly turning slightly as it observed its surroundings.

After initially completing Great Xuan’s preaching enterprise, the Holy Master phantom split off another body and headed toward the next small world.

This newly divided body was not supported by Li Fan’s true self’s power. Rather, it was formed from the power of belief absorbed by the Holy Master phantom during preaching from all the disciples.

It was similar to the Heavenly Emperor Qi Canon, except that Great Qi had become Great Xuan, soldiers had become students, and the Holy Emperor had become the Holy Master.

The initial phase of expansion would be handled by these phantoms.

When the preaching enterprise began to attract the attention of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, or other hidden powerhouses within the small worlds, Li Fan would personally act and suppress them into submission.

Before that, Li Fan still needed to make complete preparations for the future confrontation.

The portion of the You Clan whose faith had been divided and altered had already begun providing Li Fan with initial source power essence.

Using this source power essence as bait, along with various threats and inducements, Li Fan very skillfully drew old acquaintances such as Hundred Flowers, Qiao Gong, and Yin Shangren into his alliance.

“A great upheaval is about to occur between heaven and earth, though you may not yet perceive it. Today, I will attempt to explain it.”

On Great Xuan’s preaching platform, Li Fan’s true self replaced the phantom, sitting solemnly.

Below, Yin Shangren and the others listened to Li Fan’s preaching.

What Li Fan spoke of was the revival of the Star Sea, leading to the future revival of Xuanhuang.

The listeners were half believing and half doubtful.

Li Fan smiled faintly and pointed toward the sky, as if opening a vortex leading beyond the star sea.

“Everyone, please follow me.”

Seven colored rainbow light emerged around his body as Li Fan invited the group inside.

The crowd exchanged glances, but in the end, they all entered the protection of Li Fan’s rainbow light.

The seven colored radiance shot straight upward.

Passing through the vortex in the heavenly dome, in the very next moment they appeared directly at the boundary of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Judging by the momentum, there was no intention of stopping at all.

It seemed they intended to continue speeding toward the starry sky beyond the Xuanhuang Realm.

Everyone’s faces immediately turned pale.

They all knew of the terrifying suction that existed outside the Xuanhuang Realm. Once they left the protection of the Xuanhuang Realm, they might fall into it the very next moment, with no chance of survival.

But what happened next greatly exceeded their expectations.

The seven colored rainbow light separated into streams of different hues, tracing curved arcs through the star sea. It forcibly carried everyone successfully away from the Xuanhuang Realm.

The crowd was stunned.

Li Fan, however, still did not stop, continuing to move rapidly toward the depths of the star sea.

The deathly silence of the star sea stirred emotions in the hearts of the group, filling their eyes with sorrow.

The dangers lurking within the star sea left them deeply alarmed, their expressions grave.

As for Li Fan, who seemed like a prophet, always able to avoid the dangerous regions of the star sea with perfect timing, everyone looked at him with astonishment.

They all secretly guessed just how many times Li Fan had traveled back and forth through the starry void to be this familiar with it.

However, as they went deeper into the star sea, Li Fan’s speed gradually slowed.

It seemed he was also distinguishing directions.

Yin Shangren and the others were not mistaken in their feelings. After all, in the previous life, when the Holy Emperor comprehended the Dao from the center of the starry sky, the connection between him and Li Fan’s true body had already become faint and intermittent.

So on this journey to witness the path of star sea revival, the further they went, the less memory Li Fan had to rely on, and the more he had to personally find the path forward.

Fortunately, he was still following a map.

Through an indistinct sense of intuition, Li Fan had already touched upon the location of the origin consciousness of this star sea. It was just that in the previous life, the Holy Emperor had attracted the attention of the star sea’s origin consciousness by virtue of being the incarnation of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, a possible savior of the star sea.

In this life, Li Fan had not yet displayed qualifications worthy of the star sea’s notice.

Li Fan also had no intention of exposing himself to the star sea this early.

But that did not hinder his next plan.

“It should be here.” Feeling that the distance was about right, Li Fan stopped and looked into the void ahead, sighing softly.

Hearing this, everyone followed his gaze with uncertain expressions.

In their perception, this region of the starry sky was indeed somewhat different from before. It seemed slightly brighter, slightly warmer. But it was still far from the revival Li Fan had described.

It still looked utterly dead and silent.

However, since the other party had gone through so much effort to bring them here, he certainly would not act without purpose.

Could it be that my comprehension is insufficient?

At that instant, everyone felt a trace of doubt toward themselves.

Then they all continued observing with utmost seriousness.

Li Fan took in the subtle changes in their expressions and smiled without speaking.

Only after a long time did he finally ask, “Have you all gained anything?”

The response was complete silence.

Li Fan pretended to be slightly surprised. After pondering for a moment, he suddenly waved his hand.

Several streams of light entered the minds of the crowd.

They were precisely the Holy Emperor’s insights from the previous life regarding the power of star sea revival.

Everyone’s eyes lit up immediately.

Around them, strands of almost imperceptible vitality appeared out of nowhere.

Qiao Gong, Hundred Flowers, and the others had survived from the destruction of the Immortal Realm until now. Which among them was not a heaven defying genius?

Previously, because the consciousness of the star sea was far too vast and hidden beneath ruin and extinction, they had failed to notice it.

But now Li Fan directly threw the results of Dao comprehension into their minds.

Naturally, they all began to perceive something.

“So it truly is like this!” Hundred Flowers was the most deeply moved.

“If I can master this power of revival, perhaps I could restore the Wansheng Realm…”

Yin Shangren rubbed his head. The remnant specters of worlds he had devoured seemed to be drawn by this revival force, as if they wanted to crawl back out of his body.

For a time, everyone was immersed before the vast might of the star sea.

None of them noticed that Li Fan, who had guided their Dao comprehension, had for some reason moved some distance away from them.

In truth, Li Fan had even used methods approaching an Immortal formation to temporarily conceal his own traces.

He had a premonition that exposing his existence too early to the origin consciousness of the Darkest Star Sea would absolutely not be a good thing.

“At the very least, I must wait until I successfully achieve Dao Integration and reach the mortal limit,” Li Fan thought as he watched the group comprehending the Dao, his gaze flickering.

The times at which everyone awakened from Dao comprehension differed.

Qiao Gong was the first to awaken. His eyes spun rapidly, as if he had thought of some marvelous idea, eager to return to the Xuanhuang Realm immediately to experiment.

Yin Shangren, meanwhile, seemed to have spent a great deal of time dealing with the violent remnant world specters within his body.

However, what surprised Li Fan somewhat was that Hundred Flowers was actually the last to awaken.

From her eyes, Li Fan could sense the joy in her heart.

“Congratulations, everyone. You have all gained something.”

“The star sea is full of dangers. It is not suitable to remain here for long. Let us return as soon as possible,” Li Fan said with a smile.

Everyone nodded and responded with the courtesy of disciples toward a teacher.

The journey back was uneventful, and the group once again returned to the Great Xuan Lecture Platform.

Seeing with their own eyes was more convincing than hearing about it. After personally traveling through the star sea, everyone now completely believed Li Fan’s words.

The revival of the star sea was within sight.

“Everyone should understand that the star sea’s deathly silence cannot regain vitality overnight.”

“As the only surviving place in the star sea, Xuanhuang should naturally become the source of the star sea’s revival.”

“Only by having vitality spread from here can the effort achieve twice the result with half the work.”

The group considered Li Fan’s conclusion for a moment, then all nodded in agreement.

“No merit surpasses following a true dragon.”

“If we can lend a hand in the revival of the star sea, then when the star sea eventually regains its former prosperity, there is no need to explain the benefits we will receive.” Li Fan looked at them calmly.

Yin Shangren and the others were all moved.

“If the star sea revives, then even if the Immortal Path remains closed, perhaps by relying on its feedback we may still leap up and become the strongest in the star sea.” A trace of greed flashed in Qiao Gong’s eyes.

Chapter 1308: The First Transformation Of The Xuanhuang Realm

“However, what exactly should we do?” Yin Shangren’s eyes shone sharply as he pointed out the key issue.

In truth, their strengths were all roughly on the same level.

With Old Method Longevity Immortal cultivation, let alone helping the star sea recover, they were incapable of even reversing the crisis of the Xuanhuang Realm itself.

It was as if a bucket of cold water had been poured over them. The group quickly calmed down and all turned to look at Li Fan.

Li Fan sat upon the lecture platform, as if he had long expected Yin Shangren to ask this question, and replied unhurriedly, “Do you all know that a world is like a person, and the star sea is the same?”

“If a person falls ill, the treatment is to prescribe the proper medicine, then supplement it by stimulating acupoints and meridians.”

“When a world or the star sea suffers calamity, the same principle applies…”

A humanoid light projection slowly appeared before everyone as Li Fan spoke.

Important acupoints and meridians were all clearly marked.

Li Fan lightly waved his hand. The light projection suddenly transformed. It expanded, spread outward, and eventually became a faintly glowing yellow cloud mass. The acupoints and meridians that had originally been inside the human body were also redistributed throughout the cloud according to the pattern of transformation.

The group had just returned from the outer starry sky beyond Xuanhuang. How could they fail to recognize that this cloud mass represented the Xuanhuang Realm? Just as they were concentrating on observing, Li Fan pointed once more.

The cloud mass expanded again, by a thousand times, ten thousand times.

The magnificent scene instantly submerged everyone, causing them to lose themselves within it.

It was clearly a dazzling star sea.

The group faintly sensed that the occasional flickering lights within the star sea, emitting unusual radiance, were precisely the acupoints and meridian pathways from the earlier human and world projections.

“From man to world, from world to domain. This is indeed how it should be.” Yin Shangren appeared thoughtful.

The others also seemed to enter a state of enlightenment.

Just as they wished to continue observing, Li Fan waved his hand, and the star sea instantly reverted, becoming once more the image of the Xuanhuang Realm.

“To restore the star sea, one must first restore Xuanhuang. To restore Xuanhuang, this is where we must begin.”

On the miniature projection of the Xuanhuang Realm, various locations were marked out by Li Fan.

“The Xuanhuang Realm has suffered thousands of years of devouring and plundering by cultivators. By all logic, it should already be completely depleted. Fortunately, the Immortal Ancestor has continuously gathered world fragments from the star sea to nourish it. The remnant worlds are like medicine. Xuanhuang has already taken them, but has not yet fully absorbed them…”

Those scattered markings emitted rosy crystalline light, seemingly containing boundless vitality and energy.

By this point, everyone already understood Li Fan’s meaning.

In short, a single sentence: help Xuanhuang digest the medicinal effects.

Li Fan continued, “Xuanhuang has been weak for far too long. There is the danger that it cannot bear supplementation despite its deficiency. Therefore, it must be guided and enticed, using acupoints to lead meridians, and points to influence the whole…”

The lecture continued for a full seven days and seven nights.

After Li Fan’s figure dissipated, the group still remained immersed in the principles he had explained, the unity of man, heaven, and medicine, unable to contain themselves.

Yin Shangren was the first to recover. “Remnant worlds as medicine, this metaphor is truly exquisite. Absorption, digestion, integration into oneself. And those that cannot be absorbed are completely discarded. That is medicinal residue…”

Qiao Gong was absentminded, casually offering a few perfunctory words before taking his leave.

Hundred Flowers, however, frowned slightly. “Enticing Xuanhuang to digest remnant worlds is no easy matter. Xuanhuang cultivators have stood in opposition to the Heavenly Dao for so many years. Any action involving the power of remnant worlds may provoke hostility from Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao. Even if we are doing it for its own good.”

“That is why we must first resolve this misunderstanding and gain Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao’s trust.” Yin Shangren looked toward the place where Li Fan’s figure had disappeared.

Before leaving, Li Fan had said that before the next lecture, he would help handle this matter.

The only question was what method he would use.

As a remnant world wandering specter, Yin Shangren understood far better than the others just how difficult it was to dissolve the Xuanhuang Realm’s hostility.

Seven days later, when Li Fan appeared again, he invited everyone above the Great Xuan small world.

Upon arriving, Yin Shangren felt as though he had fallen into a swamp. Every movement faced immense resistance. His nature as a wandering specter of a world offered no help in overcoming this obstruction. He could not even determine the source of the strange resistance.

Hundred Flowers and Qiao Gong also wore extremely solemn expressions, indicating they too had sensed how extraordinary this place was.

“Everyone, allow me to introduce someone to you.” Li Fan said with a smile.

Then a hunched white-haired old man appeared before them.

The old man’s strength was not particularly remarkable, but the coffin strapped to his back drew everyone’s attention.

The towering resentment faintly emanating from the coffin caused Yin Shangren and the others to narrow their eyes.

“This is Fellow Daoist Xu Ke, formerly a disciple of the Beast Taming Sect. Because of the mission he carried, he concealed himself within the small world and sat in withered seclusion for thousands of years…” After briefly introducing Xu Ke’s background, Li Fan signaled with his eyes, and Xu Ke removed the coffin from his back.

It floated in the sky.

As if sensing the temporary absence of its guardian, the sealed entity inside the coffin instantly became even more violent. The coffin lid jumped continuously, as though whatever was imprisoned inside might break free at any moment.

“Do you know what is sealed inside this coffin?” Li Fan asked.

Without waiting for a reply, he directly revealed the answer. “It is a strand of Xuanhuang will.”

“However, this strand of will is now filled with resentment, madness, obsession, and other negative emotions. It has completely transformed into nothing less than Xuanhuang Evil Thoughts.”

“Today, we shall purify this evil thoughts, and then return it to Xuanhuang.” Li Fan said solemnly.

Xu Ke coughed lightly and added, “When this evil thoughts separated from Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao back then, it intended to completely sever itself forever. To Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, it was far more than simply cutting off a piece of flesh. It is more like a clone.”

“If we can return it to Heavenly Dao and restore the missing part, it will absolutely invoke Xuanhuang Heavenly favor…”

“Of course, that assumes we can completely purify the evil thoughts within.” Xu Ke looked at Li Fan.

Li Fan appeared entirely confident. “It is merely evil thoughts. With everyone working together, how could it not be purified?”

Qiao Gong had listened for quite a while, and after learning the true identity of the sealed object, he had become somewhat impatient. “Specifically, how do we do it? I will certainly cooperate with all my strength.”

“What it hates is simply that it did not leave back then. In that case, we shall fulfill its wish and let it cross the High Wall as it once desired.” As Li Fan spoke, a whisk suddenly appeared in his hand.

He raised it high, then fiercely swept it toward the coffin.

The countless white strands of the whisk shot forth like ten thousand meteors, plunging into the coffin.

The violently shaking coffin leapt high, then froze rigidly in midair.

The white strands of the whisk emitted dreamlike silver light. Within that silver glow, countless different scenes flashed.

They were all dream scenes infused by Li Fan.

Although each dream differed, without exception, they all depicted great terror and great annihilation beyond the High Wall.

After the Xuanhuang evil thoughts attached itself to Mr. Bai and successfully crossed the High Wall, escaping into the Darkest Star Sea.

Every single time, it failed to survive longer than three breaths before dying to various indescribable unknown calamities.

In the blink of an eye, the Xuanhuang evil thoughts had already experienced ten thousand deaths within the illusion.

Qiao Gong muttered to himself, “Is this not a bit too outrageous? The outside of the High Wall may be unknown, but it should not be like this, right? Even an ordinary-looking cat can swallow it in one bite? In terms of strength alone, this Xuanhuang evil thoughts is probably no weaker than Old Method Longevity Immortal cultivators. Can this really fool it?”

Xu Ke, who had spent thousands of years with the Xuanhuang evil thoughts, keenly noticed that the struggle coming from inside the coffin had indeed weakened slightly, and he could not help showing joy. “It truly works!”

At that moment, Li Fan’s voice came from above. “Everyone may also help create dream scenes. No matter how bizarre or horrifying, it does not matter. As long as the Xuanhuang evil thoughts ultimately perishes.”

The whisk’s radiance surged, expanding before the group. At the end of the handle, a vortex faintly appeared.

Yin Shangren and the others immediately understood, each projecting into it the most terrifying dreams they could imagine.

Among them, the dreams created by Yin Shangren were especially strange and horrifying.

Even with Li Fan’s current experience, after observing them, he could not help but feel chills run down his spine.

Compared to this, the illusion dreams woven by Qiao Gong, Hundred Flowers, and Xu Ke were far more ordinary.

Qiao Gong’s dreamscapes mostly involved world destruction, the self transforming into a puppet, and the inability to distinguish truth from illusion.

Hundred Flowers’ dreamscapes were connected to the withering of life, with all things falling into frozen silence.

Under the repeated baptism of these different terrifying dreamscapes, the Xuanhuang evil thought had already quietly undergone a qualitative transformation.

“So the outside of the High Wall is actually this terrifying?”

“If I had known earlier, I should never have left the High Wall. Even if I could only struggle on in miserable survival, it would still be better than instantly losing my life!”

Thoughts like these accumulated within the Xuanhuang evil thoughts after each dream ended.

Although each one was merely a nearly negligible scar, the speed at which the dreams generated and cycled through reincarnation was far too fast.

At every instant, hundreds of thousands of dreams vanished and were born anew.

More importantly, these were not merely ordinary dreamscapes in appearance. They were the world’s highest grade illusion formations, enhanced with a trace of Li Fan’s comprehension of False Becomes Real.

From the outside, one might wonder why those trapped in the formation could not distinguish dream from reality. But only those truly inside could personally experience the terrifying power of this illusion where falsehood became reality.

Looking at his masterpiece, Li Fan could not help but feel a trace of pride.

“It was reborn from the Cloudwater Illusory Dream Technique, but the effect is far stronger than the original.”

“And with the amplification of illusion formations integrated into it, even though it is not an Immortal formation, it surpasses Immortal formations.”

As the dreams continuously iterated, the speed at which the Xuanhuang evil thoughts sank into corruption grew faster and faster.

At first, it would occasionally still produce emotions of doubt and resistance.

But later, all questions completely vanished.

What remained was only endless regret and fear.

Looking at the Xuanhuang evil thoughts trembling within the formation, Li Fan understood that this dish had finally reached the moment to be served.

“Rise!”

Li Fan extended his hand forward and grasped the enormous horsetail whisk in midair.

Then he stirred it slightly.

The countless silver-white strands of the whisk also began continuously stirring within the coffin.

Like countless sharp blades, they sliced the Xuanhuang evil thoughts, which had already completely abandoned resistance, into innumerable tiny fragments.

As the evil thoughts disintegrated, the sealed coffin also became illusory.

Li Fan lightly waved the whisk, and part of the strands coiled around a portion of the dismembered Xuanhuang evil thoughts, bringing it before Yin Shangren.

“Fellow Daoist, please!”

Then he solemnly accepted the divided Xuanhuang evil thoughts before him.

Li Fan then separated another portion and delivered it before Qiao Gong.

Like carving up a defeated nation, before long Li Fan had completed the division of the Xuanhuang evil thoughts.

Everyone present received a share.

Li Fan himself did as well, and compared to the others, he received slightly more.

But naturally, Yin Shangren and the others had no objections.

“Go!”

Controlling the enormous horsetail whisk, Li Fan’s expression turned solemn as he hurled it toward the sky.

It tore apart the heavens, opening a passage leading to the Xuanhuang Realm.

“Dim and boundless azure abyss, let the soul return~”

Li Fan chanted softly.

And without Li Fan needing to do much more, from the moment the passage opened, the Heavenly Dao consciousness of the Xuanhuang Realm had already noticed the fragment of its own consciousness that had once been split away and now existed within Great Xuan.

Within the passage, enormous rumbling continuously echoed.

It was as though the Heavenly Dao consciousness of Xuanhuang was about to descend.

“Let the soul return!”

Li Fan pointed into the air.

The portion of purified and divided Xuanhuang evil consciousness before him flew toward the passage.

Its speed grew faster and faster, vanishing from everyone’s sight in an instant.

After that, Yin Shangren and the others followed suit.

After half a day, the Xuanhuang evil thoughts that had been scattered for many years had finally completely returned to the Xuanhuang Realm.

The passage closed, and all strange phenomena vanished completely.

Xu Ke looked at the sealed coffin that had completely turned illusory and disappeared, feeling a sense of emptiness in his heart.

Qiao Gong, however, was somewhat worried.

“That is it? We did not just work for nothing, did we?”

Li Fan smiled faintly.

“Rest assured, everyone. Xuanhuang does not mistreat those with merit.”

“But the Xuanhuang Realm needs some time to digest this. Before the harvest arrives, all you need to do is wait patiently.”

Li Fan’s figure faded away along with those words.

Leaving behind everyone with different expressions.

Yin Shangren looked toward Xu Ke and began asking him about Mr. Bai.

Xu Ke, who had originally still been somewhat lost, immediately became energized.

The two spoke joyfully, feeling as though they had known each other forever.

Hundred Flowers and Qiao Gong, however, did not get along very well, and each went off to attend to their own affairs.

They were all waiting for the reward from the Xuanhuang Realm that Li Fan had spoken of.

Meanwhile.

Within the Xuanhuang Realm.

Li Fan’s true body concealed his traces and quietly observed the changes in the Xuanhuang Realm.

If absorbing Immortal spiritual qi caused changes to occur on the mountains, rivers, and surface of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Then absorbing its own lost consciousness caused silent changes to occur within the world itself.

Only cultivators deeply familiar with the operation of the Xuanhuang Realm’s Heavenly Dao could perceive it.

“Comparing it to cultivators like us, it is like the strengthening of soul and divine sense.”

“The first beneficiaries should be the laws of the Xuanhuang Realm. In other words, the Xuanhuang Realm’s Longevity Immortals…”

Li Fan sensed several vast consciousnesses sweeping across heaven and earth.

Some of them were quite familiar.

“Hmph, I will let you taste a little sweetness first. In the end, all of it will have to be spat back out to me!”

Those vast consciousnesses searched several times, yet never found the cause of the mysterious changes occurring in the Xuanhuang Realm.

In the end, they could only give up.

Li Fan merely sneered inwardly and paid them no further attention.

He continued carefully comprehending the changes in the Xuanhuang Realm.

Changes completely different from the world ending transformations he had comprehended.

Chapter 1309: First Encounter With The Carefree Paradies

The Xuanhuang world ending transformations were the various extreme changes that naturally arose from the Xuanhuang Realm’s instinct for self preservation when it sensed the fate of impending destruction.

All of them were manifestations that pushed a particular aspect to its absolute limit.

For example, the transformation Li Fan used in his previous life to disguise himself as a Dao Integration cultivator, [Spirit of Heaven and Earth Heat Death, All Things Frozen]. It was no weaker than ordinary ice-type Spirit of Heaven and Earth within the Xuanhuang Realm, and in fact stronger than the overwhelming majority of them.

World ending transformations were often filled with aggression and destructive force. Since they were generally only born when the Xuanhuang Realm faced a crisis of annihilation, their appearance in the world would inevitably trigger a stress response from the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao. The result was that the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao would instinctively develop wariness and distrust toward the holder of a world ending transformation, just as it did toward Li Fan now.

However, after absorbing the evil thoughts it had separated from itself, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao underwent a transformation similar to being infused with immortal qi and experiencing complete revival. The specific manifestation of this change was reflected in the foundational laws of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The changes regarding longevity reversal principle could be set aside for now. The various restrictions the Xuanhuang Realm imposed upon cultivators also became increasingly severe alongside the Realm’s internal revival.

The bottleneck of heavenly tribulation, the inability to cultivate multiple laws simultaneously, the strange phenomena appearing in the heavenly canopy after death.

These laws, all deeply tied to cultivation, were rapidly changing in silence.

Cultivators would find breakthroughs more difficult. The heavenly signs appearing after death would record more information about a cultivator’s life. The standards by which different cultivation methods were judged would become stricter, and the total number of cultivation techniques in the world would mysteriously decrease.

Beyond that, Li Fan also faintly sensed that the efficiency with which the Xuanhuang world absorbed and transformed the returned Dao Foundations after cultivators died, as well as world fragments, was gradually increasing alongside its growing internal strength.

A faint humming like digestion echoed between heaven and earth, too subtle for ordinary cultivators to detect.

Within the Xuanhuang Realm, cultivators devoured heaven and earth to cultivate. Now that the Xuanhuang world’s strength had suddenly expanded, it would inevitably drive a dramatic surge in the power of the cultivators within it as well.

Foundation Establishment defeating Golden Core, Golden Core defeating Nascent Soul. In the near future, this might become commonplace.

As for the earlier generation cultivators seeking to escape this awkward predicament, they had only two choices. Either abolish their cultivation and start over, or find a way to break through to the next major realm as quickly as possible.

Otherwise, those cultivators who had not grown alongside the Xuanhuang world would soon become obsolete remnants of their era.

...

Li Fan observed all the dramatic transformations occurring within the Xuanhuang Realm without extracting any of them. Although the growth intensity of the Xuanhuang Realm was still far below his requirements, it was already sufficient to provide inspiration.

“This is the transformation of the Dao. Those who align with the Dao live, those who lose the Dao perish. This is true for the Xuanhuang Realm, true for the Darkest Star Sea, and perhaps it was true for the Immortal Realm as well.”

Li Fan silently pondered this.

He recalled Sun Erlang’s experience in the illusion realm of the True Fruit from the previous life.

“I wonder what gains they will obtain from heading to the Carefree Paradise in this life?”

Within the Dao Discussion Platform, the silver-white eyes turned slightly, and the images of Sun Erlang’s group of three immediately appeared within it.

Although they were only peak Golden Core cultivators, they had been fortunate enough to receive the Holy Master’s transmission of the Great Dao. In their eyes, the defensive formations of both the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association were as good as nonexistent.

They advanced straight through, passed the [Human Dao Heavenly Land], and finally reached the so-called Carefree Paradies.

At first glance, it did not seem much different from other regions of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Yue Zhenwei, the oldest among the three, surveyed the surroundings, a trace of confusion flashing in his eyes.

“Are there fewer people here than in other regions of the Five Elders Association?”

Sun Erlang nodded.

“Indeed. And they all seem dispirited. No matter how I look at it, it has nothing to do with the word ‘Paradies.’”

Wang Xuanba was completely unconcerned.

“Who cares? Didn’t we come here to search for Cave Heaven worlds needed for breaking through to Nascent Soul? Naturally, fewer people is better.”

Sun Erlang and Yue Zhenwei both felt that made sense.

One should only do what matches one’s abilities. The secrets of the Carefree Paradies were clearly not something minor Golden Core cultivators like them could investigate.

Thus, they continued concealing their traces and used the secret techniques taught by the Holy Master to search the Carefree Paradies for traces of Cave Heavens.

However...

Ten days passed, and they found nothing.

The expressions of all three became somewhat ugly.

“That is impossible. We have practically searched all of Qiuxi Prefecture, yet we did not find even a single Cave Heaven?”

Wang Xuanba was full of disbelief.

“Either the Holy Master’s secret technique has a problem. Or...” Yue Zhenwei’s expression was equally grim.

Sun Erlang continued:

“The Carefree Paradies may simply not contain any Cave Heavens at all. Or perhaps what we are seeing now is not the true Carefree Paradies, but merely an empty shell. That legendary dream is where the real place exists.”

“What do we do next?” Wang Xuanba scratched his head.

“We cannot exactly enter a dream to steal things, can we? Why not return to the Human Dao Heavenly Land? Security may be tighter there, but the territory is much larger. As long as we are careful, borrowing a few Cave Heavens should not be a problem.”

Sun Erlang and Yue Zhenwei both nodded.

The three quickly reached an agreement and prepared to withdraw from the Carefree Paradies.

But what filled them with inexplicable terror was that although they were clearly retracing the same path they had used to enter, the scenery they encountered upon reaching the boundary of the Carefree Paradies had completely changed.

The white mist barrier that stretched across heaven and earth as the natural dividing line between prefectures had vanished. In front of them now lay an endless desert stretching beyond sight.

“This...”

The three stood at the desert’s edge, drawing yellow sand from the ground and rubbing it between their fingers.

“It is real.”

Sun Erlang clenched his fist and spoke in a low voice.

Wang Xuanba still refused to believe it. He stepped forward and sank into quicksand.

“How could this happen? The path was fine when we came in, and now suddenly we cannot go back? We did not even get lost!”

Yue Zhenwei, the calmest among them, spoke:

“I fear we unknowingly entered the true dream of the Carefree Paradies.”

He gazed into the distant desert but saw no traces of life.

“It is best not to rashly enter this desert. Let us try another direction.”

The three crossed Qiuxi Prefecture once again and at another boundary encountered an entirely different neighboring region.

Roaring torrents poured down from the nine heavens. The instant they struck the Qiuxi streams, they transformed into bubbles of light and vanished.

Not far away was a world of water suspended high in the sky.

Within it swam many living creatures, and they could even faintly make out numerous underwater structures.

“How about we try here? We cannot get out anyway.”

Wang Xuanba suggested.

“Let us observe first.”

Yue Zhenwei carefully studied it and discovered that while life existed within this water world, the civilization that built the underwater structures consisted of writhing octopus-like beings.

They appeared to possess their own language and writing, ruling this underwater world.

Yet despite the thin boundary separating them from Sun Erlang’s group, and despite the group openly observing them, the creatures showed no awareness whatsoever.

It was as though they existed in different worlds.

Temporarily leaving the water world behind, the three continued searching along Qiuxi Prefecture’s border.

Finally, in the southwestern corner, they discovered a third neighboring prefecture.

In the distant prefecture, a giant stone stood by the sea.

It was exactly identical to the giant coastal stone they had previously seen in Shilin Prefecture of the Xuanhuang Realm.

“Excellent. We finally found a way out!”

Wang Xuanba shouted excitedly.

He was just about to rush forward when Sun Erlang stopped him.

“Careful. Something feels wrong.”

As Sun Erlang spoke, two figures appeared in the sky above the giant seaside rock, one chasing the other.

The one in front was in a sorry state, seemingly heavily injured.

The figure pursuing behind was clearly faster by a noticeable margin. Yet it seemed to be enjoying the thrill of the hunt, deliberately controlling the distance between them. It gave the fleeing cultivator the illusion that with just a little more effort, escape was possible, when in reality there was no chance of getting away.

If this had been an ordinary pursuit, the three would not have been particularly shocked. However, the one chasing the fleeing human cultivator was actually a demon beast with a human body and a dog's head.

Just as the human cultivator was about to desperately flee beyond the boundaries of Shilin Prefecture and enter the Congyun Sea, the dog-headed demon beast finally grew impatient and chose to end the hunting game.

Its hand reverted into a dog claw, firmly pinning the human cultivator in place. Watching the human's desperate and agonized expression amid miserable screams, the dog-headed demon beast burst into loud laughter.

Then, fully satisfied, it opened its mouth, preparing to swallow the human cultivator whole.

"You evil beast, stop!"

It was precisely the hot-blooded age of youth. How could Wang Xuanba possibly stand by and watch such a scene of a human being devoured right before his eyes?

Before Sun Erlang and Yue Zhenwei could stop him, a gray-white giant axe carrying an ancient aura had already broken through the boundary between the two different territories and arrived before the dog-headed demon beast.

Yet the dog-headed demon beast seemed to have been prepared all along.

A savage and excited gleam flashed in its eyes. It casually tossed aside the human cultivator it had captured as prey.

It completely ignored the gray-white giant axe about to strike its head and charged directly toward Sun Erlang and the other two.

As the dog-headed demon beast moved, the Xuanhuang Shilin Prefecture where it stood suddenly underwent a strange expansion as well. It instantly swallowed the territory of Qiuxi Prefecture, enveloping Sun Erlang and the other two within it.

As if a dream had descended into reality, the worlds occupied by the dog-headed demon beast and Sun Erlang's group merged into one.

Clang!

Wang Xuanba's gray-white giant axe struck the back of the dog-headed demon beast's neck, yet only produced the sound of metal clashing against metal. That full-powered strike, enough to split mountains, did not even cut through the beast's skin.

Wang Xuanba gave a cold snort, entirely unafraid.

"Did you think your grandfather's axe is only sharp? You actually dared rely on your tough body to take it head on? A beast is still a beast!"

The dog-headed demon beast seemed to understand Wang Xuanba's words, and its expression changed slightly.

Only then did it notice a clearly visible gray scar appearing at the back of its neck. The gray rapidly spread upward, directly engulfing the beast's dog head.

Moments later, the gray-white head crumbled like dust and scattered into the air.

"Be careful!"

Yue Zhenwei and Sun Erlang shouted at the same time.

Just as Wang Xuanba was feeling smug, the dog-headed demon beast, despite having lost its head, moved again.

Its figure flashed, already arriving before Wang Xuanba.

The dog claw became a streak of black light, instantly piercing through Wang Xuanba's heart.

"Xuanba!" Sun Erlang's eyes nearly split with fury.

A sinister blade arrived just a moment too late, sweeping forth endless black wind that directly engulfed the dog-headed demon beast.

Yet only moments later, the beast's flesh had already been completely stripped away by the black wind.

All that remained was a grim white skeleton.

However, this skeleton radiated an unusual golden glow.

"Something is wrong..." Yue Zhenwei's expression shifted slightly.

Yet without realizing it, a figure had silently approached from behind him.

It was precisely the human cultivator whom the dog-headed demon beast had supposedly been chasing earlier.

A mocking smile hung at the corner of his mouth as he looked greedily at Yue Zhenwei. His aura erupted explosively. There was not the slightest sign of injury.

His neck suddenly stretched out, his head flying forward as he swallowed Yue Zhenwei's head in a single bite.

Poor Yue Zhenwei had focused all his attention on the dog-headed demon beast and Sun Erlang. Caught off guard by the ambush, he died instantly.

"AAAAAH! You all deserve to die!"

Watching his two companions die one after another, Sun Erlang's eyes turned blood red.

Veins bulged across his body as black energy enveloped him.

His pupils were completely consumed by darkness. Ignoring everything else, Sun Erlang charged directly toward the long-necked demon beast.

Yet he was suddenly seized from behind by the golden skeleton.

The golden skeleton tightened its grip while letting out eerie laughter.

"This trick works so well. Every time, it hooks a few idiots."

Sun Erlang's rage surged even higher.

"AH!"

His roar echoed between heaven and earth.

A black storm suddenly erupted from his dantian.

It was several times more terrifying than the one contained within the black blade earlier.

The golden skeleton, still shouting arrogantly moments before, was instantly swallowed.

"Damn it! What is this..."

Before it could finish speaking, the golden skeleton vanished together with Sun Erlang within the black storm.

The long-necked demon beast showed no intention of going forward to rescue it.

Instead, it watched with great interest while chewing on Yue Zhenwei's corpse.

Not long after, the black storm completely dissipated.

And the corpses of Yue Zhenwei and Wang Xuanba had both become food for the long-necked demon beast.

...

"AH!"

Sun Erlang and the other two suddenly awoke from the nightmare.

Cold sweat covered their foreheads. It took quite some time before they fully recovered from the horrifying experience.

"I died?"

"I'm not dead?!" Wang Xuanba said, still shaken.

Sun Erlang fell into deep thought.

Yue Zhenwei was still the first to calm down and observe their surroundings.

"It seems we are still in the Five Elders Association's Qiuxi Prefecture where we were trapped before."

"However..."

Yue Zhenwei looked up at the sky.

"The whole world seems to have become darker?" he said uncertainly.

"That is not an illusion. The world we are in really does seem as though night has fallen," Sun Erlang observed for a while before agreeing.

"But our cultivation realms have not changed... Wait, what is this?!"

Sun Erlang's voice suddenly rose several degrees.

"Sun Erlang, Golden Core Great Perfection. Death count: 1."

"Carefree Paradies experience level: 1."

"Carefree Coins: 100."

Sun Erlang read aloud the lines of text that had mysteriously appeared before his eyes, his expression filled with shock.

"I have it too," Wang Xuanba shouted after noticing something himself.

"Wait, that is not right. Why are my Carefree Coins zero?"

"Where did your hundred come from?" Wang Xuanba asked in complete confusion.

Chapter 1310: Demon Beasts Secretly Devour Spirits

"Before I died, I took that bastard down with me. These 100 Carefree Coins should be the reward for the kill." Sun Erlang was by no means foolish. After thinking back for a moment, he guessed where the Carefree Coins on his person had come from.

"Speaking of which, what exactly did we just experience?" Wang Xuanba shivered and subconsciously touched his chest, as if the wound that had pierced through him still remained.

"Was it a dream? But the feeling of dying was far too real." Wang Xuanba muttered.

Sun Erlang stared at the few lines of text before him, trying to find more useful information.

Unfortunately, aside from the words themselves, there were no additional explanations.

"It seems we will have to figure things out ourselves." Sun Erlang's expression was somewhat unpleasant.

At this moment, Yue Zhenwei suggested, "How about we return to the border where we encountered the dog-headed demon beasts and investigate?"

"The strength of those two demon beasts was actually about the same as ours. As long as we stay alert and avoid being ambushed, we should be fine."

"Good! I want revenge on them too! Dying like that just now was too frustrating!" Wang Xuanba's eyes gleamed fiercely.

The three once again set off toward the border of Qiuxi Prefecture.

Along the way, Sun Erlang noticed that there seemed to be more cultivators than before. Moreover, they no longer appeared dispirited. Instead, they gathered in groups of three or five, seemingly discussing something.

When Sun Erlang's group tried to approach and eavesdrop, they discovered that these people were not communicating through speech or divine sense, but through some method they could not perceive.

"Maybe we can ask them for information." Wang Xuanba's gaze flickered as he looked at a group of five cultivators in the distance who appeared to be only at the middle Foundation Establishment stage.

Yue Zhenwei immediately stopped him.

"Xuanba, do not act recklessly. If our guess is correct, these people can revive just like us. It is difficult to extract information through force from people who are not afraid of death."

"Let's first investigate the target location," Sun Erlang also said in a low voice.

Wang Xuanba nodded and finally looked away.

In this life, both Sun Erlang and Wang Xuanba had learned exceptional skills from the Dao Lecture Platform at a young age. Naturally arrogant and confident, they had encountered formations that could be broken with ease ever since leaving Great Xuan. Their pride had only grown. It was only after being ambushed and killed by the demon beasts that they had become somewhat more cautious.

When they arrived at the location where they had previously fallen, the scene before them left them stunned.

"Why is the world on the other side different from what we saw last time?"

The giant stone coast of Shilin Prefecture had disappeared.

In its place stood a murderous forest of swords.

Millions upon millions of rusted swords were embedded in the earth. As the breeze passed through them, they swayed gently.

Buzz...

Perhaps because he had approached too closely, when all the decayed swords in the forest vibrated together, Sun Erlang seemed to hear a unified sword cry beside his ears.

His heart trembled.

Acting on instinct, he tilted his head.

An invisible sword qi brushed past his face, slicing away a patch of flesh.

Ignoring the pain on his cheek, Sun Erlang immediately retreated at high speed. Only after the sense of danger faded did he stop.

There was no doubt that had he failed to dodge in time, far more than a little flesh would have been cut away.

"This world seems even more dangerous than the three we encountered before," Yue Zhenwei speculated with a frown.

Next, the three roughly investigated all the worlds bordering Qiuxi Prefecture.

The sword forest.

A deep valley.

And another world that appeared to be home to a demonic sect.

Within it gathered no fewer than a thousand vicious cultivators.

Even from afar, they could see these demonic cultivators eating human flesh, taking pleasure in torture, and refining artifacts from human bones.

The hellish scene made Wang Xuanba's blood boil. He nearly charged over on the spot to wipe out the entire demonic sect.

Fortunately, Wang Xuanba was impulsive rather than stupid.

In the end, he merely spat viciously toward the other side.

The three gathered once more to discuss.

"Should we first learn some basic information from the local cultivators, or explore more worlds?"

"The cultivators of the Carefree Paradise clearly know rules that we do not. If we ask carelessly, we might reveal our identities immediately."

"Our lives may not be in danger, but we could end up trapped here forever."

"What about soul searching? The Holy Master taught us about it. Although I have never used it on an actual cultivator, I think we can give it a try." Wang Xuanba looked eager.

"Do not forget. We are probably inside a dream. Soul searching may not work at all."

After a period of silence, the three ultimately decided to test it.

"Find someone alone and relatively weak."

"Knock him unconscious first."

After searching Qiuxi Province for most of the day, they finally found a suitable target.

The man appeared to be only at the early Foundation Establishment stage. For some reason, he seemed to have become separated from his companions and was anxiously searching for them.

"Attack!"

With a shout, the three unleashed their killing moves simultaneously.

A black whirlwind.

A giant gray axe.

And Yue Zhenwei's purple qi sword.

Yet to their astonishment, the combined attack they unleashed with full strength, enough to severely injure a Nascent Soul cultivator, failed to harm the Foundation Establishment cultivator at all.

His figure flickered like light and shadow.

Every attack missed completely.

He stared at Sun Erlang's group with disbelief and involuntarily took a step backward.

At the same time, Sun Erlang noticed the lines of text constantly displayed before his eyes suddenly flicker.

Nothing else changed.

Except that his number of Carefree Coins had become zero.

Sun Erlang's face twitched.

Wang Xuanba immediately cried out through voice transmission.

"How can Carefree Coins even go negative? I lost 100!"

Yue Zhenwei's expression was equally gloomy.

"Same here."

During the brief time they were communicating, a white light suddenly emerged from the attacked Foundation Establishment cultivator.

The white light engulfed him completely.

Before disappearing, he looked at the three with the eyes of someone staring at fools.

Then he vanished from the spot.

"..."

The Great Xuan trio looked at one another in silence.

"It seems this is another natural restriction of the paradise. We and these cultivators belong to the same category. The monsters we encountered before, including those in the border worlds, belong to another."

"Cultivators cannot attack each other. There is even punishment for attempting it."

"But killing monsters in the border worlds earns rewards, including Carefree Coins."

After a brief moment of frustration, Sun Erlang quickly regained his spirit and summarized their findings.

"We do not know what happens if our Carefree Coins drop too low. It is best not to find out."

"Let's head into the border worlds and earn back the negative balance first."

At this point, the three completely abandoned the idea of soul searching.

They could not even hit the target, let alone search his soul.

Filled with frustration, they discussed their options and ultimately chose the seemingly most dangerous of the three border worlds, the demonic sect world.

"That place looks like it has a lot of enemies, but anyone refining dharma artifacts from ordinary human bones cannot be that strong."

"Their spells are crude and flashy. They may scare ordinary people, but one swing of my axe will split them apart." Wang Xuanba declared confidently.

"Still, be careful. We have already died once."

"I have a feeling that the number of deaths may be even more important than Carefree Coins." Yue Zhenwei looked at the constantly flashing characters before him and spoke gravely.

After finalizing their plan, the three entered the demonic sect world shoulder to shoulder.

The countless demonic cultivators were stunned by the sudden arrival of the trio from the sky.

After a brief pause, they shouted in a language Sun Erlang could not understand and charged forward.

Boundless blood qi surged.

Countless vengeful spirits howled.

The scene was terrifying.

"Die!"

A giant gray axe suddenly swept through the battlefield.

The blood-colored vengeful spirits jointly released by hundreds of demonic cultivators were instantly torn apart.

The axe continued forward without slowing.

Each swing claimed dozens of lives.

Wang Xuanba slaughtered wildly, his eyes bloodshot with excitement.

"Erlang, these beasts are even weaker than we expected!"

Sun Erlang, who was also harvesting demonic cultivators at great speed, did not agree.

Instead, an uneasy feeling gradually rose within him. It was exactly the same feeling he had experienced when facing the headless dog-headed demon beast.

Sun Erlang immediately looked around while continuing to eliminate enemies.

He searched for the true target.

"Look over there!" Yue Zhenwei suddenly pointed toward a gigantic statue standing within the demonic sect.

This statue had not been visible when they observed the world from outside. Even after they entered the world, it had remained hidden.

Only now, as the battle intensified, did it quietly reveal itself. The statue appeared to be stitched together from countless human corpses.

A monstrous aura of evil surged from it.

Its face possessed no actual features.

Only countless pale arms extended outward, constantly waving.

Every time Sun Erlang's group killed a demonic cultivator, another arm would emerge from the statue's face.

It was as if the dead demonic cultivators were actually being devoured by the giant statue.

Sun Erlang's slaughter slowed slightly.

But the frenzied demonic cultivators had no intention of sparing them.

They showed no fear of death.

Some even stuffed scattered flesh and broken corpses into their mouths before charging forward with crazed screams.

"What do we do? Kill them or not?"

It was obvious that killing the demonic cultivators was somehow empowering the giant statue.

Looking at the countless pale arms sprouting like bamboo shoots after rain, Sun Erlang could not help but feel uneasy.

Yet he answered decisively.

"Kill them."

Purple qi roared through the air.

A massive dragon lowered its head.

One strike annihilated over a thousand demonic cultivators, instantly clearing a huge gap in the encirclement.

Yet before long, fearless demonic cultivators filled the opening once more.

Fortunately, they were not endless.

As the Great Xuan trio fought together, the tide of monstrous, half-human cultivators gradually began to thin.

No one knew how much time had passed.

The nauseating smell of blood had become almost tangible. Even after sealing their sense of smell, they could still feel the stench seeping into their souls.

The entire demonic sect had become a sea of blood. Fragments of exploded cultivator corpses covered the ground.

The land itself seemed to breathe as it slowly absorbed the blood and remains.

Sun Erlang panted heavily.

His hand trembled slightly.

These demonic cultivators were indeed pitifully weak.

None could withstand even a single exchange with the Great Xuan trio.

But there were simply too many of them.

Even standing still and killing without resistance would have exhausted Sun Erlang.

"If I were already in the Nascent Soul Realm, I would not be in such a miserable state."

"With a Cave Heaven providing endless spiritual energy, I would not fear these human wave tactics at all."

The thought suddenly arose in his mind.

Then he seemed to realize something.

His brow furrowed slightly.

"A perfectly balanced difficulty?"

At this moment, aside from the Great Xuan trio, only the giant statue remained. It was not that they had not wanted to eliminate the hidden danger in advance.

An invisible barrier blocked their path.

They could not attack the statue beforehand.

They could only wait for it to complete its final transformation.

Rumble. Rumble. Rumble.

The entire demonic sect headquarters began to shake violently.

The giant statue, which had remained motionless until now, suddenly came alive.

Lowering its head, it gazed down at the Great Xuan trio below.

A pair of arms fell from the statue's face.

Then a second pair, a third pair...

Swish, swish, swish.

More and more arms dropped, like a torrential downpour.

Sun Erlang and the other two kept those falling arms at bay while staring solemnly at the statue as its true appearance was gradually revealed.

It was, astonishingly, the face of a pig.

The pig-headed figure wore a compassionate expression, its eyes filled with sorrow. Looking down at Sun Erlang and the others, it seemed deeply regretful.

As though they had committed some unforgivable sin. Being stared at by the enormous pig-headed statue, a nameless fury suddenly rose within Wang Xuanba's heart.

The moment he sensed that the invisible barrier blocking his way had vanished, he was the first to charge forward.

"Today, your grandfather is going to turn that pig head of yours into a drinking snack!" Wang Xuanba roared.

His gray giant axe had already expanded to the same size as the statue.

He swung it fiercely at the pig head.

The pig-headed statue neither dodged nor evaded. The sorrowful compassion in its eyes remained unchanged. However, it opened its mouth, revealing rows of terrifying fangs.

It bit directly onto the giant axe.

Then it chewed.

Bang!

The gray giant axe instantly exploded into countless fragments. Even the gray qi itself was chewed up and swallowed by the pig-headed statue.

Wang Xuanba spat out a mouthful of blood, yet a trace of madness flashed across his eyes.

"Explode!"

The countless strands of gray qi inside the statue's mouth immediately erupted like a swarm of raging dragons. The pig head's cheeks bulged slightly, as though they were about to burst apart.

Yet to Wang Xuanba's astonishment, the pig-headed statue took a deep breath and forcibly swallowed all of the gray qi into its stomach.

One had to know that this gray giant axe was not an ordinary treasure. It was Wang Xuanba's own Foundation Establishment Wonder, the [Mottled Axe of Time]

It had been awarded personally by the Holy Master as a reward for placing among the top three of the Dao Discussion Platform.

The method by which Wang Xuanba achieved Golden Core was likewise based on comprehending the laws hidden within this wonder.

The gray qi of the stone axe contained the principles of the passage of time itself. It wounded others through the power of passing years.

Yet after swallowing all of the endless gray qi contained within the axe, the pig-headed statue suffered no side effects whatsoever.

On the contrary, its body seemed to become even more solid and condensed.

With his Foundation Establishment Wonder devoured, Wang Xuanba's aura visibly declined.

Gravely wounded, he survived only by clinging to a final breath. He no longer possessed the strength to continue fighting.

The entire turn of events occurred in the blink of an eye. Before Sun Erlang and Yue Zhenwei could move to assist him, Wang Xuanba was already at death's door.

Taking advantage of the moment while the pig-headed statue was absorbing the gray qi, Sun Erlang transmitted his voice:

"Something is definitely wrong!"

"The worlds within the Land of Carefree Paradise should be some sort of trial. Judging from the strength this pig-headed statue has displayed, even Nascent Soul cultivators would be unable to contend against it. For us Golden Core cultivators, this is simply a dead end."

"There is no possibility of passing it. If it cannot be passed, then it is no longer a trial..."

"So there must be some detail within this demonic sect stronghold that we have overlooked."

Yue Zhenwei also came to his senses and began observing the surroundings once more.

After devouring the gray qi of the Axe of Time, the pig-headed statue's aura became unstable and fluctuating.

It seemed to be comprehending something and could break through to an even higher level at any moment.

"Damn it. We don't have much time left."

They had already searched this demonic sect stronghold more than once.

Aside from the scattered bones of demonic sect cultivators covering the ground, there seemed to be no hidden clues.

"Where exactly is the key to breaking this deadlock?"

At the moment of greatest danger, Sun Erlang found himself becoming calmer instead.

From the scenes he had witnessed before entering the demonic sect to everything that had happened during the battle.

Countless images slowed down and flashed through his mind one after another.

"The Holy Master once said: when cornered, change creates a path."

"For the demonic sect, outsiders like us are variables. But our existence as variables is only enough to slaughter the cultivators. We are still incapable of dealing with this giant statue."

"In that case..."

A flash of understanding appeared in Sun Erlang's eyes.

"We must seek out even greater variables!"

"This variable cannot lie with outsiders like ourselves."

"It must be..."

A sudden realization surged through his heart.

He quickly transmitted his voice to Yue Zhenwei.

"Go around the pig-headed statue! Attack the sky!"

A black whirlwind shot upward into the heavens.

Sun Erlang merged with it and soared upward.

This black baleful wind was naturally Sun Erlang's Foundation Establishment wonder, the [Annihilating Wind of Absolute Extinction]

It had likewise been bestowed personally by the Holy Master.

The pig head, which was in the midst of absorbing and evolving, sensed Sun Erlang's actions.

Within its eternally compassionate eyes suddenly appeared unmistakable anger and fear.

It let out its first roar since the battle had begun.

Just as it moved to intercept Sun Erlang, a sword of purple qi flew directly toward it.

Purple qi spread across the sky like the rising sun.

It was Yue Zhenwei's Foundation Establishment wonder, personally transmitted by the Holy Master, the [Vast Underworld Purple Firmament Sword].

Within the purple qi, the faint roar of a dragon could be heard.

The overwhelming purple radiance intimidated the pig-headed statue, causing its movements to pause for a brief instant.

That brief hesitation was enough.

Sun Erlang, transformed into black wind, had already broken through its defenses.

He struck the heavenly canopy with full force.

Cracks spread across the sky.

Even the great sun hanging high above began to fracture inch by inch.

The false sky shattered with a thunderous crash.

Countless fragments rained downward, revealing what lay beyond.

It was nothing more than a dark and enormous cavern.

As the false heavens collapsed, the pig-headed statue released a nearly insane roar.

But it no longer had any intention of dealing with Yue Zhenwei and Sun Erlang.

It seemed that something extremely terrifying was about to descend. A streak of light suddenly flew out from the pig-headed statue, attempting to escape.

"Vile beast!"

A voice like a thunderclap suddenly rang out from beyond the heavens.

Then a bolt of purple lightning appeared out of nowhere and struck the fleeing streak of light directly.

Amid a miserable scream, the creature within was reduced to ashes.

Sun Erlang vaguely made out that it was a pig demon that seemed to have been born only recently.

After descending without warning and effortlessly killing the pig demon, the purple lightning never appeared again.

Within this demonic sect, aside from the Great Xuan trio, not a single other living creature remained alive.

Sun Erlang only felt an indescribable weariness deep within his soul.

Meanwhile, Wang Xuanba and Yue Zhenwei felt both relieved and baffled.

"We won just like that?"

"There was no need to fight that terrifying pig-headed statue to the death at all. We only had to shatter this false sky above us, and heavenly lightning would descend and kill the pig demon?"

"What kind of nonsense is this? Did I risk my life for nothing?" Wang Xuanba complained while coughing lightly.

The surrounding scene suddenly froze the moment he spoke those words.

Then it shattered like countless panes of glass exploding simultaneously.

Images of innumerable identical worlds rushed into the minds of the three men. Their brains were overwhelmed by the torrent of fragments. After a wave of dizziness...

They found themselves back at the original starting point.

The Five Elders Association, Qingxi Prefecture.

"Huh? I'm fine again?" During the battle against the demonic sect, Wang Xuanba's cultivation had fallen all the way to the Qi Condensation stage and he had been on the verge of death. Yet now he had fully recovered to the peak of the Golden Core realm.

Not only that, there was not the slightest trace of injury on his body. It was as though the life-and-death battle they had just experienced had been nothing more than a dream.

Yet it was obvious that what they had gone through was far more than an ordinary dream.

"The sky has returned to its normal bright color," Yue Zhenwei observed as he looked around.

"And my Carefree Coins are finally no longer negative. I have two hundred now!" After checking his status, Wang Xuanba said happily.

Although they still had no idea what these Carefree Coins were actually used for.

Sun Erlang stared at the lines of small text before him.

"Sun Erlang. Peak Golden Core. Deaths: 1."

"Paradise Experience Level: 1."

"Carefree Coins: 500."

A small progress bar had appeared behind the Paradise Experience Level.

A pink color filled nearly thirty percent of its length.

Aside from these numerical changes, something else had appeared in Sun Erlang's mind.

"Humans are the foremost of all living beings."

"The human brain, when consumed, increases wisdom."

"The human liver, when consumed, sharpens sight."

"The human kidneys..."

One voice after another echoed continuously within Sun Erlang's mind.

There was no sinister or evil aura whatsoever, only pure explanation and exposition.

Yet when the taste and sensation of devouring those corresponding organs surged into his memories, that incomparably vivid feeling, as though he had personally experienced it all, finally became too much for Sun Erlang to endure.

He immediately began vomiting on the spot.

Seeing Sun Erlang suddenly retching uncontrollably, Wang Xuanba and Yue Zhenwei were completely confused.

Only after Sun Erlang struggled to his feet and explained what had happened did their faces also turn pale.

"This... Erlang, you're not going to become addicted to eating human flesh in the future, are you?" Wang Xuanba shrank his neck.

"This Spirit Devouring Art should be the cultivation method used by that pig demon. By passing the trial of a boundary world, it seems possible to bring items from it back into reality?" Yue Zhenwei said thoughtfully.

"Erlang, try circulating this Spirit Devouring Art," he suggested.

Wang Xuanba was startled, while Sun Erlang, having recovered somewhat, nodded slightly.

Suppressing his nausea, he closed his eyes and carefully sensed it.

A moment later, he looked at Yue Zhenwei.

"I cannot sense the existence of anyone else cultivating this technique."

Yue Zhenwei stroked his chin.

"The Carefree Paradise has existed for so many years, yet no second cultivator of the Spirit Devouring Art has appeared..."

Wang Xuanba's expression grew serious.

"I understand. There is something wrong with this cultivation method."

Sun Erlang shook his head slightly.

"That is not the important point. Although the Spirit Devouring Art was the technique that pig demon used to devour humans, humans are by no means its only targets. Any spiritual creature can be consumed."

"So although it cannot compare to the Holy Master's direct transmission, the Spirit Devouring Art is definitely an extraordinary cultivation method. Cultivating it all the way to the Nascent Soul realm would pose no problem. Even beyond the Nascent Soul realm, one can continue cultivating it, constantly strengthening oneself through the devouring of spiritual objects."

Only then did Wang Xuanba understand.

"A cultivation method like this appeared in a world experienced by newcomers like us. Yet there are no signs that anyone else cultivates it..."

"There are two possibilities. First, the dream worlds within the Carefree Paradise are not restricted by the rule that cultivation techniques cannot be cultivated simultaneously."

"Second, the dreams transform endlessly. New dream worlds are being generated at every moment. The one we encountered just happened to be a newly born dream world."
