Chapter 1311: The Initial Revival Of Xuanhuang

"Carefree Dreamscape."

The scene they had just experienced, where countless demonic cultivators fed on humans, once again surfaced in Sun Erlang's mind. No matter how he looked at it, he could not connect it with the words "Carefree."

The three of them turned their attention once more toward the border of Qiuxi Prefecture.

The world of the demonic sect that had originally stood there had already vanished.

In its place was a white mist barrier that blocked their sight.

"Can we finally go back?" Wang Xuanba said excitedly.

But things were clearly not as simple as he imagined. When the Great Xuan trio attempted to pass through the white mist barrier and return to their homeland...

Bang!

What had once been merely essence-devouring mist had now become a solid wall of bronze and iron, completely impassable.

Wang Xuanba, who rushed forward first, crashed into it and was left dazed and disoriented.

"It seems that leaving the Carefree Dreamscape completely may not be an easy matter," Yue Zhenwei said gravely.

The three of them instinctively turned to look at the two remaining border worlds.

They had a premonition that perhaps only by completing the trials of all three worlds would they learn what to do next.

...

The experiences of the Great Xuan trio within the Carefree Paradise were transmitted without the slightest omission into Li Fan's mind through the silver eyes of the Dao Lecture Platform.

"Interesting."

Having reincarnated for over a hundred lifetimes, Li Fan had witnessed the destruction of the Xuanhuang Realm, the revival of the Star Sea, and the collapse of the High Wall.

From the same experiences, he could perceive far more than his three Golden Core disciples.

"This should only be the shallowest region of the Carefree Paradise. The dreamscape's construction still uses certain events from the Xuanhuang Realm as templates. For example, the giant seaside stone in Shilin Prefecture, or the purple heavenly lightning that descended to exterminate demon beasts. A cultivator's experience and knowledge within the Xuanhuang Realm provide a certain advantage when exploring dreamscapes of this level. One must gradually become stronger by passing the world's trials in these outer dreamscapes before earning the qualification to enter deeper dreams..."

Li Fan smiled. The pattern seemed extremely familiar to him.

"The Carefree Paradise appears to operate under its own set of rules. If I want more information about it, I can simply let Sun Erlang and the others continue exploring."

Sun Erlang and the other two were merely the vanguard.

Next, numerous disciples under the Holy Master would continuously enter the Carefree Paradise.

They would gather information from within.

As the saying goes, although Paradise is vast, even ants can cross it.

The reason Li Fan paid such close attention to the Carefree Paradise was because, in his previous life when he activated the Immortal Formation to destroy the world, there had been an extraordinarily conspicuous mass of dark clouds above the territory of the Five Elders Association.

Beneath those dark clouds, even living beings that had already perished were protected.

One had to remember that when the formation, Immortal Descent, All Things Return to Void, was activated, even the Immortal Ancestor could only struggle to survive.

Yet those dark clouds not only remained intact amid the world-exterminating Immortal Formation, they still had enough power left to save others...

According to Li Fan's previous understanding, it should have been utterly impossible for the Five Elders of the Five Elders Association, despite their Longevity Immortal cultivation, to accomplish such a feat.

After so many reincarnations, Li Fan had never uncovered this secret of the Five Elders Association.

That alone showed how deeply it had been hidden.

Yet when the storm of world destruction arrived, all those deeply concealed existences revealed themselves.

"Within the Five Elders Association, besides the Carefree Paradise, there was another thing that also resisted the assault of the Immortal Formation."

Li Fan's eyes flickered.

The Dharma-Transmitter's remains, the Soul Grinding Plate.

Back in his 119th life, Li Fan had seen and heard of this object. During that lifetime, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance used an Immortal Chosen One to summon the Immortal Ancestor's manifestation and launch a surprise attack against the Five Elders Association. In the end, the Five Elders Association was forced to surrender this so-called Immortal Alliance treasure.

"Within the Soul Grinding Plate are fifty-six fragmented souls and one hundred and three skeletal remains."

"Yet those remnant souls and bones remained completely intact even while immortal power ravaged everything..."

"Even after the entire region storing the Soul Grinding Plate was reduced to nothingness, it remained unharmed. And the Soul Grinding Plate itself is merely an ordinary artifact..."

Four words instantly appeared in Li Fan's mind.

Eternal Remnant Will.

"Eternal Remnant Wills cannot be carried through [Truth]. Neither clones nor divine sense incarnations can perceive their existence. Only I myself can absorb them through [Truth]."

"Unfortunately, just like Mr. Bai's skull, both are located within the core regions of major factions. They are not easy to get my hands on."

"In this life, I can attempt to arrange matters and see whether I can acquire both objects. If that fails, then after reaching Dao Integration, I can simply seize them by force."

Li Fan let out a cold snort before returning his attention to the present.

Standing within the heavens and earth of the Xuanhuang Realm, Li Fan held an ordinary steel spear in his hand and narrowed his eyes slightly.

A chill capable of freezing all existence suddenly descended above him.

Yet it vanished just as quickly.

It was the Spirit of Heaven and Earth that Li Fan had summoned using his divine ability of False Misconversion of Heaven and Earth.

Before it fully manifested, he had already canceled the spell.

Although the Spirit of Heaven and Earth appeared and disappeared without seemingly leaving any trace behind, during the process, the steel spear in Li Fan's hand appeared to have absorbed a portion of its power and gradually became extraordinary.

Silver light shimmered across it while icy energy radiated outward. Around the spear drifted occasional illusory snowflakes.

After only several attempts, the spear had transformed from a mundane weapon into a truly peerless divine armament.

Li Fan once again invoked False Misconversion of Heaven and Earth.

This time, instead of an icy Spirit of Heaven and Earth, it was a crimson flame.

Whoosh...

The scarlet fire poured over the silver-white spear.

Instantly, the spear shaft became engraved with a vivid image of nine dragons.

Sensing the growing hostility of heaven and earth in the area, Li Fan flashed away and changed locations.

"I shall call you the Flame Dragon Ice Soul Spear."

Li Fan casually gave the newly created Heaven and Earth artifact a name before tossing it into the Dao Lecture Platform's inventory of over ten thousand rare treasures.

Using the manifested laws of Xuanhuang's heaven and earth to forge wondrous artifacts.

He had become increasingly skilled at this.

It was not only to prepare Foundation Establishment materials for his students.

More importantly, through these newly born Heaven and Earth artifacts, he could constantly judge the exact state of the Xuanhuang Realm's revival.

The nourishing effect of Xuanhuang evil thoughts upon the Xuanhuang Realm had exceeded Li Fan's expectations.

Even after such a long period of time, the improvement of the Xuanhuang Realm was still continuing.

Moreover, because the transformation was concentrated deep within the Xuanhuang Realm itself, ordinary methods could not determine its precise progress.

Thus, Li Fan had to find another approach.

This was not something he could afford to ignore.

After all, the Heavenly Dao reward for helping the evil thoughts return to Xuanhuang had still not arrived.

"Back then, after a portion of its consciousness was separated and attached to Mr. Bai, the Heavenly Dao of Xuanhuang became incomplete."

"The missing portion was not restored through the absorption of other remnant worlds."

"Instead, as it grew stronger, the deficiency became even more... apparent."

Li Fan continued constructing artificial Heaven and Earth Wonders while carefully observing the changes.

"In simple terms, the previous Xuanhuang Realm had always possessed a flaw. Returning the Xuanhuang evil thoughts was equivalent to repairing that flaw."

"Wonderful. It seems that the super Xuanhuang Realm of this life will be even stronger than what I predicted."

As his thoughts surged, another wonder was completed.

"Hm? This time, the improvement is almost negligible. It seems the digestion process is finally nearing completion." Li Fan's heart stirred slightly as he looked toward the sky.

A marvelous sensation gradually rose within him.

Half a day later, that mysterious connection with the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm formed once more.

However, because his main body possessed the Xuanhuang World-Destruction Transformation Dao Foundation, and the Xuanhuang Realm was naturally hostile toward him, the Heavenly Favor granted in this life merely offset most of that hostility, with only a little remaining goodwill.

It was completely incomparable to the favor once enjoyed by the Holy Emperor.

"Still, now that its attitude has changed, there will be plenty of ways to increase its goodwill in the future," Li Fan thought to himself.

Through his senses, he noticed that Yin Shangren, Qiao Gong, and the others also gradually perceived the descent of Heavenly Favor.

For outsiders like Qiao Gong and Hundred Flowers, the sense of estrangement they had long felt toward the Xuanhuang Realm finally disappeared.

Xu Ke had originally been one blessed by destiny. However, after guarding and suppressing the Xuanhuang evil thoughts, along with the death of his companion spirit beast Xiao Hei, his fortune had gradually dissipated over the course of several thousand years. Yet now, as Heavenly Favor descended once more, his white hair turned black, and his bent back straightened.

In the blink of an eye, Xu Ke transformed from a frail old man at death's door into the image of a steady middle-aged man.

Yin Shangren's reaction, however, was somewhat peculiar.

It was as if something had exploded directly inside his head.

His head instantly burst into a cloud of blood mist.

Through the wound at his neck, one could vaguely see the puppet-like body within him crumbling inch by inch.

The small figure inside wore a twisted expression and continuously spat out bloody fragments from its mouth. The flesh of the outer body writhed and absorbed the vomited pieces once again.

He waved his hand, stopping the others who wished to come forward and help.

Then Yin Shangren let out a burst of strange laughter.

At that moment, Li Fan's figure appeared beside everyone.

"There is no need to worry. This is actually a good thing for him," Li Fan reassured them.

Yin Shangren was a World Specter.

He was an aggregation of remnant worlds that could not be absorbed by the Xuanhuang Realm and could only exist within it like a wandering spirit.

Before this, the Xuanhuang Realm had been aware of Yin Shangren's existence but had simply ignored him.

Now, however, after helping return the Xuanhuang evil thoughts, the Xuanhuang Realm's attitude had changed.

In other words, it had marked Yin Shangren as beneficial.

The consequence was that the Xuanhuang Realm had begun attempting to accept him and incorporate him into the natural operation of Heavenly Dao itself.

If no external force intervened, then after many years, Yin Shangren would become an existence similar to the Stone Tablet or the Ruomu Divine Tree, attached to the Xuanhuang Realm in the identity of a Remnant World Specter.

Li Fan had not lied.

For Yin Shangren, this truly was a good thing.

First, with the support of the Xuanhuang Realm's Heavenly Dao power, the other remnant world consciousnesses within his body could be crushed and destroyed. He himself would become far purer and would no longer suffer from bouts of madness and confusion as before.

Second...

Within the Xuanhuang Realm still existed countless things known as Aberrations, the residue left behind from devouring remnant worlds.

These laws that could not integrate into the Xuanhuang Realm had previously required annihilation methods such as Ink Death in order to be completely eliminated.

However, once Yin Shangren became part of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao system, he would be able to freely devour these Aberrations. While strengthening himself, he would also help the Xuanhuang Realm cleanse these impurities.

It was a truly mutually beneficial arrangement.

Although beneficial in every sense, Li Fan could still perceive resistance within Yin Shangren.

If Yin Shangren himself resisted strongly enough, the integration process could very well be interrupted.

Li Fan's expression became solemn as he transmitted his voice.

"Why concern yourself with such matters? After integrating into the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, you will be no different from a cultivator of Defying Principles Longevity Immortal."

"As the Star Sea revives, the Xuanhuang Realm stands as the only pure land within it. In the future, it may very well use this revival to break through mortal limits and ascend into the legendary Immortal Realm."

"When that day comes, your achievements may be beyond imagination."

"This is the great trend of the Dao. Those who follow it prosper, those who oppose it perish."

Under Li Fan's repeated persuasion, the struggle on Yin Shangren's face gradually subsided.

Especially after hearing the words Immortal Realm, the final trace of resistance disappeared entirely.

His exploded head regenerated.

The wounds healed, concealing the sounds of flesh being chewed within his body.

Yin Shangren returned to his original appearance.

However, unlike before, when madness had been hidden beneath an ordinary exterior, the current Yin Shangren indeed resembled the Stone Tablet somewhat.

Ancient.

Profound.

"Congratulations to all of you." Li Fan smiled faintly.

"Many thanks for your guidance, Holy Master!" Yin Shangren and the others no longer addressed him as fellow Daoist. Instead, just like the students upon the Lecture Platform, they addressed him as Holy Master.

Whether it was bringing them to the center of the Star Sea to witness the Dao of Revival, or teaching them how to purify and return the Xuanhuang evil thoughts and obtain immense Heavenly Favor...

Any one of those acts could be considered a grace equivalent to rebirth.

To Yin Shangren and the others, Li Fan fully deserved the title of Holy Master.

"The Xuanhuang Realm has completed its initial transformation. Next, it will require our guidance to help it digest the remnant worlds scattered throughout its body. However, before that, some preparations are necessary."

"Please instruct us, Holy Master."

"Although the Xuanhuang Realm has devoured its own evil thoughts and repaired its flaw, thousands of years of cultivators plundering heaven and earth have already created certain deficiencies."

"It is like a person who has starved for a long time suddenly overeating. If we abruptly stimulate it to digest remnant worlds, negative consequences may occur."

Li Fan slowly explained the reasoning.

Hundred Flowers nodded slightly in understanding.

"So what we need to do now is help the Xuanhuang Realm digest one or two remnant worlds first? Where do we begin?"

"The remnant worlds within the Xuanhuang Realm have already become faintly connected as one whole. Touch one part and the entire system is affected. Therefore, using these internal remnant worlds as medicinal catalysts is not feasible."

Li Fan smiled faintly as he looked at everyone.

Qiao Gong could not help but glance toward the void outside the Xuanhuang Realm.

"So we must search for world fragments outside?"

"But where can we find them? We previously crossed more than half the Star Sea, and everywhere we looked was endless emptiness. It seems all the remnant worlds of the Star Sea have already fallen into the Immortal Ruins!"

Yin Shangren snorted coldly.

"Then where did all the remnant worlds devoured by the Xuanhuang Realm over the years come from?"

Li Fan nodded.

"Correct. There are still vast numbers of remnant world fragments within the Star Sea."

"At the edge of the Star Sea, beneath the High Wall."

Li Fan spoke in a deep voice.

Upon hearing this, Yin Shangren and the others were all shaken.

With a wave of Li Fan's hand, a magnificent scene appeared before them.

Countless remnant worlds stretched endlessly into the distance, forming a vast and majestic wall resembling a boundless Great Wall.

The group instantly fell into a daze.

"This..."

Even with their extraordinary strength, they were left speechless before such an unimaginable sight.

Chapter 1312: Immortal-Mortal Miasma Slays Immortals

"Remnant World Great Wall... Who would have thought such a phenomenon could be born at the frontier of the Star Sea?" Qiao Gong exclaimed in shock.

"No wonder all those worlds that perished back then vanished without a trace. They actually gathered beneath the High Wall? With remnant worlds stretching endlessly, what kind of power could possibly create such a sight?" Hundred Flower's face was likewise filled with astonishment.

The two of them had survived from the destruction of the Star Sea until the present day and had personally witnessed countless cultivation worlds become lands of complete death and silence. Therefore, more than anyone else, they understood the awe inspired by the endless Remnant World Great Wall stretching beyond sight.

"I seem to..." As if recalling a memory buried deep within his mind, Yin Shangren pressed a hand against his head and hesitated to continue.

Li Fan glanced at him but did not pursue the matter. Instead, he solemnly added:

"Beyond the Remnant World Great Wall, there is also a circle of Relic Great Walls serving as a barrier. Together they protect the High Wall, echoing one another and forming a grand formation. This journey will be even more dangerous than our previous expedition to the center of the Star Sea. There is even a very real possibility of disaster and death..."

Li Fan's gaze swept across the crowd.

"Whether to go or not is entirely your own decision."

"I will give you half a year to think about it. Do not blindly pursue higher realms of power. Merely from the merit of returning the Xuanhuang evil thoughts, even if you do nothing from this point onward, once the Xuanhuang Realm completes its ascension, you will still receive immense benefits."

As his words faded, his figure gradually disappeared.

The expressions of Qiao Gong and the others varied greatly.

Indeed, the moment they witnessed the wonder of the Remnant World Great Wall, all of them felt their hearts shaken and developed the urge to personally witness it up close. Yet Li Fan's words had reminded them of something important.

Within the Star Sea, wonders were often accompanied by great power.

And great power inevitably meant danger.

The Remnant World Great Wall was such a place.

The Immortal Ruins were as well.

Furthermore, stimulating the Xuanhuang Realm's ability to devour and digest only required three or four remnant world fragments as catalysts. There was no need for everyone to participate.

If this journey succeeded, there would still be many future opportunities to earn the merit of assisting the Xuanhuang Realm's ascension.

With such thoughts in mind, everyone began making their own calculations.

Li Fan naturally observed every subtle change in their expressions. After countless reincarnations, he understood their personalities extremely well. A single glance was enough to roughly guess what each person was thinking.

"To walk toward the Dao is the instinct of every cultivator. Yet this path is filled with danger and hardship. Fear, hesitation, and aversion within the heart become obstacles to progress."

"To truly touch what is called the Dao is easier said than done..."

Watching Qiao Gong and the others struggle with choices between life, death, and the pursuit of the Dao, waves of insight naturally arose within Li Fan's heart.

Waiting for the Celestial Spirit of the Super Xuanhuang Realm to integrate with the Dao did not mean Li Fan's own cultivation would cease in the meantime.

"Every breath, every word, every action is cultivation."

"The countless thoughts of living beings are all Dao scriptures."

Upon the Dao Lecture Platform, within the Great Xuan Realm, the thoughts and intentions of innumerable living beings appeared like countless stars. One after another, they flowed into Li Fan's mind and were perceived by him.

They became fuel driving the enormous wheel of his cultivation steadily forward.

His decision in this life to become the Teacher of Heaven and Earth was not a sudden impulse.

In the previous life, when the Holy Emperor lectured on the Dao, he had mentioned the concept of Dao Resonance Longevity.

By tracing the reverse projection of the Dao, one could comprehend the true meaning of Dao Resonance.

Through repeated experiments with False Becomes True, Li Fan had gradually verified the little girl's speculation regarding the Holy Emperor's newly deduced cultivation path.

A projection of the Dao descending from above truly made it easier to touch the Dao itself.

Without such projections, the Great Dao remained hidden beyond the heavens, invisible and intangible. One could only search for traces of it through cultivation and enlightenment, then gradually deepen one's understanding step by step.

Though there were countless Great Daos, how many ordinary cultivators could ever truly behold the Dao's genuine form?

Within the Immortal Ruins, that True Immortal possessed the imitation Dao-inscribed character [Hunger] as assistance, yet still sat in meditation for ten thousand years without achieving a breakthrough.

This alone demonstrated the immense difficulty of comprehending the Dao.

If even a True Immortal found it so difficult, what hope was there for those beneath the True Immortal Realm?

Among all living beings, Li Fan's situation was extraordinarily unique.

With [Truth], it was as though he already stood at the very end of this Great Dao, almost able to touch its ultimate truth.

Because of this, the seemingly miraculous ability False Becomes True could be performed despite his cultivation being only at the Soul Transformation Realm.

Previously, Li Fan could only gradually deepen his understanding of the transformations between truth and falsehood involved in [Truth] by strengthening his "bond" with it.

However, after his comprehension of False Becomes True continued to deepen, and after his encounter with that mysterious symbol hidden deep within the bodies of the You Clan, Li Fan vaguely sensed another possibility.

He could use the principle of drawing inferences from one example and apply understanding gained from other Dao traces to accelerate his comprehension of truth and falsehood.

The projection of the Great Dao descended from above and formed all worlds.

Everything within the Xuanhuang Realm, whether matter or consciousness, could be regarded as a projection of the Dao.

Yet these were already the furthest ends of the projection. To reverse the process and trace the projection back upward toward the Dao itself was almost an impossible task.

However, as the sole surviving land within the Star Sea, the Xuanhuang Realm had already gathered too many impossibilities.

For example, the peculiar existence known as Eternal Remnant Will, which could resonate with the Dao itself.

Earlier in this life, Li Fan had already visited Tianyang Cave Dwelling at the bottom of the Congyun Sea and collected Tianyang's remains containing Eternal Remnant Will.

He tried every possible method but remained unable to sense the Dao resonance within.

Yet Li Fan did not abandon his research into Dao resonance because of this. Instead, he began searching for a lower-level substitute for Eternal Remnant Will.

During the one hundred and nineteenth life, using the Faceless True Immortal Statue as a foundation, Li Fan had created the Network of True Immortal Mortal Compassion.

Among its countless believers, only Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi possessed thoughts that shone with extraordinary brilliance.

Even within the network of source power essence, they were exceptionally conspicuous.

They were genuine Seekers of the Dao with Utmost Sincerity.

Previously, Li Fan had assumed this was merely due to their innate personalities and held no particular value to him.

But now, Li Fan realized that the sincere desire for the Dao possessed by Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi might very well be the embryonic form of Eternal Remnant Will.

In other words, if guided properly and encouraged to continually deepen their pursuit of the Dao, then after their deaths there might be a chance that Eternal Remnant Will would be born.

"I cannot directly utilize Eternal Remnant Will, but can I not make use of a lower-level substitute?"

This discovery regarding Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi gave Li Fan fresh inspiration.

Combined with his intention to make use of the Super Xuanhuang Realm's Celestial Spirit Dao Integration, it naturally led to his role in this life as the Teacher of Heaven and Earth.

Upon the Dao Lecture Platform, the thoughts of countless living beings gathered together.

Like stars in the sky, they varied in brightness.

Those who stood out from the masses received special attention from Li Fan.

Unfortunately, no existence with the potential to advance into Eternal Remnant Will had yet been discovered.

However, Li Fan firmly believed that once the Dao Lecture Platform eventually expanded into the Xuanhuang Realm itself, he would gain more such individuals besides Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi.

As for Kou Hong and the other, with their current experience in this life, they still fell somewhat short of the sincerity in seeking the Dao that they once possessed. Taking them as disciples now would instead interfere with their Dao-seeking hearts. Therefore, Li Fan left them alone for the time being and even deliberately increased the difficulty of their cultivation.

Only when the flowers bloomed and bore fruit in the future would he return to harvest them.

"The Dao projects itself across all worlds. Among the living beings of every world, there will always be some whose nature resonates with Dao Marks. These are the materials I can use to increase my comprehension of the Transformation of Truth and Falsehood."

Having personally experienced the power of False Becomes True, Li Fan had already decided to raise the priority of advancing this path to the second highest level.

Second only to preserving his own life.

As for realm, cultivation, treasures, and the like.

These were things that could be obtained in every reincarnation. They simply could not compare with it.

"However, these brilliant living wills should be like Eternal Remnants. They can probably only be used for Dao comprehension once. I wonder how many people in the entire Xuanhuang Realm can bring me pleasant surprises."

His divine sense swept across the land. Looking at the endless stream of Great Xuan citizens still making their way toward the central Dao Lecture Platform, Li Fan nodded slightly.

His figure flickered, and in the next moment, he had already left the Great Xuan Small World.

He arrived in Qiling Prefecture of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The vast underground space was filled with an invisible and eerie aura.

Even with Li Fan's current cultivation, he still gathered a sufficient amount of source power essence as protection before daring to come here.

Threads of golden light formed a protective formation, isolating him from the terrifying power within the underground chamber.

"My guess was correct. This Ancient Immortal-Mortal Miasma has also undergone sublimation and transformation together with the Xuanhuang Realm."

After carefully observing for a while, Li Fan reached his conclusion.

In the 119th life, an earthquake had occurred in Qiling Prefecture, causing the Ancient Immortal-Mortal Miasma sealed here to leak out and unleash a bloody catastrophe. After accumulating within the underground space for thousands of years, this Ancient Immortal-Mortal Miasma seemed to have undergone a certain mutation, becoming even more powerful than the original version.

The Immortal-Mortal Miasma had been created by Mr. Bai in defiance of the principles of heaven and earth.

Yet it was also a part of those very principles.

Now, as the Xuanhuang Realm in this life gradually transformed toward a Super Xuanhuang Realm, the Ancient Immortal-Mortal Miasma within this underground space was likewise accumulating the power needed for its own metamorphosis.

"A mortal can also slay immortals..."

Li Fan stretched out a hand, and the golden protective formation immediately opened a gap.

The invisible force seized the opportunity and began eroding his palm.

His brows tightly furrowed. After sensing it for only an instant, Li Fan decisively severed his entire arm.

Source power essence then restored the protection, blocking the Immortal-Mortal Miasma's erosion from spreading further.

"Interesting."

Within a few breaths, Li Fan's severed arm had already regrown.

As for the original arm left behind within the Ancient Immortal-Mortal Miasma, it was completely devoured by the surrounding invisible force.

Not even a skeleton remained.

Only a pile of fine sand-like residue was left behind.

A rare trace of excitement flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

Among the items bound to [Truth], there was an item called Ten Thousand Humans Essence Blood.

It had been refined from tens of thousands of condemned prisoners.

Yet the Immortal-Mortal Miasma power contained within that Ten Thousand Humans Essence Blood was not even equal to a single strand of this enhanced Ancient Immortal Mortal Miasma.

"If the Super Xuanhuang Realm completes its final transformation, just how powerful will the Immortal-Mortal Miasma here become?"

According to Li Fan's deductions, with the combined influence of the Star Sea's power of revival, the Great Celestial Venerable's immortal spiritual legacy, the remnants of countless worlds within the Star Sea, and many other forces...

It would be enough to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm to a level infinitely close to the Immortal Realm.

Or perhaps, in a certain sense, this Super Xuanhuang Realm would itself become a newly elevated Immortal Realm.

It would merely be somewhat inferior to that ancient Immortal Realm which had already perished.

"By that time, even if it cannot truly slay immortals, severely injuring them may still be possible."

"More importantly, this Ancient Immortal-Mortal Miasma can continuously grow stronger alongside the Xuanhuang Realm. Its inherent nature of mortals slaying immortals alone guarantees that its value cannot be ignored."

"One day, when I possess the ability to truly elevate the Xuanhuang Realm into an Immortal Realm, this Immortal-Mortal Miasma will become a genuine immortal-slaying weapon."

With this thought, the way Li Fan looked at the invisible force filling the vast chamber had completely changed.

Judging from Xuantian King's experiences back then, as well as some of the clues currently uncovered beyond the High Wall, Achieving immortality within the Star Sea might require facing dangers beyond imagination.

A newly born Immortal Domain would likely attract just as much attention.

But since it would not be Li Fan's true body, even if it really triggered some crisis, it would still give him ample time to react and prepare.

Between becoming an Immortal himself and elevating the Xuanhuang Realm into an Immortal Realm, which was more difficult?

Anyone who was not insane would undoubtedly choose the latter.

But for Li Fan, the conclusion was completely the opposite.

"The Great Celestial Venerable's inheritance and the immortal spiritual qi contained within immortal artifacts are both resources that I can reuse infinitely."

"Beyond that, there are also all the other resources and powers throughout the entire star sea."

Li Fan's thoughts raced rapidly.

"Perhaps it is feasible."

"I only need to wait until the end of this life and see just how far the Super Xuanhuang Realm I personally created still falls short of the legendary Immortal Realm. Then I will be able to reach a conclusion."

The transformation of the Ancient Immortal-Mortal Miasma had opened up an entirely new line of thinking for Li Fan.

Within the Xuanhuang Realm, manifestations of laws existed in countless numbers.

Once the Xuanhuang Realm underwent elevation, these manifestations of laws would likewise ascend together with it.

"The entire Xuanhuang Realm can be regarded as my weapon against Immortals."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

There was a distinction between immortals and mortals.

However, if that mortal stood backed by an entire Immortal Realm, then the final outcome would naturally be a different matter altogether.

"The situation beyond the High Wall remains unknown."

"Using a world as the foundation may make it easier to investigate."

Li Fan carefully arranged formations throughout the underground space.

This was to prevent others from discovering the Ancient Immortal-Mortal Miasma sealed within.

"Continue growing. When you finally reach your limit, that will be the day you are forged into a sword."

Only after ensuring that everything was absolutely secure did Li Fan depart.

"If this plan truly works, then it is time for me to gather some anchor points."

"The more things capable of slaying immortals, the better."

With this thought, Li Fan quietly arrived in the void of the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven within Tianling Prefecture.

At this point in time, the Five Elements Cave Heaven had not yet fully descended.

It perfectly met the requirements for replenishing anchor points: a newly born Cave Heaven.

However, Li Fan had already used the Five Elements Cave Heaven once before to complete a recharge. He was uncertain whether it would still produce a reaction this time.

Familiar with the process, he arrived within the gestation space where black and white intertwined.

Li Fan focused his mind and carefully sensed the feedback transmitted by the [Truth].

"A little difficult to swallow, but still barely edible."

After a long while, Li Fan opened his eyes, his expression somewhat strange.

Steadying himself, his divine sense instantly enveloped the entire Five Elements Great Cave Heaven.

A moment later...

The Cave Heaven mysteriously vanished.

At the same time, the number of anchor points available to Li Fan increased by one.

A faint premonition arose in Li Fan's heart. If he attempted this again, [Truth] would truly have no appetite left.

Unlike the Cave Heavens that had already descended into the world and been devoured before, the current Five Elements Great Cave Heaven was still in the process of gestation.

Its inexplicable disappearance naturally triggered disturbances throughout the surrounding space.

Chapter 1313: The Floating Across Starry Sky Formation Complete

Countless black and white lines suddenly came alive, abandoning their original trajectories as they raced toward Li Fan.

Like innumerable tentacles, they sought to entangle and bind him.

This space, known as the Root of Heaven and Earth, was the birthplace of the Five Elements Great Cave Heavens.

Black and white lines crisscrossed one another, resembling a gigantic weaving machine that continuously wove the fabric of the Xuanhuang world.

Not only the Five Elements Great Cave Heavens, but even the mountains, rivers, blessed lands, and Cave Heavens of the original Xuanhuang Realm had all been born from this place.

It was the origin of the world, the convergence of laws, the beginning of creation itself.

When Li Fan had first witnessed this magnificent spectacle, he could only marvel at the wonders of creation while seizing the rare opportunity to comprehend the fragments of primordial laws drifting through the Root of Heaven and Earth.

Now, after more than a hundred reincarnations and returning once again, Li Fan could see many things that had previously escaped his notice.

For example, although they had become extremely faint and had almost merged completely into the entire Root of Heaven and Earth, there still remained traces that continued to influence its operation from the very foundation.

Artificial traces.

Faced with the instinctive attack of the countless black and white lines within the Root of Heaven and Earth, Li Fan neither dodged nor retreated. He allowed them to pierce deeply into his body.

Under normal circumstances, any cultivator who suffered such an attack would soon find their own body, likewise composed of countless lines, dispersing and dissolving until they vanished completely within this space.

Yet at this moment, a mysterious force existed within Li Fan's body, firmly anchoring every line that composed him.

No matter how the Root of Heaven and Earth attempted to absorb him, he remained completely unmoved.

The anchor that fixed Li Fan firmly in place was naturally the fragment of the Transformation of Truth and Falsehood that he had comprehended.

Anything originating from the Xuanhuang Realm found it nearly impossible to resist this method of returning all things to their source.

But the Transformation of Truth and Falsehood came from [Truth].

It was far beyond the ability of the Root of Heaven and Earth to analyze or separate.

Instead, countless tiny gray marks flowed along the lines piercing his body and spread toward the depths of the Root of Heaven and Earth.

They were not the world-destroying True Immortal seal script characters, but rather innumerable strands of Li Fan's divided divine sense.

He intended to use this attack as an opportunity to probe the secrets of the Root of Heaven and Earth.

Countless scenes flashed before his eyes.

Within the void, light shone steadily.

Each alternation between brightness and darkness represented hundreds of billions of intersections among the lines.

From nothingness came existence.

Within the darkness, a world was being born.

Boom!

Just as Li Fan's consciousness became immersed in the mysterious scene, all the images suddenly shattered.

The Root of Heaven and Earth had sensed Li Fan's intention to infiltrate it.

All the lines embedded in his body instantly faded and dissolved.

His connection to the Root of Heaven and Earth was severed.

Even more, the lines that had continuously woven creation within his vision gradually vanished into the void, becoming impossible to observe any longer.

The surroundings abruptly brightened.

He had been expelled by the Root of Heaven and Earth and returned to the Xuanhuang Tianling Prefecture.

"What a pity."

"Its instinctive danger response was still remarkably swift."

Although he spoke those words, he did not actually feel much regret.

Li Fan narrowed his eyes as he recalled the artificial traces he had just glimpsed.

Investigating the secrets of the Root of Heaven and Earth had merely been a pretext.

His true objective had been to attract its attention so that he could better perceive those hidden imprints.

Some of the imprints were new, while others were ancient.

With Li Fan's current strength, he could barely discern the newer traces.

As for the older ones, they were nearly impossible to distinguish.

Only because he had once encountered a similar aura could he instinctively sense their existence.

New and old were relative concepts.

Even the newer traces were already thousands of years old.

"The Five Elements Great Cave Heavens were the work of the former First Origin Sect."

"They guided the generation of laws within the Root of Heaven and Earth in order to prepare for the world-ending catastrophe."

"With all five elements complete and primordial unity circulating, each became a self-contained world. Every time a Five Elements Great Cave Heaven was conceived, it imposed an enormous burden upon the Xuanhuang Realm. It is like a mortal woman bearing a child."

"Under normal circumstances, giving birth once would already be the limit. Yet the guidance left behind by the First Origin Sect still remains within the Root of Heaven and Earth. Therefore, this process of gestation has never ceased."

A gleam flashed in Li Fan's eyes as he immediately understood the origin of the newer traces.

Pointing forward through the air, he forcefully pushed back into the Root of Heaven and Earth despite the tremendous repulsive force resisting him.

It was as if he had disturbed a hornet's nest.

The countless black and white lines within the Root of Heaven and Earth immediately erupted into violent agitation.

They surged toward Li Fan together, seemingly determined to fight to the death.

This time, however, Li Fan no longer served as a stationary target.

His figure flickered as he evaded the attacks. Using his finger as a blade, he severed the imprints left behind by the First Origin Sect one after another.

Buzz, buzz, buzz...

The Root of Heaven and Earth trembled and resonated.

It seemed to understand Li Fan's intentions.

The furious lines gradually became gentle.

They returned to their original positions and regained their calm.

Within that brief instant, Li Fan had already destroyed every trace the First Origin Sect had left within the Root of Heaven and Earth.

From this day onward, no new Five Elements Great Cave Heavens would ever be born within the Xuanhuang Realm.

After all, Li Fan intended to bring about the birth of a Super Xuanhuang Realm.

The gestation of Five Elements Cave Heavens was unquestionably a drain upon the power of the Xuanhuang world itself.

Naturally, Li Fan would not allow such a process to continue.

Not only the Five Elements Great Cave Heavens, but any other cave heavens whose birth was unnecessary would likewise be prevented from appearing.

All of their power would be conserved for the Xuanhuang Realm.

The repulsive force of the Root of Heaven and Earth had now vanished completely.

Li Fan was finally able to observe the nearly imperceptible ancient traces in greater detail.

"As expected. They are exactly the same as the ancient immortal formation that guarded the Nine-Star Red Bead."

The ancient imprints resembled natural birthmarks.

They had merged almost completely with the space of the Root of Heaven and Earth itself.

Had Li Fan not previously encountered a similar existence, he would likely have mistaken them for an inherent characteristic of the Root of Heaven and Earth.

Part of the imprint had already sunk into the space itself, preventing Li Fan from seeing the immortal formation's complete structure.

However, when compared against the formation data previously deduced within the Final Dissociation Disc, most of it matched perfectly.

"I've finally found you."

A brilliant light appeared in Li Fan's eyes.

The Floating Across Starry Sky Formation, according to his previous deductions, consisted of four subordinate formations.

Throughout his previous reincarnations, Li Fan had already identified three quarters of them.

They were respectively the golden chains used to lock onto and capture cultivation worlds beyond the Star Sea; the Eye of the Heavenly Beast, which served as an observation station; and the Dark Sea, used to escape the gravitational pull of the Immortal Ruins, namely the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation.

As for the remaining one, despite searching throughout the entire Xuanhuang Realm, it had never been discovered.

Even in the previous life when the immortal formation brought about world destruction, Li Fan had been unable to determine its possible location.

Unexpectedly, in this life, while revisiting this place to absorb an anchor point, he instead received an unexpected reward.

"This Floating Across Starry Sky Formation should have been completed by the Xuantian King through modifications made upon the foundation of the original World-Protecting Immortal Formation."

"Unlike the other formations, the degree of modification here is extremely slight. It can almost be said to have remained completely unchanged."

"With the Root of Heaven and Earth continuously weaving creation here, even while traveling through the Star Sea, the Xuanhuang Realm possesses the ability to constantly repair itself and even continuously grow stronger."

"This kind of growth originates from itself. It is different from the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor stitching together external remnant worlds. There are no strange phenomena caused by conflicting world laws, nor any side effects from the fusion process..."

A scene suddenly appeared before Li Fan's eyes.

Within the endless dark void, the Xuanhuang Realm resembled a colossal star-faring vessel slowly advancing forward.

The Eye of the Heavenly Beast was responsible for observation and positioning. The golden chains searched for targets externally and gathered resources. The Dark Sea provided an endless source of power. The Root of Heaven and Earth was responsible for repairs and growth.

It was survival in the Star Sea perfected to the utmost degree.

"Floating Across Starry Sky. Floating Across Starry Sky."

"With this formation, one can indeed traverse the starry sky and ignore calamities. The Xuantian King truly was a peerless genius." Li Fan praised sincerely.

"What a pity..."

"Such an extraordinary figure met with disaster just as he was about to ascend." Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

The disappearance of the Xuantian King was one of the greatest mysteries in the history of the Xuanhuang Realm. Even after so many reincarnations, and even after the immortal formation destroyed the world and tore away every veil concealing the truth, Li Fan still could not uncover what had happened.

He could only vaguely speculate that the process of true ascension carried tremendous danger.

"Although the Xuantian King is no longer here, this Floating Across Starry Sky Formation can still be used by me."

"Previously, I speculated that after the Xuantian King's mysterious disappearance, he might have hidden himself within the final Floating Across Starry Sky Formation. But now it seems..."

Because of Li Fan's assistance with "birth control," the Root of Heaven and Earth had already chosen to overlook his previous devouring of the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven.

However, it had not developed any favorable impression of him either.

It merely allowed Li Fan to wander freely within this world where laws converged.

Though this place appeared boundless, it was actually an illusion created through the intertwining of laws and immortal formations.

As a master of formations, Li Fan did not become lost.

Before long, he had completely searched the interior of the Root of Heaven and Earth.

As expected, he found no trace whatsoever of the Xuantian King's possible presence.

"In the previous life, when the immortal formation destroyed the world, Mo Rubin never appeared either."

"If he remained within the Xuanhuang Realm, with his strength he would definitely have been able to resist for a time. Could it be..."

Li Fan frowned slightly.

There was no reason for Mo Rubin to abandon his long-held objective and simply flee the Xuanhuang Realm. Therefore, there was a high probability that he had gone to the Eye of the Heavenly Beast, located somewhere beyond the Xuanhuang Realm.

"The Eye of the Heavenly Beast serves as the observation formation of the Floating Across Starry Sky Formation. The range it can observe should be far greater than I originally imagined. Perhaps it is not limited merely to the void beyond the world..." A flash of realization appeared in Li Fan's mind.

"The Floating Across Starry Sky Formation has almost become one with the Xuanhuang Realm itself. This Eye of the Heavenly Beast may even be capable of reversing its observation and viewing the Xuanhuang Realm in return. However, Mo Rubin probably does not know its exact location either. Searching for it recklessly within the starry sky carries considerable risk. Therefore, in the 119th life, when I pretended to cooperate with him, he did not choose this path. It was only in the previous life, when the Holy Emperor's clone pursued him and left him with no way out, that he was forced to make that choice."

Li Fan had originally learned of the Eye of the Heavenly Beast through an unfortunate cultivator from Nine Mountains Prefecture who had used a teleportation formation and been randomly transported there. Because of that incident, he had also encountered the Heavenly Doctor, who had sensed his presence.

Fortunately, relying on his own wit, he successfully gained the Heavenly Doctor's trust. What seemed like a disaster turned into a blessing, allowing him to obtain the Heavenly Doctor's secret inheritance, the Record of Mending Heaven.

The probability of randomly teleporting to the Eye of the Heavenly Beast was simply too low, so Li Fan naturally had no intention of attempting it himself.

However, Nine Mountains Prefecture had been formed from the corpse of the Heavenly Beast. It undoubtedly possessed some connection with the distant Eye of the Heavenly Beast. Perhaps that connection could be used to determine its location.

"The Floating Across Starry Sky Formation is also extremely important for my plan to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm in this life."

"Although the formation has already been damaged, if I repair and reactivate it..."

During the era of the Xuantian King, the Floating Across Starry Sky Formation only covered a small portion of the original Xuanhuang Realm.

Compared to the present Xuanhuang Realm, which had merged with many worlds, it encompassed only the central core region.

"I can expand the formation and gradually take control of the Xuanhuang Realm without anyone realizing it."

The Final Dissociation Disc was currently occupied with numerous important tasks and could not spare any attention.

Thus, Li Fan relied solely on his own understanding of the Dao of Formations for the deductions.

Within his sea of consciousness, the Floating Across Starry Sky Formation expanded outward from the center, gradually enveloping the Xuanhuang Realm's sphere of light. In the end, it transformed into a colossal vessel sailing through the Star Sea.

"When expanding and reconstructing the formation, I can incorporate the World-Destroying Immortal Formation that I comprehended in the previous life."

"When the Xuanhuang Realm finally completes its transformation, no matter how powerful the descending immortal soul may be, even if it exceeds my expectations, with the formation serving as its shackles, it will never escape my grasp."

Li Fan contemplated silently.

One had to admit that working upon the foundation laid by predecessors was naturally much easier.

With the groundwork established by the Xuantian King, Li Fan's plans would require barely half the effort.

Or rather, without the Xuantian King's arrangements, it would have been utterly impossible for Li Fan, with his current attainments in formations, to construct a completely new Floating Across Starry Sky Formation.

"At present, there is still too little information regarding the Four Floating Across Starry Sky Formations."

Naturally, Mo Rubin's figure appeared in Li Fan's mind.

During the previous life's battle against the Holy Emperor, Li Fan had already seen through most of Mo Rubin's methods.

As long as he prepared in advance, Li Fan was confident he could control him.

Back then, Mo Rubin had toyed with him. Now the time for reckoning had arrived.

However...

Before seeking out Mo Rubin for revenge and information, Li Fan first went to another Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect.

Dongyong Prefecture. Ring-Shaped Mountain.

Countless flowers formed from spiritual energy filled the sky, creating a breathtaking scene.

Yet Li Fan knew that hidden within those beautiful flowers were the memories of Ji Yuzhen, one of the former Dharma Kings of the Xuantian Sect.

Or rather...

Fragments of her soul.

The cultivation technique practiced by Ji Yuzhen was the Immeasurable Celestial Pivot Sundering Divine Technique.

Even the Xuantian King, Xuanyuan Hong himself, had once praised this divine technique as unparalleled in his life.

Though Ji Yuzhen appeared to have perished, a sliver of life remained hidden among these endless soul flowers.

At the end of the previous life, amid the storm of destruction unleashed by the immortal formation, this place had been one of the final shining strongholds within the territory of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

"My previous memory-probing technique should still have had some flaws."

"There are still true secrets hidden within Ji Yuzhen's memories."

A sharp light flashed through Li Fan's eyes as an ordinary white ring suddenly appeared in his hand.

It was the Descends into Mortal World Ring.

With a gentle toss, the white ring instantly expanded and enveloped the entire Ring-Shaped Mountain.

It descended silently, transforming everything it covered into pure spiritual energy.

The enormous Ring-Shaped Mountain cracked apart layer by layer.

Those soul flowers that had merged with the mountain itself and hidden deep within, almost impossible to detect through ordinary means, slowly drifted outward.

Chapter 1314: Ji Yuzhen’S Memories

After cultivating the Immeasurable Celestial Pivot Sundering Divine Technique, there was a distinction between the countless split souls and the original soul.

What Li Fan had discovered previously within the crater of Dongyong Prefecture were merely memories belonging to those countless split souls.

The truly important original soul had never been found.

Only now, when the White Ring, Descends into Mortal World, acted and completely annihilated the Ring-Shaped Mountain, did the original soul hidden within finally reveal itself.

Unlike the countless spiritual energy flowers drifting outside, the soul flowers concealed within the crater seemed to remain dormant.

Even when approached directly, they would not launch any attacks.

After losing their hiding place and becoming exposed, these soul flowers began gathering together spontaneously according to a certain pattern.

Gradually, they merged into a gigantic glowing white flower.

Throughout the crater region, the countless spiritual energy flowers drifting between heaven and earth seemed to have found a leader. They revolved around the glowing white flower.

Within the growing storm, the original soul flower gradually became identical to those spiritual energy flowers.

It seemed to be attempting to conceal itself in this manner.

Unfortunately, the instant the crater collapsed and the soul flowers scattered outward, Li Fan's vast and boundless divine sense had already locked onto all of them.

How could such a crude deception possibly fool Li Fan?

Yet Li Fan quickly realized that he was mistaken.

When his divine sense touched one fragment of the original soul flower, the scene transmitted from it felt strangely familiar.

It was precisely a scene he had previously encountered within an ordinary spiritual energy flower.

"So there is indeed something clever about it. Even after being locked onto by me, it can silently exchange and transfer itself..."

Looking at the trillions upon trillions of flowers before him, Li Fan let out a cold snort.

"But now that I have discovered you, how could I possibly allow you to escape again?"

"You hide within an endless sea of flowers. Then I shall boil the sea."

"Xuanhuang World-Destruction Transformation: Heavenly Extermination, Earthly Ruination, Soul Gathering and Life Condensation!"

Monstrous killing intent suddenly surged from Li Fan's body.

His eyes became completely black.

The killing aura condensed into tangible form, becoming countless tiny tendrils swaying in the wind.

Within these black strands of killing intent, bolts of lightning could faintly be seen.

It was as if heavenly punishment had descended, seeking to exterminate every living being in existence.

This was one of the transformations within Li Fan's Xuanhuang World-Destruction Transformation.

When Xuanhuang faced total destruction, in order to survive, it would slaughter every living being within the world.

Absorbing their flesh, blood, and souls to increase its chances of surviving the cataclysm.

This transformation was even more extreme than the Heavenly Heat Death, All Things Frozen transformation Li Fan had used previously.

It was a desperate transformation of survival where nothing remained except oneself.

Above Dongyong Prefecture, boundless black clouds rolled in from the horizon.

This was a stress response generated by the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao after sensing the extreme change occurring here.

Li Fan even noticed that because of the birth of this worldly life transformation, the Xuanhuang Realm's attitude toward him was rapidly deteriorating.

The favor he had painstakingly accumulated before was almost instantly reduced to zero.

However, Li Fan did not care.

The tendrils of killing intent continuously branched into new offshoots.

Every spiritual energy flower they could reach was wrapped up and violently pierced.

One after another, the spiritual energy flowers withered.

At the same time, streams of incomparably pure energy, carrying traces of strange and eerie auras, were extracted and gathered together.

Mixed within them were numerous fragmented memory pieces.

Some belonged to Ji Yuzhen.

Others belonged to cultivators who had perished here.

Li Fan separated and organized those belonging to Ji Yuzhen, gradually piecing together complete scenes.

At the same time, his mind remained highly focused, waiting for the original split soul to reveal itself.

The immortal arts of the Xuantian Sect each possessed their own mysterious characteristics.

To be safe, Li Fan did not greedily absorb the energy transformed from these spiritual energy flowers.

Instead, he gathered it all in one place and sealed it with source power essence.

The black tendrils danced wildly.

Meanwhile, the flowers filling the sky disappeared in vast swathes at a visible rate.

Very soon, the first original soul could no longer remain hidden and was found by Li Fan.

He did not drain or destroy the soul.

Instead, he merely peered into the memories hidden within it.

Boom!

Like images flashing through a lantern of life, countless scenes rapidly swept past.

Everything seemed covered by a layer of white light, brightening and dimming intermittently. Like viewing flowers through mist, indistinct and elusive.

"Zhen'er, have you remembered the method for activating the [Golden Chains Across the Sky Formation]?"

The voice of the Xuantian King sounded.

Yet his face was concealed beneath white light, making it impossible to see clearly.

"Brother Xuanyuan, do you really think I'm that foolish?" Ji Yuzhen asked teasingly.

The Xuantian King quickly explained:

"Zhen'er, do not misunderstand. I know your talent is no less than mine. However, this formation was modified from an immortal formation. The difference between immortals and mortals is difficult to truly comprehend unless one has personally experienced it."

"Since Brother Xuanyuan is so worried, then teach me once more," Ji Yuzhen replied softly.

"Well... very well."

After hesitating briefly, the Xuantian King nodded.

He said solemnly:

"The Golden Chains Across the Sky Formation spans across all heavens. Even if the target lies on the far side of the star sea, once locked onto, the chains can arrive instantly and capture it."

"I told you before that this effect is possible because it contains the Near Yet Distant Grand Formation. This formation was originally engraved upon the Ascension Platform of the Immortal Realm. When I escaped, I brought down the entire immortal formation..."

Looking at Xuanyuan Hong, Ji Yuzhen seemed to imagine him fleeing for his life while collecting immortal relics along the way.

Unable to restrain herself, she laughed again.

"Even though this isn't the first time I've heard it, I still find it difficult to imagine that Brother Xuanyuan is actually this kind of person."

Xuanyuan Hong coughed awkwardly.

"The Immortal Realm suffered catastrophe. It was obvious that the lower realms would eventually be affected as well. Naturally, I had to make more preparations. Besides, they were ownerless objects already..."

The Xuantian King seriously defended himself before continuing his explanation.

"The position of cultivation worlds observed by the Eye of the Heavenly Beast may differ slightly from their actual locations due to spatial and temporal drift within the star sea. Therefore, when using the Golden Chains to capture a target, corresponding adjustments must be made."

"At present, there is no good method for resolving this deviation. Everything depends upon the experience and intuition of the formation's controller."

"The Near Yet Distant Grand Formation consumes enormous amounts of power. After operating for a period of time, it requires repairs and replenishment."

"However, there is no need to worry about damage. I have already created three duplicate copies of the core components."

"At worst, the capture efficiency will decrease somewhat. It will not affect the formation's functionality."

The Xuantian King explained everything in meticulous detail.

Ji Yuzhen also listened carefully to every word.

However, her gaze remained fixed upon Xuanyuan Hong's face from beginning to end.

It never once moved away.

...

Returning from the memory to reality, Li Fan carefully sealed away this original soul.

Then he turned his attention toward the remainder of the sea of flowers.

As more and more incorrect possibilities were eliminated, the collection of original souls became increasingly rapid.

One memory of Ji Yuzhen after another emerged continuously.

...

The scene was vaguely that of a secret chamber.

Ji Yuzhen and Xuanyuan Hong stood facing each other.

"Brother Xuanyuan, you've finally come to your senses. You actually invited me here alone." Ripples flickered in Ji Yuzhen's beautiful eyes as she gazed at the Xuantian King.

"Zhen'er, stop fooling around. We have important matters to discuss today," Xuanyuan Hong said seriously.

"The other eleven brothers and sisters have already completed their selection of immortal arts. Only you have yet to make a decision..."

"I already said that I want Big Brother Xuanyuan to choose for me." Ji Yuzhen interrupted him.

A helpless expression appeared on Xuanyuan Hong's face.

"The reason I called you here is precisely for this matter."

"Has Big Brother Xuanyuan already chosen one for me?"

"The Immeasurable Celestial Pivot Sundering Divine Technique. Even among all the immortal arts I collected, it is among the very best. It can divide one's soul into countless portions. As long as the soul remains unextinguished, it can neither perish nor be destroyed. More importantly, it can nurture and split one's soul into Original Souls. Each Original Soul can walk its own independent immortal path..." the Xuantian King explained at length.

"I trust Big Brother. I'll cultivate this one."

Before the Xuantian King could finish speaking, Ji Yuzhen had already made her decision.

Xuanyuan Hong paused briefly and nodded slightly.

He pointed at his own forehead.

Then one dark character after another flew out from within.

Xuanyuan Hong closed his eyes, his expression calm.

Yet from time to time, his brows furrowed, as if he were enduring immense pain.

"The soul is the flower of life. When it wanders through the Great Void, its bloom resembles the fresh green of spring willows, flourishing without disorder, divided yet capable of reunion..."

The moment Ji Yuzhen saw those drifting dark characters, an incomparably profound cultivation method appeared in her mind.

Not only the contents of the technique itself, but also countless memories of cultivating it, together with detailed insights and realizations.

Though she was only beginning to learn it, it felt as if she had already reincarnated hundreds or thousands of times and cultivated it countless times before.

After an unknown period of time, the dark characters slowly returned to the Xuantian King's sea of consciousness.

"Brother Xuanyuan, are you alright?"

Ji Yuzhen hurried forward in concern.

On Xuanyuan Hong's face, countless savage and ferocious visages suddenly flashed past, seemingly trying to seize control.

Yet in the end, his appearance returned to Xuanyuan Hong's original face.

"Brother Xuanyuan, you could have simply transcribed the technique. Why did you have to use this method of inheritance?" Ji Yuzhen reproached him slightly.

Xuanyuan Hong sighed softly.

"Zhen'er, the complexity of immortal arts is far beyond that of lower realm cultivation methods. Although your talent is extraordinary, without inheritance guidance, merely reaching the introductory stage of this Soul Separation Divine Technique would likely consume more than ten years of your life."

"We do not have that much time."

Ji Yuzhen remained silent.

Xuanyuan Hong continued:

"Besides, judging from the cultivation progress of our other brothers and sisters, the difference between receiving inheritance transmission and not receiving it is obvious. It is most likely a restriction inherent to the techniques contained within the Azure Firmament Pearl."

"This Azure Firmament Pearl may not be a good thing." Ji Yuzhen let out a cold snort.

Xuanyuan Hong did not agree.

"There is no distinction between righteous and evil techniques. Everything depends on the cultivator who uses them. The Azure Firmament Pearl is the same."

"It can absorb the corpses of fallen cultivators and refine the cultivation methods they practiced in life. That alone is enough to demonstrate how extraordinary this pearl is."

"It is just a pity that I obtained it too late. I could only hastily scan the nearby corpses before fleeing in a hurry."

Xuanyuan Hong's voice carried a trace of regret.

...

Scene after scene flashed through Li Fan's mind.

They were all episodes from the life of Ji Yuzhen, one of the Dharma Kings of the Xuantian Sect.

Compared to the fragments preserved within the flower of spiritual energy, the memories contained within the Original Soul were far more complete.

Moreover, they all involved many hidden secrets of the Xuantian Sect's Xuantian King.

For example, the origin of the immortal arts cultivated by the Dharma Kings of the Xuantian Sect, and that mysterious immortal treasure, the Azure Firmament Pearl.

For example, the methods used to activate and control the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation and the golden chains spanning the heavens.

And also the various moments Ji Yuzhen shared with Xuanyuan Hong.

However, something puzzled Li Fan.

The memories within this Original Soul were still incomplete.

Certain crucial fragments were missing.

Li Fan swept his gaze across the surroundings, making sure there were no more wandering flowers of spiritual energy.

"Did they escape while I was not paying attention?"

"Or... were those Original Souls never preserved in the first place?"

From Ji Yuzhen's memories, Li Fan had obtained the complete contents of the Soul Separation Divine Technique.

Although, without the proper method of transmission, one could not truly begin cultivating it.

He still gained a general understanding of this Immortal technique.

Aside from being able to split one's soul into countless parts and achieve a state akin to immortality, the Original Soul had an even greater purpose.

After attaining the Dao, it could serve as a medicinal catalyst.

Whether consumed by oneself or by another, it could completely merge and harmonize two entirely different Dao paths.

What True Immortals pursued was a particular Great Dao.

A Great Dao was unique.

Not only did it reject other cultivators who practiced the same Dao, but it was also extremely difficult to cultivate two different Dao paths simultaneously.

Yet the Soul Separation Divine Technique could cleverly resolve this limitation.

Compared to its heaven-defying ability of Dao Fusion, the healing effects gained from consuming an Original Soul were hardly worth mentioning.

"From what I learned in those memories, when the Xuantian King was injured, Ji Yuzhen once considered feeding her Original Soul to him."

"Now that her most important Original Soul is missing, could it be that she found the Xuantian King at the very last moment and sacrificed herself to save him?"

Li Fan could not help but speculate.

Ji Yuzhen had clearly loved the Xuantian King deeply.

Yet for some reason, Xuanyuan Hong had never accepted her feelings. He had even deliberately kept his distance from her.

Sacrificing herself to save the Xuantian King was entirely the sort of thing Ji Yuzhen would do.

"Xuantian King..."

Li Fan murmured softly as he raised his head and glanced at the sky.

The dark clouds accumulating over the Xuanhuang Realm had already reached their limit. It seemed as though they could collapse from the heavens at any moment.

Having absorbed all the scattered fragments of Ji Yuzhen's divine soul, Li Fan dispersed the Heaven Extermination, Earth Ruination Transformation.

His figure flickered and vanished from the spot.

The heavenly phenomenon in the sky disappeared along with him.

The cultivators of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, who had previously been blocked outside by an invisible barrier, arrived belatedly.

When they discovered that the crater and flowers of spiritual energy had vanished without a trace, they were greatly alarmed and hurriedly reported the matter to the Alliance headquarters.

...

Li Fan did not immediately seek out Mo Rubin.

Instead, he entered seclusion first to digest the memories contained within Ji Yuzhen's divine soul.

The Dharma King’s life, even with some of its most important portions missing, was still unimaginably vast.

In particular, the Original Soul contained not only memories, but also the thoughts and emotions Ji Yuzhen had experienced at the time.

While observing them, one would inevitably be eroded by those emotions as well.

To prevent himself from being influenced, or worse, possessed in turn by Ji Yuzhen, Li Fan would pause after experiencing each segment of memory and erase the emotions that had seeped into his mind.

"The memories of Ji Yuzhen's first meeting with the Xuantian King are also missing. It seems they were the most important reason she fell in love with him, and one of her most treasured memories."

"However, Ji Yuzhen's memories of the other eleven Dharma Kings have been preserved."
