Chapter 1315: The Xuantian Sect Dharma Kings

Apart from Ji Yuzhen, the figures of the other eleven Dharma Kings of the Xuantian Sect appeared one after another before Li Fan.

Sun Xingwang, mysterious and eccentric, who spent all year hidden within the shadows.

The giant Sikong Lin, bold and heroic, unconstrained by trivial matters.

Mo Rubin, a man of few words who followed the Xuantian King without question.

Cui Zhiyuan, the eldest and most senior among all the Dharma Kings.

Zhou Yangli, the youngest among them, yet exceptionally sharp and brilliant.

Gongye Tianzong, with a thick beard and powerful physique, whose attainments in artifact refining had reached the pinnacle. Even the Xuantian King, after returning from the Immortal Realm, would occasionally seek his advice.

Luo Yichen, the peerless beauty of the Xuanhuang Realm. She always kept her face covered with white cloth. Originally, she excelled in dual cultivation and had countless lovers. Later, she killed every cultivator with whom she had once been involved in order to rectify her Dao Heart.

Auntie Nie, who controlled the Langhuan Immortal Tower, one of the largest merchant associations in the Xuanhuang Realm. Her network of informants spread throughout the world, and she handled all matters with remarkable skill and tact.

Xing Wuque, whose limbs were all missing and whose facial features had been destroyed. He permanently wore a bronze fanged mask and almost never communicated with others.

The plump and smiling peacemaker, Tian Xingke.

Yue Qianjie, the martial pillar among the Twelve Dharma Kings, universally acknowledged as the strongest in combat. Obsessed with battle, he was proficient in all forms of cultivation arts.

...

Of these people, Li Fan had only seen most of them once through Ji Yuzhen's memories and knew little about them.

Some of them, however, he was extremely familiar with.

"In the previous life, Mo Rubin personally told the Holy Emperor's clone that his strength ranked among the lowest of the Twelve Dharma Kings."

"At the time I thought it was merely a modest exaggeration, but now it seems..." Li Fan observed the limited memories remaining within Ji Yuzhen's recollections.

Although they were all among the Twelve Dharma Kings, Ji Yuzhen's heart had been entirely devoted to Xuanyuan Hong. She was not particularly close with the other Dharma Kings and merely regarded them as colleagues. However, she still possessed a rough understanding of their relative strengths.

Though there had never been any formal competition among them, Mo Rubin's strength truly ranked near the bottom among the Twelve Dharma Kings.

However, that impression was formed before the Dharma Kings abandoned their original cultivation methods and switched to the immortal techniques bestowed by the Xuantian King.

The immortal techniques were unimaginably profound. After their conversion, Ji Yuzhen could no longer discern the depths of anyone's cultivation.

"The giant skeleton Senior Sister Zhao discovered inside that cave was Sikong Lin. Sun Xingwang's cultivation technique was also left there. It seems he likely met a grim fate as well."

"Mo Rubin remains asleep. As for the others..."

After the destruction of the Xuantian Cult, the Ten Great Immortal Sects had continuously pursued them.

Even so, Li Fan did not believe that all the Dharma Kings except Mo Rubin had perished.

"Perhaps they are still sleeping somewhere within the Xuanhuang Realm, recovering from their injuries."

Li Fan shook his head slightly, not particularly concerned.

Even though they had once stood at the pinnacle of the Xuanhuang Realm, anyone unable to survive the World-Destroying Immortal Formation was not worthy of entering Li Fan's sight.

In his previous life, among those points of light that endured until the very end amidst the World-Destroying Storm, none of these Dharma Kings of the Xuantian Sect were present.

"Unless the survivors among them have long since left the Xuanhuang Realm."

This thought suddenly flashed through Li Fan's mind.

After spending half a month, Li Fan finally finished digesting all of Ji Yuzhen's memories.

Apart from the information concerning the Twelve Dharma Kings, the most important gains were the Azure Firmament Pearl, as well as the method for controlling the Golden Chains Across the Sky component of the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation.

Xuanyuan Hong had once displayed this treasure from the Immortal Realm before Ji Yuzhen.

Just as its name implied, the pearl contained the image of a deep azure sky flowing slowly within its surface. Aside from analyzing the cultivation techniques practiced by a cultivator before death and transforming them into inheritances stored within the pearl, the Azure Firmament Pearl was also said to possess another astonishing ability.

It could devour other immortal artifacts and copy their original powers, transferring those abilities into itself.

Unfortunately, the Azure Firmament Pearl was itself an immortal artifact. Activating it required enormous quantities of immortal spiritual qi. Xuanyuan Hong had merely introduced its functions to Ji Yuzhen and never personally demonstrated this ability.

"This Azure Firmament Pearl is truly a priceless treasure."

"It is said that within the Xuantian Sect there exists a secret technique known as Replacing Heaven in Its Stead. Not only can it completely strip away cultivation techniques and cultivation levels, but it can even transfer the realms and strength gained through cultivating Xuantian Sect techniques to another person."

"Perhaps that is accomplished through the Azure Firmament Pearl. After all, the immortal techniques cultivated by the Dharma Kings all originated from inheritances within the pearl."

"The Azure Firmament Pearl is an immortal treasure. It should absolutely be able to withstand the World-Destroying Immortal Formation. Yet during the storm in the previous life, I never saw any trace of it..."

Many thoughts flashed through Li Fan's mind.

Eventually, his thoughts converged and his gaze settled on a transparent figure wrapped within a golden net woven from source power essence.

The figure was extremely faint, as though it could completely dissipate at any moment.

More importantly, it was incomplete, torn apart and ragged beyond recognition.

This blurry figure was naturally Ji Yuzhen's original soul.

"Even after being subjected to such treatment, its vitality remains unextinguished. As expected of an immortal technique."

"And although the most essential portion of the original soul is already missing, I can still feel a faint temptation..." Li Fan silently praised.

Faced with such a delicious feast of soul essence, Li Fan did not choose to devour it immediately.

Instead, he directed a gentle stream of pure soul power toward the damaged original soul.

Like an adhesive, it slowly pieced together Ji Yuzhen's fragmented original soul, stabilizing it.

Naturally, this soul power did not belong to Li Fan himself.

It came from the countless ordinary soul fragments of Ji Yuzhen that had just been destroyed.

Originating from the same source, they merged without any resistance.

Golden light continued to wrap around the sleeping original soul, completely sealing it.

With a wave of his hand, Li Fan withdrew the golden light.

Then he flashed away and appeared at the ruins of the Purple Heaven Sect, his gaze falling upon Mo Rubin below.

Li Fan let out a cold snort but did not disturb him.

Instead, he silently began weaving an enormous golden net outside the hidden space where Mo Rubin resided.

The Final Dissociation Disc's deduction work on degrading immortal formations had already produced preliminary results.

Using source power essence in place of immortal spiritual qi to construct formations would inevitably result in somewhat weaker power compared to true immortal formations.

Nevertheless, they still stood at the absolute limit of the mortal world, impossible to break unless one had reached the level of the Supreme.

From beginning to end, Mo Rubin never awakened.

Yet the space he occupied was already covered by the immortal formation and transferred elsewhere.

After temporarily placing the two surviving Dharma Kings of the Xuantian Sect together, Li Fan did not wake either of them.

After learning of the Azure Firmament Pearl from Ji Yuzhen's memories, a vague plan had begun to form in his mind.

"Both Mo Rubin and Ji Yuzhen cultivated techniques inherited from the Azure Firmament Pearl."

"Does that mean an extremely subtle connection exists between them and the Azure Firmament Pearl? Even if this connection is almost imperceptible, it is still real."

"It is similar to how the Divine Tree on the Xuan Immortal Ark, which evolved from the Seed of Transformation, still retained a connection with Ruomu after it devoured the Outer-Realm Divine Tree of the Xuanhuang Divine Wood Sect."

"In the previous life, the Xuan Immortal Ark used the power of the True Immortal seal script to magnify that hidden connection. As a result, it was able to lock onto the location of the Xuanhuang Realm beneath the Immortal Ruins from across the star sea."

"If I follow the same method, perhaps I can trace the connection back and locate the Azure Firmament Pearl, or even the Xuantian King himself."

A sharp light flashed in Li Fan's eyes.

The only obstacle at present was that among the True Immortal seal script characters Li Fan had learned while possessing Zhao Xian in the Xuan Immortal Ark during his previous life, none possessed the ability to amplify the connections between things.

However, this was not a major problem for Li Fan.

Before long, he would be taking Yin Shangren and the others to the Remnant World Great Wall beneath the High Wall. They would happen to pass by the Xuan Immortal Ark on the way.

Having already gained a thorough understanding of the temperaments of the ruling elders of the Immortal Ark, Li Fan believed that borrowing this True Immortal seal script character from them would not be difficult.

After setting up the Pseudo-Immortal Formation and sealing the two Xuantian Sect Dharma Kings, all the source power essence accumulated over these past days had been exhausted.

Moreover, maintaining the operation of the Immortal Formation required a continuous supply of source power essence.

"Without Cat Treasure's abilities of lifeform simulation and marrow cleansing, it is still impossible for me, with my current methods, to replicate the bloodline of the Great Celestial Venerable."

"I can only use the flesh and blood factory cultivation method of exotic beasts to produce as many You Clansmen as possible."

In this life, Li Fan entrusted the task of cultivating the You Clansmen to the Empire small world.

With Xu Ke personally stepping forward, the Empire small world offered no resistance whatsoever. After Xiao Qing, Xiao Hong, and the Imperial Daughter received the experience and memories contained within Li Fan's Dao Teacher phantom, they immediately devoted themselves to practical implementation.

The entire strength of the Empire Small World was mobilized to cultivate the You Clansmen.

"Compared to direct replication through the flesh and blood factory, they still have to go through a complete growth cycle. The efficiency is far lower. But this is currently the best method available."

Of course, Li Fan could also generate vast amounts of source power essence through the remaining statue of the Faceless True Immortal.

Since he had escaped from the True Immortal Net once, Li Fan could escape from it countless times.

In a sense, he could almost completely ignore the threat posed by the Faceless True Immortal.

Especially now that he knew of Cat Treasure's existence.

"I just wonder what kind of reaction the Faceless True Immortal would have if it were drawn here and then happened to run straight into Cat Treasure..."

Li Fan could not help imagining such a scene.

Of course, it was only a passing thought.

Whether it was the Faceless True Immortal or Cat Treasure, both were existences beyond his control.

Even his greatest trump card at present, the Immortal-grade formation, probably could not affect them in the slightest.

Therefore, for now, he could only avoid them.

"But not for much longer."

A faint light flashed in Li Fan's eyes.

After reaching Dao Integration in this life, he might be able to conduct some experiments.

...

Time passed in a flash.

There were still ten days remaining before Yin Shangren and the others would make their final decision.

During this period, aside from creating Dao Teaching phantoms and continuing to spread teachings in the Great Xuan Small World, Li Fan also summoned Ou Daozi and his son Ou Shangtian.

Ou Daozi himself was not important.

The important one was Ou Shangtian.

At this point in time, the powers of the Kun-Qian Bone Hand and the Book of Ten Thousand Deaths within his body had not yet truly awakened.

As Heaven and Earth Wonders fused with Immortal Artifacts, both possessed unimaginable powers.

Especially in this life, as the Xuanhuang Realm underwent transformation and sublimation, these two Wonders within Ou Shangtian were also changing accordingly.

Li Fan carefully observed the specific conditions within Ou Shangtian's body.

The Kun-Qian Bone Hand had merged completely with his arm, making the two almost indistinguishable.

Meanwhile, the Book of Ten Thousand Deaths remained hidden within Ou Shangtian's sea of consciousness.

At present, it existed only as a faint transparent trace and had not yet revealed its true form.

"So this is what they call a Child of Destiny."

Li Fan sensed the continuing connection between the wonders inside Ou Shangtian and the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm and could not help thinking this.

He hoped to discover the patterns by which Immortal Artifacts circulated throughout the world after being devoured by the Xuanhuang Realm, thereby uncovering clues to other ancient Immortal Artifacts.

Yet the process appeared completely random.

Ou Shangtian himself possessed no special physique.

He had merely been chosen by the Heavenly Dao of Xuanhuang at birth to serve as the companion host of these Immortal Artifacts.

Given Li Fan's understanding of the Heavenly Dao of Xuanhuang, there was certainly some hidden purpose behind this arrangement.

After all, Xuanhuang cultivators devoured heaven and earth itself. The Heavenly Dao harbored immense hatred toward cultivators.

There was no reason for it to bestow blessings upon them.

"The only explanation that makes sense is that the Heavenly Dao of Xuanhuang lacks the ability to digest these Immortal Artifacts itself."

"So it requires cultivators as intermediaries."

"The Immortal Artifacts are first transformed through the cultivator's body. Then, after the cultivator dies, the power contained within the artifacts returns to heaven through Returning the Dao to Heaven, allowing the Heavenly Dao of Xuanhuang to absorb it."

Li Fan looked toward the sky of the Xuanhuang Realm.

"What a brilliant scheme."

Placing his hand atop the head of the sleeping Ou Shangtian, Li Fan sensed the process by which the two Wonders merged into his body and gradually confirmed his speculation.

"However, this method is something worth learning."

His other hand produced an ancient mirror.

It was none other than the Sun family's treasured artifact, the Boundless Mirror.

Its mirror spirit had already been erased by Li Fan.

A fabricated personality had taken its place.

Meanwhile, the Sun family remained completely unaware that anything had happened to their treasured artifact.

Due to the shortage of source power essence, the Obliterating Wind Calamity hidden within the Boundless Mirror had not yet been completely removed.

Therefore, Li Fan had no plans to use the Boundless Mirror for the time being.

Although the Boundless Mirror was an Immortal Artifact, its most important deduction function was completely useless to Li Fan. Furthermore, because of the effects of the Obliterating Wind Calamity, it no longer contained any Immortal spiritual qi.

As far as Li Fan was concerned, the Boundless Mirror held very little value.

Previously, he had even attempted to use Descends into Mortal World White Ring to dismantle the Boundless Mirror and see whether it could be converted into immortal spiritual qi.

Unfortunately, Descends into Mortal World seemed to possess some inherent limitation regarding Immortal Artifacts. The White Ring dismantling ability simply did not activate.

"It is not that it cannot dismantle them. There are simply special restrictions."

Li Fan's thoughts wandered regarding the origin of the White Ring.

Originally, he had thought the Boundless Mirror would become little more than a burdensome possession.

Yet the methods employed by the Xuanhuang Realm gave him inspiration.

"If the Boundless Mirror were transformed into a law-based Wonder, then merged into the Heavenly Dao of Xuanhuang through the death of a cultivator..."

"Taking the idea further, not just Immortal Artifacts like the Boundless Mirror."

"Perhaps any foreign object from the Star Sea could be handled in this way."

"In addition to Star Sea revival, Immortal spiritual qi, and the residual power of remnant worlds, there is now another path to strengthen the Xuanhuang Realm."

Li Fan tightly gripped the Boundless Mirror.

The Xuanhuang World-Destroying Transformation: Passage of Shifting Times, Blue Seas Becoming Mulberry Fields, activated instantly.

This transformation was originally a method by which the Xuanhuang Realm accelerated its own evolution in order to discover a way to survive world-destroying calamities.

In an instant, the spacetime surrounding the Boundless Mirror seemed to accelerate countless times.

Chapter 1316: A Single Sword Crossing The Star Sea

It was not that the flow of time itself had truly changed.

Rather, the rate of evolution of the Xuanhuang Realm surrounding the Boundless Mirror had expanded by countless times.

It was as if an acceleration switch had been pressed. Within a single breath, light and shadow flickered and alternated tens of millions of times.

The ancient Boundless Mirror visibly grew more weathered and aged.

One could even clearly see tiny gray particles, like grains of dust, drifting out from the Boundless Mirror, carried away by the wind before dispersing into the air.

One of Li Fan's divine soul incarnations had remained hidden within the Boundless Mirror for nearly an entire lifetime. It could be said that Li Fan understood the Boundless Mirror even better than its original artifact spirit, Sun Luyao.

Therefore, he could clearly discern the changes occurring to the Boundless Mirror.

"So this is the process by which the Xuanhuang world digests it..."

Although the shell of the Boundless Mirror was gradually dissolving, the power of the deduction laws contained within it lingered without dispersing.

Clearly, the level of an Immortal Artifact still exceeded that of the current Xuanhuang Realm. Thus, the Xuanhuang Realm did not possess the ability to completely digest it.

Space and time continued evolving at a speed multiplied millions of times over.

The ancient Boundless Mirror gradually decayed until only the mirror surface remained.

In the end, even that completely dissolved.

Only a phantom remained, quietly floating in the air.

As if sensing this free-floating Immortal Artifact law power, a mysterious transformation descended upon the Xuanhuang Realm.

The change was almost formless and invisible.

Yet with Li Fan's current strength and understanding of the Xuanhuang Realm, he could clearly see everything happening before his eyes.

A transparent human figure appeared beside the phantom of the Boundless Mirror.

The Passage of Shifting Times, Blue Seas Becoming Mulberry Fields seemed incapable of affecting it in the slightest.

The transparent figure drifted closer and gradually overlapped with the phantom.

It was as though it had swallowed the Boundless Mirror into its stomach.

Then, like ripples spreading across a water surface, the human figure slowly merged into the Xuanhuang world and vanished from Li Fan's sight.

From beginning to end, the figure never even glanced at Li Fan.

It was as if carrying away the law power of the Boundless Mirror was the only thing that mattered to it.

"A Spirit of Heaven and Earth. A type I have never seen before."

"And unlike all other Spirit of Heaven and Earth, cultivators who see it do not feel any greed or desire to devour it..."

Li Fan withdrew the World-Destroying Transformation divine ability and gazed into the distance.

He seemed to see that somewhere within the Xuanhuang Realm at this very moment, that transparent human figure had attached itself to a newborn infant.

As the child grew, a new Boundless Mirror would eventually be born.

However, it would no longer be an Immortal Artifact.

Instead, it would become a Heaven and Earth Wondrous object of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Under normal circumstances, for the Xuanhuang Realm to complete the entire process of digestion and transformation would require thousands or even tens of thousands of years.

Yet under the enhancement of Li Fan's World-Destroying Transformation, the entire process was completed in less than half a day.

Logically speaking, helping the Xuanhuang Realm consume an Immortal Artifact should have increased its favorability toward him somewhat.

But after waiting for quite a while, Li Fan noticed no increase in goodwill whatsoever.

After pondering briefly, he understood.

The transformation of Seas Becoming Mulberry Fields also represented a form of lifespan expenditure for the Xuanhuang Realm.

The gains and losses effectively canceled each other out.

Li Fan did not care much about this.

The increase in the Xuanhuang Realm's strength was real.

Every bit of growth in the Xuanhuang Realm would ultimately be reflected in the future Xuanhuang Immortal Spirit.

And he would always be the final beneficiary.

Retracting his gaze, Li Fan vaguely sensed that as the law power of the Boundless Mirror merged into the Xuanhuang Realm, a qualitative transformation was brewing.

"The Dao of deduction from the Boundless Mirror does not currently exist within the Xuanhuang Realm. Once the Xuanhuang Realm fully absorbs and utilizes it..."

"A Heavenly Dao capable of foreseeing the future. Interesting."

The Heavenly Dao likely possessed records of nearly all events that had occurred or were occurring within the Xuanhuang Realm.

With such an enormous quantity of information supporting it, its ability to deduce the future might even surpass the Boundless Mirror at its peak.

"This is the highest realm of deduction mentioned in the Nine Volumes of Derivation of Heavens of the Taiyan Sect, replacing human calculations with the calculations of Heaven."

"For the Xuanhuang Realm, devouring Immortal Artifacts is not merely a matter of increasing strength. More importantly, it is the completion of its laws. With each Immortal Artifact it consumes, it moves one step closer to becoming a true Immortal Realm."

A sudden realization surfaced in Li Fan's mind.

...

Ten days later.

The Great Xuan Dao Lecture Platform.

Yin Shangren, Hundred Flowers, Qiao Gong, and Xu Ke had already arrived.

All were waiting for Li Fan's appearance.

Their determination to seek the Dao had ultimately overcome their fear of the unknown risks ahead.

"The last time we traveled to the center of the Star Sea and back, it took nearly a month and a half. This time we're heading to the foot of the High Wall. I wonder how long it will take," Qiao Gong remarked.

"The Holy Teacher said that the fringes of the Star Sea are even more dangerous. It would not be surprising if the round trip took several years," Hundred Flowers replied with a frown.

Yin Shangren smiled.

"Think positively. Perhaps we'll encounter some disaster along the way and never return."

Qiao Gong and Hundred Flowers were both speechless.

As they continued discussing, Li Fan's figure appeared upon the Dao Discussion Platform.

Rather than immediately leading them on the journey, he sat cross-legged with a solemn expression and began teaching the Dao.

This time, what Li Fan taught was the Sword Dao.

"There are three kinds of Swordsmen under Heaven."

"The lowest level tempers the will through forged steel and cultivates the body through sharp weapons. The heart is sharpened through the sword, and body and sword become one. Wielding the sword to slay enemies, body and sword unite."

"Above that, the sword in one's hand becomes the sword in one's heart. The sword in one's heart may become the sword in one's hand. Wherever the mind reaches, all things between Heaven and Earth may become swords."

"The highest realm is the realm of No Sword and No Self."

...

After introducing the distinction between the three realms, Li Fan began explaining each level in detail.

The cultivators below the platform gradually became captivated.

Even Qiao Gong and the others found themselves drawn into Li Fan's teachings, temporarily forgetting their mission to the edge of the Star Sea.

As Li Fan's lecture deepened, numerous phenomena appeared in the sky.

The usual manifestations that accompanied every lecture need not be mentioned.

The most striking spectacle was the countless swords flying in from every corner of Great Xuan.

Though all of them were merely ordinary mortal iron swords, they now flew through the air as if paying homage to a king and holy teacher.

Suspended in the sky, the swords slightly bent their blades in salute.

More and more swords gathered, blotting out the heavens and forming a vast forest of swords above the platform.

Tens of thousands of swords stood silently, seemingly listening to Li Fan's teachings as well.

"The hand holds no sword, and the heart contains none. Though form is absent, intent remains forever..."

Seven days later, Li Fan spoke his final sentence.

At that moment, countless flying swords cried out in unison, erupting with dazzling radiance.

When the sword light faded, the cultivators on the platform were astonished to discover that every single sword had vanished.

Most cultivators did not understand what had happened.

They assumed the swords had simply returned to where they came from.

Only a few cultivators with exceptional comprehension stared blankly into the sky, seemingly gaining some insight.

"No Sword, No Self. Yet sword intent endures forever..."

Xu Ke murmured to himself.

He opened his palm.

A phantom image of a long sword appeared above it.

The other three saw this scene, and their expressions grew slightly solemn.

Just as they were about to discuss it among themselves, they suddenly heard Li Fan's voice:

"The preparations are nearly complete. It is time to depart."

"You should understand that this journey carries uncertain life and death. Once we begin, there can be no turning back midway." Li Fan gave them one final confirmation.

Everyone nodded to show they understood.

"Sword..."

"Rise..."

A gentle breeze swept past.

The phantom of a Wooden Sword, enormous like a giant flying vessel, instantly enveloped Yin Shangren and the others.

Li Fan stood at the sword's tip and pointed forward into the void.

The surrounding scenery abruptly transformed.

Everything stretched into countless twisted lines that raced backward. Then the light merged together, changing into distorted colors of every kind.

The Wooden Sword phantom isolated Yin Shangren and the others from the bizarre and dazzling sights outside.

Although they could sense that the Wooden Sword was carrying them rapidly toward the depths of the Star Sea, those within the phantom felt no change in speed whatsoever.

Beyond the Wooden Sword phantom, the flowing lights suddenly darkened.

Colors vanished, leaving only twisted shadows.

Yin Shangren's expression changed slightly.

"We have already left the influence of the Immortal Ruins?"

The only response he received was the shocked expressions of the other three.

"Weren't we told the journey ahead would be filled with danger..." Qiao Gong said in a strange tone.

They could vaguely sense that the Wooden Sword phantom was charging recklessly through the star sea, advancing without hesitation.

Ignoring the hidden calamity powers concealed throughout the void, it continued accelerating and accelerating again, racing toward its destination.

"No sword, no self. No sword, no self..."

"The sword never truly exists in this world. Even the power of the calamity that destroyed the Star Sea can do nothing against something that does not exist." Xu Ke stared fixedly at the wooden sword phantom, his eyes growing brighter and brighter.

At this moment, Li Fan's voice sounded once more.

"The fact that you chose to follow me deep into the starry sky has already proven your courage and conviction."

"You have all struggled greatly to survive until now. Unnecessary sacrifices should be avoided whenever possible."

"Holy Teacher..."

The four looked at Li Fan's figure standing at the sword tip, their expressions complicated.

Li Fan paid no attention to what they were thinking behind him.

He was currently comprehending this sword flight technique that had nearly reached the ultimate limit.

Ten days earlier, after helping the Xuanhuang Realm digest the Boundless Mirror, Li Fan had made a trip to the ruins of the Heavenly Sword Sect.

The Wooden Sword at the center of the Sword Tomb seemed to have become different as a result of the transformation of the Xuanhuang Realm in this lifetime.

Compared to when Mr. Bai casually created it thousands of years ago, the Wooden Sword now seemed deeper and more profound, as if tempered by the passage of ages.

"No one knows exactly how many immortal artifacts the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm has devoured."

"Perhaps some fragments of law power among them have completed the Xuanhuang Sword Dao..."

Li Fan had sensed and examined this Wooden Sword both in the Fallen Immortal Realm and in reality.

The insights he obtained from it were never the same.

Especially now.

After personally coming into contact with immortal spirit qi and personally laying down a world-destroying immortal formation, Li Fan found himself developing entirely new understandings when looking at the wooden sword again.

"The more one knows, the more one can see within it."

"Or perhaps it would be more accurate to say that the projection of the Sword Dao descending into the Xuanhuang Realm has become somewhat more vivid."

Li Fan spent seven days comprehending the Dao within the Sword Tomb.

He did not take away the black sword from the tomb, allowing it to continue receiving the influence of the Wooden Sword.

After returning, he imparted all his insights through the Dao Lecture Platform.

In the end, they were condensed into a divine ability that now carried Yin Shangren and the others as it rapidly fled toward the frontier of the Star Sea.

This phantom of No Sword, No Self was not merely pure Sword Dao.

It also incorporated Li Fan's own experiences, including the Transformation of Truth and Falsehood, the Hidden World, Concealed Void restriction taught by the Heavenly Doctor, and the Golden Chains Across the Sky from the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation.

Not only was it unimaginably fast, but it also existed between reality and illusion, nearly ignoring the residual power of True Immortal seal script scattered throughout the journey.

However, it had not truly reached the realm of transforming reality into illusion.

The Wooden Sword phantom would still be affected by remnants of True Immortal power to some degree.

It was simply that its speed was so great that it exceeded the speed at which the residual True Immortal power could exert its effects.

This created the illusion that it was charging recklessly forward without obstruction.

As the sword bearer, Li Fan could clearly sense that the energy maintaining the Wooden Sword phantom was being consumed at a tremendous rate.

Had he not used the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven and the Xuanhuang World-Destroying Transformation as his Dao Foundation, granting him an incomparably profound foundation comparable to several cultivation worlds in scale, he would never have been able to sustain it this long.

"Looking across the entire Xuanhuang Realm, aside from the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor, even the few Longevity Immortals of the Five Elders Association may not be able to wield this sword."

Watching the rapidly shifting starry sky and spacetime around him, Li Fan could not help feeling a trace of satisfaction.

With the enhancement of the Wooden Sword phantom, a journey that originally required more than half a year now needed only two or three days.

The destination was already visible in the distance.

After spotting several familiar relics floating within the dead star sea, Li Fan began slowing down.

"So this is the Sea of Relics the Holy Teacher spoke of?" Qiao Gong narrowed his eyes as he looked ahead.

"It should be a gathering place of items left behind from various cultivation worlds after their destruction." Hundred Flowers recognized some decorative objects among the ruins and explained them to the others.

Yin Shangren, meanwhile, had remained silent ever since arriving here.

From time to time he pressed his temple, his expression dark and uncertain.

The Wooden Sword phantom slowly moved through the Sea of Relics.

Before long, it had passed beyond the region.

Ahead of them, an even larger conglomeration of ruins suddenly entered their field of vision.

It almost filled their entire sight.

Even though it consisted only of ruins and wreckage, the piled corpses of countless worlds still filled everyone with waves of dread.

Deathly silence settled over the wooden sword phantom.

Then, all of a sudden, it came to a stop.

"Hm?"

The group snapped awake.

They saw Li Fan leave the phantom and begin constructing a formation in an empty region between the Sea of Relics and the Wall of Remnant Worlds.

Golden lines emerged one after another, seeming to come alive as they rapidly traced countless patterns through the air.

After shining briefly, they disappeared into the darkness.

Various items flew out from Li Fan's body and merged into the formation.

At a single glance, one could tell this formation was extraordinary.

Despite standing so close, none of them could sense the slightest fluctuation from it.

"Fellow Daoist Yin, what formation is this?" Qiao Gong asked in astonishment.

Yin Shangren shook his head.

Yet his gaze was not focused on Li Fan's formation.

Instead, it repeatedly drifted toward the distant Wall of Remnant Worlds.

Li Fan showed no intention of hiding anything.

The formation he was openly constructing before them was naturally the immortal formation he had recently learned from the original soul of Xuantian Sect Dharma King Ji Yuzhen.

An Inch Apart, yet Worlds Away.

Ji Yuzhen herself was not skilled in formations.

She had merely witnessed the Inch Apart, yet Worlds Away Formation several times while following the Xuantian King.

However, with the support of the Final Dissociation Disc, Li Fan was able to roughly reconstruct it.

Chapter 1317: True Immortal Power Draws The Enemy

The formation lived up to its name.

The Inch Apart, Worlds Away Grand Formation could compress the distance of the ends of the world into arm's reach. Once completed, it would connect the Xuanhuang Realm with the edge of the star sea. Even without using the Wooden Sword Traversing the Void technique, one could travel instantly between the two locations through the formation.

At first glance, it appeared to be an ultra long distance teleportation formation, but that was not the case.

Within the Darkest Star Sea, residual True Immortal power permeated everything. The Xuanhuang Realm itself lay at the edge of the Immortal Ruins and was influenced by an endless pulling force, causing even spacetime to warp subtly. The distance was simply too great, and there were far too many uncontrollable variables. Conventional teleportation methods could not possibly bridge it.

The Inch Apart, Worlds Away Grand Formation employed the most primitive method of travel.

It merely compressed the distance between the point of departure and the destination infinitely, allowing one to arrive with a single step.

Even the entire Great Xuan Small World could not contain such an enormous Immortal-grade formation. Therefore, on the Xuanhuang Realm side, Li Fan established the formation within the void outside the Great Xuan Small World, then concealed it with additional formations.

As for the Star Sea frontier, as Li Fan gradually completed the formation, an incomparably mysterious fluctuation suddenly descended, preparing to sweep outward in all directions.

Li Fan formed a hand seal and used the surrounding concealment formations to block it as well.

The golden radiance of the formation dimmed, and a two way passage connecting the Xuanhuang Realm and the edge of the Star Sea silently came into being.

Li Fan stood in the void and adjusted his breathing to recover.

"As expected of an Immortal-grade formation. Even with the assistance of the Final Dissociation Disc, constructing it was quite taxing."

His accumulated source power essence had been completely exhausted, leaving Li Fan temporarily weakened.

"Compared to true immortal spiritual qi, source power essence is still qualitatively inferior."

Li Fan thought to himself. Within a few breaths, the power within his body became abundant once more.

He separated a strand of divine sense and sent it into the Inch Apart, Worlds Away Grand Formation before activating it.

His vision blurred momentarily, and in the next instant he had already returned to the void outside the Great Xuan Small World within the Xuanhuang Realm.

Only then did Li Fan leisurely withdraw the phantom projection of the Wooden Sword.

"I have established a transmission formation here. In the future, traveling back and forth will no longer be so troublesome."

Li Fan spoke casually.

Upon hearing this, Yin Shangren and the others were all shaken to their core. With their experience, they naturally understood how extraordinary a transmission formation spanning the entire Star Sea truly was.

Even the ultra long distance teleportation formations connecting the various provinces of the Xuanhuang Realm often required more than a dozen formation masters working together for over half a year to complete.

How much more astonishing, then, was this grand formation connecting the edge of the star sea with the Xuanhuang Realm?

Yet such a formation had been completed by the Holy Teacher with effortless ease.

At first, the four of them were somewhat skeptical.

However, when Li Fan invited them to test it personally, and they stepped through the formation to once again sense the familiar aura of the Great Xuan Small World, all doubts vanished.

What remained was nothing but overwhelming shock and deep reverence toward Li Fan.

"With a single formation, the endless Star Sea becomes an open road. Holy Teacher, your methods are comparable to those of a True Immortal."

Qiao Gong sighed in admiration.

"This formation, this formation..."

Yin Shangren muttered repeatedly, still unable to recover from the shock.

Li Fan's voice pulled them back to reality.

"From now on, this place will serve as our exploration outpost and supply station."

"Whether it is the Sea of Relics or the Remnant World Great Wall, both are vastly larger than the Xuanhuang Realm itself. Finding suitable remnant worlds will not be easy."

Qiao Gong asked, "Please enlighten us, Holy Teacher. Is it not enough to simply locate a remnant world to serve as a catalyst for the Xuanhuang Realm's consumption?"

Li Fan smiled faintly and extended his hand toward the distant Sea of Relics.

Whoosh!

A relic artifact was drawn toward them at tremendous speed.

The object appeared to be a blue and white robe. After countless years of erosion, it had long since become tattered beyond recognition. The bloodstains upon it had turned black.

"Hmm?"

Before the relic robe had even fully approached, Qiao Gong and the others all changed expressions.

Within their perception, the distances between themselves and their companions were rapidly increasing as the relic robe drew nearer.

It was as though the world had suddenly expanded while their bodies had shrunk countless times over.

Even their attempts to communicate became faint and barely audible.

"True Immortal power!"

Only then did they realize that this phenomenon was caused by the True Immortal power lingering within the relic robe.

As the robe moved ever closer, the distances between them continued to grow.

Though they stood beside one another, they could neither see nor reach each other.

It felt as though they had been isolated by the entire world itself.

Within the endless emptiness, Li Fan's voice descended from above like peals of thunder.

"Within the Darkest Star Sea, all worlds have already perished. Yet the power of the True Immortal seal script that caused their destruction still remains."

"The various calamities we encounter on our journey toward the center of the Star Sea are all manifestations of this residual True Immortal power."

"The relic artifacts and remnant worlds before us likewise contain these lingering forces."

"This robe contains the power of the character, [Separation]."

Boom!

Their vision instantly returned to normal, and the relic robe changed direction, flying back into the Sea of Relics.

Above their heads, a mysterious and incomparably profound character flickered into view.

"True Immortal seal script?"

The group stared blankly at the character overhead, vaguely sensing the terrifying power contained within it.

"Separation..."

Recalling the sensation of being severed from everything around them, they raised their hands as brushes and attempted to imitate it.

Unexpectedly, the character suddenly dimmed and vanished into the air.

Even the memory of it within their minds became blurred.

No matter how hard they tried to recall it, they could not reproduce it.

"There is too much residual True Immortal power within the Star Sea. Reckless action may trigger resonance among these remnants. Studying True Immortal seal script requires special methods."

Li Fan tapped his finger lightly, and a technique instantly flew into their minds.

It was the method Li Fan had learned in his previous life from the Xuan Immortal Ark, universally used by the Dao Attainment Academy, the Celestial Pivot Institute, and the Severed Immortal Tower for researching, teaching, and passing down True Immortal seal script.

The Various Forms Method.

Every True Immortal seal script character was a projection of the power of a Dao.

Even approximate forms, though not genuine True Immortal seal script, still possessed incomparably destructive power.

If such power erupted within the Immortal Ark, it would certainly inflict irreparable damage upon it.

In order to study True Immortal seal script safely without triggering its power, generations of people aboard the Xuan Immortal Ark devoted immense effort to creating this method.

Every stroke of every character, even the motion of each brush movement, had been deliberately modified.

A dot was not truly a dot. A horizontal stroke was not truly horizontal. A sweeping stroke was not truly a sweeping stroke.

Combined together, they appeared to form characters, yet they were not truly characters.

Like the clumsiest possible imitation.

True Immortal seal script reproduced through this method retained only the outward appearance while reducing the original power by millions of times.

As a result, the influence of the True Immortal seal script during research could be safely ignored.

At the same time, when the genuine and complete True Immortal seal script was successfully reconstructed, the sudden surge of power many times greater than before could serve as an excellent indicator of success.

To truly unleash the power of the True Immortal seal script, one only needed to erase all the deliberate modifications at the moment of activation.

It was precisely because of this ingenious method that generations aboard the Immortal Ark had been able to study and pass down True Immortal seal script.

Within the Immortal Ark, only those accepted as disciples by the ruling elders were qualified to learn this technique.

Yet at this moment, Li Fan imparted this marvelous method to Yin Shangren and the others without any conditions, completely free of charge.

Whether it was the Various Forms Method, or the character [Seperation], both left these few utterly shaken.

If everything Li Fan had taught before had still remained within the realm of the mortal, then the character [Seperation] was undoubtedly genuine True Immortal power.

In the current cultivation world, to possess such power yet not hoard it for oneself, instead teaching it to others freely...

No matter what speculations Yin Shangren and the others had regarding Li Fan's motives, at this moment they were all moved by his selfless bearing.

"He truly deserves the title of Holy Teacher," they all sighed inwardly.

Li Fan's lecture continued.

Using the Various Forms Method, Li Fan once again wrote out the character [Seperation] and said frankly, "I have never seen the character [Seperation] itself. I merely worked backward from the residual power contained within relic artifacts bearing the character [Seperation], tracing it back to the origin of the True Immortal seal script."

"It is like blind men feeling an elephant. Errors are inevitable. The smaller the error, the more faithfully one can reproduce the original might of the True Immortal seal script. As for this character [Seperation], I have already achieved a similarity of ninety-eight percent. However, I have been unable to make any further progress for a long time."

Everyone stared hungrily at the character Li Fan had written.

They felt no contempt merely because it was only an imitation.

While they were studying it, faint and unusual fluctuations arrived from afar.

Yin Shangren and the others failed to notice them, but a sharp gleam flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

"They have finally arrived."

With a wave of his hand, he concealed the phantom Wooden Sword and the Inch Apart, Worlds Away Grand Formation. He himself shot toward the source of the fluctuations.

Not long afterward, two figures met head-on.

Li Fan looked at the person before him. It was none other than the Grand Elder of the Severed Immortal Tower, Zhong Daogong.

Zhong Daogong wore a solemn expression as he looked at Li Fan, confusion flashing through his eyes.

Earlier, aboard the Immortal Ark, he had sensed a familiar fluctuation of power erupt and then vanish nearby, so he had come to investigate.

He had originally assumed it was residual True Immortal power from a relic artifact. Unexpectedly, the source of that power turned out to be a cultivator.

How many years had it been since he had last seen a cultivator outside the Immortal Ark?

Zhong Daogong did not dare act carelessly.

"May I ask, Fellow Daoist, why you led me here..."

Li Fan merely chuckled.

"I think Fellow Daoist has misunderstood something. I was simply teaching my disciples about True Immortal seal script and did not expect it to attract your attention."

"I never imagined there would still be surviving cultivators at the edge of the Star Sea."

His tone was filled with delight and curiosity.

Upon hearing this, Zhong Daogong narrowed his eyes and examined Li Fan thoughtfully.

He keenly noticed the phrase "edge of the Star Sea." At the same time, Li Fan's claim of teaching True Immortal seal script caused his heart to tremble.

Without confirming Li Fan's intentions, Zhong Daogong refrained from making a move and continued probing.

"From your words, Fellow Daoist, it seems you come from the depths of the Star Sea? Could it be that civilization still survives within the Darkest Star Sea?"

Li Fan sighed.

"Along the way, I encountered nothing but emptiness. I had originally believed there were no other survivors within the Star Sea. I never expected to meet fellow cultivators again at the end of my journey."

The two exchanged words back and forth, probing each other.

After this round of verbal sparring, Zhong Daogong learned only that the other party had come from deep within the Star Sea. He remained completely ignorant regarding the nature, scale, and strength of the world from which Li Fan originated.

Clearly, a cultivator capable of crossing the Star Sea was no naive or kindhearted individual.

Zhong Daogong carefully examined Li Fan once more.

Unable to discern his background, Zhong Daogong suppressed the urge to capture him directly.

"Earlier, Fellow Daoist mentioned teaching disciples True Immortal seal script. I wonder..." Zhong Daogong changed the topic and continued probing.

Unexpectedly, Li Fan did not conceal anything this time and replied generously.

"The civilizations of the Star Sea have perished, while residual True Immortal power runs rampant. To survive, one naturally has to make use of these forces."

"After several thousand years of research, we have achieved modest results. Survival is no longer as difficult as it was in the beginning."

Li Fan's explanation happened to align perfectly with the philosophy of the Xuan Immortal Ark. Zhong Daogong nodded without objection.

"It seems your homeland's research into True Immortal seal script has reached an extraordinary level. To be honest, we have also studied True Immortal power for thousands of years. Yet we do not dare cross the Star Sea as freely as you do. We can only remain confined to one corner."

Li Fan smiled faintly.

"There is no need for Fellow Daoist to be modest. I can sense it from you."

"The scent of True Immortal seal script."

His tone carried a strange meaning.

Zhong Daogong's expression changed slightly.

Before Zhong Daogong could speak, Li Fan used his hand as a brush and casually wrote out the character [Seperation].

"Please take a look, Fellow Daoist. What do you think of this character?"

The faintly visible character floated in the void.

This time, Zhong Daogong could no longer conceal the shock in his heart. His figure retreated rapidly as he looked at Li Fan with extreme vigilance.

"Who exactly are you, Fellow Daoist? Why do you know our Xuan Immortal Ark's Various Forms Method?"

"Various Forms Method?" Li Fan looked puzzled before suddenly understanding.

"You mean the Similar Yet Different Method?"

"Naturally, this is a technique painstakingly developed by generations of our predecessors to analyze True Immortal seal script."

Li Fan looked at Zhong Daogong with great interest.

"Could it be that Fellow Daoist also knows this technique?"

Know it?

Zhong Daogong's expression flickered unpredictably.

His thoughts raced as he tried to recall everyone aboard the Immortal Ark who had inherited this method.

Not a single one showed any signs of having left the Ark.

"Could it really be a coincidence?"

For the first time, Zhong Daogong found himself uncertain.

He stared at the character [Seperation] that Li Fan had written.

"It has actually surpassed the Immortal Ark's research?"

Upon realizing this, Zhong Daogong was once again overwhelmed with shock.

Not only because the other party's research into the True Immortal seal script character [Seperation] exceeded that of the Immortal Ark.

More importantly, the other party had displayed such an incomparably precious True Immortal seal script to someone he had only just met.

Within the Immortal Ark, every single True Immortal seal script character was an absolute secret.

Even as Grand Elder of the Severed Immortal Tower, he had no authority to reveal them freely.

"This can only mean that, in his homeland, research into True Immortal seal script has already reached a certain height. The character [Seperation] no longer needs to be kept secret."

Zhong Daogong could not help but think this.

A thought gradually arose in his heart.

"Fellow Daoist, would you be interested in visiting as my guest?" Zhong Daogong asked.

Upon hearing this, hesitation immediately appeared on Li Fan's face.

Zhong Daogong fully understood Li Fan's caution and spoke frankly.

"If you are not at ease, we can remain here in the void of the Star Sea."

"The main reason is that I would like to exchange insights with Fellow Daoist regarding our research into True Immortal seal script."

Chapter 1318: Trade Beneath The High Wall

"Exchange insights..." Li Fan pondered in silence, not agreeing for a long while.

Seeing this, Zhong Daogong let out a long breath. The black and white brush formed from drifting energy wrote characters into the void.

"Please take a look, fellow Daoist." Zhong Daogong was extremely solemn. Even though they were in the uninhabited star sea, he still set up restrictions around them to prevent the characters from leaking out.

The characters flickered between light and shadow, like living beings with intelligence, coiling and flowing.

Li Fan glanced at them and casually said, "So it is the character for [Hatred]..."

"However, your [Hatred] seems to contain some errors."

Zhong Daogong's expression changed slightly upon hearing this. Just as he was about to speak, Li Fan proudly declared, "Take a look at how my [Hatred] character should be written."

His brush moved like dragons and serpents. In an instant, another seemingly identical character suddenly appeared.

The two [Hatred] characters stood side by side.

As Zhong Daogong looked at the True Immortal seal script character written by Li Fan, he was first stunned. Then his body began trembling uncontrollably.

As the Grand Elder of the Severed Immortal Tower and the cultivator within the Xuan Immortal Ark who had studied True Immortal seal script the most deeply, Zhong Daogong could naturally distinguish the subtle differences between the two characters.

Judging from the faint fluctuations emanating from them, the completeness of the character written by the other party was clearly superior to his own.

The gap was even greater than it had been with the previous [Separation] character.

"This... this..." Repeatedly struck by such revelations, Zhong Daogong found it difficult to accept for a moment. However, his instinct developed through years of research compelled him to temporarily set aside all distractions and carefully study Li Fan's [Hatred] character.

Every modification to each detail brought it closer to its original essence. If he had explored it by himself, it would likely have taken him ten or twenty years to catch up.

But now, a single glance surpassed countless days and nights of painstaking research.

Naturally, Zhong Daogong had no idea that this [Hatred] character before him had originated from his own future self decades later. At this moment, only one thought remained in his mind.

He had to invite this cultivator back to the Xuan Immortal Ark, no matter what methods he had to use.

True Immortal seal script was simply too important to the Xuan Immortal Ark. Every additional character they understood would greatly increase the Ark's combat power.

Not to mention that their crucial long-term plan required them to collect as many different types of True Immortal seal script characters as possible.

Thinking of this, after firmly engraving the new [Hatred] character into his memory, Zhong Daogong looked toward Li Fan and sighed in admiration.

"Fellow Daoist's attainments are profound. I am far inferior."

"However, in my homeland, there are more than a dozen scholars who study True Immortal seal script just as I do. They have devoted many years to this field, and their understanding is no less than mine..."

Li Fan shook his head upon hearing this. A trace of disdain flashed through his eyes as he interrupted Zhong Daogong.

"To be frank, in our Great Qi..."

Li Fan paused briefly.

"Everyone works together with a single goal, surviving within the ruined Star Sea. All research concerning True Immortal seal script is shared openly. As for your side..."

Hearing this, Zhong Daogong became even more delighted. He explained seriously, "Actually, we have a similar sharing system as well. However, since these are the results of others' research, it would be inappropriate for me to reveal them without approval. But if fellow Daoist is willing to exchange insights with us, I can guarantee you will gain new discoveries."

"You surely understand how difficult it is to study True Immortal seal script. If we can complement each other's strengths..."

After Zhong Daogong's earnest persuasion, Li Fan gradually became interested.

Finally, Zhong Daogong delivered his strongest incentive.

"In my homeland, we possess an original True Immortal seal script manuscript. If our exchanges proceed pleasantly, it may not be impossible for fellow Daoist to see it personally."

Zhong Daogong understood very clearly the irresistible temptation an authentic True Immortal seal script held for people like them. After speaking, he stared fixedly at Li Fan.

As expected, Li Fan's eyes lit up, and all hesitation vanished.

"Are your words true?"

After receiving Zhong Daogong's firm confirmation, Li Fan finally nodded in agreement.

"However, for our first exchange, let us do it here in the void."

Li Fan suddenly added this condition.

With a casual wave toward the distance, silver-white lines connected and spread outward as a grand formation slowly unfolded.

Within the formation, pavilions and towers rose from the ground. Small bridges stretched across flowing streams. Clear spring water rippled beneath the bridges, and fish could even be seen swimming playfully below.

Light and shadow shifted endlessly, appearing both illusory and real.

Zhong Daogong's pupils contracted sharply at the sight.

Li Fan entered the formation first and sat within a waterside pavilion. Turning back, he said, "This place will do."

"One must always guard against others. Since I came alone to the edge of the star sea, caution is only natural."

His expression was completely matter-of-fact.

After pondering for a moment, Zhong Daogong followed him into the formation.

Birdsong echoed beside his ears. As he walked across the bridge, water flowed beneath him. He could even feel the moist warmth in the air.

It was difficult to imagine that this landscape of pavilions and flowing water had been created instantly through a formation.

"I never expected that besides True Immortal seal script, fellow Daoist is also skilled in formations?" Zhong Daogong looked around carefully. He could vaguely tell that this was merely a formation designed to create structures within the Star Sea. Yet its ability to produce such lifelike illusions, enough to deceive even him, clearly demonstrated its extraordinary nature.

"Just trivial tricks."

Li Fan spoke indifferently.

"Researching True Immortal seal script already consumes all my effort. How could I have any spare energy to study formations?"

Zhong Daogong deeply agreed and nodded.

After inspecting the formation and finding nothing suspicious, Zhong Daogong cupped his hands.

"Then it is settled. Fellow Daoist may wait here. Before this incense stick burns out, I will certainly return with the others."

As he spoke, Zhong Daogong waved his sleeve, and a stick of earthen-yellow incense flew out and stood upright in the air.

Its flame had already been lit, and wisps of fragrant smoke drifted upward.

After bidding farewell, Zhong Daogong departed, his figure vanishing into the dark Star Sea.

Li Fan gazed after him for a long time. Only after several moments did he return to Yin Shangren and the others.

"Holy Teacher..."

Li Fan had suddenly departed and remained gone for a long time. Yin Shangren and the others naturally realized he had encountered some kind of trouble. The moment he reappeared, they immediately asked with concern.

"I did not expect that civilization still survives at the edge of the Star Sea. We likely disturbed them when we established the formation connecting to the Xuanhuang Realm."

Li Fan's expression was grave.

His words shocked everyone present.

"Here? In such utter desolation? Where could they possibly live?"

"I still do not know. We only made brief contact. However, anyone capable of surviving within the ruined Star Sea until now is certainly not easy to deal with. Do not reveal yourselves for now. Wait until I gather more information."

Everyone nodded in agreement.

Unknown beings within the Star Sea were more likely enemies than friends. No amount of caution would be excessive.

While waiting for the people from the Immortal Ark to arrive, Li Fan continued teaching Yin Shangren and the others.

"Relic artifacts contain residual True Immortal power, and fragments of destroyed worlds are even more so. If world fragments saturated with residual True Immortal power are absorbed by the Xuanhuang Realm..."

"I fear it would trigger upheavals throughout the world and bring calamity upon all living beings."

"However, so many years have passed since the great catastrophe of the Star Sea. There are always some remnant worlds where the residual True Immortal power has mostly dissipated."

"Only such fragments can serve as medicinal catalysts."

Li Fan spoke eloquently.

"With so many of us splitting up, finding suitable medicinal catalysts should not be too difficult," Qiao Gong said as he gazed at the endless Great Wall of Remnant Worlds in the distance.

Li Fan shook his head slightly.

Pointing a finger ahead, the phantom of the Wooden Sword instantly flashed to the frontier of the Great Wall of Remnant Worlds.

"Why don't you go out and try it yourselves," Li Fan said.

Qiao Gong was the first to step beyond the area covered by the Wooden Sword phantom.

The moment he reached the outside world, his expression changed drastically. It was as if an immense force of attraction seized him in an instant, dragging him uncontrollably toward the Great Wall of Remnant Worlds.

"Freeze!"

A layer of golden armor appeared around his body. Qiao Gong flailed in panic and expended considerable effort before barely managing to stabilize himself within the void.

Even so, he could not stop himself from continuing to drift toward the Great Wall of Remnant Worlds. The light radiating from his armor flickered ceaselessly, as if it had already reached its limit.

Li Fan guided the Wooden Sword phantom to envelop Qiao Gong once more.

Freed from the terrifying attraction, Qiao Gong stared ahead at the Great Wall of Remnant Worlds with lingering fear in his eyes.

"There is an Immortal Ruin here as well?!" everyone exclaimed in shock.

"Not an Immortal Ruin. A High Wall," Li Fan replied slowly, his voice distant and ethereal.

"The attraction from the Immortal Ruins is blocked by the High Wall at the frontier of the Star Sea. Then, through a mechanism beyond our current understanding, it accumulates beneath the High Wall."

"Over countless years, this formed a different kind of Immortal Ruin."

"The reason these world fragments are linked together is also to resist this Rebounding Star Force..."

The scene Li Fan described deeply shocked everyone present.

Although they could not see the invisible High Wall, the mere fact that it could firmly confine the attractive force of the Immortal Ruins, a force capable of destroying the entire star sea, was enough to prove its power and mystery.

"Operating within the Great Wall of Remnant Worlds is not much easier than enduring the attraction at the frontier of the Xuanhuang Realm. One moment of carelessness and you will lose control, crashing directly into one of the remnant worlds. If any residual True Immortal power still remains within them..."

"Moreover, under the influence of the Rebounding Star Force, the range our divine senses can explore is greatly reduced. That is precisely why finding medicinal catalysts and suitable remnant worlds to fill is so difficult," Li Fan said gravely.

Li Fan extended his hand, and a silky seven-colored crystal appeared within his palm.

"This is Voidbright Flow Crystal. When used together with the Rainbow Split Light Transformation technique, it can resist this omnipresent attraction to a certain degree."

"Remember, do not overestimate yourselves. Once your rainbow light has been consumed down to one-third, leave in advance."

Li Fan distributed the Voidbright Flow Crystals and imparted the Rainbow Split Light Transformation technique, obtained from the Immortal Ancestor, to everyone.

"Of course, if you can reach the state I have attained, the realm of No Sword, No Self, you may be able to ignore the Rebounding Star Force to some extent."

The Wooden Sword phantom flashed, bringing everyone back to safety.

"The Great Wall of Remnant Worlds contains countless world fragments. With my strength alone, finding suitable medicinal catalysts would be extraordinarily difficult. That is why I need your assistance," Li Fan said seriously.

At this moment, Hundred Flowers could not help asking, "Holy Teacher, what exactly are you seeking after going to such lengths? Are you merely trying to benefit from helping the Xuanhuang Realm ascend?"

Li Fan chuckled.

"If the Xuanhuang Realm ascends and escapes the world-ending crisis, we will all receive the world's blessings in return. We may even have a chance to break through the limits of mortals."

"With so many benefits at once, is that still not enough?"

The crowd still wanted to ask more questions, but Li Fan's eyes suddenly flashed.

"More people have arrived over there. I'll be back shortly."

"You should remain here and familiarize yourselves with the Rainbow Split Light Transformation technique first."

Before his words had even finished, Li Fan vanished.

Standing atop the Wooden Sword phantom, everyone remained silent for a long while.

In the end, Xu Ke broke the silence.

"Actually, with the Holy Teacher's strength alone, he could probably promote the ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm himself. It would only take more time."

"Yet he still brought along burdens like us... It reminds me of Mr. Bai from back then."

Xu Ke sighed with emotion, his eyes filled with longing and remembrance.

The others fell silent.

Indeed, from their perspective, they possessed nothing worth scheming for in the eyes of the Holy Teacher.

...

Outside the pavilion grand formation.

The elders of the Immortal Ark had all gathered. None of them entered, instead observing from afar.

Their divine senses continuously communicated.

"What do you think? Is it a trap?"

"It seems we were overly cautious. There are indeed no offensive measures. It should merely be an illusion formation."

"It is only a formation. How strong could it possibly be? With so many of us here, are we supposed to fear him alone?"

"Exactly. Under the power of True Immortal seal script, any formation will be reduced to ashes."

"Do not forget. The other side also understands True Immortal seal script. In fact, perhaps even more deeply than we do..."

The elders' discussion came to an abrupt halt.

At that moment, Li Fan, whom they had been waiting for, slowly emerged from the grand formation.

In his hand, he held the incense stick left behind by Zhong Daogong.

Only one-third of the incense remained. Li Fan glanced around at everyone and nodded.

"As expected, you all kept your word."

Zhong Daogong introduced everyone to Li Fan.

"This is Gan Jingda. This is Nangong Lie..."

After exchanging pleasantries, Li Fan invited everyone into the formation for further discussion.

The people of the Immortal Ark exchanged glances. In the end, they reached a consensus and followed him into the formation together.

After taking their seats in one of the pavilions, everyone immediately got to the point.

"I wonder how many True Immortal seal script characters your homeland has fully deciphered?" Zhong Daogong asked directly.

This question was extremely important. Every elder of the Immortal Ark stared at Li Fan, waiting for his answer.

"Thirteen," Li Fan replied calmly.

The elders of the Immortal Ark looked at one another. Most of them showed expressions of disbelief.

"Of course, that number is somewhat low. We only count those with a deciphering completeness above ninety percent," Li Fan added.

This time, the elders could no longer remain calm.

"Are your words truly not an exaggeration?"

Li Fan let out a light laugh, his expression filled with pride.

Zhong Daogong waved his hand, and the elders gradually settled down.

"It is not that we distrust you. It is simply that thirteen True Immortal seal script characters, each over ninety percent complete..."

"It is honestly difficult to believe," Zhong Daogong said as he looked at Li Fan.

Li Fan smiled.

"One character for one character."

The elders of the Immortal Ark held another round of silent discussion and reached a unified decision.

"I have already demonstrated the characters [Separation] and [Hatred] before. This time, you may go first," Li Fan said loudly as he looked at the assembled elders.

Though surrounded by a crowd, his face showed not the slightest trace of fear.
