Chapter 1319: The Shortcut To Attaining The Dao

Faced with Li Fan's request, the people of the Immortal Ark did not find anything inappropriate about it.

However, they also put forward their own conditions.

"True Immortal seal script characters are among the Immortal Ark's greatest secrets. Although we are deep within an uninhabited region of the star sea, we must still guard against eavesdroppers and hidden observers."

"Therefore, we must also set up our own formation here."

Li Fan smiled.

"As you wish. If you find it difficult to establish the formation, I can lend a hand."

The Immortal Ark elders snorted coldly and ignored Li Fan's teasing.

Working together within the illusion formation Li Fan had arranged, they layered another formation on top of it. Only after confirming that everything was foolproof did they finally begin the formal exchange.

"I am Jian Daosheng. Please enlighten me."

Without any unnecessary pleasantries, Jian Daosheng, the chief of the Celestial Pivot Institute of the Immortal Ark, immediately and solemnly wrote out a True Immortal seal script character.

Perhaps to suppress Li Fan's momentum and seize the initiative, the character he chose this time was indeed extraordinary.

Even during his previous life while studying in the Immortal Ark, Li Fan had never had the opportunity to come into contact with it.

Even after becoming Ai Tianjue's disciple and nearly joining the Immortal Ark's inner core, the same remained true.

Dark lines slowly drifted through the void.

The moment the character fully took shape, it was like a blazing sun, illuminating the Darkest Star Sea where Li Fan and the people of the Immortal Ark stood.

The True Immortal seal script character brought more than a mere change in brightness.

Under its radiance, this Darkest Star Sea, filled only with deathly silence, unexpectedly gained a trace of vitality.

'A True Immortal seal script character with positive effects?'

Li Fan's heart stirred, and his expression immediately grew serious.

Ignoring Jian Daosheng's rather self-satisfied expression, he focused entirely on the character before him.

With Li Fan's current knowledge, especially after glimpsing the mysteries of [Creation] and that mysterious character that created the bloodline of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, his ability to analyze True Immortal seal script characters could almost be called unrivaled throughout the Darkest Star Sea.

He carefully comprehended the constantly shifting character that remained suspended like a great sun overhead.

After only the time it took to drink a cup of tea, the true meaning represented by this character surfaced within Li Fan's mind.

[Dawn].

The rising sun, circulating vitality, the revival of all things...

These countless phenomena together formed this special True Immortal seal script character.

"So that is how it is."

After deciphering the [Dawn] character, Li Fan finally resolved a question that had troubled him for a long time.

How exactly had the Xuan Immortal Ark survived the destruction of the star sea until now?

At first, Li Fan had believed it was because of the Immortal Ark Divine Tree formed from the Seed of Transformation.

However, after living within the Immortal Ark for several years, he gradually realized something was wrong.

The Immortal Ark Divine Tree needed to continuously absorb extraordinary objects such as the Dao-Chasing Giants and the Human Emperor Rabbit in order to provide sufficient energy for the Immortal Ark.

This proved that the Divine Tree alone could not offset the consumption required for the Immortal Ark's normal operation.

Over the past ten thousand years, the Divine Tree had not continuously absorbed external energy.

During those intervals, what had ensured its vigorous growth?

Furthermore, the warm and vibrant environment within the Immortal Ark, nearly identical to a normal cultivation world, clearly could not have been provided by a mere World Beyond Divine Tree.

After all, even the original extraterrestrial Divine Tree of the Divine Wood Sect from the Xuanhuang Realm had not possessed such miraculous abilities.

Today, with the appearance of this [Dawn] character, the mystery was finally solved.

It was precisely this True Immortal seal script character representing the rising sun that had long provided the Immortal Ark with a suitable living environment.

"This is truly the foundation of the Xuan Immortal Ark's survival. It is an invaluable treasure."

"And yet these people revealed it right from the start..."

"It seems they have no intention of letting me leave."

Having spent his previous life within the Immortal Ark, Li Fan understood these elders very well.

They valued True Immortal seal script characters and the future of the Immortal Ark more than their own lives.

Yet now they were openly sharing a supreme secret tied directly to the Immortal Ark's future and destiny.

Even as a one-character-for-one-character exchange, it seemed highly suspicious.

"Unfortunately, your plan is destined to fail. Stirring up trouble is one thing, but trying to keep me here..."

Li Fan snorted inwardly.

The formation jointly established by the Immortal Ark elders appeared childishly crude and full of flaws in his eyes.

Moreover, with his unparalleled escape techniques, even if a True Immortal descended, he was eighty percent confident he could withdraw safely.

Naturally, he did not fear being besieged by the Immortal Ark elders.

Pretending to know nothing of their schemes, Li Fan continued focusing on deciphering the [Dawn] character.

As his analysis deepened, however, he discovered something amiss.

The character did indeed represent the phenomenon of the newborn sun.

The morning sun was gentle, but that gentleness applied only to the Immortal Realm.

For beings of the lower realms, even the warm sunlight of an Immortal Realm dawn was far beyond what they could endure.

If this character descended directly, it would not bring vitality.

Instead, it would instantly burn an entire world into an infernal wasteland.

"So this is not a beneficial True Immortal seal script character either."

"It still represents destruction and chaos."

"The people of the Immortal Ark merely reduced the similarity and completeness of the True Immortal seal script character, weakening its power and turning harm into benefit."

"Wonderful. As expected of a force that has survived since the great catastrophe. They truly possess extraordinary methods."

Li Fan silently praised them.

However, his expression suddenly darkened as he coldly swept his gaze across the Immortal Ark elders.

"Something is wrong."

"This character is nowhere near ninety percent complete. Do you think I cannot tell?"

Li Fan appeared furious.

Then his face filled with disappointment.

"Forget it. I never expected you to be a group that breaks its promises."

"The exchange is canceled."

The Immortal Ark elders had never expected Li Fan to uncover the truth behind the character so quickly.

While inwardly shocked, Jian Daosheng hurriedly explained.

"Fellow Daoist, you misunderstand. It is not that I deliberately concealed anything. For beings of the lower realms like us, a character with thirty percent similarity is actually more useful than one with higher completeness."

"Of course, if you insist, showing you the complete character is no problem."

As he spoke, Jian Daosheng wrote the character once more.

Even though the power of the True Immortal seal script character had been greatly weakened by the Various Forms Method, Li Fan still sensed the surroundings change the instant the character formed.

The warmth that had filled the area vanished, replaced by suffocating waves of heat.

Vitality disappeared in an instant, transforming into a chilling aura of destruction.

Li Fan memorized the complete character before speaking.

"Very well. I admit you are right."

"Since it was only a misunderstanding, let us continue the exchange."

Hearing this, the Immortal Ark elders secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

Li Fan coughed lightly to draw everyone's attention.

"Everyone, watch carefully."

His hand moved like a dragon and serpent.

In an instant, the character [Fallen] was completed.

The moment the [Fallen] character appeared, the expressions of the Immortal Ark elders became rather strange.

Especially Ai Tianjue.

He stared blankly at the character suspended in the void before him.

He had likely never imagined that the True Immortal seal script character he had studied most deeply would be written first by someone else.

"The completeness has already far surpassed the Immortal Ark's current progress. It is probably close to ninety percent..."

Ai Tianjue could not help but feel a deep sense of loss.

What Ai Tianjue did not know was that the [Fallen] character Li Fan had written had not actually reached ninety percent completion.

Having inherited the knowledge of Ai Tianjue from several decades in the future during his previous life, Li Fan's understanding of the [Fallen] character was only around eighty percent.

However, Li Fan had integrated his understanding of [Creation], that mysterious character representing the transformation between immortals and mortals, and even a trace of his comprehension regarding the [Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood]. He had reconstructed and modified the [Fallen] character.

By infusing it with the aura of a deeper level of power, the [Fallen] character written by Li Fan appeared even more advanced.

It looked even more like the true [Fallen] character than the original itself.

Li Fan had not been certain beforehand whether such a method could deceive the people of the Immortal Ark.

But judging from their expressions now, it had clearly succeeded.

Li Fan sneered inwardly, growing even more confident that the plan was proceeding smoothly.

"Everyone, what do you think of this True Immortal seal script character, [Fallen]?" Li Fan asked loudly.

The members of the Immortal Ark dearly wanted to say that their own research had already covered the [Fallen] character. However, their progress was inferior to Li Fan's. Within such a short period of time, the Immortal Ark elders had no way of matching Li Fan's level of comprehension regarding the character.

The Immortal Ark elders looked at one another. After a brief discussion, they ultimately decided to swallow this loss in silence.

This time, it was the Immortal Ark's turn.

Lu Yuzhi of the Severed Immortal Tower inscribed the True Immortal seal script character, [Solitude].

Although Li Fan's research into this True Immortal seal script character still surpassed that of the Immortal Ark, he did not push things too far. After all, he intended to reel in a bigger catch.

Pretending to mutter to himself, he said, "The character [Solitude] is not uncommon within the Star Sea. However, our research progress is indeed inferior to yours."

Li Fan cupped his fists.

"I have learned much."

This time, the Immortal Ark managed to recover some ground.

The elders could not help but breathe a sigh of relief.

After all, throughout this exchange, the Immortal Ark had already suffered considerable losses. This reversal of fortune was at least a good beginning.

When it was Li Fan's turn again, the character [Suppression] descended.

This character had likewise originated from the Immortal Ark's research. However, their analysis had not even reached one third of its full potential and lacked any coherent framework.

In his previous life, after Li Fan taught this incomplete [Suppression] character to Sun Tianci, he used Sun Tianci's extraordinary comprehension to carry out further deductions.

In this life, he combined that with his own understanding, reconstructing and fabricating the details to complete it.

Once again, he intended to test the level of the Immortal Ark elders.

The result was unexpected.

After discussing among themselves, Zhong Daogong and the others accepted the True Immortal seal script character Li Fan had provided.

Li Fan remained expressionless on the surface, but inwardly, he had already reached a conclusion.

"It seems the Xuan Immortal Ark has indeed never come into contact with True Immortal seal script characters at the [Creation] level."

"Copying and imitating from the top down is not something they can uncover in a short time."

"Of course, given enough time, they may notice some clues..."

Li Fan pondered silently. Meanwhile, the Immortal Ark revealed another new True Immortal seal script character.

The moment it appeared, both the formation jointly arranged by the Immortal Ark elders and the illusion formation Li Fan had established began trembling faintly.

As an absolute grandmaster of formations, Li Fan sharply sensed that under the influence of this new True Immortal seal script character, the most fundamental units maintaining the structure of formations were beginning to disintegrate.

Li Fan was instantly alarmed.

The formation he had casually arranged was by no means an ordinary illusion formation.

Rather, it was a pseudo Immortal formation created by combining downgraded versions of two Immortal-grade formations, [Desolate Fall, Flowers Bloom in an Empty Room] and [Immortal Descent, All Things Return to Void].

Hidden killing intent lay concealed within the invisible structure, capable of silently exterminating all enemies trapped within.

Yet even a formation of such a level had suffered damage to its very foundation under the influence of this weakened True Immortal seal script character.

"If the full power of this True Immortal seal script character were revealed, my pseudo Immortal formation could likely be shattered with a mere flick of the finger."

Having already made formations his most important trump card, Li Fan's expression became extremely grave.

While repairing the gradually collapsing formation, he simultaneously studied this newly appeared True Immortal seal script character.

"Without question, this is a direct counter to formations."

"With this True Immortal seal script character in their possession, it is no wonder the Immortal Ark's formation standards are so low."

"It is difficult to say whether the Immortal Ark intentionally revealed this character as a warning."

"Learning of this character alone has made this trip worthwhile."

Li Fan was extremely satisfied with this exchange of True Immortal seal script characters.

At the same time, he gradually deciphered the true meaning behind the character before him.

[Resolve].

The moment he comprehended the fundamental meaning of the True Immortal seal script character, Li Fan immediately thought of his treasure, the Final Dissociation Disc.

"Perhaps my Dissociation Disc has now become similar to the Derivation Law Jade, a partial projection of the Great Dao from below."

"Perhaps I can attempt to use the Dissociation Disc to glimpse the Dao of [Resolve]."

...

As the number of True Immortal seal script characters he mastered continued to increase, Li Fan gradually realized that what was truly powerful was not the seal script characters themselves, but the Great Dao they represented.

True Immortal seal script characters were merely shortcuts, tools that helped ordinary people, or even ordinary immortals, touch the Great Dao.

"Similarly, world wonders and eternal remnants are also comparable shortcuts."

"Their essence is fundamentally the same."

Li Fan suddenly thought again of the nameless True Immortal known as the Inscription Immortal, who was said to have engraved countless paths of the Dao and made them more accessible.

"The paths of the Dao cannot be cultivated simultaneously. Yet this Inscription Immortal possesses such profound understanding of countless Daos..."

This was truly beyond Li Fan's current comprehension.

...

Li Fan's fleeting thoughts did not affect the ongoing exchange of True Immortal seal script characters within the void.

Using the characters [Chaos], [Nothingness], [Devoid], together with the character [Forgetfulness] that he had learned from the Immortal Ark in his previous life, Li Fan had nearly emptied the Immortal Ark's accumulated research foundation regarding True Immortal seal script characters.

Of course, characters like [Chaos] and [Nothingness] were not the complete versions he had personally witnessed.

Instead, they were slightly modified and weakened versions.

Apart from the character [Resolve], Li Fan also learned two new characters.

[Cold] and [Mourning].

At this point, both sides had nearly exhausted their reserves.

The atmosphere in the arena gradually became subtle.

"Everyone."

Li Fan was the first to speak, slightly breaking the stalemate.

"I must admit that your research into True Immortal seal script characters is truly no less than ours in Great Qi."

"I never expected that within the star sea, there would still exist another surviving civilization capable of standing on equal footing with us."

Li Fan let out a long sigh.

Suddenly, his expression changed.

"However, even among True Immortal seal script characters, there are differences in value."

"Even if all the characters we have exchanged so far were combined, they would still be inferior to the one I am about to reveal next."

His words were shocking.

The Immortal Ark elders instantly suppressed all the schemes and calculations in their hearts and stared fixedly at Li Fan.

"Fellow Daoist, you cannot speak carelessly."

Chapter 1320: The Shock Of Creation

"I never speak falsehoods."

"Besides, there is no need for me to exaggerate." Li Fan looked down upon the crowd, his face filled with arrogance.

The restless emotions among the Immortal Ark elders instantly subsided.

They began discussing in secret how reliable Li Fan's words truly were.

Nangong Lie said, "One True Immortal seal script character is worth more than all the others combined? I do not believe such nonsense."

Gan Jingda replied, "Better to believe it exists than dismiss it outright. The civilization he comes from studies True Immortal seal script no less deeply than our Immortal Ark. If they were fortunate enough to discover something, then acting rashly may cause us to miss it forever."

Lu Yuzhi added, "Indeed. Anyone carrying a True Immortal seal script character is far too difficult to capture alive. We can only strike instantly and kill him. In that case, we must extract as much knowledge from his mind as possible before making our move."

"No matter what, this child knows far too many of the Immortal Ark's secrets. We absolutely cannot allow him to leave."

This was already a consensus the elders had reached long ago. Therefore, after Zhong Daogong spoke these words, no one objected.

At this moment, Ai Tianjue transmitted his thoughts.

"How about this..."

After a brief exchange, they reached another unified decision.

This time, Jian Daosheng spoke.

"Since fellow Daoist is so confident, then you have truly piqued our interest."

"If its value truly surpasses the combined worth of more than ten True Immortal seal script characters, then we are willing to pay any price to witness it."

The other Immortal Ark elders nodded in agreement.

"I wonder what else you can offer. Ordinary True Immortal seal script originals alone will not suffice." Li Fan's tone was astonishingly domineering as he pressed them.

Jian Daosheng smiled faintly.

"Rest assured, fellow Daoist. Our world possesses the ancient inherited Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales. It records the specialties and treasures of those cultivation worlds in this star sea that have already perished."

"If your words prove true, then aside from that original True Immortal seal script, we will allow you to choose any three additional treasures from the compendium."

Li Fan did not seem moved by Jian Daosheng's offer. Instead, he muttered repeatedly under his breath.

"Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales, Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales... I seem to have heard of it somewhere before."

The Immortal Ark elders were all stunned.

Suddenly, Li Fan came to a realization and uttered four words.

"Xuanshang Immortal Ark?!"

The words exploded like thunder in the ears of the Immortal Ark elders.

Their auras changed drastically as they immediately treated him like a major threat.

Sensing that something was wrong, Zhong Daogong secretly signaled the others to prepare for action while forcing a smile onto his face.

"What do you mean by that, fellow Daoist?"

Li Fan cupped his hands.

"In ancient times, the Xuanshang Immortal Ark traversed countless worlds. Who did not know of it?"

"I originally thought the Immortal Ark had vanished along with the silence of the Star Sea. I never expected that ten thousand years later, it would still survive."

"If my teachers learned of this, they would certainly be thrilled. No, I must hurry and inform them..."

Li Fan's words caused Zhong Daogong's eyelids to twitch violently.

He quickly interrupted Li Fan and changed the topic.

"Fellow Daoist flatters us. Since you have already recognized us, there is no need for further concealment."

"We are indeed descendants of the Xuanshang Immortal Ark. However, much has happened over these ten thousand years. Although we survived the great catastrophe, the Xuanshang Immortal Ark split into two factions. We are merely one of them."

Zhong Daogong looked at the somewhat surprised Li Fan and raised an eyebrow.

"However, there is one thing I truly do not understand. Even within the Immortal Ark, the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales is highly confidential. How does an outsider like you know of its existence?"

Ever since learning the Immortal Ark's identity, Li Fan's attitude had become noticeably friendlier.

"To be honest, my homeland, Great Qi, shares a deep connection with the Xuanshang Immortal Ark."

"It was precisely because of an immortal artifact obtained through trade with the Immortal Ark back then that we managed to survive the great catastrophe."

"Even now, that immortal artifact continues to protect us."

"Therefore, the entirety of Great Qi has always held some gratitude toward the Immortal Ark."

After hearing Li Fan's explanation, the Immortal Ark elders were momentarily dumbfounded.

Gan Jingda asked, "Old Zhong, did something like this really happen?"

Zhong Daogong frowned as he searched through the Immortal Ark's records in his mind.

"In ancient times, the Immortal Ark did indeed complete several transactions involving immortal artifacts. However, according to regulations and the customers' requests, all related records were destroyed after the transactions concluded."

"The Xuanshang Immortal Ark's central core should still have backup copies. But after the internal conflict back then..."

"Those records should now be in the possession of the Shang Immortal Ark faction."

As the chief of the Celestial Pivot Institute, Jian Daosheng provided the explanation.

"The Xuanshang Immortal Ark's sale of immortal artifacts was known only to a very small number of forces in those days. Since he can mention this matter, it is likely genuine," Nangong Lie said slowly.

"Deep research into True Immortal seal script, and protected by an immortal artifact..."

In the minds of the Immortal Ark elders, a powerful cultivation civilization that had endured since ancient times gradually took shape.

Great Qi.

At this moment, Li Fan gave them another tremendous surprise.

"Since you are people of the Immortal Ark, then matters become much easier."

"The Immortal Ark has always conducted business with integrity. I trust you."

"Originally, I planned to wait until I saw the goods before revealing anything. After all, this True Immortal seal script is simply too precious. It was obtained from residual memories of the Immortal Realm left behind within an immortal artifact."

Every word Li Fan spoke tugged at the hearts of the Immortal Ark elders.

"Everyone, watch carefully!"

Li Fan suddenly raised his voice.

The illusory scene of pavilions, flowing streams, and small bridges abruptly vanished.

In its place appeared a boundless grassland stretching endlessly into the distance.

Upon the grassland stood a solitary stone.

Suddenly, the earth began to tremble.

Large patches of green grass seemed to receive some kind of stimulation and started growing wildly.

In the blink of an eye, they became taller than a person.

The solitary stone was even lifted from the ground by the surging vegetation.

A streak of light suddenly appeared in the sky.

The arc of light displayed seven colors. Within it, flashes of lightning and gathering storms could vaguely be seen.

Around the seven-colored arc, many invisible figures gradually gathered.

They converged in one place, seemingly waiting for something.

A bolt of black lightning suddenly struck downward from the arc.

Boom. Boom. Boom.

The world was split into two.

Space itself was torn open with a deep fissure that refused to heal.

Across the grassland, the endless sea of green grass ignited.

Blazing flames spread rapidly.

The grassland trembled.

Beneath the inferno, something seemed to be awakening.

High above in the sky, the invisible figures surrounding the arc moved even closer toward its center.

They even began to fight over their positions.

Massive collisions and thunderous roars echoed continuously.

The storm reached its peak.

Then, in an instant, everything froze.

The rolling black clouds vanished completely.

Within the seven-colored arc, beneath a clear sky stretching ten thousand miles.

An incomparably profound character appeared.

...

At this point, the scene abruptly came to an end.

The elders of the Immortal Ark, who had been deeply immersed in it, immediately widened their eyes and turned toward Li Fan.

"What comes next?" Jian Daosheng shouted anxiously, completely disregarding his usual composure.

This chief of the Celestial Pivot Institute had already managed to vaguely glimpse fragments of the True Immortal seal script hidden within that arc of light.

Although Li Fan had suddenly interrupted the scene before they could fully observe it, Jian Daosheng remained convinced that the power contained within that True Immortal seal script far surpassed any other True Immortal seal script he had ever encountered.

This Great Qi cultivator before them had not lied.

"How much did you all manage to see?" Jian Daosheng nearly roared.

"It happened too quickly. He cut it off too fast. How could anyone possibly comprehend such a powerful True Immortal seal script in an instant?"

"There is no mistake. The feeling of my entire soul trembling... it was even stronger than the first time I glimpsed a True Immortal seal script. Its power far exceeds that of a single seal script character."

"The scene just now, were those True Immortals from the Immortal Realm fighting over the characters within that solitary light? Even immortals were competing for them... unimaginable, truly unimaginable."

"No matter the cost, we must obtain it."

Although the elders of the Immortal Ark appeared calm on the surface, inwardly they were in an uproar.

After personally witnessing those mysterious characters within the solitary light, they no longer harbored the slightest doubt about Li Fan's earlier words.

At the same time, they instantly reached a consensus. They had to make this True Immortal seal script their own.

The Immortal Ark elders could hardly wait any longer, yet Li Fan acted as though he noticed nothing.

With a serious expression, he said, "There is one thing I must make clear beforehand. The scene I just displayed came from the memories of an immortal artifact. It was originally hidden deep within the artifact's imprint and could not be easily detected. However, over these past ten thousand years, as our Great Qi continuously deepened our understanding and utilization of this immortal artifact, we finally managed to uncover it."

"At that time, the immortal artifact had only just been born and its power was weak. It was incapable of perfectly recording that True Immortal seal script. Therefore, what we reconstructed is merely a flawed replica."

The Immortal Ark elders had all devoted extensive study to True Immortal seal script. How could they fail to understand the implications of Li Fan's words?

Not only were they not disappointed, but Li Fan's "candor" further deepened their trust.

"Fellow Daoist, since we have already spoken this far, why not visit the Immortal Ark? Original True Immortal seal scripts, the treasures within the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales, you may choose whatever you wish." Zhong Daogong suppressed the excitement in his heart and spoke solemnly.

Under the expectant gazes of the crowd, Li Fan pondered for a moment before finally agreeing with a smile.

"I have long heard of the Immortal Ark's reputation. Now that I have the opportunity to visit it, I will certainly have something to boast about to my teachers and fellow disciples when I return."

The members of the Immortal Ark collectively let out a sigh of relief.

The group surrounded Li Fan and departed from the illusory formation in the void, heading toward the Sea of Relics.

After passing through the Sea of Relics and reaching the outer region, Zhong Daogong formed a hand seal, revealing the concealed Immortal Ark.

A trace of disappointment flashed through Li Fan's eyes at just the right moment.

However, it quickly disappeared.

After entering the Immortal Ark and seeing the divine tree floating in the void, his expression once again showed some surprise.

One of the elders introduced it to him.

"This is the Divine Tree of Life-Transformation. According to legend, its true body is a magnificent divine tree rooted beneath the boundless star sea, with branches stretching endlessly across countless cultivation worlds."

"Once its branches invade a cultivation world, they can absorb the world's vitality while their roots merge with the world itself. That is why it bears the name 'Life-Transformation.' Through this method, the divine tree spread throughout the star sea."

"Of course, these are only legends. No one has ever seen the true body of the divine tree. Now that the Star Sea lies shattered, no one knows whether it still exists."

The elders quickly shifted the topic to other sights within the Immortal Ark.

"This golden three-eyed head comes from the ancient cultivation world of [Mortal Abyss]. It is said that this world carried the bloodline of True Immortals from the Immortal Realm, which is why most of its cultivators possessed three eyes."

"They possessed extraordinary talent and all kinds of incredible divine abilities. However, when the great catastrophe descended, Mortal Abyss was among the first worlds to suffer destruction."

As they conversed, they soon arrived at the very top of the divine tree.

At the elders' signal, they jointly cast spells without avoiding Li Fan, an outsider.

Invisible ripples spread outward from the top of the divine tree.

Then, a pink flower materialized from the void and slowly bloomed.

It was only an image rather than a physical object, yet it still emitted a refreshing fragrance.

A pathway appeared at the center of the flower.

"Fellow Daoist, please." Zhong Daogong looked toward Li Fan.

Li Fan smiled faintly. Seemingly without the slightest guard, he stepped directly inside.

As he strode forward, the scenery before him instantly changed.

Rows upon rows of wooden shelves stood in orderly formation.

They stretched so far that no end could be seen.

In the air above, a long, narrow arm continuously adjusted and sorted the shelves.

When it sensed Li Fan's presence as an outsider, the arm suddenly halted.

Its five fingers extended as it reached toward Li Fan.

Fortunately, the Immortal Ark elders, who arrived immediately afterward, stopped the arm's actions.

Li Fan observed the long arm with interest.

"It does not seem to be a living creature?"

Zhong Daogong nodded.

"Fellow Daoist has keen insight. Strictly speaking, this arm is also a True Immortal seal script."

"However, it is the aggregate structure formed from countless fragments of True Immortal seal script."

"Many years ago, due to a moment of carelessness, the Immortal Ark suffered a theft. Several supreme treasures within the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales were lost."

"After reflecting deeply on that incident, we developed this Severed Immortal Arm."

A trace of pride appeared on Zhong Daogong's face.

"Without the collective approval of the Immortal Ark Council of Elders, no matter how powerful someone may be, attempting to take a treasure away in front of the Severed Immortal Arm..."

"Is absolutely impossible."

Jian Daosheng also spoke.

"Fellow Daoist, can you discern the mysteries of this Severed Immortal Arm?"

Li Fan narrowed his eyes and observed it for a while before seeming to reach an understanding.

"The Immortal Ark directly engraved the structural fragments of True Immortal seal script into this space itself?"

"In fact, the place we are standing in right now is inside the Severed Immortal Arm?"

Zhong Daogong smiled.

"Not only that."

"Even the many treasures within the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales have now become part of the Severed Immortal Arm."

"If one wishes to remove an item, it must first be separated using our secret techniques."

"Otherwise, the only option is to take the entire Severed Immortal Arm away."

He snorted coldly.

"That is absolutely impossible through mortal means."

Nangong Lie added, "Not to mention that we old fellows are present."

"Just this Severed Immortal Arm alone, which combines the power of countless True Immortal seal scripts..."

"I fear that throughout the entire star sea, there is currently no cultivator capable of forcibly moving it."

...

Li Fan merely nodded in praise as he listened to the Immortal Ark elders.

Then he slowly wandered through the secret treasury of the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales, patiently selecting his prize.

Chapter 1321: The Mystery Of Controlled Immortal Ancestor

As expected of the secret treasury that the Xuanshang Immortal Ark had preserved since ancient times, the treasures recorded in the Hidden Immortal Compendium of Hundred Tales were truly extraordinary.

As the only surviving land within the Darkest Star Sea, the Xuanhuang Realm could be said to contain the accumulated essence of the entire Star Sea. Having reincarnated for a hundred lifetimes, Li Fan had practically turned the Xuanhuang Realm upside down. Ordinary hidden treasures naturally found it difficult to attract his interest.

Yet as he strolled through this place, Li Fan still discovered many items that intrigued him.

For example, there was an immortal crane that appeared to be cast from bronze.

According to the records within the Hidden Immortal Compendium of Hundred Tales, this bronze crane had actually been forged from numerous fragments of immortal artifacts. Although it possessed none of the abilities of immortal artifacts, its material alone made it incomparably sturdy. No divine ability or spell could damage it in the slightest.

It might not truly be indestructible through countless calamities, but at the very least, even the catastrophe that destroyed the Darkest Star Sea had failed to leave any mark upon it.

'Limited by mortal materials, the Tianyang Immortal Puppets I forged in previous lives, even with the enhancement of source power essence, still failed to break through the mortal limit. The fact that Tianyang could delay Immortal Ancestor for a period of time was already due to the firmness of his fighting will. However, if this material were incorporated during the forging process...'

The thought flashed through Li Fan's mind.

Another example was a stream of seven-colored light.

It looked extremely similar to the Seven-Colored Jade Void Light that Zhong Shentong had fished out of the Fishing Pond.

However, the Seven-Colored Jade Void Light was refined by great divine ability cultivators from the seven streams of light that illuminated the world of the Chongyan cultivation realm. It was born from the evolution of the Heavenly Dao itself and contained the world's origin essence.

The stream of light preserved within the Hidden Immortal Compendium of Hundred Tales, however, was the remnant left behind after the natural end of an unknown cultivation world.

It could be regarded as the corpse of a cultivation world.

Li Fan had personally refined the Seven-Colored Jade Void Light before.

According to his understanding, although these two kinds of seven-colored light differed fundamentally in nature, they seemed to share a hidden connection.

'Perhaps it concerns the evolution from death to life within a world...'

Having already claimed the Fishing Pond as his own in this life, Li Fan naturally developed the idea of collecting both types of seven-colored light for detailed comparison.

There was also a figurine standing with its hands folded before it, its eyelids lowered.

The Xuanshang Immortal Ark had obtained it by chance. Despite all their research, they had failed to determine its purpose. Eventually, it had been placed within the secret treasury and gradually forgotten.

When Li Fan passed by the figurine, he clearly sensed a slight reaction from [Truth].

Although it was not as excited as when it encountered the Eternal Remnant Will, anything capable of eliciting a response from [Truth] was enough to demonstrate its extraordinary nature.

'It should also be related to the Projection of the Dao.'

Li Fan remained expressionless and did not linger on the figurine.

...

Li Fan patiently selected treasures within the Immortal Ark's secret treasury, while three elders of the Immortal Ark followed him the entire time.

They did not disturb him, merely watching his every move in silence.

"It seems the thief from back then truly caused the Immortal Ark tremendous losses. Even with the Severed Immortal Arm as an additional safeguard, fellow Daoists still cannot rest at ease."

Li Fan suddenly stopped and joked.

Gan Jingda, Nangong Lie, and Lu Yuzhi all stared at their noses and maintained inner calm, pretending not to hear.

"I wonder what exactly the Immortal Ark lost back then?"

Li Fan continued searching through the treasures as he casually asked.

"Hmph..."

The Immortal Ark elders mostly revealed expressions of indignation upon hearing this.

Zhong Daogong's voice drifted over from afar.

"The past is painful to recall. But so many years have already passed. Since fellow Daoist is interested, there is no harm in telling you."

"Among the several supreme treasures lost by the Immortal Ark back then, the most precious was an Ice Crystal Immortal Amber."

A trace of nostalgia entered Zhong Daogong's voice.

Seeing that Jian Daosheng, the chief of the Severed Immortal Tower, appeared to have personally experienced those events, he sighed.

"Even now, the dreamlike appearance of the Ice Crystal Immortal Amber occasionally resurfaces in my mind. I only regret that I was not more forceful back then and failed to stop it, ultimately leading to the tragedy."

The other elders also sighed in succession.

Li Fan asked curiously, "Ice Crystal Immortal Amber? The name alone sounds beautiful. But what exactly is it?"

Zhong Daogong replied, "The Ice Crystal Immortal Amber is actually a frozen cultivation world. To explain its origin, we must speak of an extremely rare celestial phenomenon that existed within the Star Sea during ancient times."

The curiosity on Li Fan's face deepened.

"I would be honored to hear the details."

"The Star Sea of that era was not as deathly silent as it is now. In addition to the countless vibrant cultivation worlds with their diverse scenery, many Star Sea phenomena would appear from time to time."

"Heavenly whales leaping, star horses galloping, yin-yang vortices..."

"When these phenomena erupted, they often covered entire star regions and affected dozens of cultivation worlds. Some merely manifested as wondrous sights upon the world's heavenly curtain, while others brought world-ending disasters."

"The Brilliant Crystal Wind was one of them."

"A freezing wind of unknown origin would suddenly descend, blowing from the starry sky toward the earth."

"Wherever the freezing wind passed, Soul Transformation cultivators, Dao Integration cultivators, and Longevity Immortals alike had no time to react before instantly freezing."

"All living beings, and even the world itself, would become ice sculptures beneath the touch of the Brilliant Crystal Wind."

With a light tap of Zhong Daogong's finger, a terrifying scene of a frozen world appeared above the secret treasury.

"The frozen cultivation world would remain isolated within the star sea forever, never to thaw again. Any living being who attempted to approach would be affected by the absolute cold, either suffering severe injuries and fleeing or becoming an eternal ice sculpture themselves."

Looking at the image above, Li Fan frowned slightly.

"I understand the meaning of 'Ice Crystal' now. But why is it called 'Immortal Amber'?"

Jian Daosheng answered his question.

"If it were merely a frozen world, the Xuanshang Immortal Ark would never have regarded it as a supreme treasure."

"In truth, although the probability of a Brilliant Crystal Wind occurring is low, considering the vastness of the Star Sea and the accumulation of countless ages..."

"The number of frozen worlds still in existence is not particularly small."

"The reason the one collected by the Immortal Ark was so valuable was because an extremely special existence was preserved within that frozen cultivation world."

Jian Daosheng's voice turned distant, as if he had returned to the past.

"The Brilliant Crystal Wind descended from the Starry Sky. The world should have become an ice sculpture instantly."

"Yet a phantom figure appeared within that world and attempted to block the freezing wind."

"But how could a mortal cultivator resist a Star Sea phenomenon?"

"It is said that when the Star Sea phenomena were at their peak, even True Immortals had to avoid them. Let alone ordinary cultivators like us."

"So the outcome was obvious. Trying to save the world was nothing more than a mantis attempting to stop a chariot, seeking its own destruction."

"However, it still managed to delay the freezing for the briefest instant."

"The world was no longer frozen in an instant. Instead, the living beings within gained a fleeting moment to react."

Jian Daosheng sighed.

"It was precisely this instant that created an entirely unique frozen world."

"Faced with a world-ending catastrophe, living beings displayed all manner of expressions. Some were terrified. Some were despairing. Some saw that figure and felt hope. Others found it impossible to believe."

"It truly captured the countless facets of sentient life."

"If that were all, it would merely be a somewhat rarer frozen world. It would not deserve the title of 'Immortal Amber.'"

Jian Daosheng continued.

"The reason it bears the word 'Immortal' is because of that phantom figure that attempted to stop the Brilliant Crystal Wind."

Hearing this, Li Fan could not help but speculate.

"Could it be that an actual True Immortal is truly sealed within that frozen world?"

Seeing Jian Daosheng shake his head, he replied, "Not exactly. If a True Immortal had truly been sealed inside, our Immortal Ark would never have dared keep it aboard. However, in terms of value alone, that figure may have been even more precious than a True Immortal. After all, before the immortal path was severed, every world had cultivators who ascended to immortality."

"But an incarnated Heart Demon is truly unprecedented and unimaginably rare throughout history."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes slightly upon hearing this.

"A Heart Demon? Incarnated?"

During his previous life, while cultivating through possessing Zhao Xian, Li Fan had already experienced the torment of Heart Demons within the Star Sea.

As long as cultivation continued, Heart Demons would accompany a cultivator throughout their entire journey without end. Even if forcibly suppressed through external means, they would soon return, growing increasingly severe.

In his previous life, Zhao Xian had been unable to free himself from the constant interference of his Heart Demons, which hindered his advancement in cultivation. That was why the impatient Li Fan had directly used the Dao Pill technique to seize his body.

And this was with Heart Demons under the shattered laws of the Star Sea.

Even after being weakened severalfold, they could still have such a tremendous impact on cultivation. One could only imagine how terrifying Heart Demons had been when the ancient Star Sea laws remained complete.

No wonder ancient cultivators turned pale at the mention of Heart Demons and avoided them at all costs.

However, what Li Fan experienced through Zhao Xian's body had merely been the various illusions erupting from within the mind. He had never seen the true source behind those illusions.

"Heart Demons should be a type of law. How could they possess physical form?" Li Fan asked with genuine astonishment and disbelief.

"That is precisely why the Ice Crystal Immortal Amber is so extraordinarily precious. Without seeing it with one's own eyes, no one could imagine that such a wondrous object could exist in this world."

"After acquiring the Ice Crystal Immortal Amber, the entire Immortal Ark spent several decades debating its nature. Only in the end did we confirm that the shadow within that frozen crystal world was indeed a Heart Demon."

"We speculate that this Heart Demon was born from the Heart Demon laws of another cultivation world. We simply do not know why it left its original world and suffered such a calamity."

At this moment, Zhong Daogong added, "The Immortal Ark actually developed a reasonable theory regarding this matter."

"Heart Demons are formless and intangible. They are not constrained by space and can freely travel throughout the Star Sea. Unburdened by physical bodies, they can even appear directly within a cultivator's mind."

"Many cultivators who fall under the influence of Heart Demons lose clarity of mind and seem to become entirely different people. The invasion of a Heart Demon can essentially be regarded as the highest form of possession."

"Although this incarnated Heart Demon is exceptionally unique, it still cannot escape the fundamental nature of Heart Demons. Traveling across the Star Sea and seeking suitable hosts to parasitize is its instinct. That may be the reason it appeared within that frozen world."

"In fact, judging from the level of power it displayed when that world was frozen, its targets would not be limited to cultivators alone."

"Even the Heavenly Dao consciousness of an entire world could be corrupted by this incarnated Heart Demon."

"Tempting the Heavenly Dao of another world and replacing it entirely. Perhaps calling it a Heavenly Demon would be more appropriate."

...

As Zhong Daogong spoke at length, his words carried deep regret over the loss of such a treasure.

Li Fan, however, felt his thoughts stir.

The scene from his previous life resurfaced in his mind.

Under the world-destroying storm unleashed by the immortal formation, the shell of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor had gradually dissolved, revealing the transparent figure hidden within.

The moment Li Fan saw that transparent figure, a faint sense of familiarity arose in his heart.

It was not because he had seen this transparent figure before.

Rather, he had encountered the aura of beings similar to it.

That familiarity came from Tian Jue, Tian Yu, Tian Yin, and the Tian Yi (Heavenly Doctor).

Or rather...

It came from the Heavenly Law Realm.

"Heavenly Demon..."

Li Fan thought he might finally understand why the Immortal Ancestor had infiltrated this place all those years ago.

"Was the Heavenly Demon also one of the Venerables of the Heavenly Law Realm?"

"The Venerables of the Heavenly Law Realm uphold the Dao on behalf of Heaven. The Heavenly Demon is the manifestation of the Heart Demon Dao."

"However, due to its unique nature, the Heavenly Demon roams the Star Sea and rarely remains within the Heavenly Law Realm."

"Perhaps through sheer misfortune, it encountered an exceptionally rare Star Sea phenomenon and suffered the calamity of eternal freezing."

"If the Immortal Ancestor had not rescued it later, it might have remained frozen forever and become nothing more than another exhibit in the Immortal Ark's collection."

"But why did the Immortal Ancestor save the Heavenly Demon?"

"And why was he later corrupted by it in return?"

The figure of the Heavenly Doctor suddenly appeared in Li Fan's mind.

Judging from their interactions in his previous life, the Immortal Ancestor had clearly been under the Heavenly Doctor's control.

Previously, Li Fan had speculated that the Immortal Ancestor was a clone created by the Heavenly Doctor.

But now, it seemed their relationship might not be so simple.

"The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor, Xuanyuan Goudan. Perhaps he truly is the reincarnation of the Xuantian King..."

"For the first half of his life, he was merely an ordinary mortal. Then suddenly he awakened, as though some consciousness had crossed over and possessed him."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

...

"No matter what, I finally understand why the Immortal Ancestor is controlled by the Heavenly Doctor."

"The Heavenly Demon hidden deep within his soul is responsible."

Li Fan then recalled that Heart Demons no longer existed in the current Xuanhuang Realm.

Perhaps this was not solely because of the new cultivation system established by the Immortal Ancestor.

With an incarnated Heart Demon like the Heavenly Demon present, ordinary Heart Demons naturally could no longer descend to interfere with cultivators.

His thoughts churned endlessly.

After listening to the explanations of the Immortal Ark elders, Li Fan could not help but sigh sincerely.

"In that case, it truly was an extraordinary treasure. For it to have been stolen is deeply regrettable."

"What did the thief look like? Is he still alive?" Li Fan asked.

"If you can provide enough information, perhaps our Great Qi can assist in tracking him down."

Zhong Daogong raised an eyebrow.

"Using True Immortal seal script?"

Li Fan shook his head.

"Not exactly. We rely on a world-protecting immortal artifact combined with the power of formations. The principles involved are too profound for me to explain clearly."

Although his explanation was vague, the power of Creation he had displayed earlier had already fully demonstrated the foundations of Great Qi civilization.

As such, the people of the Immortal Ark did not doubt his words.

After all, Li Fan had made no promises. He had only said "perhaps."

After discussing the matter among themselves and in order to avoid arousing Li Fan's suspicion, the elders of the Immortal Ark ultimately revealed the recorded appearance of the thief from back then.

As expected, it was the Immortal Ancestor.

However, the recorded image preserved by the Immortal Ark differed slightly from the Immortal Ancestor Li Fan had seen in his previous life.

His expression was far more vivid and lifelike.

As if they were two entirely different people.

Chapter 1322: The Divine Tree Conceals An Immortal Script Character

"This person's features are filled with compassion. He does not seem like a cunning thief," Li Fan commented.

Jian Daosheng let out a cold snort. "That was exactly what our Immortal Ark thought back then. As they say, knowing a person's face does not mean knowing their heart."

Zhong Daogong asked, "Can you track him based solely on his appearance? Would you not need additional methods?"

"It would be best if we had a personal item belonging to the thief. But even if we do not..."

"It does not matter."

Li Fan wore an expression of complete confidence in the "Great Qi Immortal Artifact."

"With his appearance and life experiences, it is enough to perform a deduction and track him down."

"However, I must first return to Great Qi and report this information."

Li Fan's words caused a small disagreement among the elders of the Immortal Ark.

Jian Daosheng spoke first. "In truth, we do not necessarily need to kill this man. Great Qi's civilization has researched True Immortal seal script to a level no weaker than our own. If we can use this opportunity to maintain contact and exchange knowledge, it may not be a bad thing for our Immortal Ark."

Several elders immediately voiced their agreement.

"Indeed. We originally planned to eliminate him because we feared that the Immortal Ark's research into True Immortal seal script would be leaked. But judging from the current situation, Great Qi's research shares many similarities with ours. Furthermore, they do not guard their inheritance as strictly as we do."

"Moreover, judging from his words, the cultivation world where Great Qi resides is vast and rich in resources. Everyone, do not forget the trade that sustains our Immortal Ark. Trading across all worlds and connecting through eternity, this has always been the creed of the Immortal Ark."

"Killing him brings no benefit. If we establish friendly relations, we may even escape the Immortal Ark's current predicament."

"And do not forget that plan. The requirement is to gather as many True Immortal seal script characters as possible. At our current rate of collection, it may still take several hundred years to complete. But with Great Qi's contribution, perhaps success is finally within reach."

...

The elders' arguments were reasonable and well founded.

Gradually, even those who had insisted on killing Li Fan afterward began to hesitate.

After all, only by weighing gains and losses could they guide the Immortal Ark farther into the future. Rigidity and an inability to adapt would only lead the Immortal Ark to destruction. This was the lesson the Xuan Immortal Ark had learned after surviving countless calamities.

In the end, Zhong Daogong made the final decision.

"Let us first see the power of this True Immortal seal script."

While the Immortal Ark elders were discussing matters, Li Fan had already completed his selection within the secret treasury.

He chose the three items that had interested him earlier: the bronze immortal crane, the seven-colored flowing radiance, and the bowing puppet.

"Fellow Daoist, are you certain about these items? Once chosen, they cannot be changed." Zhong Daogong glanced over them and smiled as he reminded him.

Li Fan nodded in confirmation.

Zhong Daogong joined forces with the other elders and cast a spell into the void, summoning a sheet of white paper.

The Severed Immortal Arm from the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales was controlled to press its palm onto the paper.

The blank surface was instantly dyed black with ink.

Three profound patterns appeared upon it. They resembled True Immortal seal script characters, yet were much simpler and bore the characteristics of the three selected items.

At the same time, Li Fan noticed that the three treasures he had chosen vanished from the secret treasury after a brief fluctuation.

It was as though they had been imprinted onto the sheet of paper.

With a wave of his hand, Zhong Daogong rolled up the completed paper and stored it away.

Looking at Li Fan, he said, "The items you requested are here. Once the transaction is complete, I shall present them with both hands."

"Good. Straightforward!" Li Fan praised.

"I originally planned to reveal everything after seeing the Immortal Ark's True Immortal seal script firsthand. But now it seems there is no harm in giving you a glimpse in advance."

His tone even carried a trace of excitement.

"You and I are both researchers of True Immortal seal script. The excitement we feel upon witnessing these great characters must surely be the same."

"As the saying goes, hearing the Dao in the morning, one may die without regret in the evening."

"I'm afraid the Immortal Ark is too cramped. Why not go into the outer void instead?" Li Fan asked eagerly.

The elders had gone through great effort to lure Li Fan aboard the Immortal Ark. How could they possibly let him leave?

Zhong Daogong waved his hand.

"We can do it here with the Various Forms Method."

"Do not worry. The Severed Immortal Arm within this secret treasury has fused with countless fragmented characters. Through mutual restraint, they can reduce the influence of the True Immortal seal script to the minimum."

Li Fan looked somewhat disappointed.

"I had hoped to display my attainments before everyone."

Zhong Daogong formed another hand seal.

The Severed Immortal Arm suddenly exploded before the crowd.

It transformed into countless incomplete character fragments, like swimming tadpoles, sealing the space in all directions.

A prison of True Immortal seal script was formed.

"Fellow Daoist, you may begin."

The moment Zhong Daogong spoke, the eyes of every Immortal Ark elder locked firmly onto Li Fan.

Li Fan coughed lightly, his expression becoming solemn.

"Fellow Daoists, let me emphasize once more. The True Immortal seal script character I am about to depict is reconstructed from my own understanding and memory."

"Compared to the original version from the Immortal Realm, it naturally differs. Even compared to the one preserved in the memories of Great Qi's immortal artifact, there are certain deviations."

"But please rest assured. My skill is among the very best in all of Great Qi. I certainly will not disappoint you."

After speaking a great deal of nonsense and thoroughly whetting the appetite of the Immortal Ark elders, Li Fan finally unfolded once more the scene of flickering arcs of light above the endless green wilderness.

As light and shadow shifted, an incomparably mysterious character officially appeared before everyone.

Boom!

The moment the True Immortal seal script character, [Creation], descended into the world, the wandering characters within the surrounding prison erupted into chaos.

Many fragments directly detached themselves from the prison structure and surged toward the radiant character at the center.

Even though it was only an illusory projection, it still drove the fragmented seal scripts into madness.

The Severed Immortal Arm began disintegrating on its own. The Immortal Ark elders had no choice but to divert part of their attention to maintaining its stability.

But in truth, just like those character fragments, the attention of the elders themselves had become uncontrollably fixed upon the two characters, "Creation."

"As expected, he did not exaggerate. This single character surpasses all the others combined!"

"Creation. It is actually Creation!"

"The Immortal Ark is saved!"

...

The Immortal Ark elders had immersed themselves in the study of True Immortal seal script for most of their lives. Their comprehension abilities needed no explanation.

Upon seeing the true form of [Creation], they quickly grasped its meaning.

Without exception, they cried out in shock.

Before the supreme principles of the Great Dao, all schemes and self-control were meaningless.

While all the elders' attention was completely captivated, Li Fan quietly observed and analyzed the guardian of the secret treasury, that Severed Immortal Arm.

It had to be said that using fragmented characters to fuse all the treasures together as an anti-theft measure was truly ingenious.

Even Li Fan, who had experienced countless reincarnations, possessed extraordinary knowledge, and had the support of the Final Dissociation Disc, could not immediately find a way to break it.

However, now that the character [Creation] had appeared, the seal script fragments making up the Severed Immortal Arm were disintegrating and gathering toward it of their own accord.

This gave Li Fan an opportunity to examine its composition in detail.

"Breaking this arm completely in an instant would be difficult. But taking a few key items from it should still be possible."

Li Fan silently deduced and calculated.

The True Immortal seal script character [Creation] was far too profound to comprehend in a short time.

The Immortal Ark elders were immersed within it. Seeing Li Fan merely waiting quietly at the side, they spared no additional attention for him.

As a result, Li Fan gained ample time to analyze the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales.

"This one, this one, and this one as well. It would be best to take them all later..."

Li Fan naturally noticed the killing intent the Immortal Ark elders had concealed toward him.

However, Li Fan himself harbored no good intentions either.

Taking advantage of the chaos caused by the character [Creation] within the secret vault, Li Fan had silently already laid down his methods of plunder.

He used the same incomplete True Immortal seal script character, disguising the false as the genuine and integrating it into the Severed Immortal Arm.

The longer the Immortal Ark elders immersed themselves in comprehending [Creation], the more hidden measures he implanted.

And the more items he would be able to seize later.

"There is no need to make a move just yet." Li Fan narrowed his eyes slightly while his hands continued moving in secret.

In the blink of an eye, more than thirty days had passed.

Zhong Daogong was the first to awaken from his comprehension. His expression was somewhat dazed before he let out a long breath.

He then bowed to Li Fan.

"Thank you, Fellow Daoist."

"To personally witness [Creation] is truly a blessing bestowed by heaven. If not for your generosity, I fear I would never have encountered such an opportunity in this lifetime."

Li Fan calmly accepted the gratitude and waved his hand.

"It was merely a transaction."

Zhong Daogong shook his head.

"How could mundane objects possibly compare to [Creation]? In this transaction, our Immortal Ark has gained an enormous advantage."

Li Fan laughed heartily and said no more.

The other Immortal Ark elders gradually awoke from their enlightenment as well.

Like Zhong Daogong, they first offered slight bows to Li Fan. Then their gazes met before ultimately settling on him once more.

The meaning contained within their eyes was almost identical.

They wished to see a purer and more complete version of [Creation].

As the saying goes, human desire knows no bounds. After witnessing the True Immortal seal script character written by Li Fan and vaguely sensing the limitless power contained within it, an even deeper longing inevitably arose within their hearts.

"Fellow Daoist, regarding the [Creation] contained within Great Qi's world-protecting immortal artifact..."

"May we have the opportunity to see it?" Jian Daosheng asked politely.

Li Fan revealed a troubled expression.

"Even within Great Qi, only direct descendants who pass through layers of scrutiny are qualified to witness the immortal artifact's true memory. Everyone else can only learn through repeated retellings."

Li Fan looked at the expressions of the Immortal Ark elders and smiled.

"I completely understand your feelings. However, this is only our first transaction. Once our relationship deepens in the future, perhaps your request to visit and observe it can be approved."

The Immortal Ark elders displayed varying expressions upon hearing this.

They began discussing the matter in private once more.

"Elder Zhong, what should we do now?"

"We definitely cannot kill him. We must maintain contact with Great Qi so we can obtain a more complete [Creation]."

"Indeed. Compared to [Creation], those other True Immortal seal script characters now seem somewhat insignificant."

"Great Qi is willing to share even [Creation]. Compared to them, our Immortal Ark truly appears narrow-minded."

After witnessing the power of [Creation], the attitudes of all the Immortal Ark elders underwent a complete shift.

Seeing this, Zhong Daogong had already made his decision.

"According to our agreement, we shall now lead you to see that authentic True Immortal seal script."

He smiled as he spoke to Li Fan.

"Although it cannot compare to the [Creation] you displayed, it is still the work of a True Immortal. I believe it will certainly provide you with inspiration."

"Oh? Then I can hardly wait."

Sensing the hidden measures he had left within the Severed Immortal Arm, Li Fan smiled in response.

He followed the Immortal Ark elders and temporarily departed from the secret vault.

From the very top of the divine tree, they traveled all the way to its core.

Within a space suffused with verdant light floated a ruin.

Countless branches extended downward from above, spreading throughout the trunk of the divine tree.

Inscribed upon the ground of the ruins was a True Immortal seal script character.

However, its full appearance was obscured by the divine tree branches.

The moment he saw the ruins, Li Fan's heart stirred.

Because the architectural style of this place was remarkably similar to what he had once seen upon the land of the Immortal Ruins.

"An Immortal Realm ruin?" Li Fan could not help but ask as he turned his head, appearing greatly astonished.

"You have keen insight, Fellow Daoist."

The Immortal Ark elders were likewise surprised that Li Fan could recognize the origin of the ruins. Their evaluation of Great Qi civilization rose once again.

"Indeed. These ruins fell from the upper realm when the Immortal Path was severed."

Zhong Daogong spoke solemnly.

"At that time, news of the severed immortal path had not yet spread through the Star Sea. Thus, no one realized that this suddenly appearing structure was related to the Immortal Realm."

"Only the True Immortal seal script character inscribed within brought forth a great calamity."

"It was only ten thousand years later that our Immortal Ark discovered the source of that catastrophe within the ruins of the Star Sea."

The Immortal Ark elders formed hand seals together.

The divine tree branches wrapped around the ruins gradually loosened.

The true appearance of the True Immortal seal script character was finally revealed.

Perhaps because too much time had passed, and because the divine tree had absorbed it day and night, the fluctuations emanating from the character had become nearly imperceptible.

Yet this did not prevent Li Fan from instantly understanding its meaning.

[Ancient].

"Ancient..."

Li Fan muttered softly as he used his finger as a brush, attempting to imitate and reproduce it.

The character Ancient upon the ruins seemed very similar to the character Chaos that he had once seen within the White Mist Maze.

True Immortal seal script characters were descriptions of the Great Dao itself.

However, unless the Dao personally manifested, different individuals writing the same character would naturally display different traits.

Having studied True Immortal seal script for many years, Li Fan could clearly distinguish such differences.

The characters Ancient and Chaos had been written by the same person.

The character Hunger within the land of the Immortal Ruins, however, did not share the same origin.

"If my guess is correct, Ancient, Chaos, and the True Immortal seal script characters responsible for the countless world-ending calamities in the Dark Star Sea were all created by the same individual."

"The purpose was to plunge the Star Sea into chaos."

"As for the character Hunger within the Immortal Ruins, it may have simply been used by a True Immortal for Dao comprehension."

"Although their original intentions differed, they ultimately led to the same result, the destruction of the Star Sea and its descent into complete silence."

"In the eyes of True Immortals, cultivators like us are truly no different from ants..."

Numerous thoughts flashed through Li Fan's mind in an instant.

"Although the energy fluctuations within this authentic script have completely dissipated, it still possesses unique uses."

At this moment, Li Fan suddenly heard Zhong Daogong speak these words.
