Chapter 1323: Entropy Reversal And Rejuvenation

“Oh? Please elaborate.” Li Fan's expression turned serious.

“Can Fellow Daoist discern the miraculous use of this True Immortal seal script character, [Ancient]?” Zhong Daogong deliberately kept him in suspense.

Li Fan pondered for a moment, tracing lightly through the air with his finger.

“Ancient means the past, the old...”

“...Time reversal?”

As he carefully examined the mysterious character on the ruins below, Li Fan's eyes suddenly lit up.

Zhong Daogong clapped his hands in praise.

“Fellow Daoist's comprehension is truly extraordinary. Even the elders of our Immortal Ark require several days before gaining any insight from it. Yet you managed to see through it at a glance!”

“However, describing its power as time reversal may not be entirely accurate. It is more like things themselves returning to their former state...”

Li Fan listened to the explanation and nodded slightly.

'It sounds somewhat similar to Ou Shangtian's Ancient Hands of Heaven and Earth.'

He reflected inwardly.

“When the [Ancient] character was at its peak, everything within its range would suffer an unimaginably terrifying catastrophe. All things would evolve backward toward their former selves. From life to death, reduced to drifting sand. Truly becoming ancient and passing away...” Zhong Daogong waved his hand, causing dozens of scenes to appear before them.

The moment the [Ancient] character manifested, cultivators, towering trees, endless buildings across the land, and even the world itself began evolving backward as though time had reversed.

In the end, everything transformed into microscopic particles and was scattered by the wind.

“If this original inscription still retained significant power, then no matter how tempting it might be, our Immortal Ark would only dare avoid it and never covet it. But now...”

The Immortal Ark cultivators then demonstrated the practical use of the True Immortal seal script.

The oldest among the elders, cultivator Jian Daosheng of the Severed Immortal Tower, slowly flew toward the [Ancient] character.

He did not approach too closely and instead hovered in the air.

The power of the [Ancient] character had supposedly been exhausted, as Zhong Daogong had said, but that was only relative to its former state. In truth, a faint residue of its power still remained within the original inscription.

Compared to its peak strength, it was negligible.

Yet just like the [Dawn] character, overwhelming power brought disaster while weaker power could bring benefits.

Once the reversing force of the [Ancient] character had diminished to an appropriate level...

The wrinkles on Jian Daosheng's face gradually faded.

Black strands appeared amidst his white brows and hair.

His bent body straightened once more, and even his spirit became noticeably more vigorous.

This scene was unmistakably one of rejuvenation and restored youth.

The Immortal Ark elders were already accustomed to it, but Li Fan narrowed his eyes thoughtfully.

Jian Daosheng did not remain until he had completely reverted to his youthful years.

After staying within the influence of the [Ancient] character for only a few breaths, he gracefully retreated.

Li Fan understood the reason.

It was to prevent himself from being influenced too deeply by the character's power.

After Jian Daosheng, the other Immortal Ark elders also took turns approaching the original inscription.

Some stayed longer, some shorter, but all became noticeably younger.

“With this character, wouldn't one be able to remain forever young and immortal?” Li Fan exclaimed.

Zhong Daogong smiled bitterly.

“It is not as simple as it appears. Remaining youthful is possible, but immortality...”

He shook his head.

“Using the [Ancient] character for rejuvenation can indeed increase one's lifespan limit somewhat. However, the more times it is used, the weaker the effect becomes. Once one's lifespan reaches its ultimate limit, it can no longer be extended.”

“Even so, possessing a youthful body is vastly preferable to existing on the verge of death.”

After all the Immortal Ark elders had finished, Zhong Daogong looked toward Li Fan and asked:

“Would Fellow Daoist like to experience it as well?”

Li Fan declined politely.

“I am only thirty years old. This is already the peak period of my body. Returning to childhood would be harmful instead.”

The moment those words were spoken, complete silence fell over the Divine Tree space.

Every elder stared at Li Fan as though looking at a monster.

Even Zhong Daogong's expression stiffened slightly.

“Fellow Daoist must be joking, right?”

Based on Li Fan's strength, along with the attainments he had displayed in formations and seal script characters, the people of the Immortal Ark had long assumed he was a cultivator who had lived for several hundred or even several thousand years.

Now Li Fan was claiming he was only thirty years old.

How could they possibly accept that?

Li Fan chuckled.

“I merely learn things a bit faster. Although there are not many, there are still people in Great Qi who are even more talented than I am. There is no need for everyone to be so surprised.”

His words left the Immortal Ark cultivators thoroughly shaken.

After jointly resealing the [Ancient] character, they escorted Li Fan out from within the Divine Tree.

“Fellow Daoist, please rest here for now and refrain from leaving temporarily. We still have some matters that require discussion...”

At the highest level of the Immortal Ark space, within a pavilion courtyard resembling one atop a mountain peak, Zhong Daogong gave these instructions.

“Oh, right. These are the three items you selected earlier.”

After handing over a scroll of white paper, Zhong Daogong hurried away.

Ignoring the Immortal Ark cultivators, Li Fan slowly unfolded the white paper in his hand.

The three treasures immediately leaped out from the scroll and floated before him.

He had already carefully examined the bronze immortal crane and the seven-colored stream of light.

With a wave of his hand, he directly stored them away.

His attention then focused on the figurine with downcast eyes.

Sensing the faint fluctuations transmitted by [Truth], Li Fan's mind became focused.

Just like the previous two items, the figurine vanished in an instant.

This time, however, it was not stored away.

Instead, it transformed into a mysterious energy and was absorbed by [Truth].

Li Fan stared closely at the [Truth] interface.

Tiny currents seemed to flash across it as the characters on the panel flickered several times.

Then they settled once more.

Li Fan's gaze fell upon the section that had changed.

“Virtualization Charging Progress: 400%.”

“Hm?”

Li Fan's eyes narrowed.

Virtualization Charging Progress was the prerequisite for activating [Truth] and reversing everything.

Only when the charge reached 100% could illusion become reality and reality become illusion.

This was also why, after every [Truth], Li Fan would remain hidden within the Great Xuan Small World until the charging process was complete before venturing outside.

Previously, the maximum charge limit had been 200%.

Any charge beyond 100% could, at critical moments, shield Li Fan from external attacks and ensure the successful activation of [Truth].

However, as the enemies Li Fan provoked grew increasingly powerful, this protective function had become rather insignificant.

The charge depleted too quickly and provided only marginal benefit.

Yet now, this figurine had directly doubled the maximum charge limit.

Furthermore, Li Fan could sense that if this additional 200% charge remained unused during this life, it would not disappear when [Truth] reset everything.

Instead, it would remain within [Truth] itself.

In other words, he could use it to perform three consecutive [Truth] reversions.

“Interesting.”

Li Fan recalled the appearance of that puppet.

'The origin of this puppet is rather strange. Something capable of increasing the charging limit by 200 percent is definitely no ordinary object.'

'I just wonder, if I encounter it again in the next life and absorb it once more, will the charging limit continue to increase?'

Up to this point, Li Fan still had not figured out the exact mechanism behind the charging of [Truth].

The unknown medium required to activate [Truth] could only be accumulated slowly through the passage of time.

'Perhaps by carefully studying this puppet, I can uncover the mystery.'

Li Fan narrowed his eyes and mentally recorded this objective.

A 400 percent charging limit was no different from having an extra layer of protection. More importantly, when facing beings such as the Faceless True Immortal or even higher existences, Li Fan could use [Truth] several times in succession, maximizing his chances of escaping their threat.

Otherwise, if he possessed only a single use of [Truth], then after returning to the designated anchor point, he would still have to face the same deadly danger. In that case, his situation would become extremely perilous.

From this perspective, the life-saving value of this puppet could not be overstated.

'The Immortal Ark truly is my blessed land.'

'Later, I can also ask them about the origin of this puppet.'

Li Fan thought to himself.

Not long afterward, Zhong Daogong led a group of elders back before Li Fan.

It seemed that their previous discussion had reached some kind of consensus. The faint hostility and killing intent Li Fan had sensed from several of them earlier had completely disappeared.

"Fellow Daoist, are you satisfied with this transaction?" Zhong Daogong asked first.

"My harvest has been abundant. Once I return, my master will certainly reward me. By the way, rest assured. I will do my utmost to investigate information regarding that thief for you," Li Fan promised.

"Haha, then we shall thank Fellow Daoist in advance."

After the pleasantries, Zhong Daogong changed the topic.

"Fellow Daoist has already proven your credibility to the Immortal Ark. After unanimous discussion among the elders, we believe there may be room for deeper cooperation between us."

Li Fan immediately became interested.

"You still have more True Immortal seal script characters that you have not brought out?"

Zhong Daogong waved his hand.

"Not True Immortal seal script. But something even more important."

The scenery of the surrounding pavilions suddenly changed.

It was as if they had instantly arrived within the Darkest Star Sea.

With a gesture from Zhong Daogong, the surrounding light and shadows shifted rapidly, passing through the endless Sea of Relics and the boundless Great Wall of Remnant Worlds.

They arrived at a place of utter emptiness.

"This is..." Li Fan was slightly startled.

"The High Wall. Beneath the High Wall."

Zhong Daogong's expression was complicated as he spoke in a solemn tone.

"Oh?"

Li Fan surveyed the surroundings before replying.

"I have also once traveled beneath the High Wall, to the end of the Darkest Sea. The path ahead was completely severed, yet I never saw the physical form of the High Wall."

"Why are you showing me this scene of the High Wall?"

Zhong Daogong's gaze deepened.

"The High Wall stretches endlessly, surrounding the entire Star Sea. However, the section of the High Wall we are showing you today is different from all the others."

"Different? If it is all the same High Wall, then what exactly makes it different?"

Li Fan's expression changed slightly.

It was Jian Daosheng who answered instead.

"This region can be considered the weakest part of the entire High Wall. If there exists any place in the Star Sea where crossing the High Wall is possible, then this location undoubtedly offers the greatest chance."

Zhong Daogong slowly added, "In Fellow Daoist's homeland, there must also be many cultivators unwilling to remain trapped within the Darkest Star Sea for eternity, seeking a way to escape. If we cooperate, success may not be impossible."

"The weakest part of the High Wall..."

Li Fan stared at the scene displayed by the Immortal Ark, repeating the words several times.

Instead of giving an answer, he countered with a question.

"How are you so certain? The existence of the High Wall already surpasses current understanding. It is formless, invisible, and cannot truly be perceived. Yet you can accurately identify its weakest point?"

Zhong Daogong smiled faintly.

"This matter concerns one of the Immortal Ark's greatest secrets. Until cooperation between us is confirmed, I am afraid I cannot reveal it."

"However, Fellow Daoist may rest assured. This matter is absolutely genuine. You may report it to your side. When representatives return in the future, the Immortal Ark can first demonstrate proof for you."

Li Fan's expression turned serious.

After pondering for a long time, he cupped his fists.

"This matter is indeed of tremendous importance and not something I can decide on my own. After returning, I will certainly report it to my elders. No matter what, I will definitely provide all of you with an answer."

"Then we shall await Fellow Daoist's good news."

Under the gaze of the elders, Li Fan transformed into a streak of light and departed from the Immortal Ark, disappearing into the vast star sea.

"A risky move."

"If this matter is exposed..."

"What is there to fear? Could someone in this Star Sea really come knocking on our door and demand that we share the location of the weak point in the High Wall? In my opinion, that would be even better. We are all fish trapped in the same boiling pot. We should have united long ago."

"Indeed. This Great Qi civilization is no weaker than us. After all, they survived the great catastrophe and still occupy an entire cultivation world. They are a suitable partner."

"And there is also that World-Protecting Immortal Artifact..."

The elders discussed among themselves.

Meanwhile, Li Fan, returning toward the phantom of the Wooden Sword, was contemplating the information the Immortal Ark had just revealed.

Although the Immortal Ark had not stated it directly, based on the key intelligence he had obtained while infiltrating them in his previous life, it was not difficult to infer why they knew the location of the weakest point in the High Wall.

"In the previous life, Zhong Daogong once said that the reason the Xuanshang Immortal Ark split apart was because part of the Immortal Ark's population decided to crash directly into the High Wall in order to escape the star sea."

"And in the end, they actually succeeded."

"This weak point in the High Wall may very well be the exact location where the Shang Immortal Ark struck it back then. Through the connection between the two Immortal Arks, the Xuan Immortal Ark was able to determine the precise coordinates..."

Had the Immortal Ark not revealed this information, Li Fan would have activated the hidden arrangement he had left within the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales as soon as he departed, looting all the treasures contained within.

But since the Immortal Ark still possessed secrets worth uncovering, there was no harm in waiting a little longer.

"The Immortal Ark has always been obsessed with collecting True Immortal seal script characters. Aside from the power of the characters themselves, perhaps it is also related to this plan of escaping the Star Sea."

"Crashing into the High Wall..."

"I wonder how the Shang Immortal Ark actually managed to accomplish it back then."

Li Fan pondered silently.

Within the phantom Wooden Sword, Yin Shangren was resting.

The others were still traveling along the Great Wall of Remnant Worlds, searching for suitable world fragments that could serve as medicinal catalysts for the Xuanhuang Realm.

After supplying them with more Voidbright Flow Crystals, Li Fan did not seek out the people of the Immortal Ark.

Instead, through the Inch Apart, Worlds Away Formation, he first returned to the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Great Xuan Small World.

Li Fan's figure flickered and appeared beside the sleeping Ou Shangtian.

Sensing the Kun-Qian Bone Hand still gestating within his body, Li Fan used his finger as a brush and wrote a single character.

[Ancient].

Focusing his divine sense, he carefully observed the changes occurring within Ou Shangtian's body.

His understanding of the Ancient character remained at only the most basic level. Furthermore, he infused very little spiritual energy into it.

As a result, the power of the Ancient character was extremely weak.

It barely managed to envelop Ou Shangtian's body.

Chapter 1324: Blood Reveals Memories Of A True Immortal

The situation was different from when the elders of the Immortal Ark came into contact with the Ancient character.

Ou Shangtian's already youthful body did not undergo any reverse aging phenomenon. Instead, the Kun-Qian Bone Hand hidden within his body emitted faint, nearly imperceptible tremors, absorbing and assimilating all of the power of the Ancient character.

Li Fan was not entirely sure whether "absorbing and assimilating" was the proper way to describe the process.

However, from his perception, the ancient character and the Kun-Qian Bone Hand seemed to have formed a certain resonance.

As a result, the power of the True Immortal seal script character that should have acted upon Ou Shangtian's body was instead completely redirected into the extraordinary object known as the Kun-Qian Bone Hand.

Meanwhile, the other extraordinary object within Ou Shangtian's body, the Book of Ten Thousand Deaths, remained completely motionless.

Stimulated by the resonance of the power of [Ancient], the Kun-Qian Bone Hand quietly underwent a subtle transformation.

Upon the originally bare and ghastly white bones, strands of dark red flesh unexpectedly began to appear.

They were only thin lines, almost impossible to notice.

However, Li Fan had observed the entire process from beginning to end and immediately detected the anomaly.

The birth of flesh made the Kun-Qian Bone Hand appear even more mysterious.

It seemed to become instantly filled with spirituality, as though it had come alive.

Without any control from Ou Shangtian's, the bony fingers actually began to twitch slightly on their own.

"Ugh..."

The sleeping Ou Shangtian's let out a muffled groan.

It was obvious that the disturbance of the extraordinary object within his body was causing him considerable pain.

Li Fan pressed both hands against Ou Shangtian's head, causing him to sink back into unconscious sleep.

A ray of golden light emerged from Li Fan's hand and transformed into a sharp surgical blade.

It slashed toward Ou Shangtian's arm.

The flesh did not tear apart.

Instead, the golden surgical knife directly entered Ou Shangtian's body and arrived beside the Kun-Qian Bone Hand.

As if sensing the approach of an external enemy, the Kun-Qian Bone Hand began to tremble violently without pause.

It even seemed willing to disregard the life of its host and break free in an attempt to escape.

But how could Li Fan possibly allow that?

Numerous fine threads split off from the golden blade, transforming into chains that firmly locked the Kun-Qian Bone Hand in place.

The blade's light shifted and flickered.

With astonishing speed, it scraped away every inch of the newly grown flesh from the bone hand.

A sharp and resentful howl seemed to echo through the air.

Li Fan's expression remained unchanged.

Using source power essence, he wove a golden net and sealed all the flesh inside it.

Without the influence of the newly grown flesh, the Kun-Qian Bone Hand once again became quiet and peaceful.

Ou Shangtian, however, looked as though he had suffered severe internal injuries.

His complexion was frighteningly pale.

Li Fan casually sent a stream of spiritual energy into his body to nourish him.

Then, carrying the clump of flesh that had curled up within the net of source power essence as though it had lost all vitality, he flashed beneath the Dao Lecture Platform.

Above the platform, the Dao Teacher projection continued teaching without interruption.

Within the vast cavity excavated below, Li Fan began researching the flesh.

"The appearance of the Kun-Qian Bone Hand is identical to that of the White Bone Vanguard Realm."

"According to Dao Integration cultivator Zimiao, the master of the White Bone Vanguard Realm, that realm was modeled after illustrations he once saw depicting a True Immortal Remnant Corpse."

"In other words, this is very likely True Immortal flesh?"

Li Fan narrowed his eyes as he looked at the dark red tissue within the golden net.

He had escaped from True Immortals several times.

He had even personally witnessed Cat Treasure swallow a True Immortal in a single bite.

The reverence he once held toward True Immortals had long since disappeared.

Moreover, through a fortunate series of events in this life, the charging progress of [Truth]'s Virtualization had doubled.

He could now activate [Truth] three consecutive times.

With his safety guaranteed, Li Fan began studying the True Immortal flesh.

The first thing he confirmed was that the flesh before him possessed no independent consciousness.

The reason it could move seemed more like a biological instinct.

"However, the current amount of flesh is still very small. If there were more of it, the situation might be different."

Li Fan remained extremely cautious on this point.

This amount of flesh was already sufficient for research.

Once it was mostly consumed, he could simply harvest more from Ou Shangtian later.

He first began a rough analysis of the composition of the True Immortal flesh.

A source power essence blade cut off a tiny piece.

Then golden light spun continuously, transforming into a grinder and reducing the flesh into fragments.

"There is no immortal spiritual power."

Li Fan was not surprised and therefore did not feel disappointed.

"The bodily tissues and blood separate from one another. The vitality of the tissue is clearly inferior to that of the True Immortal blood. This blood seems to contain some kind of special energy..."

Li Fan's eyes brightened.

He separated a strand of divine sense and attempted to enter the isolated blood.

Unexpectedly, the moment his divine sense touched the True Immortal blood, it was as though it had collided with a blazing iron gate.

Violent tremors and dizziness struck immediately.

Furthermore, the scorching heat hidden within the blood instantly evaporated more than half of the divine sense.

"Hm?"

Although it was merely a separated strand of divine sense, the shock and burning it suffered were still transmitted directly to Li Fan's main consciousness.

It felt as though his head had been struck by a heavy club.

Then a raging fire ignited within his soul. The agony was nearly equivalent to complete soul destruction.

Had an ordinary cultivator encountered this unprepared, they would likely have been annihilated on the spot.

But Li Fan was no ordinary cultivator.

Empowered by the Limitless Fullness and Emptiness Technique, his soul constantly circulated and regenerated, becoming nearly indestructible.

Even though it felt as if he were trapped within hell itself, he eventually endured it.

Given Li Fan's current tolerance, even after suffering this counterattack from the True Immortal blood, cold sweat covered his forehead and his muscles spasmed continuously.

The scorching sensation within his soul gradually faded.

After everything finally calmed down, Li Fan let out a long breath and dispelled all discomfort.

"The divide between immortals and mortals..."

"A True Immortal cannot be touched."

That was the feeling the experience had left him with.

Even though it was merely a drop of blood, it still used its own method to demonstrate the immeasurable gulf between immortals and mortals.

However...

Rather than causing Li Fan to restrain himself, the warning only increased his interest.

The more something forbade him from looking, the more determined he became to uncover its secrets.

Ignite the soul?

With the Five Elements united and the Limitless Fullness and Emptiness Technique sustaining his indestructible soul, he could withstand the backlash and forcibly pry into the mysteries hidden within the True Immortal blood.

Endless pain?

Li Fan had long ago learned to treat such things as insignificant.

With a thought, countless divine thoughts split apart.

Like fearless soldiers charging into battle, they all rushed toward the True Immortal blood within the golden net.

Boom. Boom. Boom.

The backlash from the True Immortal blood echoed continuously through Li Fan's soul.

It was like a giant hammer striking him again and again.

The thousands of assaults brought thousands of counterattacks.

His soul seemed to ignite instantly, countless sparks spreading into a raging inferno.

The pain was beyond description.

Even with the support of the Immortal Heart Mantra and his extraordinary willpower, he nearly collapsed and lost control.

Li Fan first glanced at the [Truth] panel.

The Virtualization charge remained at four hundred percent.

It had not decreased due to the backlash of the True Immortal blood.

This meant that the retaliation of a single drop of blood was still insufficient to threaten Li Fan at his current level of strength.

With his safety assured, Li Fan maintained the operation of the Limitless Fullness and Emptiness Technique while concentrating entirely upon the True Immortal blood, which resembled a wall of living flame.

Under the assault of countless divine thoughts, cracks gradually began to appear within its defenses.

The stalemate continued for an unknown amount of time.

Finally, Li Fan broke through the blood's protective barrier.

The backlash vanished instantly.

His soul became cool and calm once more.

A ray of light emerged from the True Immortal blood and enveloped his soul.

Then a sequence of images appeared before him.

Everything seemed shrouded in luminous mist.

None of the surrounding scenery could be seen clearly.

An angry voice echoed from a towering figure in the distance.

The words were fragmented and incomplete.

Only portions could be made out:

"...Qionglang Star Region... annihilation... garrison..."

"...target located..."

“The subject accepts the command.”

A deep voice emerged from his own body.

The light and shadows shifted once more.

The next moment, he was already within the Xuanhuang Realm.

Standing high above the heavens, he looked down upon the countless living beings below.

Yet the attention of this body did not seem focused on the Xuanhuang Realm beneath him.

Instead, it was directed beyond the Starry Sky.

As if waiting for something. An unknown amount of time passed before a streak of radiance suddenly arrived from beyond the heavens.

The body's gaze immediately locked onto it.

Yet it did not interfere, allowing that radiance to descend into the Xuanhuang Realm.

Only after the light completely dimmed and settled did the figure descend into the world to investigate personally.

"It is still not the one."

"But it is not bad. In those years, it would have had hope of ascending to immortality. What a pity..."

The body seemed long accustomed to such results. There was neither joy nor sorrow in its tone.

It shook its head slightly, sighed softly, then returned to the skies above the Xuanhuang Realm.

Silently watching and waiting for the arrival of the next target.

...

The scene suddenly froze.

Then, like a faded photograph, it rapidly lost color before dispersing completely.

Li Fan awakened from the illusion and returned to reality.

Although he had only witnessed a few scenes within the memory contained in the True Immortal blood, it felt as though he had lived through more than a dozen lifetimes.

And that sense of age had manifested upon his physical body.

His hair had silently grown to his waist, fluttering in the wind.

It was now streaked with black and white.

Wrinkles had appeared on his face, hands, and even across his entire body.

Li Fan looked at his age displayed on the [Truth] panel.

His mental age had not changed.

But the upper limit of his biological lifespan had been directly reduced to fifty years.

Though he still possessed the body of a thirty-year-old, he was already approaching the end of his lifespan.

"So this is the price of peering into a True Immortal?"

After several attempts confirmed that none of the lifespan-extending heavenly treasures of the Xuanhuang Realm could restore the lost lifespan limit, Li Fan felt a chill run through him.

"For an ordinary cultivator, this alone would likely force them into complete despair."

"Fortunately, I have [Truth]. A lifespan limit of fifty years makes little difference to me."

"There are still twenty years left in this life. That is more than enough time to complete my arrangements."

After calming himself, Li Fan could not help recalling the scenes he had witnessed within the True Immortal blood.

"The True Immortal who owned this blood was likely sent to the Xuanhuang Realm to search for a certain target..."

"The use of the word 'subject' is quite interesting."

"And that radiance descending from beyond the heavens..."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

Combining it with the information he had previously obtained from the ancient immortal formation of the Xuanhuang Realm and the Nine-Star Red Bead, a speculation surfaced in his mind.

"The ancient Xuanhuang Realm was also capturing things."

"Unlike the later captures of other cultivation worlds, the targets at that time were..."

"People?"

A strange light flickered in Li Fan's eyes.

"'But it is not bad. In those years, it would have had hope of ascending to immortality...'"

Li Fan repeated the True Immortal's words several times.

"Even someone with the potential to ascend to immortality was not the target it was waiting for. Just what exactly..."

Suddenly, for reasons he could not explain, Li Fan connected the matter to himself.

Although the True Immortal's memories were vague and originated from an era countless years ago, Li Fan unexpectedly felt a sense of having narrowly escaped a catastrophe.

By the time he came back to his senses, his back was already drenched in cold sweat.

This was not because Li Fan was timid.

Rather, after finally realizing the implications, he instinctively felt fear and relief.

"This..."

His pounding heart gradually calmed.

Li Fan temporarily left the underground space beneath the Dao Lecture Platform and flashed to the skies above the Great Xuan Small World.

Miles of clouds obscured the vision of all living beings below.

Li Fan reflected upon the premonition he had just experienced.

"Although it sounds difficult to believe..."

"My intuition is telling me that the target of that True Immortal in the Xuanhuang Realm all those years ago may truly have been me."

"Or rather, not me."

"But [Truth]!"

Li Fan closed his eyes to conceal the turmoil and shock within.

"[Truth]. [Truth]..."

As he spoke, the surrounding scenery once again became illusory and indistinct.

Only after separating himself from reality did Li Fan feel somewhat reassured.

"[Truth] concerns the Great Dao of truth and falsehood, reality and illusion."

"Whether heavenly treasures, True Immortal seal script characters, or even the mysterious symbol that created the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, all are merely projections of the Great Dao."

"But only [Truth] stands above all of them."

"It is almost the embodiment of the Dao of Truth and Falsehood itself."

Li Fan's thoughts surged as he calmly analyzed the situation.

"The one capable of making a True Immortal refer to itself as 'subject' must naturally possess extraordinary status."

"The Qionglang Star Region... Annihilation... Garrison..."

Li Fan attempted to infer the truth from those fragmented clues.

"It seems that the Immortal Realm had already encountered a crisis at that time."

"Annihilation..."

"With the power of a True Immortal, perhaps one of the methods they deduced for resolving the Immortal Realm's crisis was [Truth]."

"Was that why they waited in the Xuanhuang Realm, patiently awaiting its arrival?"

"Yet for some unknown reason, when I finally arrived here, I was tens of thousands of years late."

...

A long time after leaving the True Immortal's memories, the lingering feeling of having narrowly escaped disaster gradually faded away.

Without those inexplicable emotions clouding his judgment, Li Fan found his earlier speculation almost absurdly ridiculous.

"What on earth is the truth, exactly?"

Having regained his composure, Li Fan descended from the sky back underground.

Looking at the remaining True Immortal blood within the golden net, he pondered for a long while.

"I cannot probe it again in this life."

"I will wait until the next life and see whether I can uncover more clues."

"Even if the speculation proves true, it does not really matter."

"After all, the Immortal Realm suffered a great catastrophe. Those True Immortals who wished to hunt me have already vanished before me."

A sharp light flashed through Li Fan's eyes, and his state of mind became steady once more.

Although he could no longer explore the memories within the True Immortal blood during this lifetime, that did not prevent him from continuing his research into True Immortal flesh and blood.

"Next, let me see how resistant True Immortal flesh and blood is to the power of True Immortal seal script characters."

Chapter 1325: The Beginning Of Creating An Immortal

As his brush moved like dragons and serpents across the page, the [Nothingness] character art, disguised beneath various Dao manifestations, was completed.

Its power had been drastically weakened, making it suitable for testing.

To ensure the experiment's accuracy, Li Fan cut off a piece of his own flesh of identical size and also prepared a lump of mortal flesh as a control group.

Under the influence of the [Nothingness] character, the three pieces of flesh underwent completely different changes.

All three were instantly enveloped by a layer of shadow.

The flesh belonging to Li Fan and the mortal flesh showed no difference whatsoever. They possessed almost no resistance, as if struck down by a wave from an invisible sea. They immediately sank and vanished from existence.

The lump of True Immortal flesh, however...

Although it could not completely escape the influence of the True Immortal seal script, it was like a small boat upon the ocean. No matter how fierce the waves became, it merely rose and fell with them while remaining steadily afloat.

When the fluctuations of the [Nothingness] character finally dissipated, it was virtually unchanged from before the experiment.

"As expected of True Immortal flesh..." Li Fan's eyes flickered.

Afterward, he conducted further experiments using True Immortal seal script characters such as [Chaos] and [Solitude], obtaining some preliminary conclusions.

Perhaps because it had once been infused with immortal spiritual qi, the True Immortal flesh possessed extraordinarily powerful qualities of "self-reliance" and "recovery".

It was not truly immune to the effects of the True Immortal seal script.

Rather, after being affected and undergoing change, it would restore itself at astonishing speed.

Thus, at first glance, it appeared as though it was unaffected by any of the characters.

"The resilience and recovery speed of this thing..."

Using the True Immortal blood as a window, Li Fan glimpsed the terrifying reality of True Immortals themselves. His heart was greatly shaken.

"This is merely the power of flesh and blood alone. Yet its recovery ability is thousands upon thousands of times greater than my divine soul recovery even with the support of the Limitless Fullness and Emptiness Technique."

"What exactly drives this regeneration? There is clearly no immortal spiritual power left within this flesh."

"And from a purely structural perspective, it is no different from ordinary mortal flesh."

"Could it be..."

With a thought, the Descends into Mortal World White Ring appeared in his palm.

Flesh by itself possessed no life.

Therefore, according to the White Ring's judgment, this piece of True Immortal flesh also belonged to the category of a dead object.

As the light enveloped it, the flesh was instantly disassembled.

But to Li Fan's disappointment, no immortal spiritual power appeared.

Instead, what emerged was a foul-smelling black aura.

Merely inhaling a trace of it caused dizziness to wash over him, while countless hallucinations flashed before his eyes.

His expression changed drastically. Li Fan immediately retreated and activated formations to gather and contain the black gas.

Fortunately, the gas itself possessed little destructive power and was quickly dealt with.

Looking at the small black sphere suspended in the distance, Li Fan's eyelids twitched.

The stench that seemed capable of contaminating even the divine soul still lingered faintly in his nostrils.

"This black gas seems to be pure decay and ruin."

"Interesting. Despite possessing such terrifying vitality, this is what remains after it is disassembled."

Li Fan's curiosity toward the True Immortal flesh intensified once more. He nearly failed to restrain himself from splitting off another strand of divine sense to investigate further.

Fortunately, at the critical moment, he stopped himself through sheer willpower.

"Next life. Next life. There will be plenty of opportunities later..."

His current condition could no longer support further exploration of the mysteries of True Immortals.

Li Fan took a deep breath and calmed his turbulent thoughts.

Although he still could not uncover the secrets of True Immortal blood, that did not prevent him from developing new methods of using it.

A flash of light appeared.

The bronze immortal crane obtained from the Xuan Immortal Ark appeared in Li Fan's palm.

"Immortal Descent, All Things Return to Void!"

After making preparations, a weakened miniature Grand Return to Void Formation appeared beneath the Lecture Platform.

Within the immortal formation, invisible winds howled.

Li Fan tossed the bronze immortal crane into the center of the formation.

Instantly, countless violent wind blades struck the bronze crane according to Li Fan's design.

As expected of a remnant immortal artifact that had survived a world-destroying calamity.

Even the Grand Return to Void Formation, reduced only in scale while retaining most of its original power, failed to leave many marks upon it.

However, the endless invisible winds continued to blow.

Like gigantic hammers, they struck and battered the bronze crane repeatedly, gradually altering its shape.

Time slowly passed.

Three days later, a bronze skeleton emerged from within the formation.

Li Fan temporarily removed it from the formation.

Using golden source power essence as bait, he attracted a small lump of True Immortal flesh onto the bronze skeleton.

Perhaps because of its innate nature.

Or perhaps because it sensed the similar aura of immortality upon the bronze skeleton.

The moment the two came into contact, the True Immortal flesh slowly settled upon the bronze bones.

The flesh surged and wriggled, seemingly attempting to expand further.

Li Fan immediately seized the opportunity and infused it with a portion of source power essence.

The fusion proceeded with great difficulty.

Yet perhaps the two truly shared certain common characteristics.

In the end, the flesh absorbed the golden essence like a sponge.

After receiving additional energy, the True Immortal flesh began growing along the bronze skeleton.

Initially, it was merely a tiny lump no larger than a finger attached to the skull.

After continuous wriggling and spontaneous proliferation, it became like a crimson flood, spreading downward from the head.

After being nourished by Li Fan's source power essence, this mass of True Immortal flesh no longer emitted the strange murmurs and hateful whispers that had previously accompanied it.

Instead, it seemed like a creation existing beneath the vast net of source power essence.

It even gave Li Fan the feeling that it could be controlled as easily as his own arm.

As he continuously infused source power essence, the True Immortal flesh eventually covered the entire bronze skeleton.

Yet no skin formed afterward.

A humanoid figure composed entirely of exposed flesh appeared, looking deeply unsettling.

Li Fan could sense that the True Immortal flesh was extending root-like structures into the bronze skeleton beneath it, binding itself more firmly.

As the connection deepened, the entire body gradually began undergoing subtle changes. Yet as Li Fan silently observed the figure before him, he always felt that something was missing.

"The soul is the master of the body. A body without a soul is ultimately only an object..."

After watching for a long time, Li Fan gradually understood.

However, he did not take the final and most crucial step.

It was not merely because he lacked the essential ingredient of an Immortal Soul.

More importantly, whenever the thought arose, an inexplicable sense of danger would appear simultaneously.

"Anything involving the realm of True Immortals requires even greater caution."

"When painting the dragon and adding the eyes, one must beware of the dragon breaking through the wall and flying away, bringing its backlash in return..."

Li Fan pondered this for a moment, then slowly nodded. Forming seals with both hands, he temporarily used a grand formation to seal away this body.

"I will wait until I find a consciousness that can completely withstand True Immortal flesh and blood without losing control."

In his mind flashed the remains of Tianyang and Mr. Bai one after another.

"Eternal Remnant Will, enduring through countless ages. Since it can resonate with the Dao, it should not lose itself under the influence of True Immortal flesh and blood."

Compared to the uncontrollable Mr. Bai, the simple-minded Tianyang was clearly the more suitable candidate.

Li Fan personally made a trip to the depths of the Congyun Sea.

After taking a glance at Tianyang's puppet body, which was still slumbering beneath the seabed earth veins, Li Fan did not disturb it.

Instead, he went to Tianyang's cave abode and retrieved his remains.

After several attempts, he still could not sense the attached Eternal Remnant Will through his own perception. Li Fan suddenly crushed the remains.

Then he controlled the powder, scattering it and mixing it into the True Immortal flesh and blood body.

The remains were merely an external form. The Eternal Remnant Will would naturally not dissipate because the bones had been shattered.

Boom!

After the Eternal Remnant Will was added, the True Immortal flesh and blood body underwent a qualitative transformation.

Violent energy fluctuations surged from the body. It was as if an invisible carving blade was continuously sculpting it. Skin and hair gradually formed upon the naked mass of flesh.

The face that slowly emerged was exactly the same as the Tianyang in Li Fan's memories.

Li Fan pondered silently while continuously setting up grand formations around it to prevent the awakened Tianyang from running amok.

At the same time, he continuously used source power essence to create chains, binding the body before him.

However, Li Fan quickly sensed that something was wrong.

Although Tianyang's appearance became increasingly distinct, no vitality ever emerged.

The Tianyang before him resembled a doll constructed from Immortal artifact remnants, True Immortal flesh and blood, and Eternal Remnant Will.

It looked lifelike, yet there remained a fundamental difference between it and a true living being.

At present, even making this doll move was impossible.

"..."

Li Fan slightly shook his head.

"It seems I was taking things for granted. Life, especially when immortals are involved, is obviously not something that can be recreated so casually."

"However, that does not mean this body is useless. Its core is Tianyang's Eternal Remnant Will. Once Tianyang truly awakens, he will be able to control this flesh puppet."

"Although it possesses no spiritual energy, relying solely on physical strength, it could probably suppress more than half of the Xuanhuang Realm. Ordinary techniques and divine abilities would be completely incapable of harming it."

"Even better, this puppet flesh was nurtured through source power essence. Even after this stage of growth, it remains under my control..."

With a thought from Li Fan, the flesh puppet before him moved like a marionette, performing various actions.

However, due to the presence of Tianyang's Eternal Remnant Will, Li Fan could clearly feel many points of resistance.

"It still needs the original owner to control it before it can move as naturally as an arm or finger."

Once again, he sealed the flesh Immortal puppet within a grand formation.

Looking at the large remaining chunk of True Immortal flesh and blood, Li Fan fell into contemplation.

"Source power essence is ultimately only a lower substitute for Immortal spiritual power. After being nourished by it, the True Immortal flesh and blood seems to have changed and fallen in rank. Even though they originally shared the same source and were both generated from the Kun-Qian Bone Hand, they became almost completely unrelated in an instant..."

"Mo Rubin once said that source power essence is harmful and provides no real benefit. It seems those words were not false."

But that only applied to ordinary people.

Even if contamination by source power essence caused irreversible consequences, Li Fan could simply eliminate them through [Truth].

Therefore, before discovering a genuine path to transcendence, Li Fan would naturally make full use of every available resource.

"It is probably not limited to source power essence alone. The individuality of True Immortal flesh and blood means that once it is contaminated by any power lower than Immortal spiritual power, it will undergo a 'downgrade'..."

"The difference between immortals and mortals truly is profound."

Li Fan sighed.

"If lower powers do not work, perhaps I can try something of equal rank, or even something above immortals."

Among the methods Li Fan could currently employ, True Immortal seal script and Immortal-grade formations could barely be considered existences on the same level as True Immortal flesh and blood.

As for the Transformation between Truth and Falsehood within [Truth], that existed beyond the level of Immortals.

Li Fan began a new round of research.

This time, however, progress was nowhere near as smooth as before.

After all, these were all existences beyond the mortal realm. With Li Fan's current accumulation of knowledge, achieving a breakthrough in a short period was nearly impossible.

Li Fan possessed a clear understanding of his own limitations.

Rather than wasting the time of his main body, he created a simulated personality to conduct the research in his place. The moment any discovery was made, the main body would immediately become aware of it.

To prevent various abnormalities that might arise during the research process, Li Fan not only laid down countless formations, but also left the White Ring Descends into Mortal World to suppress the area.

If the True Immortal flesh and blood underwent an uncontrollable mutation, Descends into Mortal World would descend and completely disassemble it.

That black aura might smell unpleasant, but as long as it remained controlled and did not leak outward, it should not cause any trouble.

While returning to the frontier of the Star Sea, Li Fan reflected on this experiment involving ancient characters.

"The power of retrospection contained within Ancient characters can generate flesh and blood from remains."

"And within the Xuanhuang Realm, there is more than just True Immortal bones."

In Li Fan's mind appeared the remains of the Grand Mage beneath the Great Rift Valley of Fuguang Prefecture, within the ruins of the First Origin Sect.

During the World-Destroying Immortal formation storm of his previous life, Daoyuan Prefecture had undoubtedly survived until the very end.

Unlike the other survivors, the location of the Grand Mage had formed a black domain isolated from the outside world. Even while personally controlling the Immortal formation, Li Fan could not observe what occurred within.

Even when the High Wall ultimately collapsed and the Star Sea fell into turmoil, that black domain still remained intact.

From this alone, one could glimpse the Grand Mage' strength.

It was definitely above that of Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor.

"Allowing his remains to wander outside."

"He remained unmoved when the Xuanhuang Realm was destroyed. Unmoved when True Immortals descended."

"Even when the High Wall collapsed and the existence that hunted True Immortals beyond the High Wall arrived, he still did not move. The Grand Mage' condition is definitely highly abnormal."

"No matter how focused someone is on comprehending the Dao, they would instinctively react when sensing a fatal threat."

It was precisely because of this speculation that Li Fan intended to use the Grand Mage flesh and blood to conduct a test.

However, since there was some degree of risk involved, he planned to arrange it near the very end of this life.

As his thoughts churned, Li Fan had already returned outside the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Following the agreed method from before, he released the signal.

The elders of the Immortal Ark all came out together to welcome him, giving him considerable face.

"Fellow Daoist, how have you become like this?"

"What happened?"

The people of the Immortal Ark were greatly shocked when they saw Li Fan. They had only been separated briefly, yet his hair had already turned completely white and faint traces of death aura surrounded him.

Li Fan immediately let out a cold snort. His tone was hostile as he demanded accountability.

"Your Immortal Ark has truly harmed me miserably!"

The Immortal Ark cultivators looked at each other in confusion.

"Why would Fellow Daoist say such a thing?" Zhong Daogong asked with a bitter smile.

"You have likely already noticed that I am now close to death. I probably have only twenty years of lifespan remaining."

Li Fan's expression was gloomy as murderous intent flashed through his eyes while he swept his gaze across the Immortal Ark cultivators.

"And all of this is because of your Immortal Ark!"

Before anyone could respond, Li Fan continued.

"After I returned, I reported the entire matter to my master. Yet no response ever came."

"So I secretly used the world-protecting Immortal artifact to calculate the future of cooperating with your Immortal Ark..."

"I never expected to end up in this state!"

Li Fan stared fiercely at them and asked:

"That weakest point of the High Wall, does it have something to do with what lies beyond the High Wall?"

Chapter 1326: Feigning Madness To Witness The High Wall

"Heh heh heh, Fellow Daoist, you must be joking. Beyond the High Wall..." Zhong Daogong's eyes flickered. Faced with Li Fan's relentless questioning, he decisively denied it.

"Do I look like I am joking?" Li Fan interrupted him without the slightest courtesy.

A fierce light flashed in his eyes, and the aura around him surged violently, as if he would erupt the moment negotiations failed.

The fluctuations emanating from Li Fan were all too familiar to the elders of the Immortal Ark.

They were precisely the fluctuations of the True Immortal seal script.

Seeing that Li Fan truly seemed serious, the expressions of the Immortal Ark elders changed dramatically.

"Fellow Daoist, please calm down. We can discuss this properly!"

As they tried to persuade him, they retreated while activating layer upon layer of the Immortal Ark's defensive barriers.

Li Fan's expression remained gloomy.

"I am perfectly calm right now. I only want an explanation."

"It was precisely because I attempted to deduce the source that shook the High Wall that I suffered the backlash. Now I have little time left to live. Within this Darkest Star Sea, there absolutely cannot exist such a terrifying force."

"It was clearly the work of an unknown civilization beyond the High Wall, yet your Immortal Ark pretends it was your own achievement. You shamelessly claim credit for the work of others. Your pursuit of fame is one thing, but because of it, I..."

The more Li Fan spoke, the more agitated he became. The fluctuations of the True Immortal seal script around him grew increasingly intense.

His gaze toward the Immortal Ark cultivators resembled that of someone looking upon the murderer of his father, as if he were prepared to perish together with them at any moment.

In truth, his accusations were almost completely unreasonable and made little logical sense.

But one must not forget that, publicly, Li Fan only had twenty years of lifespan remaining.

To cultivators, twenty years passed in the blink of an eye.

Naturally, the Immortal Ark elders had no intention of arguing with a dying man whose emotions had become unstable.

They could only comfort him helplessly.

"Fellow Daoist, you have misunderstood us."

"We truly did not lie. The source behind the disturbance of the High Wall both originated beyond the High Wall and is deeply connected to our Immortal Ark. In truth, they share the same origin."

"You? Beyond the High Wall?" Upon hearing this, Li Fan calmed down somewhat, though his eyes still overflowed with suspicion.

The Immortal Ark elders secretly discussed the matter among themselves.

The story of the Shang Immortal Ark breaking through the High Wall was one of their highest secrets, but the man before them was already destined to die.

Furthermore, they were far too close to the Xuan Immortal Ark. If Li Fan suddenly went mad and scattered True Immortal seal script everywhere, the damage inflicted upon the Immortal Ark might be beyond repair.

Using a secret to temporarily stabilize him was not unacceptable.

"Sigh. It is a long story. Fellow Daoist, please allow me to explain it slowly..."

Zhong Daogong recounted to Li Fan the history of the split between the Xuan Merchant Immortal Ark and the Shang Immortal Ark, as well as how the latter ultimately smashed through the High Wall and gained its freedom.

Meanwhile, the other elders of the Immortal Ark joined forces to silently isolate the surrounding space.

On one hand, this prevented the Immortal Ark's greatest secret from leaking.

On the other, it trapped Li Fan within.

Li Fan seemed completely unaware of their subtle actions.

The hostility surrounding him gradually subsided. His expression became somewhat blank, mixed with a trace of regret.

"So it was I who acted rashly? I never imagined that the former Xuan Merchant Immortal Ark had such an extraordinary history."

Seeing Li Fan gradually calm down, Zhong Daogong finally breathed a sigh of relief.

He then asked, "May I ask what Great Qi's attitude toward cooperation truly is? Even if you are unwilling, surely there is no reason to delay your response for so long."

"The truth is that Great Qi itself remains deeply conflicted over this matter. Only after I acted recklessly and suffered this severe backlash did my master reluctantly tell me that Great Qi naturally has interest in crossing the High Wall. However, the greatest concern is that everything related to the world beyond the High Wall likely carries unimaginable danger..."

After speaking those words with complete seriousness, Li Fan glanced around.

It seemed that he had finally noticed the confinement techniques jointly arranged by the Immortal Ark elders.

A trace of displeasure flashed through his eyes.

However, he merely snorted coldly without making an issue of it.

His black and white hair fluttered without any wind.

Countless silver threads emerged from among the strands of his hair.

Before the Immortal Ark elders could even react, those silver threads had already formed a grand formation throughout the void, sealing and imprisoning the Immortal Ark elders in exactly the same way.

Repaying them in kind did not immediately arouse their vigilance.

Instead, every Immortal Ark elder found their attention drawn to Li Fan's voice.

"Everyone, take a look. This is the scene related to the world beyond the High Wall that I deduced through the World-Protecting Immortal Artifact."

The words World-Protecting Immortal Artifact and beyond the High Wall together instantly shook every Immortal Ark elder.

All eyes focused upon the projection.

The viewpoint rose endlessly upward.

The entire Darkest Star Sea lay before them.

The cold and silent Star Sea, for some unknown reason, seemed to boil.

An ominous aura that made one's scalp tingle spread endlessly.

Not long afterward, an earth-shaking roar echoed from the distant horizon.

Then it was as if an enormous boulder had crashed into the Darkest Star Sea, raising monstrous waves that swept across the heavens.

...

The scene ended abruptly.

Although it lasted only a brief moment, the Immortal Ark elders had already understood what it depicted.

The High Wall had collapsed.

An unknown existence had descended into the Star Sea.

The scene appeared both illusory and astonishingly real.

It looked exactly like an authentic recording of something that had truly happened.

The Immortal Ark elders stood utterly transfixed, unable to recover from the overwhelming shock brought by the great upheaval of the Star Sea.

"This..."

Zhong Daogong also remained absent-minded for a long while before looking toward Li Fan.

"Now you understand why the backlash left me in such a state?" Li Fan said with complete calm.

"If the High Wall collapses and the Star Sea falls into chaos, then even with Great Qi's current strength, it would be impossible to guarantee our own survival. That is precisely why we have been unable to make a final decision."

"Freedom is certainly desirable, but only when safety comes first."

Li Fan let out a long sigh.

Silence fell throughout the area.

Although the Immortal Ark elders remained silent outwardly, fierce arguments had already erupted among them through divine sense.

"Is... is that scene real?"

"Such a vision could never have been fabricated by cultivators like us. Even the most horrifying nightmare could never produce such a scene."

"In my opinion, it does not look fake. Those fluctuations felt far too real. To be honest, I almost fled instinctively just now. Only because the surrounding space had apparently been sealed by his formation was I unable to escape."

"Then what about our plan? We intended to gather the power of the True Immortal seal script, draw upon the remaining immortal power of the Star Sea, create a tidal wave, strike the weakest section of the High Wall, and ultimately leap across it. We have planned this for so long, hoping to recreate the feat of the Shang Immortal Ark. Who could have imagined this outcome? Could the High Wall in that deduction actually have been collapsed by our own impact?"

"Wait. I just tried. This fellow's formation is genuinely formidable. Even I cannot escape."

"Do not let this fellow frighten you. A deduced scene is not necessarily the true future. We absolutely cannot abandon our plan because of this..."

"I am telling you, something is wrong. Even with the three of us joining forces, we still cannot break this formation."

...

A subtle atmosphere gradually spread among the Immortal Ark elders.

On one hand, they remained deeply shaken by the vision of the Star Sea's great upheaval.

On the other hand, they were horrified to discover that Li Fan had silently imprisoned all of them within his formation.

"Fellow Daoist, what exactly do you mean by this?" Zhong Daogong narrowed his eyes and demanded.

Li Fan ignored the question.

Instead, he appeared almost deranged as he muttered to himself.

"My master and the other seniors abandoned cooperation with your Immortal Ark and gave up probing the weak points of the High Wall for the sake of Great Qi's safety. I can actually understand their decision..."

"But if that is the case..."

"Then would I not have died for nothing twenty years from now?"

"Great Qi intends to give up."

"What about your Immortal Ark?"

Li Fan stared fixedly at the elders of the Immortal Ark and asked.

Elder Zhong Daogong could not immediately discern Li Fan's state of mind. He hesitated and remained silent.

Seeing that he received no answer, Li Fan's emotions instantly became agitated again.

"And what about all of you!"

"If you abandon it as well, then let us pretend none of this ever happened. Would that not make my unauthorized use of the immortal artifact, my deduction of the future, and the shortening of my lifespan completely meaningless?"

"I originally had a bright future. Among all the young disciples of Great Qi, my talent and learning surpassed everyone else. Even if I could not become a grand literary sage whose name would be remembered for eternity, at the very least I could have become a great teacher like my master, passing on the Dao, imparting knowledge, and resolving doubts..."

"All of that vanished into smoke because of a single sentence from your Immortal Ark."

Li Fan's tone became increasingly deranged. Strange black markings even began to spread across his face. The sight alone was enough to make one's scalp go numb.

"If I die, then so be it."

"But if I become a laughingstock after death..."

"I refuse to accept it!"

Li Fan pointed directly at Zhong Daogong.

"Give me an answer!"

"Will your Immortal Ark continue with the plan, or will it not?"

"If you are afraid and decide to cancel the plan..."

"Then all of you can be reduced to ashes together with me!"

As Li Fan spoke, countless silver lines suddenly lit up throughout the surrounding void.

It was as if thousands upon thousands of suns had risen simultaneously above the horizon, illuminating the space occupied by the Immortal Ark.

Every expression on every face became perfectly visible.

A silver wind began to blow through the void.

Just the slightest brush across their faces left bloody cuts.

The Immortal Ark elders immediately employed their own methods to defend themselves.

However, as the invisible wind within the void grew increasingly violent, all of their expressions changed dramatically.

"What... what kind of formation is this!"

"Danger! Everyone be careful! I have never seen such a terrifying formation in my life!"

"Quickly! Use the [Resolve] True Immortal seal script character to break the formation!"

The elders reacted with remarkable speed. Before the words had even finished, Jian Daosheng, the Grand Elder of the Celestial Pivot Institute, had already written a [Resolve] True Immortal seal script character.

Under the influence of the True Immortal seal script's power, the silver formation lines instantly collapsed.

However, before the Immortal Ark cultivators could celebrate, an astonishing scene unfolded before their eyes.

Within the surrounding darkness, countless new blazing lights rose like another multitude of suns.

Even more silver lines than before emerged once again.

Endlessly regenerating, they wove themselves into an entirely new formation.

The [Resolve] character melted the formation like ice turning into water.

Yet at the very same moment, even more water froze back into ice.

Thus, the formation imprisoning them not only failed to collapse.

Instead, it became even larger and more intricate.

"Quick! Whoever else knows the [Resolve] True Immortal seal script character, continue using it!"

"Calm down! The Immortal Ark has not retreated, and we are all gathered here. If too many True Immortal seal script characters erupt at once, the consequences will be unimaginable!"

"This brat has gone completely mad! What exactly is he trying to do!"

As countless silver threads continued flashing, Li Fan's voice rang out once more.

"Fellow Daoist Zhong! Answer me!"

"What exactly is your Immortal Ark's decision!"

Zhong Daogong's expression turned extremely ugly.

In all his years, this was the first time he had ever been forced into such a position by a junior.

And yet...

Looking at the ever increasing number of different True Immortal seal script characters floating from Li Fan's body, Zhong Daogong felt an intense headache coming on.

If all of those True Immortal seal script characters activated simultaneously within the formation, then even with the Immortal Ark elders' lifelong mastery of True Immortal seal script, severe injuries would be unavoidable.

Only now did Zhong Daogong truly understand just how troublesome a cultivator who possessed the power of True Immortal seal script while completely disregarding their own life could be.

"Answer me!"

Li Fan's nearly insane roar echoed throughout the formation.

Seeing that Li Fan was already on the verge of complete collapse, with the True Immortal seal script characters pouring from his body in terrifying numbers.

Zhong Daogong finally sighed helplessly and answered.

"Fellow Daoist, rest assured. Our Immortal Ark will never abandon the plan to explore beyond the High Wall."

"Words alone prove nothing!"

"Then what does Fellow Daoist propose?" Zhong Daogong asked patiently, forced by the circumstances.

"Take me to that weak point in the High Wall first so I can see it with my own eyes! If you abandon the plan, then I alone, even at the cost of my own life, will crash into the High Wall myself!" Li Fan declared resolutely.

The Immortal Ark elders exchanged glances.

"What do you think? Can this formation be broken?"

"You know our attainments in formations. Even if we sat down to study it, it would take at least eighty to a hundred years to understand it. Breaking it quickly is completely impossible."

"I already warned all of you not to rely too heavily on True Immortal seal script. You should have continued developing other arts and divine abilities. None of you listened. Now you've been completely manipulated by someone else."

The elder of the Celestial Pivot Institute named Meng Xiaomeng wore an expression of obvious schadenfreude.

"So what should we do now? Are we really going to take him to that weak point in the High Wall?"

"Perhaps we should."

"This man's lifespan is nearly exhausted. His mind has already descended into madness. He cannot be judged by ordinary logic. He truly might throw himself against the High Wall and die."

"Besides, do not forget that his attainments in True Immortal seal script are extremely profound. We might be able to make use of him as the first test subject for the experimental plan."

"Indeed. Let us stabilize him first. As long as we can ensure he does not leak our secrets to the outside world."

...

Half because Li Fan threatened them with his own life, and half because of certain hidden schemes.

The elders of the Immortal Ark ultimately agreed to Li Fan's request.

They would first take him to witness the so called weak point in the High Wall.

The Immortal Ark, together with the assembled elders, moved through the void while carrying the Return to Void Grand Formation.

Passing through the Sea of Relics, they drew closer and closer to the foot of the High Wall.

"Ahead lies the continuous expanse of fragmented worlds."

"Beyond that is where the invisible High Wall stands," Zhong Daogong said.

Li Fan let out a cold snort.

"I have been there before. Tell me how we proceed from here."

"The fragmented world wall is connected as a single whole. If the Immortal Ark enters it, it will likely be captured by that supreme power and never escape again. Furthermore, as you have already noticed, the closer one gets to the High Wall, the stronger the returning stellar force becomes. With our cultivation, we can barely maintain our footing. But an Immortal Ark of this size cannot."

Zhong Daogong patiently explained.

"Do not worry. Since we have already come this far, we naturally will not break our promise."

Li Fan swept his gaze across the crowd. After pondering for a moment, he finally nodded.

Thus, six elders remained behind to guard the Immortal Ark.

The remaining elders accompanied Li Fan as they continued deeper toward the High Wall.
