Chapter 1327: Ascending To The Immortal’S Shadow

All around them was endless darkness. In the distance lay silent fragments of ruined worlds, stretching beyond the limits of sight.

The surging echoing star force grew stronger and stronger like rising tides, and Li Fan's group advanced more and more slowly.

"The residual True Immortal power gathered beneath the High Wall has become even stronger than it was back then," Zhong Daogong said as he gazed ahead, his tone heavy.

Affected by the omnipresent echoing star power, not only were their physical bodies exposed to the void, but even their divine senses became like duckweed drifting in the wind, scattering before they could travel far from their bodies.

Communication among the group relied entirely on the Immortal Ark's special Unbounded transmission method.

"Although the High Wall is majestic, if this trend continues, it will collapse sooner or later."

"The rate at which the residual power is increasing is even faster than we expected. It seems that even without that boy, we would eventually have had to continue the Wall Crossing Plan. Otherwise, once the High Wall collapses, none of us will survive."

"Even so, being forced into it like this is still difficult to accept."

"Heh heh heh. We might as well let him test it with his own body."

...

The elders of the Immortal Ark discussed the matter enthusiastically.

Unbounded was a communication technique known only to the Immortal Ark's core members. Thus, even in front of Li Fan, they spoke without the slightest restraint.

What they never imagined was that Li Fan was equally proficient in the Unbounded communication technique. Every word spoken by the Immortal Ark elders entered his ears without omission.

He pondered silently while maintaining an expression of complete ignorance.

"How... much... longer?"

From time to time, he turned back and urged them with indistinct divine sense transmissions.

Zhong Daogong's answer never changed.

"Almost there. It is just ahead."

It was not an excuse.

There was a saying that a mountain visible in the distance could exhaust a horse before it was reached. The boundlessness of the Star Sea was displayed most vividly here at the frontier beneath the High Wall. Although the Remnant World Great Wall seemed close, after flying for a long time, the remaining distance showed no sign of shrinking, as if it stretched on forever.

Only the gradually changing scenery of the Remnant World Great Wall proved that they were indeed moving forward.

Meanwhile, the increasingly powerful echoing star power became an ever greater obstacle, like trudging through an endless muddy swamp toward towering mountains in the distance.

"This is too slow." Li Fan appeared somewhat impatient. "At this rate, I will probably die of old age before we arrive."

Zhong Daogong was about to explain.

"It is not because we..."

But Li Fan suddenly interrupted him coldly.

"Be careful!"

A phantom of a golden sword radiating brilliant light descended alongside his words.

Upon the sword were engraved images of mountains, rivers, the sun, moon, and stars. Its aura was majestic and sacred.

"Which direction?" Li Fan asked solemnly.

The Immortal Ark cultivators were still immersed in shock at the extraordinary golden sword phantom.

It was not only because the phantom represented an unparalleled Sword Dao.

More importantly, they were horrified to discover that while enveloped by the golden sword phantom, the echoing star power acting upon them was instantly reduced by more than half.

It was as though they had suddenly stepped onto elevated ground, entering another world where they were no longer battered by raging waves.

"How is this possible?!"

The Immortal Ark elders cried out in astonishment.

The essence of the echoing star power was residual True Immortal power. Even though it bore the word "residual," it still belonged to the level of a True Immortal.

This golden sword phantom could actually weaken its influence. Did that not mean it stood on the same level as immortals?

Of course, none of the Immortal Ark elders dared think any further. Even so, Li Fan's ability to wield a divine ability capable of contending with True Immortal power caused every elder present to look at him differently.

"This boy truly is like a hidden treasure. Every moment uncovers another surprise."

"If we can comprehend this divine ability, perhaps we can open a second cultivation path for the Immortal Ark besides the True Immortal seal script."

"No. Rather than the boy himself, it is that Great Qi civilization that is truly unfathomable."

The appearance of the golden sword phantom stirred tremendous waves.

The expressions of the Immortal Ark elders varied greatly, yet Li Fan appeared completely unconcerned. He stared at Zhong Daogong.

"Hurry and point out the direction. This Immortal Slaying Sword consumes enormous energy. I cannot maintain it for long."

Within the domain of the golden sword phantom, even divine sense communication became much clearer.

Hearing the words Immortal Slaying Sword, Zhong Daogong's eyes flickered.

In the end, however, he still pointed out the direction for Li Fan.

The golden sword blazed as it crossed the Star Sea.

Its speed far surpassed the group's previous flight. The silent worlds within the Remnant World Great Wall rapidly grew larger before their eyes. They approached the foot of the High Wall at astonishing speed.

Following Zhong Daogong's guidance, Li Fan controlled the sword phantom until they reached an unusually protruding section of the Remnant World Great Wall.

It resembled a towering beacon tower jutting out from an endless city wall. The number of ruined world fragments piled together here was clearly much greater than elsewhere.

"So the weak point of the High Wall is here?" Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

Zhong Daogong shook his head.

"No. There are actually many such structures throughout the Remnant World Great Wall. They should serve as important nodes maintaining the stability of its structure. To reach our destination, we must borrow the momentum of this place."

The golden sword phantom came to a halt.

Zhong Daogong and the Immortal Ark elders all became solemn.

"Please ascend upward, Fellow Daoist."

The elders jointly cast a technique, causing a blurred image to appear before Li Fan.

The originally smooth yet slightly curved expanse of space was greatly distorted by this protrusion in the Remnant World Great.

Like a tower rising from the earth, both its momentum and potential clearly stood far above the surrounding regions.

"Follow the momentum of the Remnant World Great Wall upward."

Zhong Daogong pointed lightly.

The image of the spatial protrusion expanded without limit, instantly enveloping everyone.

Before they realized it, they were already standing within the spacetime protrusion indicated by the image.

Li Fan stood motionless, carefully experiencing the subtle differences in the surrounding spacetime.

"Back then, our Immortal Ark spent several hundred years before finally understanding this method of ascending. It is only natural that Fellow Daoist cannot grasp it immediately."

"If necessary, you may dismiss the golden sword phantom. We can simply fly upward with our physical bodies."

The Immortal Ark elders kindly offered their suggestion.

Li Fan ignored them.

Instead, he slowly closed his eyes.

A scene flashed through his mind.

In truth, Li Fan had personally experienced this so called sense of spatial elevation before.

It was during his previous life, when the High Wall collapsed and an unknown existence descended, throwing the entire Star Sea into violent upheaval.

At that time, however, he had been overwhelmed by the earth shaking spectacle itself.

His attention had been captured by the surface phenomena, causing him to overlook the violent fluctuations of spacetime accompanying the disturbance throughout the Star Sea.

"The distinction between high and low."

The memories within his mind gradually shifted from illusion to reality.

It was as though he had returned once again to the end of his previous life, witnessing the magnificent waves rising and falling across the turbulent Star Sea.

A sudden realization slowly arose within his heart.

The illusion faded.

When he looked again at reality, the towering protrusion of the Remnant World Great now stood out with exceptional clarity.

"Everyone, stand firm."

Li Fan spoke in a deep voice.

The phantom of the golden sword once again blossomed with dazzling golden radiance. Though it resembled the blazing sun in the heavens, for some unknown reason, the golden light only shone within this small region and did not illuminate a wider area.

Although it had not physically moved, the golden sword phantom seemed to have crossed hundreds of millions of miles of spacetime in an instant. It became weathered and flickered unsteadily.

Cold sweat began to form on Li Fan's forehead. His body trembled uncontrollably.

The cultivators of the Immortal Ark, meanwhile, gazed at the Remnant World Great Wall, which now appeared slightly smaller due to distortion and warping. Astonishment filled their eyes.

"He actually completed the ascent on the very first attempt?"

"This child's talent and comprehension are truly unmatched in this world. Even in the Great Qi civilization, he must have been one of the foremost geniuses of his era."

"At such a young age, he has already reached this level. Give him another few hundred years, and he might truly be able to cross the High Wall. No wonder he went somewhat mad after learning his lifespan was nearly exhausted. If it were me, I would not be able to accept it either."

Many of the Immortal Ark elders looked at Li Fan with traces of regret in their eyes.

The ascent and transformation continued.

The area covered by the golden sword phantom rapidly shrank until it barely encompassed Li Fan and the Immortal Ark cultivators.

The originally brilliant golden radiance also gradually dimmed.

Its consumption had clearly become far more severe, as though it could be extinguished completely at any moment.

However, the changes it brought were equally obvious.

The endless Remnant World Great Wall that had originally stretched to the horizon slowly curled inward, forming a ring that continuously contracted.

Their perspective continued rising, while the ring became smaller and smaller.

Until it finally converged into a single point.

Boom! Boom!

It felt as though they had reached the end of the road, or as though they had crashed into an invisible wall.

The last remaining phantom of the golden sword shattered instantly.

Li Fan suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood, his face turning deathly pale.

Yet he merely wiped away the blood casually, his eyes filled with delight and madness.

"So this is the High Wall?" Li Fan coughed lightly and spat out another large mouthful of blood. He paid it no attention and turned to ask.

"No."

"This is merely the true foot of the High Wall." Zhong Daogong carefully examined Li Fan before first shaking his head in denial, then speaking with a sigh.

He also surveyed their surroundings.

"We still have to climb again?" Hearing this, Li Fan instinctively looked upward.

"The High Wall cannot be crossed, or perhaps it can never be crossed at all. The only way is to sacrifice oneself and crash into it." Jian Daosheng spoke in a deep voice.

"There are fewer people this time. With only our combined strength, we likely cannot reach the impact point from back then. But we should still be close enough to observe the traces."

After speaking, the elders of the Immortal Ark formed a circle.

A strange aura then emerged from their bodies.

Rather than steadily increasing, it surged continuously like immense waves crashing upon the shore, each wave rising higher than the last.

Carried by this tremendous force, the scenery that had shrunk into a tiny point transformed once again.

The point stretched downward, becoming a straight line.

The auras of the Immortal Ark elders grew increasingly vigorous, and the line continuously thickened.

Like a heavenly pillar, it gradually extended beyond sight while firmly supporting everyone standing above it.

As they continued climbing, their field of vision also became increasingly elevated and expansive.

Li Fan gazed into the distance with all his might. Within the endless darkness, he vaguely sensed several other towering peaks similar to the one they occupied.

And at an immeasurably distant place stood a majestic mountain.

Its summit could not be seen.

It was only slightly shorter than the endless High Wall itself.

"That is..."

"A True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins?"

Turning his gaze back, a sudden realization emerged in Li Fan's heart.

Li Fan had once learned from the memories of a Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect that the Xuantian King had once told the members of the Xuantian Sect he had discovered a method to lead everyone, and even the entire Xuanhuang Realm, away from the Darkest Star Sea.

However, only a True Immortal could accomplish it.

"So this is the difference between immortals and mortals."

"Mortals will forever remain below. Only by becoming an immortal can one stand upon the summit."

"The process of cultivation is itself a process of climbing upward step by step. Yet when the great catastrophe descended, the mountains that could once support habitation collapsed."

"When the mountains no longer exist, the paths disappear with them. Even if one can temporarily soar through the sky, one can never remain at that realm for long."

Borrowing the power of the Remnant World Great Wall, Li Fan had reached a height that would normally have been absolutely impossible.

It was as though he had ascended in advance to the mountain peak of a realm that no longer existed.

Various insights that did not belong to this era continuously flooded into Li Fan's mind.

"The distinction between immortals and mortals is already so vast."

"But the High Wall..."

Li Fan shifted his gaze toward the even greater distance.

Majestic and endless, it stretched across existence like the heavens themselves.

Its beginning could not be seen.

Its end could not be seen.

Neither its highest peak nor its lowest valley could be discerned.

It simply stood there.

Blocking everything before them.

Filling all who beheld it with despair.

Had Li Fan not personally witnessed the collapse of the High Wall before, merely seeing this incomparably magnificent scene would likely have planted a heart demon within him forever. Whenever he thought of the High Wall, unavoidable fear would have arisen in his heart.

Judging from the expressions of the Immortal Ark elders, that was indeed the case.

The lofty ambition they had possessed upon arriving had completely vanished. Only endless fear and reverence remained upon their faces.

However, they seemed to possess some secret technique. As they stood together in a circle, even their wills became linked as one.

Not long afterward, they gradually awakened from their stunned state.

Li Fan also pretended to awaken at exactly the right moment.

"We cannot ascend even a single step further."

Zhong Daogong sighed softly before turning his gaze into the distance, seemingly searching for the traces left behind by the Shang Immortal Ark all those years ago.

Li Fan waited patiently.

Only after nearly half a day had passed did Zhong Daogong finally point in one direction and speak solemnly.

"Can Fellow Daoist sense the abnormality over there?"

Li Fan followed the direction Zhong Daogong indicated.

At first glance, it appeared no different from the surrounding scenery.

But after carefully examining it, Li Fan indeed discovered several subtle clues.

Li Fan extended his hand, as though trying to touch that unimaginably distant place.

"The space here... has been distorted."

"Are these the traces left behind when the Shang Immortal Ark crashed into the High Wall?"

Li Fan spoke in a strange tone.

His hand gently traced the scar in space.

Before his eyes, it seemed as though half of a magnificent Immortal Ark appeared, charging resolutely toward the High Wall.

Then it erupted with world-shaking brilliance.

A trace of emotion flashed across Zhong Daogong's eyes as he nodded.

"The energy unleashed while crossing the High Wall was so terrifying that even the High Wall itself could not completely withstand it."

"Because of that, the traces left here have endured for ten thousand years without fading."

"The mark still remains. This proves that even after all these years, there has been no sign of any so called 'repair.' Therefore, at least in theory, there is a very great possibility that we can follow the path left behind by the Shang Immortal Ark and recreate the feat of crossing the High Wall."

Zhong Daogong spoke slowly.

Li Fan narrowed his eyes, seemingly deep in thought.

A short while later, he gently shook his head.

"That is not right. We have already exhausted every bit of our strength just to reach this height. But that place..."

Li Fan pointed toward the location of the scar left behind by the Shang Immortal Ark.

"I fear that even if we exerted ten times more strength, we still could not reach it."

"Much less cross the High Wall itself."

Chapter 1328: Dark Gathering Among The Peaks

“The difference between immortals and mortals is absolute. Relying solely on ourselves, reaching that level is naturally impossible. That is why we must borrow the power of an external force. It was the same for Shang Immortal Ark back then, and it is the same for our Xuan Immortal Ark today.” Zhong Daogong smiled faintly. He did not explain in detail and instead answered somewhat ambiguously.

“An external force? The True Immortal seal script? Is that the reason you want to join forces with our Great Qi?” Li Fan asked directly.

“Yes, and no.” Zhong Daogong replied with an unreadable expression.

“Very well. Since you have already seen the weak point in the High Wall, and we have also demonstrated the sincerity of our Immortal Ark, why not return to a safe place first before discussing our cooperation further? This is not a place to remain for long...”

Before Zhong Daogong could finish speaking, the high point of the Remnant World Great Wall where they stood suddenly began to tremble slightly.

Everyone instinctively looked downward.

Within the Darkest Star Sea beneath the countless peaks, ripples had begun spreading for some unknown reason.

Like waves rolling across a sea of clouds, they surged endlessly through the Star Sea.

“It is the echoing star force!” The elders of the Immortal Ark all changed expressions slightly.

“This outbreak is no small matter. It is unlikely to subside anytime soon. We should leave as quickly as possible,” Zhong Daogong said gravely.

Li Fan looked into the distance. Although the distorted perspective prevented him from seeing the actual events unfolding within the Star Sea, he could vaguely sense the source of the echoing star force.

The Remnant World Great Wall, which resembled a breakwater, had developed a gap after one of its remnant worlds disappeared. Part of the residual power of the True Immortals accumulated beneath the High Wall had found an outlet.

It poured through the breach like a great flood.

Something similar had happened in his previous life. It had been caused by his Holy Embryo clone destroying the many remnant world fragments that the Heavenly Doctor had embedded within the Chizha Abyss of the Xuanhuang Realm, forcing the Heavenly Doctor to replenish them with new worlds.

But in this life, that trigger had never occurred. So why had the Remnant World Wall become disturbed?

'Could it be that Yin Shangren and the others caused this?'

'They should not have acted so recklessly...' A trace of doubt flashed through Li Fan's mind.

While he was still pondering, the elders of the Immortal Ark carried Li Fan as they descended from the heights of the Star Sea.

The scenery changed rapidly. The boundless Darkest Star Sea disappeared from view.

The towering Remnant World Great Wall once again stood before them, while the elevated perspective from before seemed nothing more than an illusion.

Clearly, ascending to that viewpoint was no simple task, even for the elders of the Immortal Ark. After only a brief moment, every elder's breathing had become disordered, with beads of sweat covering their foreheads.

Zhong Daogong's expression remained solemn as he looked toward the distant source of the disturbance along the Remnant World Great Wall.

In the end, however, he abandoned any thought of investigating it and instead organized everyone to withdraw immediately.

During the return journey to the Immortal Ark, Li Fan once again led the way with the phantom image of his Golden Sword.

Only now did the elders truly experience just how astonishingly fast the sword phantom was.

By the time they reached the location of the Xuan Immortal Ark, the echoing star force had not even spread that far.

The elders looked at Li Fan with noticeably different expressions.

“Fellow Daoist, please come aboard the Immortal Ark first. We can discuss our future cooperation afterward.” Jian Daosheng pointed toward the opened entrance of the Immortal Ark with a smiling expression.

Unexpectedly, Li Fan shook his head without hesitation.

“I will decline. I still need to return to Great Qi first.”

The expressions of the elders immediately became rather complicated.

Li Fan remained completely fearless, raising his head proudly.

“What? It seems all of you have objections?”

“This is different from what we agreed upon. After learning the greatest secret of our Immortal Ark, you intend to simply leave?” Zhong Daogong's expression darkened, while the other elders fixed their gazes firmly upon Li Fan, their auras locking onto him.

Li Fan merely snorted.

“I think you should stop wasting your efforts. You have all witnessed my Immortal Slaying Sword. If I use it, which of you can stop me?”

The elders fell silent.

It was indeed faster than even the spread of the residual True Immortal power throughout the Star Sea.

It could even carry multiple people at once. Such an movement art lay completely beyond their understanding.

Yet allowing Li Fan to leave so easily was equally impossible. The atmosphere gradually became tense until Li Fan himself broke the stalemate.

“Why make things so difficult? I am merely leaving temporarily and will soon return. I know what concerns you. You fear I will reveal the location of the weak point in the High Wall. There is no need for such worry.”

“This time, I intend to return and persuade Great Qi once more, to see whether they are willing to change their minds. Now that I have personally confirmed the existence of this weak point in the High Wall, my words should carry much greater weight. If my master and the others still refuse to take the risk, then naturally I will not reveal this secret. If, by some stroke of fortune, I manage to persuade them...”

“In any case, we are destined to cooperate eventually. At that point, whether the secret is revealed or not will no longer matter.”

“My lifespan is nearly exhausted. Now that I have personally witnessed the only opportunity to cross the High Wall before my death, how could I possibly abandon it?” Li Fan said earnestly.

After cupping his fists in farewell, he directly rode the sword phantom through the air, breaking through the encirclement of the Immortal Ark elders.

His speed was so great that even Zhong Daogong had no chance to react.

His figure vanished without a trace.

“This young man truly is troublesome,” Jian Daosheng stroked his beard and frowned.

“There is nothing we can do. He possesses True Immortal seal script, extraordinary mastery of formations, and an movement art beyond imagination. On top of that, his lifespan is nearly over, so he does not fear death at all. Someone like him is best avoided as an enemy.”

“Fortunately, he does not have many years left to live. Otherwise, our Immortal Ark would likely know no peace in the future.”

“I actually think his words made sense. If Great Qi refuses to participate because of the warning issued by their World-Protecting Immortal Artifact, then our Immortal Ark will become his only remaining hope. After all, it is clearly impossible for him alone to cross the High Wall.”

While the elders continued discussing among themselves, Li Fan had already returned to the boundary of the Remnant World Great Wall.

The echoing star force had become increasingly violent, like a growing storm.

The phantom wooden sword that Li Fan had previously left there now flickered like a candle in the wind, on the verge of collapse.

He sent out a streak of golden light, reinforcing it until it became stable once more.

After searching the surrounding area for Qiao Gong and the others without success, Li Fan frowned slightly.

The secret markings they had agreed to leave behind while separately searching for suitable remnant world fragments had all been scattered by the echoing star force.

“They have all lost contact?”

Li Fan was somewhat surprised.

“Fortunately, the Inch Apart, Worlds Away Grand Formation has not suffered serious damage.”

He floated beside the formation and strengthened it once more before giving up on searching for them.

“I can only hope they can take care of themselves.”

“With the fortune possessed by those few, mere echoing star force should not be enough to kill them.”

“Once the storm gradually subsides, if they remain safe, they should naturally return here on their own.”

After passing through the grand formation and returning to the Xuanhuang Realm, Li Fan discovered, just as expected, that traces of residual True Immortal power had leaked out along the formation. Only after setting up another layer of blockade on this side using a net of source power essence did he finally eliminate the disturbances that had attracted the echoing star force.

"Among them, if anyone was most likely to have caused this upheaval in the Star Sea, it would have to be Yin Shangren."

Li Fan recalled the somewhat peculiar expression on Yin Shangren's face when they had first arrived at the Remnant World Great Wall.

"He must have seen scenes from the memories of the world specters he once absorbed."

"But Yin Shangren is by no means a reckless man. If that were all, he would not have disregarded the consequences and rashly tampered with the remnant world fragment."

"The truth behind this should become clear once Yin Shangren returns." Deep within his heart, Li Fan had an inexplicable premonition that Yin Shangren was still alive somewhere within the Remnant World Great Wall.

He might even have encountered an extraordinary fortune.

"Perhaps it is related to the formation of the Remnant World Great Wall?" This thought suddenly arose in Li Fan's mind.

Within the Darkest Star Sea, not only was the origin of the High Wall unknown.

Even the formation of the Remnant World Great Wall beneath it had always remained an unsolved mystery.

Back then, the countless cultivation worlds destroyed throughout the Star Sea did not gather at the location of the Immortal Ruins.

Instead, they accumulated beneath the High Wall, connecting into one continuous structure.

In Li Fan's view, the force maintaining the Remnant World Great Wall was a great power no weaker than residual True Immortal power.

Yet it lay completely beyond his understanding.

One had to know that Li Fan's knowledge had long surpassed that of ordinary cultivators.

Through countless reincarnations, each one allowing him to explore without restraint or concern for consequences, there were now very few blind spots left for him within the Xuanhuang Realm and the Darkest Star Sea.

The force maintaining the Remnant World Great Wall was one of them.

The deepest reaches of the Dark Sea was another.

After returning to Great Xuan, Li Fan possessed the body of a sturdy You Clansman with a strand of divine sense.

He then gathered the You Clansmen, carried out the ritual to enter the Dark Sea, and slowly stepped inside.

The Dark Sea was filled with endless blackness.

To ordinary cultivators, it was naturally a deadly place full of danger. But Li Fan had traversed it countless times already. Completely familiar with the route, he encountered no danger along the way.

He ignored the corpse of the Ancient Longevity Immortal of the Xuanhuang Realm lying on the ground and continued forward without distraction.

Eventually, he arrived at the central core of the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation.

It resembled a transparent observation platform overlooking the outline of the True Immortal corpse throughout the entire Sea of Darkness.

Here, he finally stopped.

He did not descend any deeper to directly face the hidden survival instinct of the True Immortal.

Before him stood the ancient storm clouds that had accumulated for untold ages.

They resembled terrifying primordial beasts of every imaginable grotesque form.

Looking down upon these masses of accumulated power from above, Li Fan unexpectedly felt a sense of familiarity.

"As expected. My intuition was correct."

A gleam flashed through Li Fan's eyes as the scene he had witnessed not long ago while overlooking the Dark Sea from the heights of the High Wall appeared before him once more.

It gradually overlapped with the sight of the storms gathering within the Dark Sea.

It was not that the scenery itself resembled each other. Rather, because of the immense concentration of energy, this region of the Dark Sea had likewise risen to a much higher level.

"This should be one of the many mountain peaks I saw from that summit."

"The energy gathered here stands far 'Higher' than the Xuanhuang Realm as a whole. It even surpasses the position I reached beneath the High Wall by relying on the power of the Remnant World Great Wall."

Li Fan's eyes flickered as countless thoughts raced through his mind.

"It is not merely because the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation of the Dark Sea was built upon the corpse of a True Immortal."

"It is also because nearly ten thousand years have passed since the formation was established."

"Back then, Xuantian King established this formation to carry the Xuanhuang Realm across the High Wall. However, due to various unforeseen events, Xuantian King mysteriously disappeared, and the plan ultimately failed halfway."

"But the accumulation of energy within the Dark Sea never ceased because of that. Instead, it has continued uninterrupted for nearly ten thousand years."

"During these ten thousand years, countless upheavals have occurred throughout the Star Sea. Yet in reality, the height of the High Wall surrounding the Star Sea has never changed."

"In other words..."

Li Fan once again looked toward the Dark Sea below.

Those accumulated storm clouds suddenly transformed into towering mountain peaks in his vision.

Each one floated above the Darkest Star Sea.

Standing opposite the High Wall from afar.

"The Immortal Ark regards these elevated places as priceless treasures, requiring external assistance just to reach them. Yet within the Xuanhuang Realm, such locations exist everywhere."

"Standing here, crossing the High Wall is far easier than from anywhere else."

"The only concern is that it might awaken the survival instinct hidden within the True Immortal here."

"But as long as I proceed carefully, it should not be a problem."

Maintaining this elevated perspective was becoming increasingly taxing for Li Fan.

He slowly exhaled and returned to his normal state.

He then began considering how best to make use of the legacy Xuantian King had left behind.

"Simply using these high points as stepping stones is definitely not enough. I still need more data. Preferably results verified through actual practice."

"The Immortal Ark would make excellent cannon fodder."

"The Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation is one component of the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation and is related to crossing the High Wall. The Eye of the Heavenly Beast is the same."

"In that case, the Eye of the Heavenly Beast is probably not merely used for navigation and target locking."

"What it sees may also be the 'height of the High Wall,' the same higher dimensional perspective I witnessed before." Li Fan gradually arrived at this realization.

Controlling the body of the You Clansman, Li Fan remained within the main control core of the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation for seven full days.

Only after the You Clansman's body could no longer withstand the dense power of darkness and was completely consumed by it, causing Li Fan's perception to disappear, did he finally stop.

Within the Great Xuan Small World, Li Fan slowly opened his eyes.

His divine sense swept across heaven and earth. Having become accustomed to the higher dimensional perspective before returning to ordinary reality, he unexpectedly felt slightly uncomfortable.

"In ancient times, once one broke through the limit of height, one could ascend and become an Immortal."

"Later, after the path to immortality was severed, the High Wall appeared."

"But perhaps the principles behind the two are somewhat similar."

Looking upon the countless living beings within Great Xuan, an indescribable realization suddenly welled up within Li Fan's heart.

"It is simply that the height of the High Wall may surpass even the height required for becoming an Immortal. After all, Xuantian King was able to ascend through the Immortal path, yet he still could not cross the High Wall."

"Looking at it from another perspective, if one could now cross the High Wall, then perhaps in the past, one would have been able to ascend and become an Immortal."

At this thought, Li Fan fell into a brief daze.

"Immortals..."

Ten thousand years had passed, and the world had changed beyond recognition. Though the cultivation realm remained the same, one path had once led to ascension into immortality, while the other left one imprisoned beneath the High Wall.

Even if one managed to cross it, the unknown dangers beyond the High Wall still awaited.

"The Great Dao has changed. Immortals are no longer truly Immortals."

Li Fan could only sigh with such emotion.

"If my speculation is correct, and the method used to construct the High Wall originates from the very same principle as the shackles that once governed Ascension To Immortality, then things become truly interesting."

Chapter 1329: A Finger Descends, Destroying The Firmament

Li Fan had always held two theories regarding the origin of the High Wall.

One possibility was that the High Wall had been created by the True Immortals who comprehended the Dao within the Immortal Ruins. Much like the restrictions cultivators set up while in secluded cultivation, it existed to prevent outsiders from disturbing them.

The other possibility was that the High Wall had been established by some unknown existence beyond it. By sealing off the Star Sea, it isolated the catastrophe caused by the spread of the True Immortal seal script that had once engulfed the region.

Both theories had their own merits.

The High Wall possessed neither form nor substance, yet it completely sealed off the entire Star Sea. Such a method was utterly beyond the comprehension of mortal cultivators. Only beings on the level of an Immortal could accomplish such a feat. Although the Darkest Star Sea appeared vast beyond measure to cultivators of the lower realms, containing countless cultivation worlds, a True Immortal could take in its entirety with a single glance. The area enclosed with a casual stroke might simply have been the perfect size for an Immortal's cultivation ground.

On the other hand, the Star Sea itself was boundless. The Darkest Star Sea alone could never represent the entirety of the lower realms. It might not even amount to a single corner of them. After the great catastrophe that destroyed the Immortal Realm, the region where the Xuanhuang Realm was located witnessed the return of the Xuantian King after his ascension, and the escape of the Faceless Immortal. Beyond the Darkest Star Sea, could there truly have been no other survivors from the Immortal Realm? If they discovered the unusual changes occurring in the Xuanhuang Realm's star region, it would have been entirely reasonable for them to take preventive measures.

'The Immortal Realm collapsed, yet the vast lower realms instead became the battlefield where various factions gathered. What exactly lies beyond the High Wall now?'

'Do those surviving Immortals still rule supreme? Or did the cultivators of old rise up, discover a way to oppose the True Immortals, and perhaps even develop a civilization capable of hunting them?'

Li Fan's thoughts drifted leisurely, and a feeling of longing rose within his heart.

His emotions surged for a long while before finally calming.

'Soon.'

'In this life, the Xuan Immortal Ark will serve as the vanguard to leap across the High Wall. Even if they ultimately fail, I can summarize the experience and continue in the next life. At most, after three to five attempts, there should be a very good chance of crossing the High Wall.'

'And after I achieve Dao Integration through the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth, becoming the strongest cultivator within the Darkest Star Sea, I can unite the strength of both the Xuanhuang Realm and the Xuan Immortal Ark to the greatest extent possible, then begin exploring what lies beyond the High Wall.'

'Just as I once explored step by step from the Great Xuan Small World to the Congyun Sea, and then to the Xuanhuang Realm.'

As he fell into a brief trance, memories suddenly surfaced of the countless hardships he had endured before finally breaking free from the Immortal Severing Grand Formation and entering the cultivation world.

'Although the world beyond the High Wall is filled with danger, I am no longer the same as I once was.'

A gleam flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

'The difference in elevation...'

From this higher dimensional perspective, looking down upon the Star Sea beneath the High Wall, the insights welling up within his heart were dozens of times more active than when comprehending the Dao within the Star Sea itself.

Moreover, the insights naturally born while standing at such a height were fundamentally on a higher level than those gained under ordinary circumstances.

It was as if he were truly comprehending the Dao from the perspective of a True Immortal.

'Why are all beings beneath the Immortals considered ants?'

'A True Immortal can destroy the Xuanhuang Realm with a single glance. Yet no matter how powerful a mortal cultivator becomes, destroying such a vast world still requires considerable effort.'

'The reason is simple. An Immortal stands high enough. In the eyes of a True Immortal, an entire world is nothing more than a tiny point.'

He recalled what he had seen atop the Remnant World Great Wall.

The endless fragments of broken worlds had gradually shrunk as his altitude increased, eventually twisting into a ring before finally converging into a single point.

Compared to that colossal Remnant World Great Wall, even the present Xuanhuang Realm was merely an insignificant fragment.

The Great Wall became a point.

Yet viewing the Xuanhuang Realm as a point required nowhere near that level of elevation.

As he savored the sensation of continuous ascent, the scenes of the Great Xuan Small World and the Xuanhuang Realm within his vision gradually twisted and shrank.

Although they had not yet condensed into a single point, they already resembled a mass of yellow clouds viewed from outside the world itself.

Li Fan instinctively reached out to touch it.

Only then did he discover that his body seemed frozen solid.

Endless resistance surrounded him, preventing him from moving even the slightest bit.

'I am still too weak. Although by fortunate coincidence I have obtained the perspective of a True Immortal, possessing such vision and actually being able to act are two completely different things...'

Li Fan tried several more times.

The result never changed.

His body seemed detached from the world itself, making any meaningful movement impossible. Moreover, those repeated attempts rapidly drained the energy within him. Even with Li Fan's current foundation, he soon found himself nearly exhausted.

Knowing that he could not force the matter, Li Fan quickly descended from that lofty height.

Only after his viewpoint lowered did freedom of movement gradually return.

Li Fan let out a long breath as he recovered the energy he had just consumed.

A moment later, his gaze narrowed slightly.

He had noticed something unusual.

According to his normal recovery speed, he should have returned to peak condition within only a few breaths. After all, he possessed the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven as his foundation and had also absorbed the World Destruction Transformation of the Xuanhuang Realm. The energy that the newly fused Xuanhuang Realm could unleash when facing world destruction was unimaginably vast. For an individual cultivator, it was virtually inexhaustible.

Yet now, merely attempting to move while at that higher elevation had nearly depleted his entire energy reserve in a short period.

'It is not merely the change in elevation. Even the energy required simply to move increases almost exponentially.'

'This is also one of the fundamental reasons behind the difference between Immortals and mortals. Spiritual qi, even the total spiritual qi of an entire world, cannot support the expenditure required to act at that height.'

'The energy itself exists on too low a level. A higher grade substitute is needed.'

'Immortal spiritual qi...'

Various realizations flashed through Li Fan's mind.

Taking a single step, he left the Great Xuan Small World and arrived in another desolate small world inhabited only by endless primeval forests.

He quietly rested until fully recovered before once again attempting to ascend.

This time, however, he carefully controlled the rate of ascent.

When the endless primeval forest before his eyes had shrunk to the size of a glass marble, he stopped.

For Li Fan, who originally stood at the very lowest level, merely maintaining this elevation already consumed an enormous amount of energy.

This time, however, he did not use his own spiritual energy.

Instead, he employed source power essence, whose nature closely resembled Immortal spiritual qi.

Golden light enveloped his body.

The feeling of restraint weakened slightly.

Compared to before, when he had been completely frozen, it was incomparably easier.

Looking at the small world before him, now resembling a glass marble, Li Fan slowly extended the index finger of his right hand.

Buzz.

As if sensing an approaching fatal danger, a mournful lament suddenly echoed across the heavens of that desolate small world.

Yet nothing could prevent what was about to happen.

Li Fan gently lowered his finger.

Simultaneously, an enormous finger appeared above the heavens of the small world.

He applied just a little force.

Li Fan felt a slight resistance.

Golden source power essence surged forth like a roaring torrent.

That resistance was as fragile as paper.

It shattered instantly.

The finger's shadow above the heavens spread like boundless dark clouds, covering the entire small world.

There was no earth-shattering explosion.

Only a crisp sound, like glass being crushed beneath a finger.

In a single instant, the desolate small world was reduced to ashes.

A violent storm spread through the void as a result of the world's destruction.

No matter how fiercely it howled, Li Fan remained standing firmly within it.

Protected by golden light, the storm could not harm him in the slightest.

He narrowed his eyes as he looked at his own finger.

He was still immersed in the might of the world destroying strike he had just unleashed.

The tremendous consumption of source power essence had already caused him to fall from that "higher place" and return to a normal perspective. Even so, erasing an entire small world with such effortless ease...

It truly gave Li Fan the illusion of being an omnipotent god.

Li Fan closed his eyes. Only after a long while did he dispel that sense of disorientation.

'Back then, when the True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins destroyed the Xuanhuang Realm with a single glance, what they did was fundamentally no different from what I have done now. The only difference is that they stood at a far greater height and could wield far greater power...'

'Give me enough time. One day, I will be able to accomplish the same.'

Li Fan lightly brushed the tip of his right index finger, as though wiping away dust that did not exist.

'This move descends from above, like the finger of a True Immortal falling upon the world...'

'I shall call it, the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger!'

'It signifies both the descent of a True Immortal into the mortal world, and the descent of a True Immortal's power to subdue the mortal world.'

'Excellent!'

Li Fan was quite pleased with the name he had chosen.

Sensing divine senses approaching to investigate the inexplicable destruction of the small world, Li Fan transformed into a streak of sword light and departed directly.

The desolate wilderness small world was too insignificant. Even if it vanished, it would not affect the overall stability of the Xuanhuang Realm.

After returning to Great Xuan, Li Fan savored the sensation of using the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger while contemplating how he could unleash this divine ability more easily in the future.

Although the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger possessed the power to destroy worlds, its shortcomings were equally obvious.

Its casting time was far too long. Merely ascending to the required height demanded that Li Fan spend a long time accumulating momentum.

Afterward, he also had to gather source power essence before he could move freely at that specific height.

If the target were a world, this would not matter much. After all, a world could not grow legs and run away. Its location would remain fixed.

But if the target were a cultivator, they would certainly not give Li Fan so much time to prepare.

'One solution is to set up formations beforehand and trap the target, buying me sufficient time.'

'As for the other...'

Among all of Li Fan's attainments, his greatest was in the Dao of Formations.

Now that he had comprehended a divine ability approaching the Immortal level yet could not wield it freely, it was only natural for him to seek a breakthrough through formations.

'All Daos under heaven share the same origin. Divine abilities can perhaps be transformed into formations, and formations can perhaps be transformed into divine abilities...'

Ever since ascending to that lofty height, Li Fan felt that his thoughts had become more active than ever before.

Standing at such an elevated vantage point allowed him to examine problems from a perspective that transcended mortal limitations.

'Final Dissociation Disc, begin deduction!'

Temporarily suspending all its other tasks, Li Fan poured every experience from beneath the High Wall, along with all his insights from casting the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger, into it.

Because directly converting this divine ability into a corresponding formation clearly exceeded the processing limits of the Final Dissociation Disc, its simulated personality immediately entered a frozen state.

Li Fan pondered briefly upon seeing this.

Then he changed his strategy.

Rather than expecting to directly transform the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger into a formation, he instead planned to divide the casting process into a series of graded formations.

Just as several ancient Immortal formations ultimately combined to form the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Li Fan intended to use several linked formations to achieve the rapid casting of the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger.

'The first step is naturally Ascension.'

Having personally ascended several times, Li Fan already possessed a preliminary understanding of the process.

The so called ascension was, in truth, the act of stimulating energy and raising its "position" within this starry sky.

'To find a method of achieving this, perhaps I should imitate the Xuan Immortal Ark's plan. Gather sufficient power from True Immortal seal script characters, then use the High Wall to unleash it all at once.'

'But on one hand, I am not seeking to topple the High Wall with a single finger. The amount of energy required is therefore nowhere near that terrifying.'

'On the other hand...'

Li Fan once again recalled the towering peaks gathered within the depths of the Darkest Star Sea.

'Perhaps I can draw inspiration from the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation,' Li Fan thought silently.

'The reason the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation can so easily create one of the few energy peaks within the Darkest Star Sea is because it is built upon the corpse of a True Immortal.'

'If I also use a True Immortal's remains as formation materials...'

Li Fan's train of thought immediately expanded.

A flash of crimson light appeared in his hand.

It continuously writhed while emitting an ominous and bizarre aura.

It was none other than the remaining True Immortal flesh that had previously been activated by the ancient characters upon the Kun-Qian Bone Hand within Ou Shangtian's body.

'Although it lacks immortal spiritual power, it still belongs to a True Immortal. It should be of some help.'

Li Fan muttered as he used the mass of True Immortal flesh as the primary material for his first experiment.

With the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation serving as a template, the Final Dissociation Disc's deduction progressed smoothly.

Before long, the prototype of a new formation had already taken shape.

Li Fan used source power essence to construct the formation, mixing the constantly writhing True Immortal flesh into it.

After a long period of preparation, everything was finally complete.

Narrowing his eyes, Li Fan activated the formation.

Silence lingered for a brief moment.

Then an incomparably dazzling pillar of light erupted from within the formation.

Fueled by the True Immortal flesh, its brilliance was astonishing.

What delighted Li Fan even more was that, from his perspective, the pillar was far more than merely bright.

It was slowly rising, continuously ascending, climbing above all living beings.

'It worked so smoothly?'

The thought had only just appeared in his mind when the pillar of light, which seemed capable of illuminating the entire sky, suddenly went out.

Li Fan was momentarily stunned.

After examining it carefully, he finally understood that there was nothing wrong with the formation.

Rather, the True Immortal flesh serving as fuel had already been completely exhausted.

Li Fan frowned slightly.

'Its efficiency is still too low.'

'There is still room for improvement.'

'Besides, it is not limited to the Kun-Qian Bone Hand.'

'There should still be other remains of True Immortals within the Xuanhuang Realm. Perhaps I can gather them all together...'

The purpose of the Ascension Formation was not merely to rapidly cast the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger.

Its ability to elevate one's position might one day become indispensable for crossing the High Wall, or even attaining True Immortality itself.

Li Fan attached immense importance to it.

Temporarily casting aside all outside matters, he devoted his entire focus to researching it.

Under the deductions of the Final Dissociation Disc and Li Fan's own guidance and refinements, the Ascension Formation underwent more than a thousand iterations in only seven days.

Only then did its utilization efficiency of the True Immortal flesh rise to a level that Li Fan found barely satisfactory.

Chapter 1330: An Immortal Fall Annihilates All Things

Li Fan began a new round of experiments.

This time, after burning away a fist-sized piece of True Immortal flesh, the elevation he reached was already sufficient to activate the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger. It could effortlessly crush a small world on the scale of Great Xuan.

"To achieve the effect of destroying the Xuanhuang Realm with a single finger, I would need to burn at least nearly a human-sized amount of True Immortal flesh."

Li Fan fell into silent contemplation.

"Compared to how efficiently a True Immortal can use it, there is still an enormous gap. But this is already the limit of what I can accomplish at present. Perhaps only after my strength improves further will I discover a more suitable method of refinement."

With the first and most important step solved, the subsequent deduction progressed smoothly.

Using eight interconnected formations, the Final Dissociation Disc successfully recreated the divine ability of the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger.

With the assistance of the Final Dissociation Disc, and provided all the required materials were available, Li Fan could complete the entire formation in a single instant. It could essentially be treated as an instantaneous divine ability.

"Unfortunately, it is still a composite formation rather than an innate divine ability. It cannot achieve the flawless natural unity of a true divine art. If I were to face an enemy equally proficient in formations, they might exploit the flaws between the interconnected formations and dispel this technique with little effort."

"There should be no one in this Darkest Star Sea whose formation attainments surpass mine. But beyond the High Wall, that may not necessarily be the case."

"No matter what, my current priority is to gather enough True Immortal flesh for further research. At the same time, I must guard against the possibility that, once enough pieces accumulate, they may generate self-awareness."

Li Fan stood suspended above the Great Xuan Small World, gazing beyond the world itself.

Reflecting upon everything that had happened recently, he gained an even deeper understanding of his plan to bring the Super Xuanhuang Realm into existence.

"If the path to immortality is the process of a single individual climbing upward."

"Then what I intend to do is raise the entire Xuanhuang Realm to the other shore."

His eyes flickered with thought.

"At present, it is already impossible for even a single person to ascend to immortality. Let alone elevating an entire world."

"In truth, if not for the cluster of immortal spiritual qi left behind by Mr. Bai, I would never even have considered such a possibility. It was precisely because I personally witnessed the changes brought about when the Xuanhuang Realm became infused with immortal spiritual qi in my previous life that I now possess a measure of confidence."

"Advancing an entire world may also have been the Heavenly Doctor's long-standing plan. The only difference is that the world he intended to elevate was not the Xuanhuang Realm, but the Heavenly Law Realm. Unfortunately for him, this life is destined to have his opportunity taken by me."

Li Fan felt no guilt whatsoever.

"With the Ascension Formation, perhaps I can make even more efficient use of that mass of immortal spiritual qi. But should I also incorporate the burning of True Immortal flesh during the world's ascension..."

After pondering for a while, Li Fan ultimately decided to first conduct an experiment on another small world.

Although, according to theory, nothing should remain after True Immortal flesh was completely consumed by the formation, Li Fan still sensed vaguely that there were changes taking place which he was presently unable to perceive.

This time, the small world he selected was even smaller than the primitive world he had previously crushed with a single finger.

There was scarcely any vegetation at all. It was an absolute desert of life.

After using the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger to sever its connection with the Xuanhuang Realm,

Li Fan dragged it through the void opened by the Rift Whale.

Only after traveling an immense distance from the Xuanhuang Realm itself, ensuring that even the greatest disaster would not spread back to it, did he finally stop.

"It is said that immortals can pluck stars and seize the moon. My methods are hardly inferior."

Since he was using formations in place of divine abilities, casting them required almost no effort. In fact, the entire process appeared remarkably graceful. Only the rapidly consumed True Immortal flesh caused Li Fan some heartache.

"After this experiment, my entire stockpile will be exhausted. I will have to accumulate more."

Standing within the void, Li Fan looked down at the small world beneath him and began arranging the Ascension Formation throughout every corner of it.

"Besides that, I should also observe the effects of the character [Creation]."

Because he remained wary of the possibility that a True Immortal had already occupied that Dao, even after learning the True Immortal seal script character [Creation], Li Fan had never attempted to comprehend the Great Dao contained within it.

He had only used it as a tool.

For this experiment, he deliberately distorted its meaning.

The version he used was not the fully comprehended form of the [Creation] character.

After everything had been prepared, the Ascension Formation activated instantly.

Towering peaks rose from countless places throughout the world.

Like heavenly pillars, they lifted the entire world upward. As its "height" steadily increased, countless mysterious transformations unfolded throughout the once lifeless wasteland.

Vegetation and trees seemed to undergo millions of years of evolution in the blink of an eye.

What had once been a thin layer covering the ground became endless primeval forests reaching toward the heavens.

The previously monotonous landscape also began to differentiate and evolve. Towering mountains, deep canyons, and magnificent natural scenery emerged one after another.

"These kinds of changes do not occur in cultivators."

"Until the very final stage of ascension, a cultivator's body experiences no changes regardless of how much their height increases. But for an entire world, the situation is different."

"It may not increase in a perfectly linear fashion, but the world truly receives continuous feedback throughout the process."

Watching the astonishing transformations taking place below, waves of insight continuously arose within Li Fan.

The world's ascension continued as the True Immortal flesh burned away.

It was obvious that the higher the ascent became, the more energy was required.

Gradually, the world's evolution slowed.

"It has already reached its limit."

Li Fan understood this well.

He had never expected that the amount of True Immortal flesh supplied this time would be enough to raise the small world to any especially great height.

He fixed his gaze upon it, observing the changes after the ascension had been completed.

The last traces of True Immortal flesh were completely consumed.

The small world, which had been rumbling without pause, suddenly fell into an eerie silence.

It was as though time itself had been frozen. The wind, clouds, flowing qi, and every living thing within the world...

All became completely motionless, as though frozen by an invisible force.

"Hm?"

Li Fan sensed something and his expression changed slightly.

The phantom image of the Wooden Sword flew from its sheath, carrying him rapidly away from the surrounding region of space.

Shortly after Li Fan departed, a terrifying calamity descended upon the small world.

Cracks burst forth across the world.

At first there were only three or five, stretching across heaven and earth.

Soon afterward, however, the fractures spread rapidly until they covered every corner of the entire world. It was like something that had fallen from an immense height.

The higher it had climbed before, the more catastrophic its fall became.

The small world, temporarily elevated by Li Fan's formation, finally returned to its original position.

In that instant, it shattered into countless pieces.

Unlike a world silently crushed by the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger, a world falling from such a height collided violently with the surrounding void of the Xuanhuang Realm.

It was like a massive boulder plunging into a tranquil lake.

Invisible ripples spread outward from the location where the small world was destroyed.

They expanded rapidly in every direction.

Like a raging gale sweeping across the void, although Li Fan himself remained completely motionless, his robes fluttered violently in the wind.

Li Fan turned his gaze back toward the Xuanhuang Realm.

Although the Xuanhuang Realm itself would not be harmed by this accidental worldfall.

The resulting hurricane did indeed cause the Xuanhuang Realm to tremble slightly.

"It seems those flies will be attracted again."

Sensing an aura from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance approaching, Li Fan did not choose to hide or leave for the time being.

He had not forgotten the primary purpose of this experiment.

Li Fan swept the site where the world had fallen with his divine sense. There seemed to be no wreckage left behind. Everything within the small world had been reduced to ashes during the fall.

However, the black mist formed after the True Immortal flesh and blood was decomposed by the White Ring Descends into Mortal World did not vanish together with the destruction of the world.

It continued to float silently within the void.

"What exactly is this black mist?"

"As expected, using True Immortal flesh-blood as fuel causes it to become hidden within the world itself."

Having obtained the result he wanted, Li Fan waved his hand. A golden net wrapped around the black mist and carried it away as he rapidly departed.

Not long after Li Fan left, a figure arrived belatedly.

Had Li Fan still been present, he would have recognized this person as the chief of the Dharma-Transmitters, Dharma-Transmitter Jiang.

Dharma-Transmitter Jiang was stationed in the Returning Ruins Realm and rarely left it. He would only appear when the Xuanhuang Realm encountered a world-ending catastrophe beyond the ability of ordinary Dharma-Transmitters to handle.

This incident was merely a minor disturbance caused by a world's fall. Yet, for some unknown reason, it had drawn him here personally.

Dharma-Transmitter Jiang arrived at the source of the disturbance and gazed thoughtfully at the empty void where all traces had already disappeared.

He surveyed the surroundings but found no clues, causing him to frown slightly.

After searching for a long time without finding anything, Dharma-Transmitter Jiang was about to leave when his eyes suddenly narrowed. He turned to look once more at the place where the world had fallen.

A wisp of black mist, which Li Fan had clearly collected completely, unexpectedly emerged once again.

The instant he saw the black mist, Dharma-Transmitter Jiang's expression changed drastically.

It was as though he had seen it before and was intimately familiar with it. Without the slightest hesitation, he opened his mouth wide and swallowed not only the black mist, but even the entire space surrounding the impact site in a single gulp.

After swallowing the black mist, Dharma-Transmitter Jiang's complexion visibly deteriorated.

Dark patterns rapidly spread across his body like a tide of black ink, threatening to engulf him completely.

Yet in the face of such a terrifying sight, his eyes remained incomparably calm.

A ripple emerged from the center of his chest. Under the influence of that ripple, Dharma-Transmitter Jiang's body began to waver like the surface of a tranquil lake that had been disturbed.

As the rhythmic oscillations continued, Dharma-Transmitter Jiang, together with the black mist and the space he had swallowed, gradually faded.

In the end, they vanished completely.

From that point onward, no more black mist emerged from the impact site.

It was as though nothing had ever happened.

...

Li Fan naturally had no way of knowing that the "fly" from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance he had spoken of had unknowingly solved a major problem for him.

Had Dharma-Transmitter Jiang not cleaned away the black mist in time, it was highly likely that before Li Fan even realized what had happened, the black mist would have already silently begun eroding the Xuanhuang Realm.

Li Fan's Dao Integration plan for this lifetime would likely have ended in complete failure.

At this moment, Li Fan was contemplating the reason his experiment had failed.

"The ascension of a world is fundamentally different from the ascension of a cultivator."

"The difference is reflected not only in the process, but also in the outcome."

"When cultivators return from the 'higher level' to their normal state, they experience at most a little physical discomfort. They would never suffer such a catastrophic collapse as a falling world."

"Perhaps it is because the world itself absorbs an enormous amount of energy during the ascension process."

Recalling the scenes he had witnessed inside that small world during its sublimation, Li Fan pondered silently.

Now that he had obtained preliminary verification, a difficult problem stood before him.

After pushing the Xuanhuang Realm toward higher sublimation, there would be a period before the Xuanhuang Realm evolved a Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth that Li Fan could devour.

During that interval, he had to find a way to anchor the relative position of the Super Xuanhuang Realm.

Otherwise, before he could even achieve Dao Integration, he would very likely shatter together with the falling Xuanhuang Realm and be forced to return through [Truth] far earlier than planned.

"As the world ascends, it only becomes stable after reaching a certain point."

"That point should be the boundary separating immortals from mortals."

"I wonder whether the preparations I have made in this lifetime will be sufficient. If not, what method can I use to temporarily anchor the Xuanhuang Realm?"

The ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm into immortality was by no means an easy task.

Originally, Li Fan believed that simply following the plan step by step would achieve his objective. However, the gap between immortals and mortals was as vast as heaven and the abyss. As the plan gradually unfolded, one problem after another surfaced.

Fortunately, Li Fan possessed sufficient resources to deal with and resolve each obstacle one by one.

Thus, he felt no anxiety.

While Li Fan contemplated these matters, the Xuanhuang Realm enjoyed a brief period of calm.

Just as it had in its original course of history.

However, this rare tranquility was soon broken.

The cause was that someone had crossed the Inch Apart, Worlds Away Formation and returned from beneath the High Wall.

Sensing the disturbance, Li Fan temporarily set aside his thoughts.

The one who had returned was Hundred Flowers.

She appeared somewhat disheveled. Her originally flawless glass-like body was now covered with numerous scars. Light flickered unsteadily across her form, as though it might extinguish at any moment.

"Holy Teacher..."

Upon seeing Li Fan appear before her, Hundred Flowers let out a long sigh of relief.

"What happened? After I returned, the rest of you had already disappeared. Even the Remnant World Great Wall had fallen into chaos, with the accumulated residual True Immortal power pouring down..." Li Fan asked with a solemn expression.

As he questioned her, he simultaneously sent a stream of source power essence to heal her injuries.

The effect of the source power essence was immediate.

After receiving its nourishment, Hundred Flowers instantly regained her vitality. She first cupped her hands in thanks before speaking somewhat angrily.

"That Yin Shangren suddenly went mad for some reason. Despite all our attempts to stop him, he rushed directly toward a certain location on the Remnant World Great Wall."

"It would have been one thing if he alone wished to throw away his life. But not long afterward, the sudden upheaval erupted. We were completely caught off guard by the surge of residual True Immortal power and were scattered."

Hundred Flowers suppressed her anger before continuing.

"I was fortunate enough to crash directly into the Remnant World Great Wall. Although I suffered some minor injuries, I ultimately managed to survive."

"Fellow Daoist Qiao Gong probably was not so fortunate."

Her expression became rather grim.

"I personally saw him drifting toward the High Wall."

"In my opinion, his chances of survival are very slim."

After hearing Hundred Flowers' account, Li Fan fell into thoughtful silence.

"Where is Xu Ke?" Li Fan asked again.

Xu Ke had always possessed extraordinary fortune. Logically speaking, he should also have escaped safely.

"The situation was far too chaotic at the time. I did not see him."

"However, while returning, I did discover the communication mark he left behind."
