Chapter 1331: The Depressions Of The Darkest Star Sea

"The mark should have been left behind by Xu Ke. However, I searched the surrounding area and could not find any trace of him. The residual power of the True Immortal kept growing stronger, and I simply could not endure it any longer. Left with no choice, I passed through the grand teleportation formation and returned." Hundred Flowers said, still visibly shaken.

The principle behind the Inch Apart, Worlds Away Grand Formation was actually different from that of ordinary teleportation formations, although the end result was essentially the same. Hundred Flowers habitually referred to it as a teleportation formation, and Li Fan did not bother correcting her.

He began sensing the marks he had previously left on each of them, determining their current locations and conditions.

Xu Ke and Qiao Gong were indeed still alive.

However, Qiao Gong's situation was actually even better than Xu Ke's. Xu Ke's aura flickered weakly, clearly showing that surviving amid the aftershocks of the residual True Immortal power was extremely difficult. Yet on Qiao Gong's side, everything remained surprisingly stable. It was as though the Echoing star power had no effect on him whatsoever.

As for Yin Shangren...

The mark Li Fan had left on him had completely disappeared.

'Just as expected, something is strange. With his current strength, he should have been incapable of detecting my methods. Even if he vaguely sensed something, judging from everything I deliberately demonstrated before, he should have regarded it as my protection and would never have taken the initiative to remove it.'

The frontier of the Star Sea, the Remnant World Great Wall, and the High Wall were still almost entirely unfamiliar territory to Li Fan.

Having these individuals, blessed with immense destiny and who had survived since the era of the ancient catastrophe, scout the way had been part of Li Fan's plan from the very beginning. This sudden eruption of echoing star power had merely accelerated the process.

Li Fan decided not to concern himself with them for now. Once they returned, he could question them in detail.

He understood each of their temperaments thoroughly. Nothing major was likely to happen.

"Do not worry. They are all safe, and each has encountered their own opportunities."

When Li Fan said this, Hundred Flowers' expression immediately became somewhat complicated.

Ignoring whatever thoughts she harbored, Li Fan handed her another mass of source power essence.

"Do not go near the teleportation formation for now. Wait until the storm subsides."

"However, under the erosion of the residual True Immortal power, the teleportation formation must be maintained periodically. Otherwise, if it is damaged, someone will have to make another trip, creating many unnecessary variables. I will leave this task to you."

Along with the source power essence came a vast amount of knowledge concerning the maintenance of the Inch Apart, Worlds Away Grand Formation.

Hundred Flowers nodded in understanding and quickly immersed herself in the profound formation knowledge. Although it only covered the grand formation's fundamental structural units and did not involve its core mechanisms, it still captivated her completely.

After arranging matters for Hundred Flowers, Li Fan gazed into the Darkest Star Sea.

"The impact of the echoing star power will reach the vicinity of the Xuanhuang Realm in about half a month."

"Just like in my previous life, the entire world will fall into violent upheaval."

"Such a vast force would be an incredible waste if simply allowed to dissipate."

Having witnessed the Darkest Star Sea from a higher dimensional perspective, and having personally seen a small world ascend in dimension only to collapse into pieces after falling, Li Fan had gained an entirely new understanding of the residual True Immortal power accumulated beneath the High Wall and sealed behind the Remnant World Great Wall.

"The True Immortal power released by the True Immortal within the Immortal Ruins while comprehending the [Hunger] character expanded outward until it encountered the High Wall. Over countless years, it continuously accumulated beneath the High Wall."

"The accumulation of the 'momentum' of True Immortal power gradually formed a relative highland."

"Since it is merely a simple accumulation of power, it cannot maintain permanent stability."

"On one hand, it naturally seeks to flow downward. On the other..."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes, as if once more witnessing the magnificent scene beneath the High Wall.

"Ordinarily, this True Immortal power should have gradually flowed back into the Darkest Star Sea. But for some unknown reason, the continuous Remnant World Great Wall formed beneath the High Wall."

"It firmly blocked these True Immortal powers."

"Thus creating an unusual state of equilibrium. But now, that balance has been broken."

"The True Immortal power pours downward."

"Like a raging flood, it slowly flows into the lower regions of the Darkest Star Sea."

"Raising the overall level of the Star Sea itself..."

A flash of understanding crossed Li Fan's mind.

The astonishing speed at which the Star Sea revived during his previous life had likely been driven in part by this very event.

"What I must do now is find a way to intercept these floodwaters and preserve them temporarily."

"So they may be used later when the Xuanhuang Realm begins its ascent."

Without question, this was a colossal undertaking.

Perfect execution within only half a month was impossible. Li Fan could only do everything within his ability.

The location of the Xuanhuang Realm was exceptionally unique.

Outside the Immortal Ruins.

Because of the Dao-Comprehending True Immortal residing within the Immortal Ruins, when viewed across the entire topography of the Darkest Star Sea, the Xuanhuang Realm lay near one of its highest peaks.

Its close proximity even caused it to occupy a relatively elevated position itself.

Like the raised earth surrounding a towering mountain.

"Therefore, it possesses an additional invisible barrier."

"The impact naturally faced by the Xuanhuang Realm will be far weaker."

"And what I need to do is create depressions, then divert and accumulate as much True Immortal power as possible from the surrounding regions."

Li Fan nodded slightly.

He had personally experienced the journey of ascension before. To rise and approach immortality required only the continuous release of energy to elevate one's own position.

But as for creating depressions...

Li Fan currently knew absolutely nothing.

However, while overlooking the Star Sea from the heights of the Remnant World Great Wall and from the Star Sea's central control core, he had indeed noticed regions that lay noticeably lower than ordinary areas.

"I should investigate them first."

Li Fan acted immediately. He first visited Ou Shangtian and generated another batch of True Immortal flesh.

Looking at Ou Shangtian's face, now as pale as thin gold leaf, Li Fan frowned slightly.

"It seems finding the remains of a True Immortal can no longer be delayed."

Suppressing the thought for now, he transformed the source power essence into golden armor surrounding his body.

The phantom Wooden Sword left its sheath.

In an instant, he departed the Xuanhuang Realm and sped through the Darkest Star Sea.

As he rapidly flew toward the region from his memories, he simultaneously experienced the subtle differences in elevation throughout the Star Sea.

After the Wooden Sword passed beyond one region of the Star Sea, Li Fan suddenly sensed something.

He immediately turned back.

Suspending himself within the void, he carefully observed the surroundings.

"This truly is a natural depression."

"If I had not previously witnessed the topography from a higher dimensional perspective, I would never have discovered its uniqueness."

"On the surface, it appears no different from any other region of the Star Sea."

Li Fan frowned.

Streams of divine sense spread outward, exploring every corner of the region separately.

The results matched his earlier perception.

Although this depression possessed a naturally lower momentum, it seemed no different from ordinary regions.

He remained there for more than half a day, yet still found no clues.

Then Li Fan suddenly realized something.

Suppressing both his physical strength and spiritual energy, he flicked a finger.

A single strand of sword qi shot forth.

The sword qi merely simulated a single strike from an ordinary Soul Transformation cultivator. As it whistled through the air, it actually tore open a crack in the surrounding space.

Although it vanished in an instant and the rift quickly healed itself, Li Fan still noticed it.

"So that is how it is."

"This depression has become more fragile."

Li Fan suddenly understood.

It was not just space itself.

Rather, every condition that sustained the existence of this region of space had undergone a significant decline compared to normal regions of the Darkest Star Sea.

"The relationship between the Xuanhuang Realm and this place is much like the relationship between the Immortal Realm and the Xuanhuang Realm."

"That comparison may be somewhat exaggerated, but it illustrates the difference between the three rather well."

"A Dao Integration cultivator from the Xuanhuang Realm would probably be equivalent to a True Immortal in this region. With a single glance, they could destroy the entire world without any effort."

Li Fan carefully sensed the fragility of this depression.

"In terms of fundamental potential, it is actually not much lower than the Xuanhuang Realm. Yet when manifested in reality, the difference is so obvious."

He fell silent in thought.

"What would happen if it were even lower? If it reached the absolute limit?"

The question naturally surfaced in his mind.

Li Fan's thoughts drifted.

Unfortunately, this place was already close to the lowest point of the Darkest Star Sea.

For now, there was no existing answer he could use as a reference.

The day when the surging immortal power would once again sweep across the Star Sea drew closer, bringing Li Fan's attention back to the present.

"With my current understanding, I still cannot determine the true reason these depressions formed."

"But that does not prevent me from making use of them first."

Back when Li Fan had served as an official in the Great Xuan Dynasty, he had personally surveyed the land, drafted blueprints, and overseen the construction of irrigation systems that benefited entire regions.

In his eyes now, guiding the power of True Immortals into this depression was fundamentally no different from constructing waterworks.

"This depression is a natural reservoir."

"What I need to do is divert the power of True Immortals here."

"The first step is preventing the depression itself from absorbing the incoming immortal power. Otherwise, it would simply rise until it disappeared..."

"Source power essence is incompatible with True Immortal power. It is the perfect material."

A brilliant light flashed across Li Fan's eyes.

An endless stream of source power essence burst forth from his body, stretching like an immeasurably long strip of cloth.

Only a thin layer was required as insulation.

Under Li Fan's control, it quickly spread across the entire depression.

Golden radiance scattered through the darkness as the source power essence disappeared into the void.

On the surface, nothing seemed different.

But Li Fan knew that this place had already undergone a fundamental transformation.

"Next, I need to enlarge the inlet through which this depression gathers immortal power."

"At the same time, I must continuously reinforce the insulating layer at the bottom."

"My source power essence is already running low. It seems the You Clansmen will have to suffer a little longer."

Li Fan's divine sense stirred.

Within the Great Xuan small world, every You Clansman being raised there simultaneously sensed something.

They awoke from their slumber.

Then they all knelt upon the ground and began praying with utmost devotion, neither eating nor drinking.

The source power essence gradually became abundant once more.

Li Fan again viewed the surrounding region from his higher dimensional perspective.

The depression possessed an irregular boundary and was not particularly large.

At its current size, even when the waves of residual True Immortal power swept past, it would probably gather only a very limited amount.

"How should I divert the flow?"

After some contemplation, Li Fan immediately came up with an idea.

The phantom of the Wooden Sword flickered continuously.

Over the next several days, Li Fan established one Ascension Formation after another throughout the vast starry region surrounding the depression.

Because the True Immortal flesh and blood was being consumed far too quickly, Li Fan had no choice but to return once more to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Ou Shangtian was already barely clinging to life.

Even the Kun-Qian Bone Hand had developed numerous fine cracks.

It was obvious that it would be unable to produce any more True Immortal flesh for quite some time.

Fortunately, Li Fan had already gathered enough materials.

Once every formation had been arranged according to plan, Li Fan quietly waited for the approaching surge of echoing immortal power.

"I still have not found a method to permanently anchor the elevated state created by Ascension."

"But producing a brief eruption to create one peak after another and redirect the flow of True Immortal power is entirely possible."

"According to my precise calculations, all the True Immortal power throughout this vast surrounding region of the Star Sea will be diverted here."

Buzz.

As Li Fan anticipated, the echoing immortal power arrived exactly on schedule.

It resembled both a roaring tidal wave and a terrifying storm.

With unwavering determination, Li Fan activated each Ascension Formation one after another.

Near the Xuanhuang Realm within the Darkest Star Sea, an extraordinary spectacle appeared.

Ordinary cultivators could not perceive it.

Only peerless experts standing upon the highest peak might perhaps look down from above and witness it.

One low mountain after another suddenly rose from nothingness.

They stood directly before the overwhelming torrent of True Immortal power.

Although each mountain quickly collapsed soon after rising.

They nevertheless truly collided with the incoming tide.

The low peaks crumbled amid deafening explosions.

The torrent of True Immortal power, however, gradually changed direction after each collision.

Wave after wave surged violently toward the depression Li Fan had designated.

Whoosh. Whoosh. Whoosh.

At first, it was only a gentle breeze.

But as more and more immortal power was diverted, the howling current within this region eventually surpassed even the original eruption beneath the High Wall.

Li Fan had no choice but to hide within the phantom of the Wooden Sword.

Relying on the profound mystery of Truth and Falsehood Transformation, he avoided the effects of the True Immortal power.

Watching the depression gradually fill to the brim.

Even someone with Li Fan's composure could not help feeling a deep sense of pride.

"What a True Immortal can accomplish, I can now accomplish as well."

"It may require a little more effort, but once the method is mastered, it can be reproduced countless times."

Just as beneath the High Wall, where the Remnant World Great Wall had once blocked the immortal power.

An enormous quantity of True Immortal power accumulated within the depression.

Because of the insulating layer formed by the Source Power Essence, combined with the naturally unique properties of this place.

The fundamental potential of the surrounding space did not rise.

Only its stored power continued increasing.

It was as though another Immortal Ruins was slowly taking shape before Li Fan's eyes.

The phantom of the Wooden Sword flickered between brightness and darkness.

The attraction acting upon it grew stronger and stronger.

It felt as though Li Fan were truly facing a living True Immortal within the Immortal Ruins.

Frowning, Li Fan controlled the phantom and withdrew from the depression.

The instant he left its boundary, he immediately felt that the overwhelming attraction within had diminished by more than half.

It was as though the inside and outside belonged to entirely different worlds.

The torrent of True Immortal power continued pouring into the depression.

Eventually, only after the entire depression had been completely filled did the overflowing torrent resume sweeping toward the other regions of the Star Sea.

However, with such an enormous reservoir absorbing the power, the destructive force of the storm had already been greatly weakened.

More importantly, this reservoir stood directly before the Xuanhuang Realm.

As a result, the countless living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm barely noticed the disturbance at all.

In this life, the members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance likewise received the warning transmitted by the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor.

They exchanged puzzled glances.

"The disturbance the Immortal Ancestor mentioned has not arrived yet, has it?"

"This is definitely only the prelude. The real event is still to come."

Chapter 1332: Tempting Mo Rubin Once More

However, after waiting for a long time, the Dharma-Transmitters of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance never witnessed the greater upheaval in the Xuanhuang Realm that they had been expecting.

Could it be that the Immortal Ancestor had misjudged the situation?

No matter how unbelievable it seemed, the Dharma-Transmitters ultimately had no choice but to accept this fact.

Out of reverence for the Immortal Ancestor, however, none of them dared discuss it openly.

They were even less willing to take the initiative to send a message asking the Immortal Ancestor about it.

In the end, they could only conclude that the Immortal Ancestor cared deeply for all living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm. Even the slightest disturbance was enough for him to issue a warning. After all, some unrest had indeed occurred.

What the countless living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm could not perceive was that, beyond the void, an immense quantity of True Immortal power had quietly accumulated.

Li Fan stood before the now completely filled depression. Feeling the faint attractive force emanating from it, he nodded in satisfaction.

This harvest had exceeded even his own expectations.

The naturally formed depression had become an almost perfect vessel for storing True Immortal power. Coupled with the formations Li Fan had arranged around its perimeter to conceal it, every abnormality in this place was perfectly hidden.

Li Fan was confident that even people like the Immortal Ancestor, unless they deliberately conducted a careful investigation, would never notice anything unusual if they merely passed by.

"With this accumulation, the plan to create the Super Xuanhuang Realm has become much more certain."

The power drawn forth by the Enlightened True Immortal in the Immortal Ruins through the Hunger character art was naturally different from pure immortal spirit power and could not be directly absorbed by the Xuanhuang Realm.

However, Li Fan could use the Ascension Formation as an intermediary to transform this enormous power into the driving force that would elevate the Xuanhuang Realm. In this way, the consumption of True Immortal flesh and blood would be greatly reduced. Otherwise, relying solely on the output of the Kun-Qian Bone Hand, even if Ou Shangtian were squeezed dry, it would still be impossible to construct enough Ascension Formations.

"It hangs in the heavens like a lake, resembling the ruins of the Immortal Realm."

Only after gazing at it for a long while did Li Fan finally withdraw his eyes from the depression.

He temporarily concealed the place with formations.

"The next step is to find a method of anchoring the world's elevation."

"Otherwise, I will have to take a dangerous gamble and force the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth out before the Xuanhuang Realm falls from immortality. The situation could change in an instant, and anything could happen. The entire plan might fail at the final moment."

"I also need to find a way to increase the production of True Immortal flesh and blood and source power essence simultaneously."

Using a mortal body to accomplish the work of a True Immortal naturally came with countless limitations.

Although Li Fan's accumulation over many reincarnations allowed him to find all kinds of extraordinary substitute powers, they were ultimately not true Immortal Spirit Power. As he drew closer and closer to his objective, everything became increasingly troublesome.

As for how to temporarily anchor the world at a higher level, Li Fan still had no clues.

Putting aside the Enlightened True Immortal within the Immortal Ruins, from the perspective of higher dimensions, the highest points throughout the entire Darkest Star Sea were likely only the Remnant World Great Wall beneath the High Wall, along with the place deep within the Dark Sea of the Xuanhuang Realm where everything converged.

Naturally, there were also some naturally formed mountain peaks scattered throughout the Star Sea. Like the depression before him, they were things the current Li Fan had no ability to fully study or comprehend.

"The next step will proceed along two paths simultaneously."

"I will investigate both beneath the High Wall and within the Dark Sea at the same time."

"As for the High Wall, perhaps I can leave it to the Xuan Immortal Ark. If they can research True Immortal seal script characters and turn them into something they can use, then the elders of the Immortal Ark certainly possess sufficient ability. As for the Dark Sea..."

The face of the Xuantian Sect Dharma King, Mo Rubin, immediately appeared in Li Fan's mind.

"Now that my exchange with the Immortal Ark has allowed me to obtain the [Reveal] character, perhaps it is time to awaken Mo Rubin once again."

One of the functions of the [Reveal] character was to reveal the connections that existed between all things.

The cultivation methods of the Xuantian King all originated from the inheritance of the Azure Firmament Pearl.

If successful, perhaps by activating the [Reveal] character, he could follow these connections and discover the whereabouts of the Azure Firmament Pearl, or even the Xuantian King himself.

"Mo Rubin cultivates the Innumerable Calamities Undying Demon Heart Immortal Art. His numerous personalities can shift almost at will. Moreover, he is meticulous and extraordinarily cunning."

"But the Xuantian King is his greatest weakness."

Li Fan's figure flickered.

In an instant, he returned to the Xuanhuang Realm and arrived beneath the Dao Lecture Platform.

A massive golden net woven from source power essence continued sealing the sleeping Mo Rubin and the original soul of Ji Yuzhen.

Li Fan did not awaken Ji Yuzhen, the female Dharma King.

Although he had already absorbed most of her memories and undoubtedly understood her better than before, this female Dharma King still gave Li Fan a greater sense of danger than Mo Rubin.

By comparison, Mo Rubin, with whom Li Fan had dealt across several reincarnations, was much easier to control.

With a flick of his finger, the phantom of the Wooden Sword left its sheath. Li Fan brought Mo Rubin with him into the void beyond the Xuanhuang Realm.

He then slowly withdrew the golden net that had imprisoned him.

Exposed to the cold, silent Darkest Star Sea, Mo Rubin instinctively sensed danger and slowly awakened.

Almost the moment he regained consciousness, he noticed Li Fan standing not far away.

"Hm? Before I fell asleep, I should have been..."

Mo Rubin was momentarily bewildered. After thinking briefly, he roughly guessed who was responsible for everything.

"What do you intend to do, Fellow Daoist?"

Mo Rubin sized up Li Fan, his voice filled with vigilance.

A mirror-like boundary hidden within the darkness silently came into existence and locked onto Li Fan.

This was one of the divine abilities contained within the Innumerable Calamities Undying Demon Heart Immortal Art. It could replace the person reflected on the opposite side of the mirror and transform them into another Demon Heart belonging to its user.

As long as someone was enveloped by it, regardless of cultivation level, none could escape.

This confidence came from the Immortal Realm inheritance Mo Rubin had received.

However, he quickly realized something was wrong, and his expression changed slightly.

The mirror had indeed enveloped Li Fan.

Yet on the other side of the mirror, Li Fan's reflection did not exist at all.

It was as though the person before him was merely an illusion that did not exist within the real world.

Yet paradoxically, the vitality radiating openly from Li Fan clearly proved that he was real.

The Transformation of Truth and Falsehood surpassed even the [Creation] True Immortal seal script.

Naturally, it was far beyond anything Mo Rubin could comprehend.

At this moment, the Xuantian Sect Dharma King only knew that he had encountered an extraordinarily troublesome opponent.

After several more attempts still failed to lock onto Li Fan, he decisively gave up.

Without making the slightest sound, he withdrew the mirror boundary divine ability.

"Fellow Daoist Mo, there is no need to be so nervous. If I truly intended to harm you, why would I have awakened you myself?"

"The Innumerable Calamities Undying Demon Heart Immortal Art is not truly undying through all calamities. I know at least three or four methods of breaking it."

Li Fan smiled faintly as he spoke.

These few words struck Mo Rubin like thunder.

The Innumerable Calamities Undying Demon Heart Immortal Art had been personally taught to him by the Xuantian King long ago. Very few people knew of its existence.

Yet Li Fan had revealed its secret with a single sentence.

"Just who exactly are you, Fellow Daoist?"

Mo Rubin asked solemnly.

Li Fan did not answer directly. Instead, he asked, "Fellow Daoist, do you know how long you have been asleep?"

Earlier, Mo Rubin's entire attention had been focused on Li Fan.

Only after Li Fan reminded him did Mo Rubin begin calculating with his fingers. The moment he finished, his body trembled violently.

"Ten thousand years have passed. Everything has long since changed beyond recognition. If Fellow Daoist is interested, allow me to tell you what has happened during these years," Li Fan said sincerely.

Mo Rubin pondered for a moment before nodding.

Thus, Li Fan slowly recounted everything that had happened after the fall of the Xuantian Sect. The Ten Great Immortal Sects rose to replace it, another great calamity erupted, the Xuanhuang Realm was nearly destroyed, the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor rose to prominence, and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association came to jointly rule the world.

Mo Rubin's expression changed repeatedly.

"Those vermin of the Ten Great Immortal Sects truly deserved to die!"

From beginning to end, this was the only sentence he could not restrain himself from uttering. The rest of the time, he listened attentively.

With the acute sensitivity of his Demon Heart Immortal Art to the emotions of those around him, Mo Rubin was eighty percent certain that Li Fan was not lying.

"The people of the Ten Great Immortal Sects inherited the Xuantian Sect's legacy. They also possessed the Grand Mage's true inheritance, so they were not so easily destroyed. Some of them escaped the Xuanhuang Realm before the calamity completely erupted," Li Fan said with a slight shake of his head.

"Escaped?" Mo Rubin narrowed his eyes.

"They did not merely leave the Xuanhuang Realm. They crossed the High Wall and entered the world beyond it!" Li Fan declared firmly.

Mo Rubin reacted more intensely than ever before.

"Beyond the High Wall? Impossible!"

Li Fan had long expected this response.

"Please take a look, Fellow Daoist."

With a casual wave of his hand, the scene of a world-rifting divine sword erupting with boundless radiance, tearing apart heaven and earth before flying into the void, appeared before Mo Rubin.

"This was the scene when the Heavenly Sword Sect forged the World-Rifting Divine Sword and departed the Xuanhuang Realm. Although there is no certainty whether they truly succeeded, with such overwhelming might, surely they were not merely escaping the Xuanhuang Realm?" Li Fan asked.

Mo Rubin stared fixedly at the repeating scene before him.

"This World-Rifting Divine Weapon is nothing more than a mortal artifact. How could it possibly cross the High Wall? What a joke," Mo Rubin insisted.

"The divine weapon was forged from Taiyuan Refined Gold, countless Sword Intent Dao Embryos, and supplemented with innumerable heavenly treasures..." Li Fan said unhurriedly.

Mo Rubin interrupted him.

"Only that? No matter what heavenly treasures you use, as long as they originate from the Xuanhuang Realm, they could never achieve such an effect."

"What if..." Li Fan asked in a deep voice, "a mass of pure immortal spiritual qi was also incorporated into it?"

Mo Rubin suddenly raised his head and stared at Li Fan.

"Immortal spiritual Qi?"

Both his expression and tone had completely changed.

After remaining silent for a long while, Mo Rubin finally spoke softly.

"If the core of that World-Rifting Divine Weapon truly contained immortal spiritual qi, then it would indeed be possible to cross the High Wall by relying on it..."

"Exactly," Li Fan replied meaningfully.

Did the World-Rifting Divine Weapon forged by the Heavenly Sword Sect truly contain immortal spiritual qi?

Li Fan himself did not know.

However, the forging of the divine weapon had been ordered by Mr. Bai.

Mr. Bai had inherited the legacy of the Great Celestial Venerable and had once crossed the High Wall before returning. How could he possibly not know that ordinary mortal materials alone could never cross the High Wall?

If the attempt failed and the divine weapon crashed directly into the High Wall, there would be absolutely no chance of survival.

Given Mr. Bai's character, he would never send people to such meaningless deaths.

Thus, after learning from Sun Tianci in his previous life just how significant the Great Celestial Venerable's legacy truly was, Li Fan gradually formed a conjecture.

Mr. Bai had likely separated a portion of the immortal spiritual qi produced by detonating the immortal artifacts and given it to the Heavenly Sword Sect, allowing them to successfully carry out their plan of escaping beyond the world.

Compared to the remaining four immortal artifacts such as the Great Sun Golden Bell, the amount of immortal spiritual qi produced by detonating the other nine immortal artifacts had indeed been surprisingly small.

Rather than being completely consumed, it seemed more likely that part of it had been diverted elsewhere.

Perhaps that World-Rifting Divine Weapon had carried members of other sects besides the Heavenly Sword Sect as well.

After hearing Li Fan's explanation, Mo Rubin remained silent for a long time before finally cursing.

"Those damned bastards. They only cared about saving themselves and had not the slightest concern for the countless lives of the Xuanhuang Realm."

Mo Rubin naturally had every right to speak such words.

Back then, if the Xuantian King had wished to escape alone with his half-immortal body, it would have been effortless.

Yet precisely because he wanted to bring his homeland, the Xuanhuang Realm, with him, the long Floating Across Starry Sky plan and all the subsequent disasters came into being.

Hearing this, Li Fan smoothly steered the conversation toward the Xuantian King.

"The Xuantian King's character was as pure and noble as the eternal sun itself. There has never been anyone in this world who could stand beside him. Leaving aside the vermin of the Ten Great Immortal Sects, even throughout the ten thousand years that followed, not a single person inherited his will. The only reason the Xuanhuang Realm has survived until today is because its countless living beings have struggled desperately to save themselves."

Li Fan let out a long sigh.

Hearing Li Fan praise the Xuantian King so highly, Mo Rubin's opinion of him gradually began to change.

However, he was still far from lowering his guard.

"To speak honestly, I wish to inherit the Xuantian King's will. I want to save the Xuanhuang Realm from disaster, help it cross the High Wall, and escape this Darkest Star Sea."

"I have exhausted both heart and soul for this cause, sacrificing more than half my life. Yet when my lifespan finally approaches its end and I look back, I discover that within the vast Xuanhuang Realm, there is not a single person whom I can truly trust."

A trace of loneliness filled Li Fan's voice.

Mo Rubin carefully observed him and quickly realized that Li Fan's lifespan was indeed nearly exhausted.

His pupils suddenly contracted.

Li Fan continued.

"By fortunate chance, I discovered the deeds of the ancient heroes of the Xuantian Sect. I was deeply moved and regarded them as kindred spirits."

"I searched everywhere for traces of any survivors among them."

"And in the end, I found you, Fellow Daoist, still sleeping..."

Li Fan looked at Mo Rubin with a relieved smile.

For a moment, countless indescribable emotions surged through Mo Rubin's heart.

However, by nature he was extremely cautious. He forcefully suppressed those emotions and instead began evaluating the credibility of Li Fan's words.

"The affairs of the Xuantian Sect happened more than ten thousand years ago. How do you know all this?" Mo Rubin asked.

"I discovered Ji Yuzhen's shattered divine soul among the endless flowers within a circular mountain valley," Li Fan answered truthfully.

"Although only countless fragments of memory remained, piecing them together was enough to glimpse the past of the Xuantian Sect."

Mo Rubin's expression changed dramatically.

"Ji Yuzhen? She is still alive?"

Li Fan gently shook his head.

"Only a remnant soul remains."

Mo Rubin was about to continue asking, but suddenly stopped himself.

After remaining silent for a while, he looked directly at Li Fan.

"When the Xuantian Sect suffered its great catastrophe, many of my brothers died, many were gravely injured, and we all lost contact with one another."

"There may even have been traitors among us."

"To be honest, aside from the Xuantian King, I trust no one."

Li Fan nodded in understanding.

"In truth, one of the reasons I awakened you was because I hoped to find the Xuantian King through you."

Chapter 1333: The Mystery Of The Xuantian King’S Disappearance

Li Fan spoke with complete sincerity.

"Over the years, in order to find the outstanding heroes of the former Xuantian Sect, I searched from the highest heavens to the deepest underworld. I have practically turned the entire Xuanhuang Realm upside down. I was fortunate enough to discover traces left behind by several Dharma Kings, but I have never found even the slightest clue regarding the Xuantian King. Yet I refuse to believe that, with the Xuantian King's unparalleled cultivation back then, he truly perished..."

Mo Rubin listened quietly, his expression remaining completely unchanged.

"After tens of thousands of years, the situation in the Xuanhuang Realm has become increasingly perilous. It now stands only a single step away from falling into the Immortal Ruins. Had it not been for the many arrangements the Xuantian King left behind back then, the world would never have endured until today."

"The arrangements from back then?" Mo Rubin narrowed his eyes.

"Precisely. The Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation!" Li Fan sighed with deep emotion. "Built upon an ancient immortal formation, it manifests power approaching the immortal level through mortal means. It is just a pity that the formation has long since become incomplete."

Li Fan's expression turned solemn.

"Restarting the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation may be the only way to save the world. This formation is unimaginably profound. Even though it was constructed ten thousand years ago, I still cannot comprehend it."

Mo Rubin let out a cold snort.

"Naturally. It is an inheritance from the Immortal Realm. How could mortal cultivators possibly glimpse its mysteries?"

Li Fan nodded in agreement.

"First, the Ten Great Immortal Sects collectively fled. Then came ten thousand years of slaughter and calamity. Countless inheritances have already been severed. Compared to ten thousand years ago, the standards of formations, artifacts, alchemy, and talismans in today's Xuanhuang Realm have not only failed to improve, they have actually declined greatly."

"If we wish to reconstruct and restore the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation, then finding the Xuantian King is our only hope. But just as I said before, there is not the slightest clue. My lifespan is nearly exhausted. I truly cannot wait any longer. Left with no other choice, I could only awaken you."

Looking at Mo Rubin's contemplative expression, Li Fan continued in a deep voice.

"From the memories within Ji Yuzhen's remnant soul, I also learned of the traitors who existed within the Xuantian Sect back then. Therefore, making this decision required tremendous resolve. I feared entrusting the matter to the wrong person and bringing disaster upon the Xuantian King. That is why I deliberately chose to awaken you here, far away from the Xuanhuang Realm, out in the void."

"During the siege of the Xuantian Sect by the Ten Great Immortal Sects, where exactly were you? According to Dharma King Ji's memories, you never left the Xuantian King's side."

Li Fan's tone gradually became stern.

Seeing that this cultivator from a later age had begun questioning him instead, Mo Rubin showed no anger.

He frowned slightly as memories of the past resurfaced, as though he had returned to the day that changed the fate of the Xuanhuang Realm.

"At that time, I was leading the core cultivators of the Ten Great Immortal Sects into the deepest part of the sect."

Mo Rubin's words were astonishing.

Li Fan's eyebrows twitched, but instead of becoming excited immediately, he quietly waited for him to continue.

Somewhat surprised by Li Fan's composure, Mo Rubin nodded slightly before continuing.

"At that time, Brother Xuanyuan had already realized there were people within the sect whose intentions were impure. They planned to collude with the Ten Great Immortal Sects and carry out treachery."

"Brother Xuanyuan happened to be on the verge of a breakthrough then. Therefore, he decided to play along with their scheme and lure the snake from its hole."

Mo Rubin paused and took a deep breath.

"The plan was originally progressing very smoothly. I successfully gained the trust of the Ten Great Immortal Sects and secretly guided them through the defensive restrictions protecting the headquarters of the Xuantian Sect."

A trace of regret flashed across Mo Rubin's eyes.

"However, those restrictions were originally only meant to delay them. The true killing move was Brother Xuanyuan's strength after his breakthrough, along with the killing formation he personally arranged. Dispelling the restrictions in advance would only lower their guard. What none of us expected..."

"Run!"

The Xuantian King's final transmission echoed once more in his ears.

Mo Rubin unconsciously clenched his fists.

"When I heard Brother Xuanyuan telling me to flee, I knew something unexpected had happened. I immediately accelerated toward the place where his aura had disappeared."

"It was neither our agreed ambush location nor the place where Brother Xuanyuan usually cultivated in seclusion. It was merely the great hall containing the Faceless Immortal statue. Brother Xuanyuan had previously ordered that place sealed away. I have no idea why he appeared there again."

"When I arrived first, Brother Xuanyuan had already disappeared completely. As for that statue..."

Mo Rubin suddenly fell silent.

After hearing Mo Rubin's account, Li Fan's heart trembled violently.

Even so, he deliberately acted as though he knew nothing.

"The Faceless Immortal statue? What is that? Why was it sealed away by the Xuantian Sect? After the Ten Great Immortal Sects unified the Xuanhuang Realm, they erased nearly everything related to the former Xuantian Sect. Even Dharma King Ji's remaining memories seem to contain no trace of this Faceless Immortal statue."

Mo Rubin looked up at Li Fan.

After pondering for a moment, he finally explained.

"The Faceless Immortal was a True Immortal who once saved Brother Xuanyuan's life. When Brother Xuanyuan first arrived in the Immortal Realm, he had not yet condensed his True Immortal body when disaster suddenly struck. Had that Faceless True Immortal not casually lent him a hand, he would probably have perished in the Immortal Realm back then."

Li Fan nodded slowly before asking with obvious confusion.

"In that case, this Faceless True Immortal sounds like a good person. Why then did the Xuantian Sect later order the statue sealed away? It seems they became highly wary of him."

Mo Rubin let out a cold snort.

"A good person? He was not some ordinary person. He was a genuine True Immortal. The same matter appears completely different from the perspectives of mortal cultivators and True Immortals."

"At first, Brother Xuanyuan erected the statue of the Faceless Immortal for two reasons. First, to express his gratitude for saving his life. Second, he hoped to establish contact with this True Immortal whom he had met only briefly."

"If he could obtain the assistance of this senior True Immortal, saving the Xuanhuang Realm would surely become much easier."

As he spoke, Mo Rubin's expression gradually darkened.

"However, Brother Xuanyuan soon realized he was wrong. The attitude True Immortals hold toward mortal beings can only be described as utter indifference."

"The Faceless Immortal casually saved Brother Xuanyuan because Brother Xuanyuan had already stepped onto the immortal path. Although he had not yet condensed his True Immortal body, he was already a genuine Half-Immortal."

"He was one of their own."

"But toward mortal beings... even if it meant saving every living creature in an entire world, even if it required only the slightest effort, the Faceless Immortal was neither willing nor interested in doing so."

Mo Rubin spoke with deep resentment.

"He even turned around and tried to persuade and warn Brother Xuanyuan..."

Mo Rubin's hatred was obvious.

Li Fan narrowed his eyes and deliberately breathed more heavily, pretending to be filled with righteous indignation.

"The gulf between immortals and mortals is as vast as heaven and earth. But regardless, did not immortals themselves ascend from mortal cultivators? To stand by and refuse to save them, to be so utterly indifferent..."

Mo Rubin continued.

"As the saying goes, those who follow different paths cannot work together. After their disagreement, Brother Xuanyuan severed all contact with that True Immortal and sealed away the statue. He even planned to remake all the Xuantian statues throughout the world."

"But before he could do so, the great catastrophe had already arrived."

"From what you have said, it seems very likely that the Xuantian King encountered disaster at the hands of the Faceless Immortal?"

Li Fan's face filled with shock.

"If a True Immortal personally intervened, then even with the Xuantian King's unmatched talent, he would probably have had no chance of survival. No wonder I have searched for so many years without finding even the slightest trace of him..."

Li Fan deliberately put on an expression of sudden realization, followed by one of complete despair.

Mo Rubin frowned and interrupted Li Fan's muttering.

"The Faceless Immortal may have had some differences in philosophy with Big Brother Xuanyuan, but there was no reason for him to strike with lethal intent."

"Moreover, although a True Immortal is powerful, it is absolutely impossible for one to instantly kill Big Brother Xuanyuan," Mo Rubin said with certainty.

"Big Brother Xuanyuan was already a Half-Immortal who had ascended to the Immortal Realm. Before carrying out the plan to lure the snake from its hole, he told us that after his battle with the Grand Mage, he had broken through once again. Even if he had not yet become a true Immortal in the strict sense, he already possessed enough power to cross the High Wall on his own."

Li Fan's heart shook once more.

"Then what exactly was it that caused the further advanced Xuantian King to vanish without a trace?"

Although he spoke those words aloud, another scene involuntarily surfaced in his mind.

In his previous life, at the very end, Cat Treasure had suddenly leaped out, swallowed the phantom of the True Immortal in a single bite, and then instantly carried away the True Immortal from the Immortal Ruins.

The two situations were astonishingly similar.

"Could there actually be some connection between them?"

"But Xuantian's accident happened ten thousand years ago. Combined with my earlier speculation that time may flow differently inside and outside the High Wall, if those outside the wall were truly responsible, then from their perspective this may have happened a hundred thousand, or even a million years ago..."

Li Fan felt something about the idea did not quite fit.

"However, viewed this way, the methods used by the forces outside the wall to hunt True Immortals have indeed advanced tremendously. Xuantian King was not a genuine True Immortal, yet after suffering misfortune he still had enough time to send out a warning. But the one in the Immortal Ruins was already a True Immortal of the Immortal Realm itself. After comprehending the Dao within the Immortal Ruins for ten thousand years, he may even have approached the realm of the Nameless True Immortal. Yet his fate was even worse."

A chill of horror rose within Li Fan's heart.

Faced with Li Fan's question, Mo Rubin could only remain silent.

If he knew the answer himself, then while being hunted by the Ten Great Immortal Sects, he would not have been so terrified and lost, as though he had lost his pillar of support.

"Although I do not know what terrifying existence caused Big Brother Xuanyuan's disappearance, I am certain that he is still alive in this world."

After a long silence, Mo Rubin spoke with absolute conviction.

"Oh?"

Li Fan raised an eyebrow, unable to understand where Mo Rubin's confidence came from.

After carefully considering his words, Mo Rubin continued.

"When Big Brother Xuanyuan disappeared back then, by the time I arrived at the scene, the great hall that housed the statue of the Faceless Immortal had already been destroyed."

"And that statue of the Faceless Immortal..."

"It had actually grown a face."

"The stone statue had fallen to the ground. Its head had been severed by a strike through the air and rolled off to one side. Yet the face on that lonely stone head was identical to Big Brother Xuanyuan's."

Mo Rubin revealed something that left Li Fan utterly stunned.

The image of that scene unconsciously appeared in Li Fan's mind.

"This..."

"What exactly happened?"

Surrounded by layers of mystery, Li Fan was thoroughly bewildered.

Mo Rubin said in a deep voice, "At first, all of us believed that the Faceless Immortal had harmed Xuantian King. But later, during our days on the run, I gradually felt that something was wrong. The reason is exactly what I mentioned before."

"Later, I took the risk of finding the remaining Xuantian statue. I tried once more to contact the Faceless Immortal using the method that Big Brother Xuanyuan had taught us."

Li Fan drew in a sharp breath.

"Fellow Daoist, your actions truly placed your life and death completely aside."

Ignoring Li Fan's praise, Mo Rubin continued.

"True Immortals generally do not concern themselves with insignificant mortals like us. As expected, my first attempt at communication received no response."

"But I did not give up. I continued without interruption for a full three years, attempting to contact him every single moment."

The moment he heard this, Li Fan immediately understood what Mo Rubin meant.

"Even if a True Immortal disdains paying attention to ants, if those ants constantly buzz beside them, the True Immortal would surely become enraged and punish them. Based on my understanding of the Faceless Immortal, he certainly possesses such power."

"But he did nothing."

"It was as though that statue was nothing more than an ordinary stone statue. For three whole years, there was not the slightest response."

"So I concluded that after that day, it was not only Xuantian King. Even that Faceless Immortal had suffered severe injuries."

"As for why the Faceless Immortal's statue mysteriously manifested Big Brother Xuanyuan's face, and even had its head severed..."

Li Fan could hardly believe his own words as he continued.

"Could it be that the Faceless Immortal intervened and helped Xuantian King survive that disaster?"

Mo Rubin nodded.

"That is also why I have always been convinced that Big Brother Xuanyuan is still alive. Although they followed different Dao paths, from what Big Brother Xuanyuan once revealed between the lines, he and the Faceless Immortal actually got along quite well."

"And besides, they were of the same kind. Since there had already been one precedent of him lending a hand, saving him once more would not be impossible."

Li Fan remained silent for a long time.

Only after a great while did he shake his head.

"That is merely your speculation."

"I originally believed that the one who harmed Xuantian King back then was, at most, another Half-Immortal. But if a True Immortal, or even an existence beyond that, made the move, then Xuantian King's chances of surviving would be far too small."

Li Fan sounded somewhat discouraged.

"Speculation alone is simply not enough to convince anyone."

Seeing this, Mo Rubin hesitated for a long time before finally adding in a deep voice.

"It is not merely baseless speculation. The connection between Big Brother Xuanyuan and me, one that exists beyond explanation, tells me that he is still alive."

Mo Rubin spoke only vaguely, deliberately keeping the matter obscure.

Li Fan wanted to press for more details, but Mo Rubin refused to say another word.

"The Azure Firmament Pearl?"

Li Fan could not help making the guess inwardly.

"Very well. Since you are this certain, then I will believe you this once."

Realizing he could extract no more information, Li Fan pretended to ponder for a long time before finally relaxing.

"In any case, I do not have many days left to live. This will simply be my final gamble."

"Judging from your conduct, Fellow Daoist, you are certainly not one of the traitors of the former Xuantian Sect. Perhaps we can cooperate and search for Xuantian King's whereabouts together."

Li Fan fixed his blazing gaze upon Mo Rubin.

"Fellow Daoist knows a great deal about Xuantian King, but you are unfamiliar with today's Xuanhuang Realm. Ten thousand years have passed. Seas have become mulberry fields. The arrangements left behind by the Xuantian Sect may have disappeared along with the changing landscape."

"On the other hand, I have already searched every corner of the Xuanhuang Realm over the years. I can directly lead you to the places most worthy of investigation, greatly increasing the efficiency of our search."

"Furthermore, the remnants of the Ten Great Immortal Sects still exist today. They have become the Five Elders Association and control half of the Xuanhuang Realm. Without my cooperation, even with your considerable strength, you will inevitably encounter many difficulties."

Chapter 1334: The Revival Of True Immortal You

Faced with Li Fan's proposal, Mo Rubin did not answer immediately. Instead, he remained silent for a long while, deep in thought.

His gaze rested on Li Fan's graying hair. Perhaps because Li Fan's words were sincere, and because he truly did not have long to live, Mo Rubin finally nodded.

"There is no reason not to."

Li Fan nodded in delight.

"Excellent! With your assistance, Daoist Brother, our efforts will yield twice the results with half the effort."

"In that case, let us first return to the Xuanhuang Realm."

The phantom of the Wooden Sword left its sheath. Li Fan extended his hand, inviting Mo Rubin inside.

At first, Mo Rubin paid it little attention. But after personally entering the phantom's protective range and experiencing its unbelievable speed, his expression finally changed.

The way he looked at Li Fan became noticeably different.

Then, after witnessing with his own eyes how the phantom's protection allowed them to completely ignore the attraction of the Immortal Ruins and descend safely into the Xuanhuang Realm, Mo Rubin could no longer hold back.

"It seems that Fellow Daoist is truly one of the greatest figures of this age."

Li Fan smiled bitterly and shook his head.

"I may stand unrivaled in this era, but I cannot suppress all ages. Besides, no matter how many divine abilities one possesses, lifespan still comes to an end. This divine ability is ultimately inferior to the decree of heaven."

Mo Rubin opened his mouth as if to reply, but ultimately remained silent.

The two had already descended into the Xuanhuang Realm. Mo Rubin silently swept his divine sense across the world. When he saw that the territories had expanded countless times over, along with the towering White Mist Barrier stretching across heaven and earth, even this well-traveled Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect could not suppress the astonishment in his eyes.

After a long while, he sighed.

"If I could not still sense the lingering traces of the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation, I would never have believed that this magnificent world before me was once the ancient Xuanhuang Realm."

"In merely ten thousand years, the world has changed to such an extent."

Li Fan nodded.

"When the world approaches destruction, all changes occur hundreds or even thousands of times faster than usual. I have watched these transformations. They come as swiftly as thunder and as rapidly as light. This is the Heavenly Dao saving itself."

As he spoke, Li Fan casually cast an illusion.

Within the sphere of light, the Xuanhuang Realm was turned upside down. Yin and Yang fell into disorder. The stars dimmed. Mountains trembled. Vegetation withered. Birds and beasts fled in panic. It was the very image of the apocalypse.

At the moment of life and death, the Xuanhuang Realm had indeed produced countless instinctive transformations. Frozen extinction, thermal silence, the reversal of time, heavenly punishment, world annihilation.

Mo Rubin was momentarily left completely spellbound.

At the crucial moment, Li Fan gave a light cough and withdrew the illusion.

A profound sense of loss immediately arose in Mo Rubin's heart.

He vaguely sensed that the vision within the sphere truly concealed the principles behind the evolution of heaven and earth. To any cultivator, it would be an unimaginable treasure.

Unfortunately, Li Fan had displayed it for too short a time. Mo Rubin had not been able to comprehend much.

Moreover, as a Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect and an ancient predecessor who had awakened within the Xuanhuang Realm, his pride prevented him from shamelessly asking Li Fan to demonstrate it again.

"Perhaps after we successfully find Big Brother Xuanyuan and become more familiar with each other..." Mo Rubin thought to himself.

"Of course, the reason the Xuanhuang Realm has become what it is today is not solely because of the changes in the Heavenly Dao itself. The Immortal Ancestor has also secretly intervened."

Li Fan continued truthfully.

"The Immortal Ancestor is very likely one of the Venerables from the former Heavenly Law Realm. After the Heavenly Law Realm perished, he intends to use the Xuanhuang Realm, the only cultivation world still surviving in the star sea, as a borrowed corpse through which to revive."

"The Immortal Ancestor has comprehended the Dao within the star sea for thousands of years. His strength is unfathomable and may already have reached the absolute limit of the mortal realm. I am not his opponent."

"We must proceed cautiously and remain vigilant against him. Any existence that might threaten his revival of the Heavenly Law Realm is something he will never tolerate."

Li Fan sighed as he offered his sincere advice.

"This Immortal Ancestor is actually not a bad person. Unfortunately, he is destined to stand in opposition to the Xuanhuang Realm."

As Mo Rubin observed the fragments of other worlds embedded throughout the Xuanhuang Realm, clearly out of place, he became increasingly convinced by Li Fan's words.

"What a pity..."

In truth, Mo Rubin had held a certain degree of admiration for the man who was said to have destroyed the Ten Great Immortal Sects.

However, after witnessing the present state of the Xuanhuang Realm being dismantled and reconstructed, and after listening to Li Fan's explanation, that already faint goodwill completely vanished.

"Rest assured. We will keep a low profile. Before we find Big Brother Xuanyuan, we will not come into conflict with the Immortal Ancestor."

Mo Rubin continuously scanned heaven and earth, as though searching for traces of something.

After a long while, he frowned.

"It seems the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation really was severely damaged. I can only sense its faint residual aura. Manipulating it is impossible."

"Partly because countless ages have passed, and partly because during the era when the Ten Great Immortal Sects used the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation to capture other cultivation worlds, they fought battle after battle. The formation became increasingly damaged, yet the cultivators of the Ten Great Immortal Sects lacked the ability to repair it. In the end, the formation was completely ruined."

Li Fan spoke slowly.

"At least, according to my investigation, that is what happened."

Seeing the sharp light that flashed through Mo Rubin's eyes, Li Fan shrugged and answered frankly.

"How could those fools from the Ten Great Immortal Sects possibly know how to operate the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation? Unless..."

A terrifying aura suddenly erupted from Mo Rubin.

Li Fan subtly stepped back and agreed.

"Then it must have been one of the Dharma Kings who betrayed the sect and revealed the method of controlling it to the Ten Great Immortal Sects."

Mo Rubin frowned deeply, yet did not respond.

Only after a long silence did he shake his head.

"Not necessarily. Perhaps they were captured by the Ten Great Immortal Sects and forced to reveal it under torture."

Hearing this, Li Fan could not help but feel somewhat surprised by Mo Rubin's attitude.

After all, Li Fan knew that the Xuantian King had entrusted the control methods of each subordinate formation within the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation to different Dharma Kings in case of unforeseen circumstances.

Mo Rubin was responsible for the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation, namely the Dark Sea.

Ji Yuzhen was responsible for the Soaring Golden Chains.

Perhaps sensing Li Fan's thoughts, Mo Rubin explained why he had spoken in their defense.

"Back then, Big Brother Xuanyuan once told me that the ones responsible for the Star Locking Golden Chains were Ji Yuzhen and Luo Yichen."

"Among the twelve Dharma Kings, anyone else might have betrayed us. Only those two never would."

Li Fan became thoughtful.

"Within Dharma King Ji's memories, she deeply loved the Xuantian King. As for Luo Yichen..."

Mo Rubin nodded.

"That is correct. After she fell in love with Big Brother Xuanyuan, Luo personally killed all of her countless male companions. From that day onward, she devoted herself entirely to him alone."

Li Fan shook his head even harder.

"The Xuantian King entrusted the same responsibility to those two women. That was truly an unwise decision."

Mo Rubin chuckled.

"Fellow Daoist is overthinking it. The two of them were actually very close to one another."

Li Fan offered no further explanation.

While chatting, the two had already decided where they would first search for traces of the Xuantian King.

Their destination was the Dark Sea.

The journey was almost identical to the one from the previous life. After overcoming many obstacles, with Li Fan pretending to be filled with shock and astonishment along the way, the two finally arrived at the core of the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation.

They were first horrified by the True Immortal corpse lying in the depths of the Dark Sea, as well as the faintly reawakening survival instinct of the True Immortal that had been stirred.

After regaining his composure, Mo Rubin was slightly startled.

"Hm? It seems someone came here not long ago."

Li Fan was inwardly alarmed. He had not expected that despite taking every precaution to erase his traces during his previous visit, Mo Rubin would still detect them.

However, although surprised, he remained calm. Instead, a trace of delight appeared on his face as he hurriedly asked, "Was it the Xuantian King?"

Mo Rubin did not suspect the person beside him.

After all, this place was sealed by the fortuitous immortal formation, the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation. It was not somewhere an ordinary cultivator could force their way into.

"Someone definitely entered this place before us. Although they never reached the very core where the True Immortal corpse lies..."

"One of the cultivators from the Ten Great Immortal Sects died here. They were probably lured inside and then killed by the True Immortal's survival instinct."

"Could it have been Elder Cui?"

The Elder Cui he referred to was Cui Zhiyuan, the other Dharma King who jointly controlled the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation alongside him.

Although he guessed as much, after examining the traces left by the formation's activation once more, Mo Rubin felt something was not quite right.

"It does not look like the formation's restrictions were activated directly. It seems someone forcibly broke through without damaging the immortal formation itself. They overcame technique with sheer power."

"And afterward, they even improved the formation, sealing away the True Immortal's will while preventing outsiders from entering."

Mo Rubin pondered for a long time but could not determine the intruder's identity.

Li Fan naturally noticed his confusion, yet he did not kindly reveal what the Immortal Ancestor had done all those years ago.

Mo Rubin wrestled with the matter for quite some time before finally deciding to set it aside. His first priority was searching the Dark Sea for traces of the Xuantian King.

The core of the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation, shaped like a circular observation chamber, suddenly lit up within the Dark Sea. Countless nearly imperceptible ripples spread outward from it, rapidly sweeping through the endless darkness.

Only after quite some time did Li Fan sense those ripples returning.

Mo Rubin silently waited for the complete search results.

The conclusion was obvious.

The Xuantian King was not within this Dark Sea.

Seeing Mo Rubin frown once again, Li Fan comforted him.

"Then let us head to the next place."

Mo Rubin shook his head.

"I never expected we would find Brother Xuanyuan so easily."

"I simply feel that something is wrong with this Dark Sea."

Li Fan's heart stirred.

"What do you mean?"

"The Dark Sea was formed upon the corpse of a True Immortal. Although the True Immortal has completely perished, it was still a True Immortal. Its methods far surpass anything we mortal cultivators can imagine."

"For example, that spontaneous survival instinct which manifested after sensing living beings entering."

"The power of darkness accumulated here has undergone subtle changes compared to before."

Mo Rubin's expression became rather solemn.

Following his gaze, Li Fan looked toward the endless darkness.

Mo Rubin continued in a deep voice.

"The True Immortal has died, leaving the power of darkness without a master. Yet this power was born from the True Immortal's corpse. It would have remained dormant indefinitely, but a trace of the True Immortal's survival instinct was awakened."

"Perhaps under the influence of that survival instinct, the power of darkness has begun to change."

Li Fan deliberately appeared deeply shaken.

"A True Immortal possesses such terrifying power? What exactly do you mean by the changes in this power of darkness?"

Mo Rubin replied, "It is still difficult to determine. But one thing is certain. Everything is evolving in a direction favorable to the revival of the True Immortal. Even if resurrection ultimately fails, that tendency will certainly remain."

"Do you remember the corpses we saw on the way here? Their life essence had been completely drained, becoming nourishment for the revival of the True Immortal. If this Dark Sea senses lifeforms useful for that revival, it may launch the same kind of attack."

"Fortunately, after being transformed by the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation, the influence of the True Immortal's corpse upon the power of darkness is much weaker than the influence of the True Immortal's will."

"So the situation is not yet as bad as I feared."

Li Fan nodded in agreement.

"The energy accumulated within this Dark Sea is already so vast. If it were ever to erupt, it could probably engulf the entire Xuanhuang Realm in an instant and turn it into nourishment for the True Immortal's resurrection."

Mo Rubin gazed deeply into the Dark Sea before nodding.

"If left unchecked, that day may truly come."

Li Fan asked curiously, "If, and I mean only if, the entire Xuanhuang Realm were used as nourishment, would it truly be enough to revive this immortal corpse?"

Mo Rubin turned toward Li Fan and remained silent for a long while.

There was not the slightest malice in Li Fan's eyes.

Only pure curiosity toward the unknown.

After contemplating for some time, Mo Rubin answered, "Judging purely by the amount of energy involved, the present Xuanhuang Realm should indeed be enough. After all, it has absorbed so many cultivation worlds, even if they were only shattered remnants after world destruction."

"The life within those worlds has perished, but their origins still remain."

"But even if resurrection succeeds, it would only be an empty shell, a walking corpse. Its true consciousness would no longer exist."

Li Fan slowly nodded.

"Even the body of a True Immortal is an extraordinary existence. If someone could possess it, would they not, in a sense, become a True Immortal in this age?"

Mo Rubin merely smiled at Li Fan's fanciful speculation and did not take it seriously.

After finding nothing within the Dark Sea, the two prepared to travel to their second destination, the Eye of the Heavenly Beast.

"The Eye of the Heavenly Beast can not only observe the star sea, but also monitor the Xuanhuang Realm. It exists independently outside the Xuanhuang Realm, connected only through an incomprehensible mystical link."

"If the Heavenly Beast were still alive, we could travel there directly. But now that it died in battle, reaching it will require considerably more effort."

Mo Rubin explained.

He then brought Li Fan to Nine Mountains Prefecture.

Looking at the nine enormous mountain ranges stretching endlessly across heaven and earth, a trace of sorrow flashed through Mo Rubin's eyes.

Just as in the previous life, they eventually found the White Jade Banner Pole of an immortal artifact within the underground ruins.

"This is..."

"An immortal artifact?"

Li Fan deliberately acted extremely shocked.

Mo Rubin remained unconcerned.

"Its immortal spiritual power has long since been exhausted. Only the shell of the immortal artifact remains."

"But using it to reach the Eye of the Heavenly Beast will not be difficult."

With the White Jade Banner Pole as the central core, Mo Rubin began arranging the formation.

"During my search for the Xuantian King, I also discovered fragments of several immortal artifacts."

"They were all like this White Jade Banner Pole, completely drained of immortal spiritual power. Some had even suffered unimaginably great catastrophes, shattered beyond recognition."

Li Fan sighed as he asked, "What kind of catastrophe did the Xuantian King witness in the Immortal Realm back then? Even the Immortal Realm itself could not escape destruction?"

Mo Rubin's hands paused slightly as he prepared the formation, as though he had fallen into memories.

At that moment, silence filled the air.
