Chapter 1335: The Dao Annihilation Calamity Of The Immortal Realm

"As for this question, it was not just you and me. In fact, throughout the ancient Xuanhuang Realm, everyone who knew that Big Brother Xuanyuan had ascended to the Immortal Realm and later returned was incomparably curious," Mo Rubin said with deep emotion.

"However, no matter what methods they used to investigate, Big Brother Xuanyuan never revealed any details. He merely glossed over it by saying that the Immortal Realm had suffered a terrifyingly great catastrophe."

"He did not even tell us, his fellow Dharma Kings, nor Ji Yuzhen, the person he trusted most."

"Only after Big Brother Xuanyuan successfully broke through and decided to carry out the plan to lure the snake out of its hole did he casually mention a few things about the great calamity of the Immortal Realm."

"He referred to it as the Dao Annihilation Calamity. Although he never described the specific scenes of the calamity to us, merely hearing those two words was enough to make one's blood run cold. All of us Dharma Kings saw the flash of fear that passed through Big Brother Xuanyuan's eyes..."

"Dao Annihilation." Li Fan silently repeated the two words. As he carefully pondered them, an uncontrollable chill gradually rose within his heart.

He recalled the memories he had previously glimpsed within the flesh of the True Immortal.

Broken fragments of a voice echoed from the towering figure standing above the True Immortal.

"Qionglang Star Domain... annihilation... garrison..."

Li Fan fell into thought.

"This word, Annihilation, should refer to the Dao Annihilation Calamity. The Qionglang Star Domain encountered this disaster, requiring True Immortals to be dispatched to defend it, or perhaps to defend other star domains in advance."

He silently speculated.

"As expected, the calamity that destroyed the Immortal Realm showed warning signs long beforehand. The Immortal Realm must have attempted countless methods of self salvation, yet in the end they were still unable to stop the spread of the Dao Annihilation Calamity."

A new question arose in Li Fan's mind.

Did the Dao Annihilation Calamity exist only within the Immortal Realm?

After the destruction of the Immortal Realm, did it disappear forever?

Or would it one day reappear within the Lower Realm Star Sea?

What connection did the Dao Annihilation Calamity have with the Obliterating Wind Calamity that Li Fan had witnessed within the Boundless Mirror and the ruins of the First Origin Sect?

The power of the True Immortal seal script had run rampant across the Star Sea, bringing catastrophic destruction to an enormous region. The starlight dimmed, transforming it into the Darkest Star Sea.

However...

Life itself had not been completely extinguished.

Not to mention the still flourishing Xuanhuang Realm, even the seemingly lifeless Darkest Star Sea still retained the lingering consciousness of the Star Sea itself. As time continued to flow, its eventual revival was almost inevitable.

"The destruction suffered by the Darkest Star Sea is probably not even on the same level as the Dao Annihilation Calamity."

The word "Annihilation" allowed Li Fan to envision everything, all existence itself, being completely erased beneath the calamity.

"I'm afraid not even fragments of worlds would remain."

A shiver ran through Li Fan's heart.

Just then, while Li Fan was lost in thought, Mo Rubin continued.

"Big Brother Xuanyuan once instructed us that the details of this Immortal Realm calamity were something we should know as little about as possible. The more we knew, the more harmful it would be."

"He even warned us not to dwell upon its name whenever possible. Because it might seize that opportunity to become a nightmare heart demon. Even if we have never witnessed its true form, it can still exploit weaknesses in our minds."

"He only told us the name, Dao Annihilation, so that we would possess the most basic awareness to guard against it."

Mo Rubin's expression became solemn.

"If you do not know its name, then even if you encounter it face to face, you will not understand the true nature of the calamity. But if you know its name, then even the first time you glimpse the slightest trace of it, you will instinctively recognize it."

"In truth, Big Brother Xuanyuan encountered this world destroying calamity immediately after arriving in the Immortal Realm. Everything he later learned about the Dao Annihilation Calamity came from his conversations with the Faceless Immortal."

"Enough. We should not speak of this any further."

Mo Rubin abruptly ended the topic.

While they had been speaking, the White Jade Banner Pole formation had already finished its preparations.

With a solemn expression, Mo Rubin formed hand seals.

The White Jade Banner Pole rose into the air, releasing rings of light that enveloped the two of them.

"Let's go."

It resembled Li Fan's Wooden Sword phantom somewhat.

The White Jade Banner Pole pointed toward the heavens, constantly adjusting its direction.

Then countless tiny specks of white light emerged from the pole itself. After gathering power for several breaths, it shot toward the sky with Li Fan and Mo Rubin.

Although it was somewhat slower than Li Fan's Sword Shadow Divine Ability, the unstoppable, razor sharp will to pierce through all obstacles that surrounded it was something Li Fan's divine ability did not possess.

The pillar of light produced during its flight was extremely thin.

Furthermore, not the slightest trace of energy leaked outward, preventing the cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm from noticing it.

Standing within the banner pole, Li Fan watched the scenery of the Xuanhuang Realm rapidly retreat behind him.

Even the attractive force of the Immortal Ruins merely slowed their speed slightly.

Meanwhile, Mo Rubin remained completely focused on controlling the banner pole, occasionally steering around regions where the residual power of True Immortals had gathered.

After calculating that the White Jade Banner Pole would not collide with the basin filled with residual True Immortal power, Li Fan quietly waited for their destination.

After flying through the starry sky for roughly the time it took to burn one stick of incense, the White Jade Banner Pole suddenly came to a halt.

Its light dispersed, forming a bubble that completely enclosed the two of them.

Moments later, it slammed directly into an invisible barrier hidden within the void.

The bubble of white light perfectly absorbed the impact, dissolving the tremendous collision.

Li Fan and Mo Rubin arrived within the Eye of the Heavenly Beast.

"Ah!"

A scream immediately echoed throughout the small space.

It did not come from Li Fan or Mo Rubin.

Instead, it came from Han Zhong, the cultivator Li Fan had previously encountered, the one who had accidentally entered the Eye of the Heavenly Beast after making a mistake while activating a teleportation formation in Nine Mountains Province.

Having been trapped here for so long, Han Zhong had long since abandoned all hope of escaping.

Only his instinct to survive had allowed him to endure until now.

Upon seeing other living people, he first let out an excited roar.

Just as he was about to say something else...

Mo Rubin's expression suddenly changed.

Without hesitation, he fired a streak of black light that struck Han Zhong directly.

Han Zhong's eyes were filled with disbelief.

Without understanding what had happened, he was reduced to ashes and completely annihilated.

"Fellow Daoist, you..." Li Fan pretended to be completely stunned.

Mo Rubin first carefully inspected the surroundings, making absolutely certain that not even a fragment of Han Zhong remained. Only then did he explain.

"Although I have no idea why that cultivator appeared here, he had already been contaminated."

"If we made contact with him recklessly, there is a very high chance we would become infected as well. It is better to eliminate the danger before anything happens."

Li Fan's expression relaxed somewhat, though he still appeared puzzled.

"Contaminated?"

While observing the surroundings, Mo Rubin replied, "It is an extremely troublesome illness. Even for Big Brother Xuanyuan, resolving it was exceedingly difficult."

"It should be related to the calamity that struck the Immortal Realm back then."

"Fortunately, under normal circumstances, it is extremely difficult to encounter within the Star Sea. This is the Eye of the Heavenly Beast, however, so the probability of contamination is much higher."

"The concentration of this illness throughout the Lower Realm Star Sea is extremely low. It was already like this ten thousand years ago. During our journey through the Star Sea just now, I deliberately checked again. It appears nothing has changed."

"However, the Eye of the Heavenly Beast observes an incomparably vast expanse of star domains. Once the scale expands beyond a certain limit, no matter how low the concentration may be, it will inevitably become apparent."

As he spoke, Mo Rubin set up several layers of restrictions throughout the surrounding area.

They appeared to be specifically designed to guard against this strange affliction of the void.

Li Fan carefully pondered the meaning behind Mo Rubin's words.

"So this illness becomes more likely to spread as the area of observation expands. Does that mean merely observing it is enough to become infected?" Li Fan asked, inwardly startled.

Mo Rubin nodded.

"Exactly. That is why I killed him immediately without any hesitation. Fortunately, the chance of this illness spreading through ordinary means is quite low. I have already checked, and it has not spread any further. This place is safe for now."

"Such a bizarre method of transmission, and it is even connected to the Immortal Calamity of the upper realm..." Li Fan appeared somewhat worried.

"What happens after someone is infected? That trapped cultivator just now did not seem to display anything unusual."

Mo Rubin cast several more restriction seals.

The transparent bubble that had been tightly wrapped around them, barely large enough to hold two or three people, slowly expanded as if it were being inflated.

"The reason there were no abnormalities is because the illness was still dormant within his body and had not yet erupted. You would only understand its true horror after coming into contact with it. It reduces the upper limit of one's divine soul and even the upper limit of one's life essence. The severity of that reduction increases as the infection worsens. Eventually, although the victim does not die, they become as fragile as a paper figure."

"Even an ordinary breeze would be enough to scatter both soul and body. Of course, before reaching that point, they must first endure all the suffering caused by the continual reduction of their life essence."

Mo Rubin sighed softly.

"Just imagine it. Another person's quiet whisper would sound like deafening thunder in your ears, shaking your divine soul until it aches and tears apart. An accidental touch from someone else would feel like a devastating blow, leaving your flesh mangled and bloody."

"The normal world would become, in your eyes, an endless apocalypse where horrifying disasters unfold every moment. By then, death might actually become a form of release."

"But because this illness exists to sustain its own spread, it will actually keep its host alive until their life essence has been reduced to its absolute limit. One cannot live, yet cannot die either..." Mo Rubin slowly shook his head.

"So this illness is truly troublesome," Li Fan said.

However, what surfaced in his mind was the scene from years ago, when the Heavenly Doctor had used a jade bottle to collect the black mist that emerged from Han Zhong's corpse.

"If it were to spread throughout the Xuanhuang Realm, that would become a serious problem," Li Fan said with an unreadable tone.

"Ten thousand years have passed, yet the illness has barely spread at all. Even if it truly has a tendency to spread into the lower realm, the time required would certainly be unimaginably long," Mo Rubin replied casually, attempting to reassure him.

His attention shifted toward the Eye of the Heavenly Beast before them.

"So this transparent space is the Eye of the Heavenly Beast? It seems Xuantian King is not here either." Li Fan sounded somewhat disappointed.

Mo Rubin shook his head.

"This is merely one observation node of the Eye of the Heavenly Beast. Do you know how the compound eyes of tiny insects are made up of countless smaller eyes? The Tianshou Beast is the same."

Li Fan immediately understood.

As Mo Rubin continued casting spells, the transparent bubble shook violently and steadily shrank.

It seemed to be trying to expel the two of them.

Pop!

The bubble burst.

Li Fan felt his vision blur.

The next moment, they found themselves within a strange space.

It resembled one bubble floating among countless others upon the surface of a vast ocean.

Across the curved boundaries flashed the images of countless identical bubbles.

Li Fan could even vaguely see himself and Mo Rubin inside some of the surrounding bubbles.

However, those other versions of himself differed in appearance, clothing, expressions, and movements. Yet they still carried an inexplicable sense of familiarity.

Countless versions of himself met one another's gaze.

An indescribably strange feeling arose within Li Fan's heart.

"It is merely a distortion caused by the simultaneous observation of countless Eyes of the Heavenly Beast."

"As long as you remain true to your heart, you will not be deceived."

Mo Rubin was already accustomed to this strange sight. He carefully observed the countless bubbles, seemingly searching for something among them.

"Brother Xuanyuan never taught me how to control the formation governing the Eyes of the Heavenly Beast. Fortunately, I have come here several times before. I can only rely on this clumsy method and search little by little."

Mo Rubin sounded rather helpless.

Within this space, the number of Eyes of the Heavenly Beast seemed endless.

They appeared both incredibly close and unimaginably distant from one another.

Divine sense could not lock onto them. One could rely only upon direct observation with the naked eye.

Nor did the countless bubbles remain stationary.

From time to time, as though struck by waves, every bubble underwent irregular drifting movements, constantly changing position.

As a result, most previous observations immediately became useless.

Despite the immense difficulty, Mo Rubin showed no trace of frustration, remaining completely focused upon his search.

He also reminded Li Fan.

"Within the Eyes of the Heavenly Beast, an independent set of natural laws almost exists. You need not worry about reaching the end of your lifespan. Even if you remained here for ten thousand years, you would never die of old age."

"If one day your lifespan truly comes to an end and you do not wish to die, you could hide here instead. I cannot guarantee everlasting immortality, but surviving another several thousand years should not be difficult."

Li Fan nodded.

"The Heavenly Beast truly is extraordinary."

"I have heard its body was comparable in size to an entire prefecture of the Xuanhuang Realm. Could it have been brought back from the Immortal Realm by the Xuantian King?" Li Fan asked.

As expected, Mo Rubin nodded.

"Yes. And no."

"Back then, Brother Xuanyuan believed it was merely an ordinary jade pendant, nothing more than an inanimate object. Unexpectedly, after it touched water, it began to emit the aura of a living creature."

"After carefully raising it, it continued growing larger and larger. Even its combat strength increased continuously."

"To be honest, if we truly fought to the death, I might not even be its opponent."

A trace of nostalgia flashed across Mo Rubin's eyes.

Then, perhaps remembering that the Heavenly Beast had long since perished, with even its corpse having transformed into mountains and rivers, a dense killing intent flashed through his gaze.

Li Fan remained silent.

The surroundings once again sank into complete silence.

Li Fan imitated Mo Rubin and began searching through the countless bubbles for possible clues.

Although the number of bubbles was as countless as the stars in the heavens and their positions constantly shifted.

Li Fan possessed the support of the Dao Deviation Stone.

Every bubble was ultimately different from the others.

Each time he observed one, he deeply imprinted it into his memory, effectively placing a unique mark upon it.

No matter how the bubbles drifted, he could still distinguish each one with perfect clarity.

Time slowly passed.

The number of bubbles marked by Li Fan steadily increased.

One possibility after another was eliminated, and Li Fan's gaze gradually became sharper.

Because he had discovered something rather strange.

Compared to his true self, every distorted version of himself within those peculiar bubbles appeared to be missing a small piece.

The missing portion differed in every bubble.

But if all those missing pieces were combined together...

Chapter 1336: Before The Dao Of Inscription

The missing portions were all extremely small. Had it not been for the Dao Deviation Stone recording every single one of them and comparing them against each other, Li Fan would never have discovered this hidden anomaly within the countless Eyes of the Heavenly Beast so easily.

"As Mo Rubin said before, the differences in what is seen are caused by distortions from the observations of different Eyes of the Heavenly Beast..." Li Fan's gaze seemed to pass through the countless bubbles and reach directly behind the scenes.

"These missing portions can actually be regarded as the blind spots of the Eyes of the Heavenly Beast. Or rather, an invisible existence occupies fixed positions within the Heavenly Beast's field of vision. Even after comparing hundreds or thousands of different observations, it is still impossible to glimpse its complete form. Only by stitching together all of the blind spots from every Eye of the Heavenly Beast..."

Li Fan's thoughts surged.

Within his mind, those tiny fragments slowly pieced themselves together.

In the end, they formed a twisted, mysterious, and incomparably complex character.

Calling it a character was not entirely accurate. In Li Fan's eyes, it looked more like a distorted human silhouette.

This humanoid character possessed neither form nor substance, yet it still fell within the observational range of the Eyes of the Heavenly Beast. No single Eye of the Heavenly Beast could perceive its complete form. They could not even detect its existence. Yet it still occupied a portion of their field of vision.

It was like shadows cast from different angles.

Although it was impossible to see the object's true appearance directly, by combining all the shadow patterns together and deducing them in reverse, one could reconstruct this formless and shapeless object.

"This character..."

Li Fan suppressed the shock in his heart and showed no sign of anything unusual before Mo Rubin.

This humanoid character was not a True Immortal seal script character.

Yet in essence, it was perhaps no different from one.

Characters such as Chaos, Hunger, and Creation were projections of the Dao and tangible manifestations of its power.

The humanoid character before him was likewise a projection of a certain Dao.

"When cultivators first behold a True Immortal seal script character, the specific power it represents naturally appears within their minds. Hunger, Chaos, Creation, even that mysterious character representing the distinction between immortals and mortals, all behave in this way. The reason is that every True Immortal seal script character is an inscription and interpretation of the Dao left behind by the Inscription Dao Immortal."

"The Great Dao is originally formless, yet the Inscription Dao Immortal transformed its essence into individual characters, making it countless times easier for later generations to perceive and comprehend."

"But this humanoid character is different..."

Li Fan slowly contemplated the immense power contained within the character.

"Perhaps it is a naturally formed projection of a certain Dao."

"Or perhaps it was another True Immortal's attempt at the Dao of Inscription."

"But this individual was clearly far inferior to the later Inscription Dao Immortal."

The reason Li Fan could determine that this character predated the Inscription Dao Immortal was because a True Immortal's Dao admitted no second master. If the Inscription Dao Immortal had already existed, no other being could have attempted the Dao of Inscription.

"The instant such an attempt was made, it would have been mercilessly crushed by the terrifying power of the Nameless True Immortal."

The gap between this unknown pioneer and the true Inscription Dao Immortal was like that between two painters who both attempted to record the mountains and rivers of heaven and earth with a brush.

The Inscription Dao Immortal's paintings were so lifelike that viewers almost felt as though they had entered the scene itself.

The unknown pioneer, however, resembled a child scribbling with a brush. The abstract lines bore little resemblance to reality. One could not even tell what the painting was meant to depict.

Li Fan stared silently at the twisted humanoid character for a long time.

Yet he felt no contempt for such a crude method of inscribing the Dao.

Because the object this humanoid character was attempting to inscribe...

Having witnessed Creation, the Transformation Between Immortals and Mortals, and even the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood, Li Fan's ability to judge the rank of True Immortal seal script characters was likely unmatched even among True Immortals.

Li Fan faintly sensed that although the technique used to inscribe this Dao was crude, it did not diminish the rank of the fundamental Dao it sought to record.

"It surpasses Creation."

"It may stand on the same level as the Transformation Between Immortals and Mortals."

A trace of brilliance flashed through Li Fan's eyes, too subtle for anyone else to notice.

"The Heavenly Beast was originally transformed from a jade pendant that the Xuantian King brought back from the Immortal Realm. Yet after coming into contact with water, it unexpectedly became a living creature."

"Could it be because of the hidden character concealed within that jade pendant?"

The method of discovering this hidden humanoid character was both difficult and simple.

Even without the Dao Deviation Stone, Li Fan refused to believe that the half-immortal Xuantian King would have failed to uncover this hidden secret.

Likewise, the Dark Sea and the You Clan were both creations of the Xuantian King.

There was no reason he would have failed to notice that character representing the distinction between immortals and mortals.

"Perhaps Xuantian King's breakthrough back then relied upon the power of these two characters."

Li Fan silently speculated.

Because the Dao inscription technique behind this humanoid character was so crude, Li Fan could not gain any immediate insights from it.

He could only firmly engrave it into his memory for the time being.

As for traces of the Xuantian King...

Li Fan had already examined every Eye of the Heavenly Beast.

As expected, there was no sign that the Xuantian King had ever come here.

However, Li Fan did not mention it. He remained standing quietly while beginning to contemplate a method to break the formation here.

The Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation had been built upon ancient immortal formations before being improved by the Xuantian King.

Now that Li Fan already understood the Spirit Gathering Ascension Formation, it was by no means impossible for the Final Dissociation Disc to decipher the Eye of the Heavenly Beast formation here.

Especially since Mo Rubin had brought Li Fan directly into the heart of the formation, allowing every detail of its operation to be observed clearly.

Within the silent atmosphere, Li Fan's progress in deciphering the formation steadily soared.

Mo Rubin completed his observation of every Eye of the Heavenly Beast in only twice the time it took Li Fan.

A trace of disappointment flashed openly across his face.

"Nothing here either?" Li Fan asked at the perfect moment.

Mo Rubin shook his head and sighed softly.

"He did not even come here to take refuge."

"The two places where my deductions indicated Brother Xuanyuan was most likely hiding have both turned out to be empty."

His expression was rather unpleasant.

"Then shall we head to the next location?"

Mo Rubin rejected Li Fan's suggestion.

"The Eyes of the Heavenly Beast observe the Star Sea outwardly and the Xuanhuang Realm inwardly."

"Now that we have come here, how could we possibly leave without making use of them?"

Mo Rubin gazed at the countless floating Eyes of the Heavenly Beast before him and spoke softly.

"I thought you said the Xuantian King never passed down the method of controlling them. Can you actually command the power of the Eyes of the Heavenly Beast?" Li Fan asked in surprise.

Mo Rubin replied proudly, "They are all part of the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation. No matter how much things change, they all originate from the same source. As long as you give me a little time, it will not be difficult for me to command a portion of their power."

Li Fan could not help but praise him. "Fellow Daoist, you truly possess extraordinary talent. How long will it take exactly?"

"Within three to five months, it will certainly be completed," Mo Rubin replied in a deep voice.

Li Fan nodded slightly after hearing this. After a moment of thought, he suggested, "There is no point in my remaining here doing nothing. I might as well return to the Xuanhuang Realm and continue searching carefully for anything we may have overlooked. Perhaps I can uncover some additional clues."

Mo Rubin studied Li Fan for a while before finally agreeing.

"Very well."

He tossed over a jade talisman.

"Carry this with you. The moment I obtain any results, I will notify you immediately."

Li Fan accepted the jade talisman and cupped his fists.

"Then I ask Fellow Daoist to first send me out of this Heavenly Beast Eye formation."

Mo Rubin nodded and formed a hand seal with a single finger.

Li Fan's vision blurred. In the next instant, it felt as though he had appeared inside another tiny bubble.

The bubble continued shrinking until it gradually became a thin membrane surrounding his entire body.

Finally, the membrane completely tore apart.

A moment later, Li Fan had returned directly to Nine Mountains Prefecture within the Xuanhuang Realm.

"In the future, returning here will no longer be so troublesome. You can simply transfer through the Heavenly Beast's corpse."

"The Heavenly Beast may be dead, but its skeletal veins still remain."

Mo Rubin's voice echoed beside Li Fan's ears before slowly fading away.

Li Fan raised his head, his gaze seemingly piercing through space and time to reach the Heavenly Beast Eye beyond the void.

After conducting a thorough inspection and confirming that Mo Rubin had left no hidden marks or secret methods on him, Li Fan narrowed his eyes and sneered inwardly.

'He agreed rather readily.'

'Perhaps he was eager to get rid of me.'

Li Fan vaguely sensed that while inside the Heavenly Beast Eye formation, Mo Rubin had not truly gone all out. It seemed he still possessed hidden methods that he had deliberately withheld. Therefore, Li Fan had simply gone along with the situation and proposed leaving for the time being.

In any case, with the assistance of the Final Dissociation Disc, he would probably decipher the Heavenly Beast formation even before Mo Rubin.

'If he can discover the whereabouts of the Xuantian King, so much the better.'

'If not, he can still contribute to the ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm.'

Compared to Yin Shangren, Xu Ke, and the others, a Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect was even more useful.

Naturally, Li Fan had no intention of wasting such a valuable piece.

With that thought, the phantom of the Wooden Sword activated.

In the next instant, he returned to the Great Xuan small world.

The moment he returned to the Xuanhuang Realm, he had already sensed that Yin Shangren, who had previously disappeared within the echoing star force storm, had safely returned.

However, as the culprit who had caused the entire disturbance, Hundred Flowers' attitude toward him had completely changed from friendliness to hostility.

The two were currently confronting each other above the Dao Lecture Platform.

Hundred Flowers wore a solemn expression, clearly demanding an explanation from Yin Shangren.

Meanwhile, Yin Shangren kept his eyes closed from beginning to end. He offered no explanation, yet also showed no hostility.

As Li Fan looked at Yin Shangren, an indescribably strange feeling arose within his heart. He had interacted with Yin Shangren through far too many reincarnations. Altogether, they had spent well over a century together.

No one in the world understood Yin Shangren better than Li Fan.

He immediately detected the mysterious transformation that had taken place within Yin Shangren.

Yin Shangren was a World Specter.

He was one of the remnants left behind after the Xuanhuang Realm devoured and assimilated other destroyed cultivation worlds, residue that could not be absorbed.

Because of this, Yin Shangren was always accompanied by an aura of eeriness and deathly silence.

But now...

This aggregate of World Specter actually radiated strands of unique vitality.

Even Li Fan could not help but be greatly astonished.

He immediately revealed himself and arrived before Yin Shangren.

"Congratulations, Fellow Daoist. Misfortune has truly become a blessing." Li Fan carefully observed him for a while before speaking softly.

Only then did Yin Shangren slowly open his eyes.

"Without the Holy Teacher's assistance, I would never have reached the frontier of the Star Sea, let alone obtain such fortune."

Yin Shangren expressed his gratitude with complete sincerity.

The instant Li Fan saw his eyes, he also understood why Yin Shangren had refused to open them while facing Hundred Flowers.

One eye was black.

The other was white.

The black eye radiated boundless vitality.

The white eye overflowed with endless deathly energy.

The instant Li Fan met those black and white eyes, it was as though he had been pulled into an endless illusion.

Countless lives were born.

Then they perished beneath countless calamities.

Life and death continuously cycled and evolved at an unimaginably terrifying speed.

Li Fan even discovered that his Psychological Age, which had never before been affected by any illusion, began changing rapidly the instant it fell into the black and white vortex.

If even Li Fan was affected to such a degree, Hundred Flowers fared far worse.

She was not even looking directly into the eyes, merely observing from the side.

Yet her seemingly indestructible glazed body flickered like the last candle in a violent wind, trembling violently and standing on the verge of collapse.

Fortunately, Yin Shangren also noticed the changes occurring to Li Fan and Hundred Flowers.

Moreover, he had no intention of harming them.

Somewhat slowly, and with visible difficulty, he closed his black and white eyes once more.

The storm of life and death illusions gradually subsided.

Only then did Li Fan and Hundred Flowers recover.

"You..."

Hundred Flowers pointed at Yin Shangren in shock, unable to conceal the horror on her face.

She simply could not believe it.

Only a few days earlier, Yin Shangren's strength had been roughly equal to her own.

Yet in merely a few days, he had undergone an almost earth-shattering transformation.

Li Fan asked with great interest, "What exactly is the source of this vitality within you? Beneath the High Wall, the endless Great Wall is made entirely from destroyed worlds. How could such overwhelming vitality possibly be hidden there?"

Yin Shangren paused briefly before slowly explaining, "It was precisely because I discovered this vitality within that ruined world that I disregarded all consequences and acted as I did. In truth, at that time I had already been controlled by instinct. For a short period, my actions were no longer under my own control."

Li Fan frowned upon hearing this.

"Even now, after absorbing the vitality from that ruined world, I still do not know where it originally came from. However..."

"I can show the Holy Teacher exactly where that vitality resides."

After pondering for a moment, Li Fan nodded.

"The Great Xuan small world is still too fragile."

The phantom Wooden Sword left its sheath, carrying Yin Shangren and Hundred Flowers into the void outside the Xuanhuang Realm.

Stimulated by that limitless vitality, even his half-completed 'Foundation Establishment Through Oneself' showed signs of gradually repairing itself.

The True Self Dao Foundation within his body slowly began merging with his own being.

As a result, Yin Shangren's characteristic double echoing voice gradually disappeared.

With a solemn expression, Yin Shangren turned away from Li Fan and the others.

He once again opened his black and white eyes.

Then he raised his left hand and inserted two fingers into his eye socket.

With a slight exertion of force, he dug both eyeballs out.

There was no blood.

Only two small spheres, one black and one white, continuously rotating within the void.

After leaving Yin Shangren's body, the black and white spheres gradually drifted toward one another.

However, Yin Shangren kept his palm between them the entire time, preventing them from merging together.

"So the source of that vitality is these two black and white spheres?"

Seeing the bizarre scene before her, Hundred Flowers could not help asking.

"Not only vitality."

"They are also the source of deathly energy."

For some unknown reason, after the two spheres left his body, even speaking became difficult for Yin Shangren.

The black and white spheres continuously emitted their unique energies into the surrounding void.

However, because they mutually attracted and restrained one another, their energies did not erupt outward explosively.

Instead, they formed a Taiji-like vortex, maintaining an eerie equilibrium.

Li Fan gazed at the black and white spheres. From them, he faintly sensed a strangely familiar aura.

Chapter 1337: Taijia Realm Divine Art

In his previous life, Li Fan's Holy Embryo clone followed the Xuan Immortal Ark on its expedition to the Xuanhuang Realm, only to fall into the Immortal Ancestor's trap.

There, he encountered the terrifying Immortal Realm Watcher who, with a single glance, stripped away the lives of one tenth of all living beings aboard the Immortal Ark.

A great cauldron boiled the world like an endless abyss, refining a frozen world containing countless cultivators into a Yin Yang Pearl.

Within the Yin Yang Pearl existed two separate worlds.

One was a boundless sea of deathly silence covered in ice. Opposite that lifeless world was an ocean overflowing with vitality.

When Li Fan first entered the small world within the Yin Yang Pearl, he mistook it for the Dao field of the Xuanhuang Realm's Rebirth Heavenly Sovereign. Within that world, yin and yang, life and death endlessly circulated, perfectly matching the concept of reversing life and death.

However, as Li Fan's horizons gradually broadened and he witnessed countless genuine Immortal formations, he began to doubt his own judgment.

Although the formation within the Yin Yang Pearl was incomparably profound, Li Fan had already been able to glimpse its mysteries when he first encountered it. It was clearly still far from the level of an Immortal formation.

The cycle of life and death within the Yin Yang Pearl did not rely on the Reversal of Life and Death Formation itself. Instead, it depended entirely upon the world's origin essence and the power of the Immortal Realm Watcher.

The Reversal of Life and Death Formation functioned more like a catalyst, merely accelerating the process of reversing life and death.

In his previous life, the Holy Emperor turned the Xuanhuang Realm upside down. Afterwards, the Xuanhuang Realm fell into an apocalyptic crisis within the All Things Return to Void Grand Formation. The Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor exhausted all their strength trying to stop it. Yet from beginning to end, that mysterious Rebirth Heavenly Sovereign never appeared.

Perhaps this was because Lan Yu had chosen to venture into the Star Sea to comprehend the Dao, and the true Rebirth Heavenly Sovereign had not yet successfully defied the natural order. However, Li Fan believed that even if the Rebirth Heavenly Sovereign had truly been born, they likely would not have intervened to stop his world destroying actions.

There was an inseparable connection between the Rebirth Heavenly Sovereign and the Watcher.

The Watcher bore the mission of the Immortal Realm. Besides monitoring abnormalities within the Xuanhuang Realm, it also seemed responsible for collecting information on every different human who had ever appeared within the Xuanhuang Realm.

As for the Rebirth Heavenly Sovereign...

It seemed to have freed itself from the restraints of the Immortal Realm's mission, acting solely for its own benefit.

The Watcher encountered by Li Fan and the Xuan Immortal Ark possessed no independent intelligence. It acted entirely according to instinct, or perhaps according to predetermined rules.

It was little different from a puppet and hardly seemed capable of bearing the enormous responsibility of overseeing an entire cultivation world.

Therefore, Li Fan speculated that the Watcher's true spirit might have already abandoned its original body. Only by doing so could it free itself from the duties imposed by the Immortal Realm after its destruction.

The backlash suffered by the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable after neglecting their duties in the previous life proved that even after the Immortal Realm had perished, the restraints it imposed still remained.

No one wished to remain shackled forever.

Theoretically speaking, it was entirely reasonable for the Xuanhuang Realm Watcher to seek freedom.

"Back then, I used a fake True Immortal relic to lure the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's Dharma-Transmitters into the Yin Yang World. In the end, they all died there. Yet afterward, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance behaved as though nothing had happened. This proves that the Immortal Ancestor, or perhaps the Heavenly Doctor, certainly knows the true identity of the Rebirth Heavenly Sovereign. It is even possible that the Heavenly Doctor assisted in the Watcher's transformation into the Rebirth Heavenly Sovereign..."

Returning to the present.

The black and white spheres formed after Yin Shangren dug out his own eyes emitted an aura almost identical to that of the Yin Yang Pearl.

The only difference was that within these black and white spheres, life and death remained completely separate. They had not yet reached the endless circulation and perpetual cycle of life and death found within the Yin Yang Pearl of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Li Fan stared silently at the black and white spheres for a long time.

Only after quite a while did he finally speak.

"There is a secret realm somewhere within the Xuanhuang Realm that contains a similar creation."

"However, compared to your simple dual Life and Death Pearls, the Yin Yang Pearl where black and white, life and death intertwine is even more marvelous. Within that Yin Yang Pearl lie countless frozen corpses. I wonder..."

Li Fan's eyes shone brightly.

After displaying them, Yin Shangren reabsorbed the black and white spheres into his body, restoring his normal eyes.

"The White Pearl indeed once contained frozen corpses. But that was before the world was destroyed."

"When the world died, those frozen corpses gradually melted away and transformed into the purest death qi..."

Hearing this, Li Fan silently pondered.

"This should be the difference caused by the absence of the Watcher."

"Among the countless cultivation worlds of the lower realms, the Xuanhuang Realm is clearly extraordinary. Not only does it have an Immortal Realm appointed Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable and an Watcher, but a True Immortal once personally descended there. Although I do not know the reason, that True Immortal ultimately perished..."

"The world where Yin Shangren obtained these black and white pearls was likewise under the surveillance of the Immortal Realm. However, its status was clearly lower than that of the Xuanhuang Realm."

Li Fan would certainly seek contact with the Rebirth Heavenly Sovereign, who was likely the Watcher that had shed its shell like a cicada.

However, the primary objective of this life remained integrating the Dao through the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth. Naturally, he intended to avoid introducing unnecessary variables.

Yin Shangren continued.

"I am merely the lingering soul of a dead world. I originally believed I would remain forever as this worthless remnant. Yet the instant I sensed the immense vitality within these black and white pearls, a powerful premonition suddenly arose within me..."

As he spoke, the vitality swirling within his black eye accelerated.

"Perhaps absolute decay does not truly exist in this world. The reason I have become this remnant soul is merely because all vitality has been severed. As long as enough vitality can be poured into me..."

As he spoke, Yin Shangren's complexion became increasingly rosy.

He looked more and more like a normal human cultivator.

However, Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

He could already see that things would not be so simple.

Just as Li Fan had expected, stirred by the intense vitality throughout his body, the originally tranquil gray eye also began rotating increasingly faster.

Threads of withered, decaying death qi emerged from Yin Shangren's body.

Very quickly, they neutralized the original vitality and suppressed it.

The aura of decay slowly spread from Yin Shangren's body.

Yin Shangren coughed softly several times.

The storms within his black and white eyes gradually subsided, revealing a trace of helplessness.

Seeing this, Hundred Flowers fell into thought. A hint of schadenfreude even flashed through her eyes.

Li Fan spoke directly.

"Life qi and death qi appear to oppose one another, but in truth they are one."

"You seek to awaken vitality while suppressing death qi. That will only produce the opposite result."

"Life is the root of death. Death is the fruit of life. Dig out the root, and the fruit must inevitably move. Pluck the fruit, yet the root need not necessarily be harmed."

Li Fan perfectly played the role of a Holy Teacher.

Right there, he began expounding the Dao to Yin Shangren.

Yin Shangren already possessed extraordinary comprehension, and now he also carried the black and white Life and Death Pearls.

The many profound and mysterious statements Li Fan intentionally crafted presented no difficulty for him whatsoever.

Within his tranquil eyes, the circulation of black and white qi became increasingly rapid.

Even Hundred Flowers proved to possess exceptional talent in the Dao of life and death.

As she listened attentively, she too seemed to gain considerable enlightenment.

The Dao lecture continued for half a day.

Li Fan nearly exhausted every bit of knowledge he possessed.

Finally, he waved his hand and transmitted the Reversal of Life and Death Formation into the sea of consciousness of both cultivators.

This Reversal of Life and Death Formation had been further deduced by the Final Dissociation Disc based upon the original formation inside the Yin Yang Pearl.

It could be called the supreme application of the Dao of life and death within the Darkest Star Sea.

The instant he came into contact with the formation, unconcealable shock and joy appeared upon Yin Shangren's face.

"Life and death stand opposed to one another. However, with this formation, you may gradually transform the endless death qi within the White Pearl into vitality."

"But you must always maintain the balance between life and death."

Li Fan glanced at Hundred Flowers before continuing.

"Consume the vitality produced by the transformation as quickly as possible. Besides cleansing your own decay, perhaps you can also lend Fellow Daoist Hundred Flowers a helping hand."

Hundred Flowers' body trembled slightly.

She had no idea what secret of hers Li Fan had discovered.

Yin Shangren nodded slightly.

"By the way, Holy Teacher, while absorbing the black and white twin pearls, I also learned some information about this ruined world."

"It is not much, but it is quite interesting."

After briefly organizing the Reversal of Life and Death Grand Formation, Yin Shangren spoke again of his own accord.

"This world is called the [Taijia Realm]."

"Before its destruction, although it was not particularly large, it was one of the most powerful cultivation worlds in the Star Sea."

"The reason was that the Taijia Realm was an extremely rare cultivation world that possessed no Worldly Heavenly Dao."

"The cultivators there cultivated the Taijia Divine Art. It is said that they could bypass the nonexistent World Heavenly Dao and communicate directly with the Star Sea's Source Will, drawing upon the power of the Star Sea..."

A trace of amazement flashed across Yin Shangren's eyes.

From the fragmented scenes he displayed with a wave of his hand, the divine abilities of the Taijia Realm cultivators were indeed terrifying.

Their swords crossed the Star River.

Their fists suppressed entire worlds.

Without any protection, they could traverse the Star Sea with their physical bodies alone.

Yin Shangren's tone suddenly changed.

"However, precisely because they were directly connected to the Star Sea's Source Will, when the power of the True Immortal seal script erupted throughout the Star Sea, the cultivators of the Taijia Realm were among the very first to be affected."

"The Star Sea's divine power that they had always relied upon lost its effectiveness. As a result, the once renowned Taijia Realm declined even faster than ordinary cultivation worlds."

"The most laughable part was that when the Taijia Realm was on the verge of complete destruction, a portion of its cultivators did not choose to fight to the death. Instead, they knelt on the ground and continued praying to communicate with the Star Sea's Source Will..."

Yin Shangren shook his head in disdain.

Hundred Flowers also commented, "We cultivators pursue power that belongs to ourselves. Borrowing the Star Sea's strength may grant overwhelming might for a time, but when calamity descends, it ultimately vanishes like a bubble."

"In truth, the Longevity Immortal cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm are no different..."

At this point, Hundred Flowers suddenly stopped speaking.

She had suddenly realized that their efforts to promote the Ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm and improve their own cultivation through the merit of assisting its rise were, in essence, not fundamentally different from the Longevity Immortal cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm or the cultivators of the Taijia Realm.

Li Fan naturally saw at a glance why Hundred Flowers had suddenly fallen silent.

He smiled slightly.

"There is still a difference."

"Once the Xuanhuang Realm completes its transformation, the power fed back to each of us truly becomes our own. It is a one time transaction. Even if we later become enemies of the Xuanhuang Realm, the power bestowed upon us cannot be taken back."

"As for the cultivators of the Taijia Realm..."

Li Fan shook his head without offering further comment.

"However, this Taijia Divine Art, which communicates directly with the Star Sea's Source Will, does have some merit."

Li Fan had previously taken Yin Shangren and the others to witness the awakening Star Sea's Source Will.

"The Xuanhuang Realm is not a completely isolated existence. After all, it still exists within the Star Sea. If its ascension could receive the support of the Star Sea..." Yin Shangren also realized the potential value of the Taijia Divine Art.

"Unfortunately, what I obtained from the black and white twin pearls were only fragmented memories."

He spoke with some regret.

Yin Shangren then painstakingly recited the incomplete Taijia Divine Art.

Its wording was obscure and awkward, filled with strange expressions. It was indeed completely different from ordinary cultivation techniques.

It was also Li Fan's first encounter with such a type of cultivation art, and it immediately aroused his interest.

"The essence of this technique lies in communicating with the Star Sea's Source Will."

"Ten thousand years ago, when the Star Sea was at the height of its prosperity, even Half Immortals were no more than ants in its eyes. Ordinary cultivators were even less significant. Naturally, establishing communication with the Star Sea's consciousness was unimaginably difficult."

Li Fan spoke slowly.

Yin Shangren nodded in agreement.

"Exactly. The Taijia Divine Art is extremely difficult to cultivate. Among countless cultivators, perhaps only one can truly master it. But once someone succeeds, every movement and every strike can mobilize power far beyond what ordinary cultivators can achieve."

Li Fan smiled.

"However, times have changed. The Star Sea has perished, and its Source Will has been reborn amid the ruins. It is now like a mighty being reincarnated, still in its infancy."

A sharp light flashed through Li Fan's eyes, and his voice was filled with confidence.

"As one side declines and the other rises, under the current circumstances, communicating with It has become far easier than before."

"Let me give it a try first."

The phantom of the Wooden Sword left its sheath as Li Fan stepped onto the flying sword.

In an instant, he flew out of the Xuanhuang Realm, disappearing from Yin Shangren and the others' sight.

"This flight divine ability is truly enviable. If I could master it, I would no longer be constrained by the Star Sea."

Hundred Flowers said with undisguised admiration.

Yin Shangren did not reply.

He quickly lowered his head and began studying the Reversal of Life and Death Grand Formation that Li Fan had previously taught him.

In Yin Shangren's eyes, the value of this grand formation was no less than that flight divine ability.

In the blink of an eye, Li Fan crossed more than half of the Darkest Star Sea and arrived at its center.

Here, the awakened Star Sea's Source Will was at its most active.

Li Fan stood silently within the void.

He did not immediately activate the incomplete Taijia Divine Art.

What he had said earlier was indeed true.

But he had not revealed the whole truth.

Even though the Star Sea's consciousness had only recently been reborn, the gap between it and ordinary cultivators remained as vast as heaven and earth.

Under the current circumstances, only someone like the Holy Emperor, a Child of Destiny capable of driving the revival of the entire Star Sea, could possibly communicate directly with the Star Sea.

As for ordinary cultivators who wished to achieve the same result...

"Then the first step is to make the Star Sea notice you."

A brilliant light flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

The Ascension Formation was completed in an instant.

A towering "Mountain" rose from the center of the Star Sea.

It continued climbing ever higher.

Standing upon the summit, Li Fan looked upward.

It was just like the ancient emperors who climbed sacred mountains to perform the Feng and Shan sacrifices, hoping to draw closer to the heavens.

Li Fan also wished to stand higher, increasing his momentum so that he would become more conspicuous within the vision of the Star Sea's Source Will.

When he sensed that the Ascension Formation had reached its limit.

Li Fan silently began reciting the Taijia Divine Art.

Although incomplete, it still retained its ability to communicate with the Star Sea's consciousness.

A strand of thought drifted upward.

Straight toward the source of the Star Sea.

Boom!

In that instant, Li Fan felt as though he had fallen into a magnificent river of stars.

Chapter 1338: Ten Thousand Years Of Favorability

'As the body transforms into the universe, the mind roams the star sea. Taijia without limits, the spirit wanders. Taijia without change, the spirit transforms. Taijia without emptiness, spirit within spirit...'

Li Fan silently recited the incantation.

Within his field of vision, just as the Holy Emperor had experienced before, the seemingly dark and extinguished Star Sea suddenly lit up with countless specks of starlight.

This time, however, it was different from directly coming into contact with the true will of the Star Sea's source.

With the Taijia Divine Art serving as a translator between the two, Li Fan could distinctly feel that the Star Sea's source instinctively regarded him with a certain degree of goodwill.

Not only had its disdain toward insignificant living beings faded away, but Li Fan even sensed that the consciousness of the Star Sea was listening.

The gap between a cultivator and the boundless Star Sea was unimaginably vast.

Yet through the Taijia Divine Art, that difference was greatly reduced. Naturally, this was partly because the Star Sea was currently in a new stage of recovery after its destruction, while Li Fan himself already stood at the pinnacle of the mortal world within the Star Sea.

Even so, there was no denying that the Taijia Divine Art was an incomparably profound divine ability.

'Only someone whose understanding of the essence of the Star Sea had reached an extraordinary level could have created such a divine art.'

'Perhaps the creator of this divine art had already ascended to become a True Immortal.'

The thought suddenly flashed through Li Fan's mind.

However, he did not forget the purpose of this communication.

Maintaining the Taijia Divine Art, Li Fan wore a solemn expression. He first praised the greatness of the Star Sea and its rebirth after destruction.

Then he described the current lifeless state of the Star Sea, placing particular emphasis on the only remaining source of life within it, the Xuanhuang Realm.

Finally, with complete sincerity, Li Fan pleaded with the consciousness of the Star Sea, asking for its assistance in elevating the Xuanhuang Realm and escaping the Immortal Ruins.

It resembled an ancient emperor offering sacrifices and prayers to Heaven.

After expressing his request, Li Fan fell silent and patiently waited for the Star Sea's response.

It seemed as though he had presented it with a difficult problem. The consciousness of the Star Sea remained silent for a long time.

However, Li Fan could still feel that their connection had not been severed, so he continued waiting quietly.

During his connection with the Star Sea's consciousness, countless insights and realizations concerning the Dao of the Star Sea continuously emerged within his mind. It was as though he had entered the legendary state of unity between Heaven and Man, experiencing enlightenment every passing moment.

What disappointed Li Fan somewhat was that these realizations resembled waves upon the endless sea. Though they arose one after another, they quickly dissolved back into the waters as each wave subsided.

'These are not truly my own realizations. They are merely natural phenomena produced by this special state. As for how much I can ultimately remember, that depends entirely upon my own fortune.'

Li Fan immediately understood.

Immersed within this near-enlightenment state, he had no idea how much time had passed before the consciousness of the Star Sea finally gave its answer.

Immediately afterward, Li Fan was forcibly expelled, and his connection with the Star Sea's consciousness was severed.

The Taijia Divine Art could not be used again for quite some time.

A peculiar summoning ritual.

These two realizations simultaneously appeared within Li Fan's mind.

'It seems the principle behind the Taijia Divine Art is that it consumes the favorability of the Star Sea's source consciousness. This favorability gradually increases over time. Ever since the destruction of the Taijia Realm, no cultivator has used the Taijia Divine Art for ten thousand years. Because of that, the accumulated favorability has reached an astonishing level. That is why I felt as though the Star Sea was listening to me...'

After completing the communication ritual, Li Fan gained a deeper understanding.

'However, all the favorability accumulated over these years has now been completely consumed because of my request. At least during the remaining twenty years of this lifetime, it will no longer do anything that I can take advantage of. Still, that is of no consequence. Since I have already mastered the Taijia Divine Art, when the next life begins, I will once again have another ten thousand years of accumulated favorability to spend.'

Perhaps the ten thousand years of accumulated favorability had truly been immense. Or perhaps the elevation of the Xuanhuang Realm also benefited the Star Sea's overall recovery.

In any case, the consciousness of the Star Sea accepted Li Fan's request and agreed to provide its full assistance in the matter of elevating the Xuanhuang Realm.

The ritual it had transmitted was precisely the method for receiving the Star Sea's support.

'Once the ritual is completed, the Star Sea will directly bestow its great power.'

'Even a newly reborn Star Sea is far beyond what the Xuanhuang Realm, even after merging with countless worlds, can compare to.'

'With yet another source of assistance, the plan to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm has become several times more certain.'

A strange expression flashed across Li Fan's eyes.

'I wonder whether this ritual will still work in the next life.'

After a moment, Li Fan slowly shook his head, rejecting the thought.

'This ritual is essentially nothing more than a signal transmitter. Whether the Star Sea chooses to help still depends entirely upon its own will. Without first establishing communication and goodwill, the Star Sea would probably only regard the signal as an annoyance and respond with anger. Not only would I fail to obtain its assistance, it might even send down calamity as punishment.'

After all of the accumulated favorability had been exhausted, Li Fan once again became no different from any other cultivator in the eyes of the Star Sea.

At the same time, the duration of the Ascension Formation had also reached its limit.

Li Fan immediately rode the phantom wooden sword away, allowing the formation to collapse behind him.

The collapse of the towering peak stirred a few ripples within the center of the Star Sea.

As the disturbance gradually subsided, an extremely faint strand of black qi silently appeared.

It was exactly the same as the strand of black qi that had appeared previously when Li Fan used the Ascension Formation to conduct his small world elevation experiment, causing the small world to fall from the heights and be annihilated.

The only difference was that no small world had fallen this time.

Rather, because this location lay close to where the consciousness of the Star Sea's source was most active, the black qi naturally came into existence.

Compared to the strand later devoured by the Dharma-Transmitter Jiang, this one at the center of the Star Sea appeared much weaker.

However, that apparent weakness was undoubtedly only an illusion.

This strand of black qi steadily grew stronger as time passed.

Wherever it spread, the Star Sea, which had only just begun recovering a trace of vitality, was once again reduced to complete nothingness.

Strangely enough, the consciousness of the Star Sea itself never noticed this parasite-like black qi.

It simply allowed it to continue devouring the Star Sea's vitality, completely powerless to stop it.

Its growth was extremely slow in the beginning.

However, as the amount of Star Sea it consumed continued to increase, its ability to expand likewise grew stronger.

It would likely not be long before this mysterious black qi swept across the Star Sea at an unimaginably terrifying speed.

For now, however, it continued to develop silently.

None of the surviving living beings within the Star Sea noticed anything unusual. Nor did Li Fan, the one who had unknowingly created this disaster.

He had already returned to the Xuanhuang Realm and recounted everything that had happened at the center of the Star Sea to Yin Shangren and the others.

Hundred Flowers sighed repeatedly in amazement, her eyes filled with delight.

"The Taijia Realm accumulated ten thousand years of favorability, only for it all to become a wedding dress for the Xuanhuang Realm. With the Star Sea's consciousness assisting us, the elevation of the Xuanhuang Realm is now within reach."

Yin Shangren remained much calmer.

"While I was searching near the fragments of the Taijia Realm, I also found fragments of another world that can serve as the medicinal catalyst for the Xuanhuang Realm."

"However, because I rashly devoured the Taijia Realm fragment, the stability of the Remnant World Great Wall was affected. We will likely need to wait a little longer until the echoing star force storm completely subsides before proceeding with the next step."

Hundred Flowers became even more delighted.

"Everything is falling into place one step after another. At this rate, in no more than half a year, we can officially begin the plan to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm."

Li Fan smiled faintly.

"It is not quite that simple. Although we now have the Star Sea's assistance, we still cannot lower our guard. The Star Sea's power is like an incomparably potent medicine. Used correctly, it can cure any illness."

"But if used improperly..."

"The body may be too weak to bear the nourishment, bringing disaster upon itself instead."

Hearing this, Hundred Flowers' expression immediately turned solemn.

Using the principles of the Heaven and Man, Li Fan gave the two of them another lesson.

He then assigned each of them a task.

"Xu Ke is still beneath the High Wall. His life force has not been extinguished, so he must have encountered another fortunate opportunity. Since the echoing star force storm was created by you, you should go and bring him back," Li Fan said to Yin Shangren.

"As it should be." Yin Shangren nodded in agreement.

Li Fan then looked toward Hundred Flowers.

"During the journey to the frontier of the Star Sea, both Yin Shangren and Xu Ke gained their own fortunate opportunities. Although you returned safely, you were destined to miss such an encounter..."

Hundred Flowers smiled bitterly. Then, as if she had thought of something, she looked at Li Fan, a trace of anticipation appearing in her eyes.

"Fortunate opportunities do not exist only beneath the High Wall. Go to this location. Perhaps you will find something there."

Li Fan informed her of a location in the Darkest Star Sea, not far from the Xuanhuang Realm. His expression was rather mysterious.

"Remember. Do not be greedy. Your safety comes first. If you are not fated to obtain anything there, simply return."

Hundred Flowers firmly memorized the location Li Fan had given her, then cupped her fists in thanks.

After watching the two of them disappear one after another, Li Fan calculated that the timing was about right. Only then did he leisurely make his way back toward the Xuan Immortal Ark.

The place he had pointed out to Hundred Flowers was a natural "high ground" located outside the Xuanhuang Realm.

Li Fan had passed by it several times while traveling through the Star Sea. Although he had never discovered anything on the surface, he had always felt that some unknown secret was hidden there.

After his brief communication with the consciousness of the Star Sea, Li Fan became even more certain of his judgment.

Thus, he decided to let Hundred Flowers investigate it first.

Among the known high grounds within the Star Sea, whether the High Wall or the Dark Sea, every one of them was filled with danger. Although Li Fan now possessed sufficient strength to protect himself, he still had no intention of taking the lead personally.

Not long afterward, he arrived outside the Xuan Immortal Ark.

He deliberately released his aura.

Very soon, the elders of the Immortal Ark arrived.

They surrounded Li Fan on all sides.

Seeing that Li Fan had returned as promised, they all secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

Their expressions then became solemn as they turned to the important matter at hand.

"Fellow Daoist, what did Great Qi say?" Jian Daosheng was the first to ask.

A trace of anger flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

"A bunch of petty schemers. There is no point mentioning them."

Zhong Daogong smiled faintly, his eyes flickering.

"So, Fellow Daoist failed to persuade them?"

"You could say that." Li Fan let out a cold snort. "I already reported everything I witnessed beneath the High Wall to my teacher, yet they still dismissed it."

"My teacher even told me that throughout the Star Sea, there are actually quite a few such high grounds. However, their height compared to the High Wall is like the difference between the peaks of mountains upon the earth and the heavens themselves."

"Trying to cross the High Wall by relying on them is nothing more than a fool's dream."

Li Fan's words caused the expressions of all the Immortal Ark elders to change slightly.

"If one possesses no special methods, then merely relying on elevation is indeed insufficient to cross the High Wall." Zhong Daogong smiled faintly.

"However... Fellow Daoist just mentioned that there are many such high grounds within the Star Sea?" Zhong Daogong suddenly changed the subject. His expression became somewhat serious.

Li Fan nodded.

"Correct. My teacher personally took me to one of them. It was indeed as he said. Although it was somewhat lower than the location atop the Great Wall of Remnant Worlds, one could still overlook the High Wall from there."

Upon hearing this, Zhong Daogong remained silent for a long time.

Apparently communicating with the other elders through divine sense, he finally spoke after quite a while.

"It seems we of the Immortal Ark have truly underestimated the civilizations of the world. Any civilization capable of surviving the great catastrophe until today could never be ordinary."

"They may be powerful, but they are as timid as mice. They do not even possess the courage to make an attempt." Li Fan snorted coldly in rebuttal.

Instead, Zhong Daogong unexpectedly defended the nonexistent Great Qi.

"Fellow Daoist has oversimplified the matter."

"Even with traces left behind by those who came before, crossing the High Wall would still require an entire civilization to exhaust all of its strength. It is not something that can simply be described as making an attempt."

"They have lived peacefully within the Star Sea for tens of thousands of years, and perhaps will continue to survive for many more. There is absolutely no need to gamble everything."

"Of course, Fellow Daoist does not have much time left to live. Wanting to seek the true Dao before death is perfectly understandable."

Li Fan merely let out another cold snort and did not continue arguing.

For a moment, both sides fell silent.

It was Jian Daosheng who finally spoke again.

"Of course, Fellow Daoist may rest assured. Our Xuan Immortal Ark has never abandoned its determination to cross the High Wall. If you wish to fulfill your desire, then cooperating with us is probably your only choice."

Only then did Li Fan seem to recall something.

He frowned and asked, "Why is the Xuan Immortal Ark so persistent?"

"Is it merely because the other half of the Immortal Ark lies beyond the High Wall?"

Jian Daosheng did not answer directly. Instead, he replied meaningfully.

"Before this, the situation of the Xuan Immortal Ark was actually very similar to yours. Now, although another turning point may exist, we have already reached the point where there is no turning back."

"It is not as difficult as one might imagine."

"Only for our Xuan Immortal Ark," Zhong Daogong added.

Li Fan narrowed his eyes as he examined the elders of the Immortal Ark.

"It seems your Xuan Immortal Ark still has quite a few secrets."

Zhong Daogong merely smiled without answering.

"Since you possess such confidence, why should I be afraid?"

Li Fan spoke in a deep voice.

"I shall spare no effort in helping the Xuan Immortal Ark succeed. Everything I have learned throughout my life in Great Qi was originally not meant to be passed on to outsiders. But now..."

The eyes of the Immortal Ark elders immediately lit up with delight.

"To be honest with everyone, aside from the True Immortal seal script, the Dao I have studied most deeply is formations. Furthermore, I also possess an ancient divine technique that allows communication with the consciousness of the Star Sea..."

Li Fan raised his head proudly as he introduced his abilities.

The elders of the Immortal Ark listened with shining eyes.

"The research Great Qi conducted on the True Immortal seal script. Is the True Immortal seal script [Creation] that Fellow Daoist demonstrated to us last time the highest level among them?" Zhong Daogong asked the most crucial question.

Li Fan immediately put away the arrogance on his face.

"With my status in Great Qi, among all the True Immortal seal script characters I was permitted to access, 'Creation' was indeed the highest."

"However..."

Chapter 1339: The Xuan Shang Of Those Bygone Years

"The character [Creation] is not the highest achievement of Great Qi's research into the True Immortal seal script."

Li Fan's expression became somewhat absent-minded, with a trace of melancholy.

Yet now, Li Fan was claiming that Great Qi had actually comprehended a True Immortal seal script character that surpassed [Creation].

"It seemed... to concern the [Transformation Between Immortal and Mortal]."

"The Transformation Between Immortal and Mortal?"

Li Fan had spoken only a few brief sentences, yet the Immortal Ark elders all displayed different expressions as countless possibilities raced through their minds.

Li Fan observed their reactions. To further strengthen the credibility of his words, he added, "That character truly is extraordinary. Ever since my master participated in its research, some of the True Immortal seal script structures that he habitually wrote during my daily instruction underwent subtle changes."

"But those seemingly insignificant adjustments caused the True Immortal seal script itself to undergo an almost complete transformation."

Before everyone's eyes, Li Fan moved his hand like a dragon and snake, drawing two character structures in the empty air.

Their overall shapes were identical, but subtle differences existed in the curvature, turning points, and other minute details.

The Immortal Ark elders stared blankly at the two character structures.

It was as though they possessed boundless magic, completely capturing everyone's attention.

Nearly half a day passed before Zhong Daogong was the first to regain his senses. Without disturbing the others' enlightenment, he turned his head away from the floating characters and began attempting to reproduce them himself.

As he traced them with his fingers, delight gradually appeared on his face.

"So that is how it is."

These altered character structures were precisely those Li Fan had obtained from the bloodline inheritance of the You Clansmen race, structures seemingly related to the Transformation Between Immortal and Mortal.

That True Immortal seal script character had appeared boundless, containing the ultimate principles of heaven and earth. Although Li Fan had been fortunate enough to glimpse only a fragment of it in this life, his strength had been insufficient to completely reproduce it.

His memory of that mysterious character had vanished alongside his failed attempt to observe it.

Only faint impressions of the countless minute structures that composed the mysterious character remained.

At this moment, Li Fan was presenting those structures derived from the Transformation Between Immortal and Mortal to deceive the people of the Immortal Ark.

Although calling it deception was not entirely accurate.

The Transformation Between Immortal and Mortal stood at an unimaginably high level.

Even the tiniest fragment was enough to benefit the Immortal Ark endlessly.

Just as at this very moment, the elders gradually awakened from their enlightenment, each feeling as though enlightenment had suddenly descended upon them.
