...

The elders discussed excitedly among themselves, filled with joy.

In this simple manner, Li Fan once again proved his value.

During the following month, Li Fan officially took up residence aboard the Immortal Ark.

Within the Severed Immortal Tower atop the Immortal Ark's Divine Tree, Zhong Daogong personally opened another small courtyard for Li Fan, demonstrating the Ark's high regard for him.

Li Fan did not disappoint them.

By his own efforts, he almost single-handedly completed the Immortal Ark's severely underdeveloped formation system.

"With the guidance of a predecessor, the Immortal Ark's formation research has advanced by a hundred years in a single night," Elder Meng Xiaomeng sighed.

He carefully engraved the formation knowledge that Li Fan taught onto jade slips one after another.

Meng Xiaomeng had always opposed placing all of the Immortal Ark's hopes solely upon True Immortal seal script.

Therefore, besides researching True Immortal seal script, he had also studied formations and alchemy, hoping to open new paths for the Immortal Ark's survival.

However, lacking a proper master, he could only study the ancient formations preserved within the Immortal Ark's records.

As a result, his attainment in formations had remained rather mediocre.

After witnessing Li Fan's formation theories over the past month, he regarded them as nothing short of miraculous.

His passion had been completely ignited, and he devoted himself wholeheartedly to formation research, even casting aside True Immortal seal script entirely.

Zhong Daogong did not stop him.

After all, there were already plenty of elders researching True Immortal seal script. Losing one Meng Xiaomeng made little difference.

But establishing a complete formation inheritance for the Immortal Ark was of tremendous importance.

During this period, Li Fan did far more than simply establish the Ark's formation inheritance.

Under his leadership and guidance, every defensive formation throughout the Immortal Ark was completely reconstructed.

After extensive testing by the elders, the newly reinforced formations increased the Ark's defensive resilience by more than threefold.

Critical locations such as the Severed Immortal Tower, the Celestial Pivot Institute, and the Divine Tree all received vastly improved defensive capabilities.

There was also a small incident during this process.

At first, many Immortal Ark elders had voiced objections to rebuilding the formations.

They especially disagreed with entrusting something as vital as the Ark's defenses to Li Fan, someone who had only recently joined.

However, after witnessing Li Fan effortlessly dismantle the original defensive formations within a few breaths, passing through countless restrictions as though they did not exist, the elders immediately broke into cold sweat.

Their opinions quickly became unanimous in support.

By establishing a new formation inheritance and rebuilding the Ark's defenses, Li Fan gained the deep trust of the overwhelming majority of the Immortal Ark in a remarkably short time.

Furthermore, after joining the Ark, Li Fan conducted himself with elegance and courtesy.

He treated everyone kindly.

Anyone who came seeking advice received answers without reservation.

Before long, Li Fan had earned an excellent reputation among the elders.

Visitors came to his courtyard in an endless stream.

On this particular day, several elders had come to Li Fan's courtyard, where he was explaining the Taijia Divine Art.

"Transform the body into the universe, let the mind roam the river of stars. Taijia knows no limits, and the spirit wanders. Taijia knows no change, and the spirit transforms. Taijia knows no emptiness, and spirit gives rise to spirit..."

The elders had always devoted themselves to True Immortal seal script and initially showed little interest in what was merely called a divine art.

However, after hearing the complete technique, every one of them became serious.

"Brother Li, this divine art appears to be incomplete," Immortal Ark Elder Lu Yuzhi said with a frown.

After spending so much time among the people of the Immortal Ark and earning everyone's goodwill, Li Fan's way of addressing them had naturally become much more familiar.

"Although it is only a fragment, it does not prevent communication with the Star Sea consciousness. However, even with the Star Sea consciousness now approaching destruction, it is still far from easy for cultivators like us to make contact with it. Whether you succeed or not will ultimately depend on your own fortune."

After finishing his explanation of the Taijia Divine Art, Li Fan looked at the crowd with a faint smile.

Lu Yuzhi nodded.

"We naturally understand that. Communicating with the Star Sea is akin to the ancient state of unity between heaven and man. Whether it is comprehending the Dao or carrying out deductions, the efficiency is incomparable to one's normal state."

"It is even of tremendous benefit when comprehending True Immortal seal script. Haha. Those old fellows who did not come today will certainly regret it once they find out. The few of us must keep our mouths shut. Unless they pay a heavy price, we absolutely must not reveal anything." After grasping the mysteries of the Taijia Divine Art, Gan Jingda stroked his beard and joked.

"Brother Li's knowledge is truly terrifying. It is like an inexhaustible treasury. Every time I come here, I gain something new." Elder Nangong Lie's words immediately drew nods and praise from everyone present.

Facing their compliments, Li Fan merely replied calmly, "My lifelong wish is to empty everything stored in my mind before I fall, leaving it all behind for the Immortal Ark."

"Then, at the very end of my life, I will stake everything on one final attempt."

"I want to see what lies beyond the High Wall."

Li Fan spoke with ease and complete composure.

The elders of the Immortal Ark present reacted differently. Some felt regret, some heartache, and some could not bear it.

"Brother Li, is there truly no other way?"

"The Immortal Ark treasury should contain several secret medicines that extend lifespan. Perhaps..."

Li Fan waved his hand dismissively.

"After the protective formation was fully restored, Elder Zhong already took me into the secret treasury to try them. My lifespan has truly reached its end. No heavenly treasures or earthly treasures can help anymore. I accepted my fate long ago."

"I can only say that the backlash from beyond the High Wall is truly terrifying."

"Yet because of that, my curiosity has only grown stronger. Before my life ends, I must see for myself what truly exists beyond the High Wall."

His eyes shone with unwavering determination.

The people of the Immortal Ark fell silent and sighed upon hearing his words.

Suddenly, Li Fan seemed to recall something.

"By the way, when I suffered the backlash earlier, my master said that if not for the figurine I obtained from the Immortal Ark treasury absorbing part of the force, I probably would not have had even twenty years of life remaining. I would have perished on the spot, body and soul extinguished."

"Where exactly did that figurine come from? When I selected it, I only thought its appearance was rather unusual. I never expected it to possess the ability to withstand power from beyond the High Wall."

As he spoke, Li Fan projected the image of the figurine standing with its hands lowered, its eyes cast downward.

Everyone present had accompanied him when he selected it from the treasury. Hearing this, they all recalled the scene, their expressions becoming rather strange.

"So this figurine actually possesses such an extraordinary ability?"

The elders looked at one another, yet none of them knew its origin.

"Wait. Let me look through the records." Lu Yuzhi immediately stood up with a solemn expression.

After all, anything capable of resisting power from beyond the High Wall deserved the utmost caution.

"Brother Li, something this important. Why didn't you ask earlier?" Nangong Lie shook his head.

Li Fan smiled bitterly.

"When I first learned that my lifespan was almost exhausted and my bright future had vanished into nothing, my state of mind completely collapsed. How could I still care about such things? Only after gradually calming down did the mention of the treasury remind me again."

After Li Fan explained himself, no one pursued the matter further.

Lu Yuzhi was gone only briefly before hurrying back.

"According to the records, this figurine came from a cultivation world that has already been destroyed, the Unfettered Free Realm."

With a wave of his hand, he displayed an image for everyone.

Hearing the somewhat familiar name, Li Fan's heart stirred slightly.

"The cultivators of that world disliked conflict. Just as the world's name suggests, they were carefree by nature and valued absolute freedom, unwilling to be bound by anything. This figurine was purchased by the Xuanshang Immortal Ark from a gambler when it passed through the Unfettered Free Realm."

The image shifted, revealing a slovenly man in tattered clothes.

The recording was extremely ancient, making the reconstructed image unstable. It flickered constantly, and the sound was intermittent.

Even so, it did not prevent everyone from understanding what had happened.

"This thing is a genuine treasure. Buy it, and you definitely won't lose out." The ragged man scratched beneath his crotch, sniffed his hand, then spoke carelessly.

"The figurine does indeed appear somewhat extraordinary. However, your asking price of one hundred thousand high-grade spirit stones is simply too high. It exceeds the limits of my authority." A crisp voice sounded from outside the image.

"That was the merchant assigned to the Unfettered Free Realm back then. His name was..."

"Jia Chu. Yes, Jia Chu." Lu Yuzhi explained to Li Fan.

"He was the one who completed this transaction. In strict accordance with the Immortal Ark's regulations, he recorded the entire process and archived it. That is why, after ten thousand years, we are fortunate enough to witness this scene."

"It is a pity that Jia Chu chose to stand with the Shang Immortal Ark during the Immortal Ark Schism. No one knows where he is now." Lu Yuzhi said regretfully.

Li Fan nodded slightly and continued watching the recording.

Jia Chu stood up, preparing to leave without the slightest hesitation.

The previously indifferent ragged man immediately panicked.

He grabbed Jia Chu's hands and said with a flattering smile, "If the price is too high, we can negotiate. Eighty thousand. Eighty thousand is enough. For the famous Xuanshang Immortal Ark, a mere eighty thousand high-grade spirit stones is practically nothing."

Jia Chu paid no attention to the hands tightly gripping him.

He calmly replied, "Although our Xuanshang Immortal Ark possesses great wealth, we cannot spend eighty thousand spirit stones on a figurine of completely unknown origin."

"Thirty thousand spirit stones is already the highest amount I am authorized to decide on. Any higher, and I would have to report it to my superiors. That would be too troublesome. I would rather not make this deal."

His tone was completely resolute.

"Thirty thousand? You're driving the price down far too much." The ragged man muttered unhappily.

"If you think the price is too low, you can always sell it to one of the Unfettered Free Realm's local merchant guilds." Jia Chu replied indifferently.

The ragged man scratched his head without answering.

"The Unfettered Free Realm's local merchant guilds actually maintained countless ties with our Xuanshang Immortal Ark. They were practically branches of our Immortal Ark within the Unfettered Free Realm. That ragged cultivator knew this as well, which is why he had nothing to say." Lu Yuzhi explained.

After another lengthy round of bargaining, Jia Chu ultimately purchased the figurine for forty-five thousand spirit stones.

Just before handing over the payment, Jia Chu suddenly asked, "Where did you obtain this figurine?"

The ragged man's expression immediately became vigilant.

Jia Chu casually pointed toward the recording light sphere beside them.

"It is merely a routine question. You do not have to answer."

"However, if any problems arise with this figurine in the future, we will come looking for you again."

Chapter 1340: Sun Piaomiao’S Journey Across The Starry Sky

"Our Xuanshang Immortal Ark has left its footprints throughout the Star Sea. If we truly want to find someone, even if they flee to the most remote wilderness at the edge of the Star Sea, they cannot escape." Jia Chu spoke in a calm tone, yet it carried quiet confidence and authority.

Even Lu Yuzhi and the other Xuan Immortal Ark elders ten thousand years later unconsciously straightened their backs, their eyes filled with pride.

Within the recorded scene, the scruffy man trembled slightly upon hearing this and hurriedly waved his hands.

"No, no, no. It is better to explain all these troublesome matters at once. I hate dealing with trouble the most."

As he spoke, he somehow produced a cucumber from nowhere. While reminiscing, he happily chewed on it.

"I never really understood what that meant. I just guessed it could protect its owner from disaster in times of crisis, so I happily accepted it." At this point, the scruffy man paused and wiped the juice from the corner of his mouth.

Because of Zhong Daogong's arrival, the recorded projection temporarily paused.

At the conclusion of the transaction, besides the agreed forty-five thousand spirit stones, Jia Chu handed the scruffy man an additional five thousand.

After receiving the spirit stones, the scruffy man became exceptionally cooperative.

"Just that? No problem!"

"Let me think. What was that fellow's name again? Right. Sun Piaomiao. He was not a native cultivator of our Unfettered Free Realm. Although he narrowly survived, he was gravely injured and fell from the sky."

"If I had not suddenly been moved by compassion and taken good care of him, he definitely would not have survived in that condition." The scruffy man spoke with obvious pride.

"Xuanhuang Realm. Sun Piaomiao..."

The scene ended abruptly with Jia Chu's quiet murmur.

The name Sun Piaomiao immediately stirred the Immortal Ark elders.

"That name sounds familiar. I feel like I have heard it somewhere."

"Sun Piaomiao. Sun Piaomiao..."

The moment Li Fan heard the name, his heart also shook.

Because Sun Piaomiao was none other than the founding ancestor of the Medicine King Sect in the Xuanhuang Realm.

Back then, Sun Piaomiao had traveled through many cultivation worlds, leaving behind a travel journal that recorded the Dao Coordinates of twelve different cultivation worlds. Among them were Unfettered Free and Xuanshang.

Li Fan looked toward Zhong Daogong, who had suddenly arrived.

"The interesting matter you mentioned refers to this Sun Piaomiao?"

Zhong Daogong nodded and waved his hand lightly.

Three illusory objects instantly appeared before everyone.

"According to the surviving records of the Immortal Ark, ten years after the figurine transaction, Sun Piaomiao visited the Xuanshang Immortal Ark. He then accompanied the Immortal Ark in pursuing the Star Sea phenomenon known as the Starfall Hailstorm."

"The Starfall Hailstorm was one of the rarest phenomena in the Star Sea during that era. Countless enormous crystal meteors surged from the depths of darkness like a torrential storm. Everything that blocked their path was smashed to pieces. Every collision unleashed dazzling sparks and icy mist, creating terrifying storms where freezing cold and blazing heat intertwined. Even if only the edge of such a storm brushed against a cultivation world, it would bring about an extinction level catastrophe."

Zhong Daogong briefly explained the Starfall Hailstorm.

"Although the Starfall Hailstorm is unimaginably dangerous, at the very core of the meteor swarm there often forms a unique substance called Abyssal Frost Dust."

"It is said that a single speck of this substance is enough to freeze an entire ordinary cultivation world. When the frozen world finally shatters, the force released possesses nearly the might of creating heaven and earth."

"Were they successful?" Li Fan asked, completely absorbed.

"The Xuan Immortal Ark contains no record of the outcome. However, I believe they succeeded in obtaining at least some Abyssal Frost Dust. Sun Piaomiao took a portion and left behind these three items as payment. The remainder was most likely taken away later by the Shang Immortal Ark." Zhong Daogong's voice was filled with regret.

Li Fan was not surprised.

After all, the Shang Immortal Ark had ultimately emerged as the true victor of that era, taking away nearly all of the Immortal Ark's forces that had reached the threshold of immortality. From Zhong Daogong's description, the destructive power unleashed by Abyssal Frost Dust rivaled that of a True Immortal. It was only natural that the Shang Immortal Ark would value it.

The important matter was the three objects left behind by Sun Piaomiao.

"I do not remember seeing these in the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales secret treasury. Were they also taken to the Shang Immortal Ark?" Li Fan asked with a frown.

Zhong Daogong smiled.

"Not at all. These three items still remain in the collection of our Xuan Immortal Ark. However, the section you previously visited was only the outer layer of the secret treasury. These items should be stored within the second layer."

Li Fan was not offended. Instead, he joked.

"That makes it sound as though there is also a third layer and a fourth layer."

"The deepest part is only the third layer. You already know about the theft committed by outsiders back then. These are simply necessary security precautions." Zhong Daogong answered calmly without the slightest embarrassment.

Li Fan did not pursue the matter further and instead focused on Sun Piaomiao's three relics.

Their appearance was remarkably similar to that bowing figurine.

The first was a gray bird with broken wings. Although its wings had been severed, it still held its head high as though crying out toward the heavens.

The second item was a three-pronged tree. At the end of each branch were not leaves, but countless miniature trees.

As for the third item, it was something Li Fan was extremely familiar with.

It was a small cauldron. Judging from its appearance, it was almost identical to the Medicine King Cauldron of the Medicine King Sect.

"This Sun Piaomiao does not look like some peerless powerhouse. Yet the items he left behind actually contain power capable of contending against what lies beyond the High Wall..." Li Fan remarked thoughtfully.

Sun Piaomiao

Zhong Daogong said in a deep voice, "The era in which Sun Piaomiao lived was one where the Immortal Ascension Passage had not yet been severed. There were even records of True Immortals descending into the mortal world. Although, judging from the records within the Immortal Ark concerning Sun Piaomiao's travels, his cultivation only appeared to be at the peak of Dao Integration, we cannot rule out the possibility that he concealed his true strength."

Li Fan nodded slightly.

However, he did not voice his own speculation.

There was no doubt that Sun Piaomiao was immensely powerful, having crossed the starry sky alone and safely returned.

But Li Fan was equally certain that he had never ascended to become an Immortal.

Throughout the long ancient history of the cultivation world, every record of those from the Xuanhuang Realm who successfully ascended to immortality had been mysteriously erased. No trace of them could be found.

This was the meaning behind the saying that True Immortals have neither names nor surnames.

Perhaps only someone like Mo Rubin, who had personally lived through the transition between the old and new eras, could preserve by word of mouth the story of the Nine Refinements Temple's founding ancestor, Master Miaofa, ascending and later perishing.

First, the descendants of the Medicine King Sect never mentioned their founder Sun Piaomiao ascending to immortality. They did not even know his ultimate fate. Did he die peacefully of old age, perish in an accident, or simply disappear without a trace? The records concerning Sun Piaomiao ended after his return from his journey through the starry sky. After that, there was no further information.

Second, Sun Piaomiao's existence was not recorded only within the Medicine King Sect. As the unparalleled expert who saved countless lives and founded the Medicine King lineage, he was mentioned in many ancient texts throughout the Xuanhuang Realm. His existence had never been erased.

"When Sun Piaomiao crossed the starry sky, he had originally intended to continue exploring even deeper. However, after discovering something unusual about the starry sky surrounding the Xuanhuang Realm, he ultimately turned back."

"Was it because he was unwilling, or because he was unable?"

Just as Li Fan was deep in thought, Zhong Daogong spoke again.

"These three items left behind by Sun Piaomiao are like the bowing servant figurine you selected before. Although the Immortal Ark carefully examined them and found nothing unusual, since they all came from Sun Piaomiao, perhaps they conceal some hidden secret."

Li Fan remained silent, but the other elders could no longer sit still.

"Then what are we waiting for? Let's go take a look!"

Li Fan calmly looked at Zhong Daogong.

Zhong Daogong smiled faintly.

"Based on your contributions during this period, I doubt any member of the Council of Elders would object to allowing you into the second layer of the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales."

Not long afterward, Li Fan entered the second layer of the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales together with the elders.

Compared to the first layer, the space here was much smaller.

Every treasure was sealed within an individual sphere of light.

The colorful spheres floated throughout the air.

Their protective method was neither a formation, nor a restriction, nor even True Immortal seal script.

Li Fan narrowed his eyes as he observed the countless treasure spheres overhead. He vaguely sensed a trace of life from within them.

"These spheres... are alive?"

Zhong Daogong nodded approvingly.

"Your intuition truly is sharp."

"Correct. Guarding the second layer of the treasury is a wondrous lifeform known as the Heavenly Star Light Lotus. Even during the flourishing age of the ancient Star Sea, this creature was extraordinarily rare. Its dreamlike radiance could envelop half a star region, weaving itself into the form of a magnificent lotus. When the lotus bloomed, the entire star region was bathed in dazzling light. When it withered, the star region sank into lifeless darkness."

"Whenever a world within that star region perished, a lotus seed would form within the Heavenly Star Light Lotus. This cycle repeated for countless ages without end. The light spheres before you were formed in exactly this manner."

As Li Fan listened to Zhong Daogong's explanation, he could almost see the magnificent spectacle of the ancient Star Sea unfolding before his eyes.

"Back then, the Shang Immortal Ark took away many treasures. This Heavenly Star Light Lotus was one of the most valuable things left behind."

"The treasures are sealed within the lotus seeds and cannot easily be removed. If someone wished to seize them through brute force..."

Zhong Daogong let out a cold snort.

"Unless they destroy the entire Heavenly Star Light Lotus. This spiritual lifeform exists as a parasite upon the Star Sea itself. It has survived countless calamities throughout endless ages. Destroying it requires nothing less than Immortal-level power."

"Moreover, we have already tested it. Even by using the power of True Immortal seal script, it cannot be destroyed in a short period of time."

The elders of the Immortal Ark were clearly extremely confident in the Heavenly Star Light Lotus's protective abilities.

Li Fan, however, had a different thought flash through his mind.

'During my previous life, beneath the Grand Formation of All Things Return to the Void, this so-called Heavenly Star Light Lotus did not seem to last very long.'

'Now, I would not even need to use an Immortal-grade formation. The Descending Mortal Finger alone would be enough to destroy it. Destroying it is easy. Retrieving the treasures preserved within the lotus seeds is the truly difficult part.'

Naturally, the elders of the Immortal Ark had no idea of the dangerous thoughts running through Li Fan's mind.

Working together, they opened the three light spheres containing Sun Piaomiao's relics.

Everyone focused their attention on the three treasures.

Meanwhile, Li Fan's heart stirred slightly.

From the three-pronged tree, he sensed the same [Truth] reaction that he had felt from the bowing servant figurine.

However, he did not reveal it and instead carefully observed the relics alongside the elders.

The gray bird with the broken wings and the second Medicine King Cauldron appeared to contain no special power.

"'Guard Against Calamities and Ward Off Disasters.' It is almost like a projection of the Dao itself. Sun Piaomiao truly was extraordinary."

"And this ability was never passed down to the Medicine King Sect."

A flicker of light passed through Li Fan's eyes as he suppressed [Truth]'s eager desire to absorb it.

"Gentlemen, have any of you discovered anything?" Zhong Daogong asked after observing for quite some time.

"I cannot find anything unusual. But these objects truly do give me a very strange feeling."

Lu Yuzhi's words immediately drew agreement from the other elders.

If one did not already know that these three relics were extraordinary, then at first glance, nothing seemed out of place.

However, once one already knew there was something unusual about them, every careful observation produced an increasing sense of disharmony.

If only one or two people felt that way, it could be dismissed as an illusion.

But when all more than ten elders present experienced the same feeling...

Then it was certainly far more than mere imagination.

Chapter 1341: The Cause Of The World’S Destruction Back Then

"It is an ingenious method of concealment. Only those who deliberately search for these objects and know they may contain hidden secrets will notice anything unusual about them."

"As for everyone else..."

"They are nothing more than ordinary objects."

Everyone present gradually understood.

"If Brother Li had not accidentally uncovered the secret hidden within that figurine, then even after another thousand years, our Immortal Ark might never have discovered anything unusual about these relics," Lu Yuzhi said with a sigh.

"The problem now is that although we know they are extraordinary, we still have no way to uncover their secrets."

"Haha, there is no need to worry. We have already deciphered True Immortal seal script. Are we really supposed to be helpless before a few relics? Could it be that Sun Piaomiao is even greater than a True Immortal?"

The elders of the Immortal Ark were full of confidence.

And indeed, their talent was extraordinary.

After observing the relics continuously for seven days, someone finally discovered something unusual.

"Everyone, look carefully at this small cauldron."

The speaker was Mo Yinfeng, who was usually quiet and devoted entirely to his own research.

"During our previous examinations and appraisals, the Immortal Ark concluded that it was simply a supreme-grade alchemy treasure. It even contains a Cave Heaven space capable of generating spiritual energy on its own and cultivating spiritual herbs and crops. However..."

As he spoke, Mo Yinfeng struck out with a [Reveal] character.

The Medicine King Cauldron was immediately enveloped by it.

As though submerged within hazy luminous mist, tangible lines of varying thickness gradually emerged from the surrounding fog.

They sliced through space and extended toward different directions.

In an instant, they disappeared beyond everyone's field of vision.

"This is..."

"So the Medicine King Cauldron is not unique? It is connected to other existences somewhere within the Star Sea?"

The expressions of the Immortal Ark elders all changed.

Li Fan also narrowed his eyes.

Among everyone present, only he noticed that one of those misty lines pointed precisely toward the direction of the Xuanhuang Realm.

As for the others...

"The overwhelming majority extend toward the Remnant World Great Wall. However, another two or three lead somewhere deep within the Darkest Star Sea."

One of the abilities of the [Reveal] character was to reveal the hidden connections between all things.

The secret concealed by the Medicine King Cauldron for ten thousand years had finally been exposed beneath its illumination.

"If my guess is correct, Sun Piaomiao forged many Medicine King Cauldrons back then. These cauldrons exist as a single interconnected whole, linked together through some mysterious connection. Even when separated by more than half the star sea, they can still sense each other's existence."

Zhong Daogong gazed into the empty air, as though those vanished lines were still visible.

"Judging from the records left behind during Sun Piaomiao's stay aboard the Immortal Ark, he once traveled extensively throughout the Star Sea. The places he visited surpassed even those explored by the Immortal Ark. Since forging a Medicine King Cauldron is no simple matter, deliberately scattering them throughout the Star Sea must have served a purpose. One possibility is that he used their locations as anchors to determine his own position," Mo Yinfeng said calmly.

"I am afraid that was not the only purpose. At that time, the world-destroying catastrophe had not yet erupted. The locations of the cultivation worlds throughout the Star Sea were relatively stable. If his goal was merely to avoid getting lost, there were countless easier methods. Why would he go to such extraordinary lengths?"

"Exactly. If I remember correctly, the coordinates of each cultivation world were not considered highly classified information in those days. Since Sun Piaomiao could already traverse the Star Sea, obtaining accurate coordinates would not have been difficult."

The elders discussed the matter among themselves.

Mo Yinfeng quietly listened.

Only after everyone fell silent did he cough lightly before speaking in a somewhat distant tone.

"If his purpose had merely been to explore the known Star Sea, then naturally none of this would have been necessary."

"But what if his goal was to travel beyond the Great Void?"

The moment those words were spoken, everyone's expressions changed.

"The Great Void?"

It was a term Li Fan had never heard before.

The confusion on his face was genuine.

He turned toward Zhong Daogong, whose face showed thoughtful contemplation, hoping for an explanation.

After remaining silent for a while, Zhong Daogong slowly explained.

"Back then, the Xuan Immortal Ark traveled throughout every explored star region. Even in the wilderness at the very edge of the Star Sea, our merchants maintained permanent stations."

"However, the civilized regions of the Star Sea are not infinite. Beyond the outermost wilderness lies an endless expanse of absolute nothingness."

"It is called the Great Void."

"No one knows how vast it truly is."

"No one has ever managed to pass beyond it."

"Every cultivator who attempted to cross the Great Void ultimately shared the same fate."

"They became completely lost."

His expression turned solemn.

"However, compared to today's Darkest Star Sea, the explorable Star Sea of that era was filled with life. There was abundant room for cultivation worlds to flourish. The vast majority of cultivation worlds had not even reached the desolate frontier, so very few cultivators actually cared about the existence of the Great Void."

"But cultivators are, by nature, beings who seek to break every limitation imposed upon them."

"So there were always a handful who wished to cross the Great Void and uncover whatever secrets lay beyond."

"Sun Piaomiao was clearly one of them."

"Unfortunately, no one ever succeeded."

"He was no exception."

"The Great Void. The High Wall."

"It seems the predicament of cultivators has remained unchanged since ancient times," Li Fan said quietly.

At the same time, he thought to himself.

"'The Great Void. Could this have been the reason Sun Piaomiao failed to continue his exploration? If so, then the twelve coordinates he left behind become rather suspicious. Given the vastness of the regions he explored, he certainly visited far more than twelve cultivation worlds. Yet he intentionally preserved only these...'"

"'What secret was so important that it could not be stated directly, forcing him to conceal it in this manner?'"

Countless questions arose in Li Fan's mind.

"Unfettered Free, Xuanshang, Ocean of Light, Beige, Spiritual Mound..."

Having once served as the Young Sect Master of the Medicine King Sect, Li Fan naturally knew of the information that the founding ancestor Sun Piaomiao had passed down.

At the time, however, he had not paid much attention to it.

First, because the great catastrophe had descended and countless cultivation worlds had already been destroyed.

Second, because of the existence of the Immortal Ruins. Even if those cultivation worlds had survived, their spatial positions would inevitably have shifted.

The coordinates Sun Piaomiao left behind had therefore become meaningless.

"'But what if Sun Piaomiao had already foreseen that such a future would arrive, and deliberately left the Medicine King Cauldrons behind to assist in locating them?'"

A bold speculation suddenly appeared in Li Fan's mind. There was no concrete evidence supporting it. It was simply an inspiration that flashed through his thoughts.

Meanwhile, the discussion among the Immortal Ark elders continued.

"The power contained within the Medicine King Cauldron is extraordinarily mysterious. Perhaps this connection allows one to maintain a sense of direction within the Great Void. If so, then even if exploration ultimately failed, at least one could safely return instead of perishing meaninglessly."

"You must understand that the Great Void truly deserves its name. According to the limited records that remain, not only is there no light or spiritual energy there, even the medium through which divine sense can propagate does not exist. It is complete and absolute nothingness..."

Mo Yinfeng's speculation received the approval of many elders.

Exploring the Great Void had once been one of the highest ideals pursued by cultivators of that age.

Sun Piaomiao was entirely capable of attempting such a feat.

"Regardless of his true objective, if we can uncover the mysterious power maintaining the connection between these Medicine King Cauldrons, it will certainly benefit our Immortal Ark."

Now that they had a clear direction for their research, progress advanced much more smoothly.

After unanimous approval from the elders, including Li Fan, everyone decided to completely refine the Medicine King Cauldron and force out the mysterious power hidden within it.

As a famous alchemy cauldron, the sturdiness of the Medicine King Cauldron required no explanation.

After all, one of its counterparts had once carried the entire Medicine King Sect across the endless void.

However, before the Immortal Ark, which had already mastered the power of True Immortal seal script, such durability meant nothing.

Bang. Bang.

Under the crushing force of an invisible power, the ancient bronze cauldron instantly shattered into countless fragments.

The fragments continued to be ground apart, breaking down into particles even finer than dust.

In the end, every last particle disappeared.

Yet as the dissolution process continued, the expressions of the Immortal Ark elders gradually became increasingly solemn.

Because they discovered that the material composing the Medicine King Cauldron did not vanish as greater external force was applied.

It merely became even more condensed.

"Our previous analysis concluded that the Medicine King Cauldron had been forged by refining rare ores together with heavenly treasures gathered from various cultivation worlds."

"It now appears that was merely an illusion."

"This material..."

The Immortal Ark elders stared fixedly at the final transformation within the force field.

It had become so small that it could no longer be seen with the naked eye. Had they not been monitoring it from beginning to end, even divine sense would have struggled to detect it.

Condensed to the absolute limit, it was not a perfect sphere.

Instead, it was slightly flattened, convex on both sides, resembling a single Go piece.

"The enormous Medicine King Cauldron was actually transformed from this?"

The elders were all dumbfounded.

Li Fan also gazed at the gray Go piece, but his thoughts drifted back to the lifetime in which his Holy Embryo clone had wielded the enhanced Medicine King Cauldron and charged into the Immortal Ruins.

"At the time, I was so overwhelmed by the True Immortal's world destroying gaze that I did not notice anything unusual. Looking back now, there were several unreasonable aspects."

"In the eyes of a True Immortal, cultivators are no different from ants. Let alone my Holy Embryo, who only possessed the cultivation of a mortal at the time."

"If a True Immortal was in secluded cultivation, how could they possibly have been disturbed?"

"It is just like when I enter seclusion. I am never interrupted by ants. Before they can even approach, my protective methods reduce them to nothingness."

"And yet, that True Immortal within the Immortal Ruins really was interrupted during seclusion."

"When I destroyed the Xuanhuang Realm with an Immortal Formation in my previous life, They merely sent out a single projection to investigate."

"But in that lifetime..."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes, as though returning once again to that scene.

Within the pitch black darkness, a vast barren wilderness suddenly appeared.

Countless ruins lay scattered across the wasteland.

The True Immortal was nothing more than skin hanging loosely over a skeleton, resembling a corpse.

Dozens of crimson chains were deeply embedded into the ground, binding the True Immortal firmly upon the wilderness.

The moment They sensed Li Fan, or rather the Medicine King Cauldron under his control, the True Immortal, who was comprehending the Dao, suddenly opened Their eyes.

"So that is the truth. What caused the True Immortal to open Their eyes was not simply an external object intruding into the Immortal Ruins."

"It was this mysterious Go piece material used to forge the Medicine King Cauldron."

Li Fan's thoughts returned to the present.

Like the elders around him, he stared intently at the gray Go piece.

Now that it had returned to its original form, its connection with its "companions" scattered throughout the Star Sea seemed to have become even stronger.

Without needing to use the [Reveal] True Immortal seal script character, everyone present could vaguely sense the direction of those connections.

However, the connection flickered intermittently, making it impossible to use as reliable guidance.

"It seems that possessing the Go piece alone is not enough. There must also be a corresponding special method." Zhong Daogong also perceived the mystery behind it.

"Interesting. Now I am truly curious about what exactly Sun Piaomiao has been trying so hard to conceal."

"Although the origin of this gray Go piece is mysterious, I do not believe it is directly related to immortal power. After all, the Immortal Ark has collected quite a number of immortal artifacts before. We are confident in our judgment in this regard."

...

"I, on the other hand, believe this gray Go piece may truly have originated from the Immortal Realm," Li Fan suddenly said, presenting an entirely different opinion amid the elders' discussion.

"Oh? Brother Li, what makes you say that?"

Li Fan had already established considerable prestige within the Immortal Ark. None of the elders dared dismiss his conclusions lightly and immediately asked for his reasoning.

Li Fan answered in a deep voice, "It is very simple. Just observe this object's reaction to the [Reveal] True Immortal seal script character. The answer should become obvious."

The elders were briefly stunned.

Then quite a few of them suddenly slapped their thighs as realization dawned.

"Indeed. Although the [Reveal] character reveals connections between things, the Medicine King Cauldron, or rather this gray Go piece, reacted far too sensitively to the residual power of the True Immortal."

"Exactly!"

To verify Li Fan's speculation, Lu Yuzhi produced a seven colored stone.

"This stone was carved from a piece of Jade Crystal Marrow. There are eighteen pieces in the complete set. The other seventeen remain in my residence."

As he spoke, he activated the [Reveal] True Immortal seal script character.

The power of the True Immortal seal script enveloped the seven colored stone.

It was as though immortal power slowly seeped into it. Only after a long while did mist and fine threads indicating its connections emerge from within the stone.

The difference compared to the Medicine King Cauldron's earlier reaction was obvious at a glance.

"We previously believed it was because the cauldron contained some mysterious power. Looking back now, it was actually caused by the material itself."

"There is an absolute distinction between immortals and mortals. Objects originating from the Immortal Realm naturally possess a much greater sensitivity to immortal power."

The elders sighed in amazement.

"And do not forget. The indication from that Go piece just now proved that many more identical objects exist throughout the Star Sea. Objects from the Immortal Realm..."

Everyone's eyes lit up.

Only Zhong Daogong remained calm.

"Let us first determine exactly what this gray Go piece is."

"When its nature remains unknown, something from the Immortal Realm may bring disaster rather than fortune."

Now that they had confirmed the object's origin, the Immortal Ark naturally had a complete research procedure for studying artifacts originating from the Immortal Realm.

There was no longer any need to worry about the power of the True Immortal seal script damaging the object. They could freely employ various True Immortal seal script characters to conduct extensive testing.

While participating in these experiments, Li Fan also saw, for the first time, the Immortal Ark's greatest research treasure.

It was a completely blank scroll.

"The Myriad Manifestations Yin-Yang Painting? The painting is clearly blank. Why is it called by such a name?" Li Fan asked curiously.

Zhong Daogong answered with obvious pride.

"It is precisely because it encompasses all the myriad manifestations beneath heaven that it appears completely blank."

Chapter 1342: A True Immortal Lays Out The Go Board

"The method of using this Myriad Manifestations Yin-Yang Painting is quite simple. It is like a mirror. It reveals the true essence of things upon the blank scroll. Of course, it may not present everything so directly. Some further comprehension may still be required."

"But no matter what, it is far easier than directly researching this gray Go piece."

As Zhong Daogong spoke, his lips moved slightly as he slowly unfurled the blank scroll.

Like a long dragon, it floated above everyone's heads.

"Go."

The gray Go piece slowly flew toward the Myriad Manifestations Yin-Yang Painting. At the instant it drew near, it vanished from everyone's sight.

Meanwhile, colors began to appear upon the previously blank scroll, as though countless pigments had been dripped across it. Strange and bizarre images gradually emerged.

It resembled a storm of swirling paint. Different colors intertwined, collided, separated, and merged.

"This Myriad Manifestations Yin-Yang Painting can actually analyze objects from the Immortal Realm. Could it also have originated from the Immortal Realm?" Li Fan casually asked as he watched the ever-changing images upon the scroll.

"No, no."

Jian Daosheng smiled and answered Li Fan's question.

"This painting is unquestionably an artifact of the lower realms."

"It was acquired by the Xuan Immortal Ark from a destitute cultivator many years ago."

"That cultivator's ancestors were originally direct disciples of the renowned Star Dao Sect. In ancient times, the Star Dao Sect's influence extended across several neighboring cultivation worlds. It was said that the sect's supreme arts could control the Dao of the Star Sea itself, surpassing even the Taijia Divine Art that Fellow Daoist has taught us."

Li Fan raised an eyebrow.

"How did such a glorious great sect decline?"

"That remains one of history's greatest mysteries. Even back then, countless theories existed, yet no definitive answer was ever found. Some claimed they offended a True Immortal of the upper realm, bringing down immortal punishment. Others believed the Star Dao Sect attempted to refine and control the Heavenly Dao of the Star Sea itself, only to suffer its backlash."

"In any case, for reasons unknown, the Star Dao Sect's upper echelon and backbone cultivators all seemed to vanish overnight. The remaining lower-ranked disciples, who understood nothing of what had happened, waited for a short time before realizing there was no hope of recovery. They scattered in every direction. Before leaving, they made sure to loot every valuable treasure they could carry."

"In barely a month's time, this once mighty sect that had dominated the Star Sea completely collapsed."

Jian Daosheng sighed softly.

"This Myriad Manifestations Yin-Yang Painting was one of the Star Dao Sect's treasures. It is said that within the sect's Star Communion Hall, where Star Dao Sect cultivators communicated with and comprehended the Heavenly Dao of the Star Sea, countless such paintings hung upon the walls."

"Whenever the Heavenly Dao of the Star Sea resonated with a cultivator, it was as though an invisible brush left traces upon the scroll. Over time, these paintings gradually copied portions of the Heavenly Dao of the Star Sea into themselves."

...

Hearing this, Li Fan interrupted.

"Even if they contain an engraved image of the Heavenly Dao of the Star Sea, how could they possibly reveal objects from the Immortal Realm?"

Although he deliberately pretended ignorance, Li Fan had already reached his own conclusion.

Zhong Daogong smiled.

"The Star Sea and the lower realms are the foundation of all existence."

"They are where the projections of the Great Dao ultimately manifest. Although the Immortal Realm stands high above, it is not a castle built in the air. Looking upward from below, one cannot glimpse its true form, but one can still perceive the shadow of its Dao."

Upon hearing this, Li Fan acted as though he were encountering this theory for the very first time. His expression changed dramatically as he appeared lost in deep contemplation.

Meanwhile, the Myriad Manifestations Yin-Yang Painting continued its transformation.

It was as though an invisible True Immortal wielded a brush with effortless mastery, painting with sweeping strokes.

Eventually, the storm of colors settled into a single image.

The painting became completely still.

Li Fan gazed at the picture overhead, his pupils contracting slightly.

It was not a highly detailed realistic depiction.

Instead, it was an abstract ink painting that merely outlined its subjects.

A towering figure occupied nearly half of the entire image, looking down from above.

Its face could not be seen.

One impossibly long arm extended outward.

Beneath the figure appeared to be a Go Board.

The pieces arranged upon it were not gray Go pieces.

Instead, each Go piece was an entirely different cultivation world.

What initially appeared to be nothing more than clusters of blended colors suddenly transformed, the moment one attempted to observe them carefully, into countless scenes of different living beings.

Within those worlds, they were born, aged, fell ill, died, cultivated, and fought. The stories of those countless lives, together with the cultivation worlds themselves, ultimately became individual Go pieces upon the board.

Boom.

After remaining visible for several breaths, the Myriad Manifestations Yin-Yang Painting suddenly seemed to be struck by a violent gale.

Not only did the scroll itself sway violently, but even the pigments upon the canvas were swept away by the raging wind.

The image gradually disintegrated.

The gray Go piece slowly emerged once more from the painting.

"The Myriad Manifestations Painting has reached the limit of its analysis."

Zhong Daogong spoke gravely as he joined the other elders in carefully putting away the Myriad Manifestations Yin-Yang Painting.

Afterward, everyone stared silently at the gray Go piece floating quietly in midair.

An eerie silence filled the room.

"If I understand correctly, this gray Go piece seems to represent a cultivation world after all living beings have perished and all life has withered away. That towering figure should be a True Immortal from the upper realm."

Li Fan was once again the first to speak.

No one answered.

Only after quite some time did Elder Jian Daosheng slowly shake his head and offer his own opinion.

"Although the Myriad Manifestations Painting reveals the true essence of things, it is never so superficial."

"The Medicine King Cauldron is practically a world unto itself. It can naturally generate spiritual energy and nurture spiritual herbs and medicinal plants."

"How could a world completely devoid of life possibly accomplish such a thing?"

Zhong Daogong nodded in agreement.

"Precisely."

"I believe that this world embodied by the Go piece does not represent death."

"Rather, it represents a world that has already fulfilled its purpose upon the Go Board and has become a discarded piece."

As he spoke, intersecting lines appeared, forming a Go Board where black and white pieces were placed one after another.

Soon afterward, the black pieces completely surrounded and captured a group of white pieces.

Those captured white pieces left the board.

Never again could they return.

Their colors faded into gray, no longer participating in the struggle between black and white.

"Elder Zhong's interpretation seems much more reasonable."

The elders of the Xuan Immortal Ark rarely engaged in political scheming among themselves. They simply voiced whatever they truly believed.

Most of the elders agreed with Zhong Daogong's interpretation of the painting.

"True Immortals play the game, while the lower worlds become their Go pieces."

"If that is truly the case, then what is the purpose behind this game?"

"And in the end, is there even a true victor?"

An even greater mystery now arose within everyone's hearts.

"There is no need to investigate matters involving True Immortals for now."

"What we know at present is that this gray Go piece was most likely created by a True Immortal through refining an entire world into an artifact."

"Even without immortal spiritual power sustaining it, it should still qualify as half an immortal artifact."

"And not just one, but an entire set."

"If even these gray Go pieces, which have already lost their place in the game, possess such miraculous abilities, it is difficult to imagine what the black and white world pieces that still remained upon the Go Board must have been like."

Lu Yuzhi spoke with obvious longing.

"Heh. Do not forget that the Immortal Realm has already been destroyed."

"Even the players themselves may already have perished."

"Those worlds remaining upon the Go Board most likely disappeared together with the Immortal Realm long ago."

"On the contrary, these gray Go pieces, having left the game beforehand, survived through a fortunate coincidence after being transformed into artifacts."

...

The elders of the Xuan Immortal Ark continued discussing the matter.

After half a day of deliberation, they finally reached a preliminary consensus.

Since the gray Go piece was fundamentally an entire world, they would refine it using the same methods employed to refine a world itself.

The elders selected Jian Daosheng, Zhong Daogong, and three others.

Each would separate a portion of their divine consciousness and jointly begin refining the gray Go piece.

Li Fan was not among the five chosen participants.

To avoid causing any displeasure, the elders of the Xuan Immortal Ark even offered an explanation.

Although Li Fan had already earned the trust of the elders, he had only joined the Immortal Ark recently. More importantly, his "lifespan was nearly exhausted."

If he were allowed to participate now, then after less than twenty years, once he passed away, the refinement process would have to be repeated from the beginning.

And so on.

...

Li Fan waved his hand, wearing an unconcerned expression.

His gaze remained fixed on the gray Go piece that the elders were refining.

'This object is one of Sun Piaomiao's hidden arrangements. If anything abnormal occurs during the refinement, it will prove that Sun Piaomiao is still alive...' Li Fan silently pondered.

Unfortunately, he was disappointed.

The refinement process carried out by the elders of the Immortal Ark proceeded with astonishing smoothness.

Before long, the refined Go piece seemed to lose some of its gray coloration.

However, the gray color never completely faded away.

'Has Sun Piaomiao truly fallen?'

The question flashed through Li Fan's mind before he temporarily suppressed it. He then asked Zhong Daogong and the others about their impressions.

"Marvelous. The originally orderly Heavenly Dao of the world has seemingly been reforged under countless mighty hammer strikes. Such methods are simply miraculous. Truly miraculous!"

"It is not merely a single form that has been forged. It has already forged hundreds of possible future forms. After refining it, one can freely control it and transform between those different states at will."

"Although... such transformations seem to require an enormous amount of energy. Spiritual qi alone is far from sufficient."

"I even tried using the power of True Immortal seal script characters. That was not enough either." Nangong Lie's voice was filled with regret.

Like children who had just obtained a fascinating new treasure, the elders of the Immortal Ark eagerly began researching the gray Go piece.

"This object is of immense significance to our Immortal Ark."

"Perhaps our resource shortage will be greatly alleviated for a very long time."

"What a pity. Such an invaluable treasure remained buried within our treasury all these years. Had Brother Li not reminded us, who knows how much longer it would have remained forgotten."

The joy and regret of the elders intertwined as they once again transformed the gray Go piece.

This time, it no longer became the Medicine King Cauldron capable of nurturing spiritual plants.

Instead, it assumed the form most suitable for the current Immortal Ark.

Bang. Bang. Bang.

It was as though countless invisible giant hammers continuously struck the gray Go piece.

The originally tiny object gradually unfolded across space itself.

It spread directly over the outer shell of the Immortal Ark.

Under Li Fan's watchful gaze, the Immortal Ark seemed to grow an additional layer of hard gray armor.

This gray shell not only provided protection.

It also continuously supplied spiritual qi and resources to the Immortal Ark.

"With an entire world's protective shell covering the Ark, our defensive capability has increased by far more than double. Even its overall stability has undergone a qualitative leap."

"We no longer need to worry that the original power of a single True Immortal seal script character spreading freely will bring catastrophic destruction upon the Ark."

"The ten thousand years of accumulated life force stored within the gray Go piece has now been completely transferred into the Divine Tree."

"The results are remarkable. At the very least, for the next hundred years, unless something extraordinary occurs, the Divine Tree will no longer need to feed."

...

Every elder of the Immortal Ark wore broad smiles.

At that moment, Li Fan suddenly spoke in a cold voice.

"Everyone, now that your harvest has been so tremendous, surely you are not planning to abandon the plan of crossing the High Wall?"

The lively atmosphere immediately became silent.

The elders instinctively avoided Li Fan's gaze.

In the end, Zhong Daogong stepped forward to reassure him.

"You need not worry."

"Crossing the High Wall has always been our established strategy. It will not change simply because our resources have become more abundant. You may rest assured on that."

"However..."

"The better prepared we are, the better. According to the mutual resonance between these gray Go pieces, there are at least eleven more of them scattered throughout the Darkest Star Sea."

"Just this single piece has already brought almost earthshaking changes to our Immortal Ark. If we could gather the entire set..." Zhong Daogong's eyes shone brightly.

"What do you think, Fellow Daoist? By then, we might not even need any additional assistance. The defensive layers alone could directly smash through the High Wall."

"Furthermore, the direction indicated by their mutual resonance is very clear. At our current speed, even if we had to travel throughout the entire Star Sea, it would take no more than three years. At the same time, collecting them would not interfere with any of our other preparations."

Zhong Daogong's explanation was perfectly reasonable.

Li Fan pondered for a moment before nodding slightly in agreement.

Only then did the somewhat awkward atmosphere return to normal.

"In that case, there is no time to waste. Let us depart immediately."

"I am also very curious to see what will happen once the complete set of gray Go pieces has been assembled," Li Fan said calmly.

The elders exchanged glances before holding a brief council.

Their first conclusion was unanimous.

"The Xuan Immortal Ark itself absolutely must not be moved lightly."

"Correct. The Ark's current structural strength is still insufficient to withstand the pressure beneath the High Wall."

"There is no need for all of us to go searching for the gray Go pieces. That would only be cumbersome. It would be far more convenient to travel individually."

"One person can remain behind to use the resonance for guidance and direct the search. The others can spread throughout the Star Sea to recover the gray Go pieces."

"That should be much more efficient."

"Each group should consist of at least three people, in case of unexpected danger."

"Seven or eight of the Go pieces are relatively close to our current location. They appear to be near the Remnant World Great Wall. We should recover those first."

...

As the elders discussed the matter, Li Fan also spoke.

"I can contribute as well. With my movement technique, even crossing the entire Star Sea requires only a single day."

This time, the elders of the Immortal Ark had no reason to reject Li Fan's proposal.

Once the preliminary arrangements had been finalized, the first mission to recover the gray Go pieces was assigned to Li Fan, Nangong Lie, Lu Yuzhi, and another Academy of Dao Attainment elder named Xu Gongding.

"First investigate the situation. If you encounter any danger, preserving your own lives takes priority above everything else," Zhong Daogong instructed before they departed.

Chapter 1343: Forging Fragments Of The Immortal World

Within the Remnant World Great Wall.

Li Fan rode the phantom Wooden Sword, carrying the three elders of the Immortal Ark, Nangong Lie, Lu Yuzhi, and Xu Gongding, as they slowly traveled through its depths.

"Brother Li, this movement technique of yours is truly heaven defying. Not only is it incredibly fast, it also reduces the influence of the echoing star force throughout the surroundings. With your protection, our search for the gray Go pieces should proceed much more smoothly," Nangong Lie said with admiration.

Lu Yuzhi nodded in agreement.

"Indeed. Otherwise, merely resisting this terrifying suction would consume the vast majority of our strength."

Xu Gongding remained silent, his eyes constantly scanning the surrounding void, doing his utmost to locate the gray Go pieces.

The resonance between objects belonging to the same set was insufficient to pinpoint an exact location. It could only vaguely indicate a general region.

Within the Remnant World Great Wall lay countless fragments of shattered worlds.

The gray Go pieces, meanwhile, had concealed themselves in the form of artifacts within those world fragments.

Finding them was no different from searching for a needle in the ocean.

Especially since divine sense was also suppressed here, making the search even more difficult.

Having personally experienced it now, Li Fan finally understood the Heavenly Doctor's predicament.

Spending several thousand years collecting the fragments of the Heavenly Law Realm without finishing the task was entirely understandable.

Fortunately, the mysterious power the gray Go pieces used to conceal themselves was exceptionally unusual. As long as one already knew the secret hidden within them, a single glance was enough to notice something abnormal.

There was no need to worry about overlooking them during the search.

Their luck was also remarkably good. Only three days later, they found the first lost chess piece.

It lay quietly upon the ruins of a devastated land. It had taken the form of a bronze war chariot covered in rust.

Five magnificent divine steeds stood proudly before the chariot with their heads held high.

The surface of the chariot was covered with countless sword and blade scars, giving it the appearance of having endured endless ages of hardship.

Rather than restoring the chariot to its original form in the void, the four simply stored it away for safekeeping. Once they returned to the Immortal Ark, it would be handed over to the Council of Elders for processing.

The first success greatly encouraged everyone.

Over the next ten days, the phantom Wooden Sword moved continuously, carrying them back and forth throughout the Remnant World Great Wall.

They found three more disguised Go pieces.

One was a broken sword.

One was an ordinary looking wine gourd.

The last was a tiny wooden boat.

"I cannot continue. I need to rest for a while."

Just as they were preparing to continue the search, Li Fan's face suddenly turned pale as he spoke weakly.

Lu Yuzhi immediately understood.

"We overlooked this. Such a heaven defying divine ability must consume an enormous amount of energy. Brother Li has used it continuously over the past several days. No wonder you've reached your limit..."

Nangong Lie asked with concern.

"How long will you need to recover, Brother Li? Without your movement technique, our search efficiency will become unbearably slow."

Li Fan answered with a solemn expression.

"Do not worry. Give me three days and I will recover. Spiritual energy consumption is only a minor issue. The real burden is the tremendous exhaustion of my mind."

Lu Yuzhi first lavishly praised Li Fan before seizing the opportunity to inquire about the principles behind this movement technique.

The elders of the Immortal Ark had long coveted Li Fan's miraculous phantom Wooden Sword movement technique.

However, although Li Fan had always generously shared everything else he learned, he remained exceptionally tight lipped regarding this Wooden Sword divine ability. He had never revealed even the slightest detail.

The elders naturally refused to give up and attempted to probe whenever an opportunity arose.

This time, however, Li Fan's attitude toward secrecy appeared to soften slightly.

"My movement technique is formed from the fusion of two supreme Dao intents."

"The first is the Sword."

"It embodies the unstoppable momentum of advancing forward with fearless courage."

"As for the second..."

Li Fan deliberately paused, whetting the curiosity of the three elders before continuing leisurely.

"It is the Dao of Near Yet Distant."

"The ends of heaven and the corners of the sea are merely within arm's reach. Crossing the Star Sea may seem incomparably distant, but if everything exists only a short distance apart, then a single step is enough to arrive."

He then gave the three elders a detailed explanation of these two supreme Dao intents.

The three listened attentively, nodding repeatedly as they sank into deep contemplation.

Li Fan, meanwhile, revealed an indescribable smile.

Throughout his explanation, he had not distorted or fabricated anything.

Given the knowledge possessed by the elders of the Immortal Ark, any falsehoods would have been easily exposed.

Li Fan had merely concealed the most crucial element.

The true core of this escape technique was the [Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood].

Sword Dao.

Near Yet Distant.

Without the enhancement provided by the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood, neither of them alone could allow one to ignore the countless dangers and remnants of True Immortal power filling the Star Sea during flight as Li Fan did.

Li Fan intentionally revealed part of his divine ability for one purpose. To divert the attention of the three Immortal Ark elders.

Naturally, his true objective was the four recovered gray Go pieces.

Perhaps because the Immortal Ancestor's betrayal in the past had left lasting psychological scars, even though the four people sent to search for the Go pieces were, in theory, almost incapable of betraying the Immortal Ark, strict precautions were still enforced.

The Immortal Ark required all four of them to guard the pieces together.

Each person held one fragment of a spherical artifact.

When the four fragments were combined, they formed a sealed storage space that contained the recovered Go pieces.

Only with the combined effort of all four could the sealed Go pieces be removed.

Otherwise, they could only observe and supervise them.

Originally, all four frequently directed part of their attention toward the stored Go pieces.

However, after Li Fan casually revealed part of the secrets behind his supreme movement technique, the other three elders inevitably became distracted as they pondered everything he had taught them.

As a result, Li Fan gained much more time to secretly study the mysteries hidden within the gray Go pieces without attracting suspicion.

"Returning from the gray Go piece form requires an enormous supply of energy."

"Spiritual energy is insufficient."

"True Immortal power is also insufficient."

"Yet the Immortal Ark transformed them into armored keratin forms without anyone noticing..."

"It seems there are still treasures hidden within the second and third layers of the Immortal Ark's treasury."

Li Fan let out a cold snort inwardly as his divine sense continuously swept across the four Go pieces.

"They were forged from Worlds themselves."

"Perhaps they are gray Go pieces formed from worlds that have lost their value."

"If the Heavenly Doctor's Mending Heaven Record treats worlds as though they were human beings..."

"Then the being who forged this set of Go pieces regarded worlds as artifacts."

"Humans and artifacts may be different."

"But the underlying principles are identical."

"The prerequisite for transformation is complete mastery over their fundamental structure."

As he sensed the four creations before him, Li Fan silently recited the Mending Heaven Record.

After comprehending and modifying its countless tiny passages, they gradually transformed into an entirely different text.

"I merely followed the existing framework."

"I replaced the principles of the human body with the methods of artifact forging."

"Although certain portions were forcibly converted and make absolutely no sense..."

"The overwhelming majority..."

"...actually works."

Li Fan's eyes lit up.

Within his vision, the four objects inside the sealed storage space immediately changed.

The broken sword, war chariot, and the other physical forms all disappeared.

In their place appeared countless glowing lines, crisscrossing vertically and horizontally.

All of those illuminated lines ultimately converged at the same origin.

Beyond them lay even more countless dim lines, incomparably intricate in number.

"The origin of these lines represents the original gray Go piece form."

"The dim lines represent every other form the Go piece can transform into."

"How beautiful..."

Li Fan was almost completely absorbed by what he saw.

He had once directly witnessed the fundamental principles of heaven and earth within the Xuanhuang Realm.

The countless horizontal and vertical lines that formed the innumerable living beings and all the different phenomena of the world intertwined and stretched across heaven and earth. Li Fan had originally believed that the world's underlying principles were already complex enough.

But compared to what this gray Go piece had unfolded before him...

"The principles that make up the Xuanhuang Realm are only a small part of it."

"The rest were forged by True Immortals using the laws of the Immortal Realm. They exist beyond the world itself."

Li Fan's heart trembled.

"By observing these, perhaps I can vaguely glimpse a corner of the former Immortal Realm."

Li Fan closed his eyes, pretending to rest. In reality, he was concealing the tremendous waves that had suddenly risen within his heart.

The Immortal Realm had suffered the Dao Annihilation Calamity and had been destroyed for more than ten thousand years.

Everything that had once belonged to the Immortal Realm had become a thing of the past.

Even the True Immortals of old had become exceedingly rare. They had become prey hunted by civilizations beyond the High Wall.

Yet now, Li Fan had discovered fragments of the Immortal Realm that had been hidden through a special forging method.

Or rather, calling them fragments was already somewhat exaggerated.

They were merely traces of higher Immortal Realm laws that had been incorporated while refining a lower realm cultivation world.

Even so, for those living ten thousand years after the immortal path had been severed, they still possessed extraordinary significance.

Especially for Li Fan.

"The law fragments contained within a single Go piece are far too few."

"But what if I could gather an entire set?"

"When Sun Piaomiao founded the Medicine King Sect, judging solely from his understanding of medical principles, his comprehension of the world and the Heavenly Dao may not have been inferior to the Heavenly Doctor."

"If I can perceive the mystery within these Go pieces, there is no reason he could not. Especially since he used such a special method to leave this secret behind for future generations through his travel journal."

"If these Immortal Realm fragments can truly be restored through fusion..."

A flash of inspiration suddenly crossed Li Fan's mind.

"Could this be, in a certain sense, a plan to preserve the final spark?"

But only an instant later, Li Fan naturally thought of another use for these gray Go pieces.

"My plan to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm is already nearly perfect."

"If I can further incorporate fragments of the former Immortal Realm..."

"The laws of the Immortal Realm would become heavenly pillars, strengthening the fundamental principles of the Xuanhuang Realm."

"Transforming it into a true Immortal Domain would only be a matter of time."

Li Fan rapidly deduced the possibilities. The result made his heart pound with excitement.

"Furthermore, if the Immortal Ark truly gathers all of these gray Go pieces, I fear they will lose all ambition to cross the High Wall."

With Li Fan's insight, he naturally saw that Zhong Daogong's previous words had merely been an attempt to calm everyone temporarily.

"However, I will need someone to cooperate with me in putting on a performance."

After some thought, he had already settled on a plan. Another day later, Li Fan pretended that he had barely recovered.

After briefly sensing the locations of Yin Shangren and Hundred Flowers, he controlled the phantom Wooden Sword and flew toward them.

The direction he traveled happened to overlap with the sensing range of one of the gray Go pieces.

Therefore, it did not arouse the suspicion of the Immortal Ark elders.

"Hm? This Ruined World Great Wall seems somewhat different from before."

While flying, Li Fan suddenly spoke with uncertainty.

The moment those words left his mouth, the three Immortal Ark elders, who had been secretly comprehending the Dao, were immediately startled awake.

They carefully investigated the surroundings before all shaking their heads in confusion.

"Could it be that Brother Li exhausted himself too much and is merely imagining things?"

"We have not sensed anything unusual."

Faced with their doubts, Li Fan still wore a solemn expression.

Yet he could not explain exactly what felt wrong.

The three Immortal Ark elders exchanged glances and also became tense.

Li Fan's nervousness appeared completely genuine.

Sometimes a cultivator's inexplicable intuition was even more reliable than deliberate investigation. None of them dared to lower their guard and remained on high alert against any possible disaster.

Perhaps Li Fan truly was simply being overly suspicious.

An entire incense stick's worth of time passed without anything unusual happening. Only then did the tightly wound elders gradually relax.

"It seems Brother Li was worrying too much." Nangong Lie laughed.

Li Fan sighed.

"Perhaps."

They continued searching through the Ruined World Great Wall.

Not long afterward, Li Fan suddenly became alarmed once more.

"No. Be careful!"

His repeated alarms instantly caused the auras of the Immortal Ark elders to surge, and the True Immortal seal script characters they had prepared were ready to activate at any moment.

However...

They carefully observed their surroundings and waited for quite some time.

Still, nothing happened.

The three elders stared directly at Li Fan.

Somewhat embarrassed, Li Fan explained, "I do not know what is happening today. My heart keeps pounding as if some great catastrophe is about to befall me at any moment."

"You may not know this, but my spiritual intuition has always been exceptionally accurate. It was precisely because of this keen intuition that I escaped numerous deadly calamities in the past."

"I simply cannot ignore it."

Li Fan smiled bitterly.

Lu Yuzhi comforted him.

"It is fine. Being cautious is never a bad thing. Perhaps the previous journey exhausted your mind too greatly, and you have not fully recovered yet. Why not rest for a while?"

Li Fan shook his head.

"If I stop moving, I become even more uneasy."

"Let us continue."

The three elders could hardly refuse.

They could only continue following Li Fan.

After Li Fan repeated the same false alarms twice more, even the three Immortal Ark elders had become mentally exhausted.

Nangong Lie looked as though he wanted to speak but hesitated.

Lu Yuzhi was considering how to persuade Li Fan to take a proper rest.

Little did they know that Li Fan had already located Yin Shangren and Hundred Flowers.

He quietly established contact with them. Their communication was completed almost immediately.

Li Fan's expression changed dramatically once again before the three elders.

"Be careful!"

This time, instead of becoming alert, the Immortal Ark elders were so irritated that they laughed.

"Brother Li, you..."

Before he could finish speaking, an incomparably terrifying aura of death swept over them in an instant.

It was as though they had personally fallen into the scene of a world's destruction.

All four of them froze momentarily.

At the same time, the vitality within their bodies began to drain away at an astonishing speed.

While they stood motionless, the sealed sphere jointly containing the four gray Go pieces suddenly lost control for no apparent reason.

It fell out into the void.

"This is bad!"

Nangong Lie's expression changed drastically as he instantly regained his senses.

The [Suppression] seal script immediately struck toward the direction from which the death aura had originated.

However, the attacker had apparently anticipated his reaction and had already fled that location.

Nangong Lie's attack struck only empty space.

Lu Yuzhi also regained consciousness at this moment.

After examining the rapidly disappearing vitality of everyone present, his expression changed dramatically.
