Chapter 1344: Li Fan’S Self Defense

The elders of the Immortal Ark were far older than they appeared.

Over the course of thousands of years, they had repeatedly used the [Ancient] Character seal script to reverse their own state. Time after time, they returned to youth and maintained their youthful appearance. However, reversing one's age was not the same as attaining eternal life.

Old age had still been quietly accumulating within them.

Now, after Lu Yuzhi and the others were struck by Yin Shangren's death aura, all the accumulated aging from countless years erupted at once.

As a result, the effect of the Death Character was even more terrifying than anyone had imagined.

The hair of the three Immortal Ark elders turned completely white in an instant, as though covered in frost. Deep wrinkles rapidly spread across their faces.

The aura of decay surged from within their bodies.

"Ancient!"

Having recovered his senses, Lu Yuzhi forcibly calmed himself. With a slightly trembling hand, he swiftly wrote an Ancient character into the void.

Its target was not the unknown enemy, but themselves.

Under the power of the Ancient character, the rapid aging of their bodies was somewhat slowed.

However, it only treated the symptoms, not the root cause.

The source of this reversing power was not the genuine True Immortal seal script, but merely a crude imitation. The extent to which it could reverse their condition was far inferior to the speed at which they were aging.

Meanwhile, the surrounding death aura storm only continued to intensify. If this continued, the four of them would soon be reduced to piles of white bones.

Under the combined effects of the death aura storm and the Ancient character, Li Fan and Xu Gongding also suddenly regained consciousness.

Their faces were filled with horror and confusion.

"Run!"

Lu Yuzhi struggled to hold on as he roared at Li Fan.

Li Fan's originally black and white hair had already become completely snow white. Yet he looked toward the direction in which the sealed sphere had disappeared, hesitating.

"But that gray Go piece..."

"If your life is gone, then nothing else matters!"

Although Lu Yuzhi was equally unwilling to let it go, he still roared those words.

"Ahhh!"

With a roar of frustration, the phantom of a Wooden Sword left its sheath, temporarily easing the assault of the death aura.

Sword light flashed, carrying the four of them out of the terrifying sea of death aura.

Only after their figures disappeared beyond the horizon did Hundred Flowers and Yin Shangren slowly reveal themselves.

Releasing such a massive death aura storm all at once was no easy task for Yin Shangren, who had only recently absorbed the Yin-Yang Pearl.

The black and white pupils in his eyes spun faster and faster, almost beyond his control.

He had no choice but to close his eyes and calm himself.

Meanwhile, following Li Fan's instructions, Hundred Flowers continuously cast streams of golden light, sealing the sphere they had just seized.

"I wonder who those three people accompanying the Holy Teacher really were."

"The characters they used seemed identical to the residual True Immortal power scattered throughout the Star Sea."

"That said, the Holy Teacher's acting was truly remarkable. If he had not secretly transmitted a message instructing us to cooperate, even I would have been deceived."

Hundred Flowers wore a complicated expression as she continued constructing the sealing formation without pause.

This sealing formation was extraordinarily profound, but with Li Fan's guidance, Hundred Flowers was barely able to complete it.

...

Outside the Great Wall of the Remnant World.

The Immortal Ark group that had narrowly escaped death still looked deeply shaken.

Although they had escaped the range of the death aura storm, traces of death aura still remained within their bodies.

It continuously eroded their lifespan.

"Return to the Immortal Ark first."

Lu Yuzhi had become incomparably frail, looking like an elderly mortal in his seventies or eighties, seemingly on the verge of death. Even speaking those four simple words exhausted nearly all his strength.

The others looked little better.

Li Fan in particular could only shake his head slightly, indicating that he had become so weak he no longer possessed the strength to use any movement techniques.

Among the four, only Nangong Lie remained in relatively better condition.

He carried the others while flying toward the Immortal Ark and simultaneously released a distress signal.

About the time it took to drink a cup of tea later, Zhong Daogong arrived with seven Immortal Ark elders.

To guard against the possibility that this was a diversionary tactic, they had not dispatched every elder, despite the lives of four elders being at stake.

Looking at the four who were barely clinging to life and enveloped in an aura of decay, Zhong Daogong and the others wore solemn expressions.

However, they knew saving lives came first. They did not immediately ask what had happened and instead first brought the four back for treatment.

Through the genuine Ancient character, along with numerous longevity treasures, they finally managed to temporarily stabilize their condition.

Three days later.

Li Fan stood inside a small courtyard, his expression somewhat absent minded.

"I only have about ten years of lifespan left."

"I lost half of it just from one trip."

Hearing this, Lu Yuzhi smiled bitterly.

"My situation is about the same. Less than fifty years remain..."

Nangong Lie and Xu Gongding looked equally grim.

Such a major incident naturally required a thorough investigation by the Council of Elders. They truthfully recounted everything they had experienced.

Zhong Daogong comforted them extensively and tried every possible method to extend their lifespan.

Unfortunately, the results were minimal.

"Hmph!"

The courtyard remained silent for a while before Nangong Lie suddenly slammed the stone table.

"We suffered such a great disaster, and even had all four gray Go pieces stolen."

"It is an utter humiliation. Zhong Daogong should have immediately led everyone there. Even if he could not recover them, he should at least investigate the identity of the culprits."

"But instead, so much time has passed and he has done absolutely nothing. Every time I ask, he gives the same pleasant sounding excuse about needing long term planning. Bah. I think after seeing the miserable state we ended up in, they became afraid."

Nangong Lie vented all the frustration in his heart.

Lu Yuzhi frowned slightly.

"Still, Elder Zhong is not entirely wrong. That death aura storm truly was far too strange and terrifying. Even after spending the past several days thinking about it, I still cannot find any method to confront it directly. We four have already suffered severe injuries. The Immortal Ark absolutely cannot withstand another blow of the same magnitude in such a short time."

Li Fan also nodded.

"Although it is frustrating, that is indeed the reality. That death aura appeared far too suddenly. It was clearly targeting the gray Go pieces in our possession."

"Do not forget. There is still one gray Go piece within the Immortal Ark."

"Perhaps that unknown enemy will attack us at any moment."

Li Fan's words immediately plunged everyone into silence.

The Immortal Ark had always placed the greater good above all else.

They could still distinguish between personal grievances and the overall interests of the Immortal Ark.

"The enemy has come fully prepared."

Lu Yuzhi let out a long sigh, his eyes filled with worry.

To prepare for this unknown enemy, the Immortal Ark soon convened a joint meeting of all its elders.

As one of those directly involved in the incident, Li Fan also attended.

Zhong Daogong was the first to summarize the situation.

"The enemy was undoubtedly after the gray Go pieces. The gray Go piece in our possession has already lost part of its connection with the others. It should correspond to the four pieces that were taken."

"However, there are two major questions."

"First, how were they able to pinpoint Elder Lu Yuzhi's group with such precision?"

"Second, what method did they use to block the resonance between the gray Go pieces?"

"As for the death qi storm they used in the attack..."

"After searching the Immortal Ark's records, we have found several possible explanations."

His words immediately drew everyone's attention.

Jian Daosheng coughed lightly before explaining.

"Death qi and vitality exist in opposition while depending upon each other. After the Great Catastrophe, most regions of the Darkest Star Sea fell into complete silence. Theoretically speaking, such an enormous amount of death qi should not exist there."

"Therefore, we believe this death qi originated from a cultivation world."

"And for them to use death qi as a consumable offensive weapon, the amount of death qi they possess must be beyond imagination." Jian Daosheng's tone was heavy.

Upon hearing this, the Immortal Ark elders quickly voiced the doubts in their hearts.

"The Star Sea Catastrophe destroyed the myriad worlds long ago. Where could they possibly have gathered such an enormous amount of death qi?"

"It completely defies common sense."

Zhong Daogong sighed.

"That is precisely the key issue. I fear this death qi was accumulated long ago, back in the ancient era before the Star Sea suffered its catastrophe."

"The enemy is very likely an ancient civilization that has survived from antiquity until today, just like us."

"They were able to predict and avoid attacks from the True Immortal seal script. They possess an intimate understanding of the gray Go pieces, which are creations of the True Immortals, and caught us completely off guard. Throughout the entire encounter, they never once revealed themselves."

"Judging from everything they have displayed, this unknown civilization is no weaker than our Immortal Ark."

As Zhong Daogong finished speaking, the meeting fell into an eerie silence.

Every elder frowned deeply, each lost in thought.

Li Fan finally broke the silence.

"I never imagined that besides the Immortal Ark and Great Qi, another brilliant civilization still exists within this seemingly lifeless Star Sea."

The elders all turned their gazes toward Li Fan.

Jian Daosheng narrowed his eyes slightly.

"Fellow Daoist Li, is it possible that the unknown force which attacked you is actually your homeland, Great Qi?"

This was also the question shared by every Immortal Ark elder.

Now that Jian Daosheng had asked it openly, everyone fixed their eyes upon Li Fan, waiting for his answer.

"Great Qi?"

Li Fan was clearly caught off guard.

"How could..."

His first instinct was to deny it.

However, he quickly seemed to realize something. His brows furrowed as he sank into deep thought, abruptly falling silent.

After a long while, Li Fan finally spoke again in a quiet voice.

"First of all, I can state with absolute certainty that Great Qi has placed no surveillance methods upon me. I am certainly not one of Great Qi's spies."

"I have no evidence to prove it. But after spending so much time together, I believe everyone here understands what kind of person I am."

Li Fan paused before speaking proudly.

"To say something you may not like to hear. If I truly were a Great Qi spy, and my objective were those gray Go pieces, then when I helped reconstruct the Immortal Ark's defensive formation, with my unmatched movement technique throughout the Star Sea, I could have simply stolen the piece and escaped immediately."

"There would have been no need to go through all of this trouble."

The meeting became even quieter.

No one refuted him.

Most silently accepted his reasoning, though a handful still looked at Li Fan with lingering suspicion.

Li Fan continued his defense.

"Besides, when we were attacked, we were preparing to continue deeper into the Remnant World Great Wall to collect even more Go pieces. If I truly were an inside agent, why wouldn't I wait until we found more before informing my allies and wiping everyone out in one strike?"

"After succeeding, why would I return to the Immortal Ark at all?"

"At that time, the other three Immortal Ark elders were already on the verge of collapse. Without my movement technique, they would have died long ago. Would it not have been far easier to simply let them disappear forever without anyone knowing what happened? Why go through such unnecessary effort?"

The more Li Fan spoke, the more genuine anger seemed to build within him.

He snorted coldly.

"If not for the fact that, in the final stage of my life, my interactions with the Immortal Ark had already made me regard it as my home, I would never have bothered explaining so much."

"If I wished to leave, who among you could possibly stop me?"

Not a single Immortal Ark elder could refute those words. After all, that phantom Wooden Sword ignored nearly every restrictive force. It was truly beyond comprehension.

At that moment, Zhong Daogong hurriedly stepped in to smooth things over.

He laughed gently.

"Fellow Daoist Li, there is no need to become so agitated. We absolutely trust you. However, we know very little about the Great Qi behind you. Naturally, some suspicion is unavoidable."

Li Fan's anger gradually subsided.

After thinking for a moment, he answered cautiously.

"Great Qi itself contains numerous factions. I am only familiar with my master's lineage."

"However, I have never heard of anyone within Great Qi possessing such an immense quantity of death qi."

"Besides, my face carries some reputation within Great Qi. If the attackers truly came from Great Qi, none of them would dare attack me. Even if I died, my master would never forgive them."

Li Fan spoke with complete certainty.

Zhong Daogong nodded slightly and temporarily ended that line of questioning.

"Regarding this attack, I have formed several hypotheses. Let me present them for everyone's consideration."

"The gray Go piece has remained safely stored within the Immortal Ark's secret vault for countless years without incident. Yet now it has suddenly become the target of an attack."

"Assuming nobody deliberately leaked information, perhaps gathering too many Go pieces together attracted their attention."

Zhong Daogong said loudly.

"This unknown civilization may have been searching for the gray Go pieces all these years. Unfortunately, without possessing one themselves, they were unable to locate them through resonance."

"But during our collection process, the increasing concentration of Go pieces allowed them to detect the signal. That exposed us and led directly to the attack."

The elders all fell silent once again.

It sounded somewhat unbelievable, yet it was currently the only reasonable explanation.

"If my speculation is correct, then what we must now worry about is this unknown civilization attacking the Immortal Ark itself." Zhong Daogong's tone suddenly became serious.

"The gray Go pieces can resonate with one another. The piece that has become part of the Immortal Ark's outer chitinous armor undoubtedly provides the enemy with our approximate location at all times."

"That is clearly unacceptable."

The expressions of every Immortal Ark elder changed immediately.

"Our highest priority is resolving this problem."

"Either we separate the chitinous armor from the Immortal Ark and abandon the gray Go piece entirely."

"Or we find a method capable of blocking the resonance between the gray Go pieces."

Zhong Daogong concluded.

The elders exchanged uncertain glances.

Soon afterward, heated debate broke out among them.

Chapter 1345: The Divine Art That Equalizes Heaven

"A gentleman does not stand beneath a crumbling wall. Keeping the Xuan Immortal Ark exposed under the enemy's surveillance at all times is by no means a wise decision."

"Exactly. Although this gray Go piece is a creation of a True Immortal, it is not worth taking such an enormous risk."

"Foolish! This set of Go pieces must conceal an enormous secret. Opportunity and danger have always gone hand in hand. How can we abandon it so easily?"

"Indeed, simply discarding it would be far too wasteful. I have an idea. Since that unknown enemy can track the location of the gray Go piece, why not use their own strategy against them? We send one elder carrying the gray Go piece to wander alone through the void while we lie in ambush nearby. Once the enemy takes the bait, we wipe them out in one stroke."

"Do not underestimate them! Elder Gan, how can you be certain that our so called ambush will not instead fall into an even greater encirclement prepared by the enemy?"

...

The elders argued fiercely, clearly divided into two opposing factions. Neither side could convince the other.

Throughout the Immortal Ark's history, whenever similar situations arose, the final decision was always made by the Chief Elder. No matter what stance anyone had previously taken, once a course of action had been decided, everyone aboard the Immortal Ark had to support and carry it out unconditionally.

This was also to prevent the Immortal Ark from splitting apart once again.

However, this time, the usually decisive Zhong Daogong hesitated with unusual reluctance.

He seemed to be contemplating something. His gaze swept across everyone present before finally settling on Li Fan.

"Everyone, return and think it over carefully. We shall discuss this again tomorrow."

As the meeting concluded, Li Fan alone was asked to remain behind by Zhong Daogong.

"What? Elder Zhong intends to interrogate me privately now?" Li Fan asked with a hint of mockery.

Zhong Daogong smiled faintly, completely unconcerned.

"Fellow Daoist, please do not misunderstand. I asked you to stay because I have a favor to request."

Li Fan raised an eyebrow and became slightly more serious.

"Please speak freely, Elder Zhong."

"I heard that after being struck by the death qi storm, Fellow Daoist only has ten years of lifespan remaining?" Zhong Daogong did not immediately reveal his purpose, instead beginning with what seemed to be an unrelated question.

"Correct. Ten years is merely my estimate. In reality, it may well be even less."

"But to me, whether it is twenty years or ten years no longer matters. What concerns me is whether I can witness the scenery beyond the High Wall before I die." Li Fan let out a cold snort.

Zhong Daogong cupped his hands slightly.

"The matter I wish to entrust to Fellow Daoist is precisely related to crossing the High Wall. Before today's council convened, Elders Nangong and the other two secretly came to see me."

Li Fan's eyes instantly narrowed.

Zhong Daogong continued.

"Does Fellow Daoist know what the Immortal Ark truly relies upon to cross the High Wall?"

"Aside from the elevated section of the Great Wall of the Remnant World that we showed you before. After all, you saw it yourself that day. Although that place overlooks the Star Sea, it still lies an immeasurable distance beneath the summit of the High Wall."

"The explanation the Immortal Ark has always given me is that it intends to gather as much power from the True Immortal seal script characters as possible, then detonate it to shake the High Wall and leap across it like a fish jumping through the Dragon Gate." Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

"That explanation is indeed true. But have you ever considered this? Without some form of restraint, how could we guarantee that the Immortal Ark itself would survive the violent storm of residual True Immortal power?"

A smile appeared on Zhong Daogong's face.

"Elder Zhong means that the Immortal Ark actually possesses a method capable of controlling the residual power of a True Immortal to some extent?" Li Fan asked in surprise.

"It would not be accurate to call it control. It is more accurate to say... self preservation."

"And every use requires paying an enormous price. That is precisely why Elders Nangong and the others secretly came to see me."

Zhong Daogong's expression became rather complicated.

"What exactly is it? Could it even possess the ability to extend one's lifespan?" Li Fan became even more curious.

"It is neither an immortal artifact nor a secret treasure."

"It is the Divine Art of Equal Heaven."

A brilliant light flashed through Zhong Daogong's eyes.

"The Divine Art of Equal Heaven?"

Li Fan carefully contemplated the meaning behind those four words.

A nostalgic expression appeared on Zhong Daogong's face.

"This divine art is the crystallization of the wisdom accumulated over ten thousand years by the elders of the divided Xuan Immortal Ark."

"It is the Immortal Ark's highest secret. Its classification even surpasses that of the True Immortal seal script characters."

"The effect of the divine art is exactly as its name suggests. It lies in the word 'Equal.' Within the area covered by the divine art, for a short period of time, all living beings become equal."

"When the storm of residual True Immortal power rages, under the protection of the divine art, we become equal to immortals."

"When one person is on the verge of death, under the protection of the divine art, we equally divide our lifespans to extend our brother's life."

"The existence of this divine art is the true foundation upon which the Immortal Ark's Council of Elders has stood for ten thousand years."

Zhong Daogong spoke solemnly.

"If what Elder Zhong says is true, then this divine art is the most powerful divine ability I have ever seen in the Star Sea. But if the Divine Art of Equal Heaven is so miraculous, why not cast it directly upon the High Wall?" Li Fan asked.

Zhong Daogong smiled and shook his head.

"Leaving aside the fact that what we call the High Wall has no actual physical form and is merely the boundary confining us, even if it could be targeted, once the Divine Art of Equal Heaven is cast, so long as the effect remains active, no matter how powerful the external force is, we will always remain equal to the target."

"But to leap across the High Wall, one must surpass it. If one is merely equal to the wall, how could such a feat ever be accomplished?"

He sighed softly.

Li Fan nodded, acknowledging Zhong Daogong's explanation.

"Then what is the price of using this divine art?" Li Fan continued.

Stroking his beard, Zhong Daogong answered honestly.

"Although the Divine Art of Equal Heaven can defy the heavens, it also has its limitations."

"First, it requires a long period of careful preparation."

"Second, because its essence lies in equality, the greater the number of elders participating in the casting, the stronger its effect."

"However, the Immortal Ark has long suffered from a shortage of talented people. For all these years, the number of Council of Elders members has remained rather low. Naturally, the effectiveness of the Divine Art of Equal Heaven has been greatly reduced."

"The third point is also the most important."

"It is its side effect."

"After the state of equality ends, every person who participated in casting the Divine Art of Equal Heaven will, to a certain degree, continue to be affected by that equality."

"Specifically..."

"It manifests as certain tendencies toward convergence."

Zhong Daogong spoke quietly.

Li Fan immediately understood.

"This Divine Art of Equal Heaven also originates from a True Immortal seal script character?"

Zhong Daogong nodded.

"Correct."

"In truth, you may regard the divine art as a single True Immortal seal script character jointly written by all the elders of the Immortal Ark."

"Through the united efforts of all the elders, it comes infinitely close to being personally written by a True Immortal."

"Because it involves the very source of the Divine Art of Equal Heaven, the character 'Equal' itself has become one of the Immortal Ark's highest secrets."

"That is why it was not shown to Fellow Daoist during our previous transaction."

Li Fan smiled faintly.

"And yet Elder Zhong has now revealed everything to me without reservation."

"It seems that whatever you are about to request, I will have little choice but to agree."

Zhong Daogong waved his hand, displaying humility.

"Please do not worry unnecessarily. Faced with someone possessing an unparalleled movement technique and only a few years left to live, there is truly nothing the Immortal Ark can do."

"This is not coercion."

"It is a sincere request."

"What request? At long last, are you inviting me to join the Immortal Ark's Council of Elders?" Li Fan let out a cold snort.

"That is one of them."

"There is another request as well."

Zhong Daogong's expression remained perfectly calm.

Li Fan stared fixedly at him.

Zhong Daogong calmly cupped his hands, bowed slightly, and respectfully saluted him.

Then he slowly said,

"I ask Fellow Daoist to carry a portion of the Divine Art of Equal Heaven back to Great Qi."

"What?!"

A trace of killing intent immediately flashed through Li Fan's eyes. He abruptly rose to his feet and met Zhong Daogong's gaze directly.

"Elder Zhong, this is no joke."

"Did you not just say that only members of the Council of Elders may participate in casting the Divine Art of Equal Heaven?" Li Fan asked coldly.

"I also said that the Divine Art of Equal Heaven is, in essence, nothing more than a True Immortal seal script character jointly written by many people."

"The Immortal Ark has studied the True Immortal seal script characters for countless years. Naturally, we possess methods that allow other living beings to unknowingly participate in writing the [Equal] character."

"Even if they are located at opposite ends of the Star Sea."

"Of course, accomplishing this will require Fellow Daoist's cooperation."

"The number of Council of Elders members within the Immortal Ark is simply too small. As a result, each use of the divine art comes with consequences that are increasingly difficult to bear."

"But if Great Qi were to share part of that burden..."

Only then did Zhong Daogong finally reveal his true intentions.

Li Fan remained silent for a long time.

For a moment, the entire hall fell into complete silence.

Zhong Daogong did not press him any further. He simply waited quietly for Li Fan's reply.

Li Fan frowned deeply, his expression filled with hesitation.

"I... need some time to think it over carefully," Li Fan finally said.

Hearing this, a faint smile finally appeared on Zhong Daogong's face.

"Then, before tomorrow's council meeting, I will pay you a visit first."

Li Fan's expression remained indifferent as he turned and left.

After returning to his small courtyard and confirming that no one was watching him.

His expression did not change, but his thoughts had already begun to surge.

"The Equal Heaven Divine Art? It truly is extraordinary. No wonder it is the ultimate foundation behind the Immortal Ark's plan to cross the High Wall."

"It requires countless living beings to cast the technique together, sharing the backlash of the True Immortal seal script?"

Li Fan sneered inwardly.

"If I can see the true form of the True Immortal seal script..."

"Then why should I fear it?"

"However, the elders of the Immortal Ark possess extremely long lifespans. Even if the three unfortunate fellows, Nangong Lie and the others, are included, there is no way they would willingly share their lifespans equally with all the living beings of Great Qi civilization."

"So what exactly is the true target of this divine art?"

Although he appeared as motionless as a stone statue, Li Fan had already begun making plans in secret.

When it came to understanding the True Immortal seal script, even if the entire Council of Elders combined their knowledge, they might still not compare to Li Fan, who understood the Transformation Between Immortals and Mortals, as well as Truth and Falsehood.

"As long as I uncover the true form of the [Equality] character, I can interfere at any moment and completely overturn this divine art."

...

The next day.

Zhong Daogong arrived as promised.

"Have you reached a decision, Fellow Daoist?" Zhong Daogong asked with a smiling face.

"I can agree to your proposal. However..." Li Fan replied coldly. "When exactly will the Immortal Ark cross the High Wall?"

"I need your promise of the precise time when the operation will begin."

"I will also participate in the Equal Heaven Divine Art from beginning to end."

...

Li Fan put forward several conditions in succession.

Without the slightest hesitation, Zhong Daogong agreed to every one of them.

His decisiveness instead made Li Fan even more cautious.

"Then may Elder Zhong tell me who the true target of this Equal Heaven Divine Art is?"

"It cannot simply be to extend the lifespans of Nangong and the others, can it?" Li Fan stared intently at Zhong Daogong.

Zhong Daogong replied, "There is no need to trouble the people of Great Qi with the Equal Lifespan Art. Our Immortal Ark will bear that burden ourselves. As for the final objective..."

"Once Fellow Daoist has completed the placement of the Equal Heaven Divine Art, we will naturally tell you."

Li Fan stared at Zhong Daogong for a long time without moving.

Only after a long silence did he finally say, "Very well. I agree."

"Great Qi... may once have been my homeland."

"But why should I care if the flood comes after my death?" A trace of savagery flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

Zhong Daogong's expression remained unreadable, and he offered no response.

Li Fan did not attend the subsequent Council of Elders meeting.

Instead, he devoted himself entirely to studying the ritual of the Equal Heaven Divine Art that Zhong Daogong had given him.

Although it was called a ritual, it was actually a formation combined with the inscription ritual of the True Immortal seal script. It also seemed to incorporate a lifeform similar to the Immortal Ark's Divine Tree.

"As long as this ritual is inscribed into a world, once the divine art is activated, every living being within its range will automatically be drawn into the ritual."

"Once the arrangement is complete, our Immortal Ark will also sense it. Fellow Daoist may then return. At that time, we certainly will not break our promise."

Zhong Daogong's instructions still echoed in his ears.

Li Fan muttered quietly, "The ritual only judges the number of living beings involved. Their cultivation level is irrelevant. That certainly makes things easier for me."

"There is no need to arrange it inside the Xuanhuang Realm. Any small world with a large enough population will suffice."

Li Fan remained aboard the Immortal Ark for several more days.

Only after thoroughly understanding every aspect of the Equal Heaven Divine Art ritual did he finally depart under the hopeful gazes of everyone aboard.

The phantom Wooden Sword left its sheath, and Li Fan returned to the Xuanhuang Realm.

He arrived at a mortal world known as Great Qian.

"The Xuan Immortal Ark has drifted alone through the Star Sea for far too long. It has completely lost its sense of population size."

"Three million people already meets the target they were hoping for."

Li Fan's divine sense swept across the small world below.

"One hundred million people. Without the existence of spiritual qi, it is already remarkable that they have multiplied to such prosperity."

"I simply wonder whether exceeding the mission requirements will earn even greater rewards from the Immortal Ark."

Li Fan let out a cold laugh. He cared nothing for the Immortal Ark's promises.

He simply wished to witness how the Equal Heaven Divine Art would actually unfold.

The ritual was quietly deployed, enveloping the entire world of Great Qian.

Li Fan could vaguely sense the unease of heaven and earth.

Heavy storm clouds began gathering in the sky, only to be scattered with a single glance from Li Fan.

The resistance of the small world was insignificant beneath his suppression.

The ritual was completed very quickly.

The faint ripple of energy flowing through the ritual like a gentle breeze seemed to indicate that the Immortal Ark at the edge of the Star Sea had already received confirmation.

Li Fan, however, did not return immediately.

Instead, he first traveled to Great Xuan.

The four gray Go pieces recovered by Yin Shangren and Hundred Flowers rested quietly upon the Dao Lecture Platform.

"Holy Teacher."

Upon seeing Li Fan return, they both bowed slightly.

Then they followed Li Fan as their gazes settled upon the four objects of different shapes.

Li Fan waved his hand gently.

Under the crushing force of spiritual power, all four objects shattered layer by layer.

They were compressed and ground into their most fundamental particles.

Finally, their true forms were revealed.

Four completely identical Go pieces floated into the air, attracting one another as they continuously revolved in circles.

Chapter 1346: Bearing The Weight Of The Immortal Realm

Just as the Xuan Immortal Ark had previously speculated.

Each gray Go piece had been forged from an entire world.

Li Fan looked at the four Go pieces spinning before him as countless visions surged into his mind.

They were scenes from these four dead worlds before they had been transformed. A frozen land stretching for countless miles. Upon an endless plain stood majestic dynasties founded by different cultivators. Around a terrifying sword scar that split the entire world in half, countless Sword Dao Sects stood like stars. A vast azure ocean covered the whole world. Monstrous storms raged all year long, raising waves thousands of feet high and destroying everything upon the sea. Living beings could survive only beneath the ocean floor.

Along with those visions, the names of the four worlds appeared in Li Fan's mind.

"Crystal Pole, Hundred Hills, Sword Gate, Abyssal Ocean."

Although each world was different, they were all filled with vibrant life.

However, at a certain moment, an unimaginably terrifying force descended.

Everything in the world froze.

Boom. Boom. Boom.

Amid continuous impacts like enormous hammers striking down, every living being was instantly annihilated. Only the worlds themselves survived the devastating blows.

Like molten iron heated until liquid, then cooled and hammered into a sword, the four completely different worlds slowly underwent mysterious changes in both form and essence amid the deafening impacts.

The chaotic visions disappeared.

In the end, they once again became the four constantly rotating gray Go pieces.

"Holy Teacher, this..." It was not only Li Fan who sensed the extraordinary nature of the gray game pieces. Yin Shangren's gray eyes, black and white pupils spinning ever faster, revealed the turmoil in his heart.

"Forging Go pieces from worlds. The power of a True Immortal is truly extraordinary." Li Fan glanced indifferently at Yin Shangren before sighing softly.

"True Immortal, Go pieces?" Having caught those two key phrases, Yin Shangren's body trembled. He immediately said, "As expected, my intuition was correct. The Yin-Yang Pearls I absorbed before may also be related to a True Immortal."

Li Fan looked toward Yin Shangren and silently waited for him to continue.

Yin Shangren paused, seemingly organizing his thoughts before calmly speaking.

"The moment I saw these four Go pieces, I felt a strange sense of familiarity. Not because I had seen them before, but because they belonged to the same kind. It was like the feeling I get whenever I see those ghostly spirits of dead worlds..."

Li Fan's eyes flickered. After pondering for a moment, he nodded.

"The immense death qi and vitality contained within those Yin-Yang Pearls are indeed probably beyond what cultivators of our level can control."

Yin Shangren continued.

"But while these Go pieces feel familiar, they also instinctively fill me with fear. It is like facing something of an incomparably higher rank."

"I can also sense that although these worlds no longer contain any power of life or death, they still possess an irresistible attraction for me. It feels as though devouring them would bring me unimaginable benefits. Far greater benefits than even the Yin-Yang Pearls."

As he spoke, Yin Shangren's voice gradually became absentminded. Just before the greed in his eyes overwhelmed him, he forcefully closed them.

Only after a long while did the whispers tempting him like heavenly demons finally fade away. He gradually regained his composure, though he no longer dared look directly at the four Go pieces.

Li Fan naturally understood the source of the fear and temptation the gray Go pieces inspired in Yin Shangren.

"Fragments of laws originating from the Immortal Realm..."

Silently circulating the altered version of the Mending Heaven Record within his heart, Li Fan's vision once again transformed the four Go pieces into countless intersecting lines.

They were the laws of the worlds after they had been reconstructed and transformed.

Li Fan carefully compared their similarities and differences.

Although tens of thousands of years had passed, and although the Star Sea had collapsed before reviving once more, the Great Dao principles forming the foundation of worlds had not actually changed very much.

Throughout countless reincarnations, Li Fan had already gained an exceptionally profound understanding of the laws governing cultivation worlds.

After repeatedly observing and comparing them, he truly discovered those portions within the four Go piece worlds that did not belong to the lower realms.

At first glance, they looked no different from the ordinary lines representing the natural laws of heaven and earth.

In truth, however, they were superior replacements, evolved and sublimated forms of the lower realm laws.

Even though they were merely fragments of laws used in construction, they appeared to Li Fan like the most brilliant jewels in existence.

If the laws of the lower realms were merely a low mountain less than a hundred meters tall, then the portions originating from the Immortal Realm within these four Go pieces were like magnificent mountain ranges stretching hundreds of miles, encompassing everything and overflowing with vitality.

The two simply could not be compared.

Furthermore, whether by coincidence or not, the Immortal Realm law fragments contained within each of the four Go pieces were completely different from one another.

"The laws contained within each Go piece are like fragments of a puzzle. Once they are all combined, they may form a complete picture."

"There are twelve gray Go pieces altogether. They should correspond to the twelve Dao coordinates records left behind by Sun Piaomiao."

"In that case..."

"There should actually be thirteen. The Medicine King Cauldron inherited by the Medicine King Sect throughout history in the Xuanhuang Realm is not within the range of this perception."

Thinking of this, Li Fan could not help raising his head to look beyond the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Medicine King Cauldron of the Medicine King Sect was still struggling near the Immortal Ruins and had not yet returned to the Xuanhuang Realm.

"In any case, it will not be long before it falls back. I can simply wait. There is no need to risk salvaging it from the Immortal Ruins."

Thinking this, Li Fan reached out and drew one of the Go pieces into his hand.

Sure enough, a peculiar sensation immediately arose within him.

Somewhere in the depths of the Star Sea, he vaguely sensed the approximate locations of the other gray Go pieces.

"There are four here."

"There is one within the Xuan Immortal Ark."

"There are another four within the Remnant Worlds Great Wall."

"There are still three remaining. One of them should be located within the Sea of Relics."

"As for the final two..."

A strange light flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

He discovered that these two gray Go pieces were actually inside the Xuanhuang Realm.

"The worlds they originally belonged to were probably used by the Heavenly Doctor and the Immortal Ancestor to repair the Xuanhuang Realm."

"Watch over this place. I will return shortly."

After giving instructions to Yin Shangren and Hundred Flowers, and ignoring their astonishment, the phantom shadow of the Wooden Sword flashed.

Li Fan had already followed the direction indicated by the mysterious connection and arrived at the first location.

It was the bottomless Cangwu Abyss.

The Cangwu Abyss lay in the southwestern corner of the Xuanhuang Realm, resembling an enormous wound splitting the world apart.

Its currently explored depth had already reached three hundred thousand feet.

Layer upon layer within the abyss existed countless strange landscapes, phenomena, and objects.

What had once been a place of extreme danger could no longer pose much threat to Li Fan, who was now capable of traversing the Star Sea itself.

Following the mysterious connection, he descended deeper and deeper.

Watching the scenery in his vision continuously drift upward toward the sky, Li Fan suddenly had a realization.

"Everything within the Cangwu Abyss should originate from different cultivation worlds that have already perished. Piled together here, it resembles a temporary storage site for all kinds of materials used during the stitching together of the Xuanhuang Realm."

"If something is missing during the process of repairing the world, it can simply be retrieved from here. One day, the Cangwu Abyss will eventually be filled. By that time, perhaps the Xuanhuang Realm will have truly been reborn."

Li Fan observed the many strange sights within the abyss with great interest.

The closer the abyss was to the surface of the Xuanhuang Realm, the more it was influenced by the vitality of the Realm itself. This gave rise to all kinds of unique landscapes, such as the Forest of Spirit Speech, the Puppet Gorge, and the Lost Maze City.

However, the deeper one descended, the closer the floating world fragments resembled their original appearance.

After a world was destroyed, nothing remained except deathly silence.

Some of the world fragments even retained traces of residual True Immortal power.

"It could practically be regarded as a miniature Remnant World Great Wall."

"However, its stability is nowhere near that of the true Remnant World Great Wall. The accumulated residual True Immortal power erupts from time to time."

"No wonder this place is considered a forbidden zone for cultivators."

When the sword shadow descended to a depth of five hundred and thirty thousand zhang beneath the earth, Li Fan once again sensed the existence of the Suppressing Immortal Power within the abyss.

"This Suppressing Immortal Power should be the pressure created by the Heavenly Doctor after imitating the Remnant World Great Wall and constructing the Cangwu Abyss."

"To be precise, the 'momentum' of the Cangwu Abyss rises in distinct layers from top to bottom. Although the increase at each level is extremely limited, and the overall elevation does not even exceed that of the Xuanhuang Realm by much, cultivators within the abyss experience it very clearly."

"Only those who have reached the corresponding cultivation level can safely survive within each layer. Otherwise, it is no different from an ordinary mortal accidentally entering the Immortal Realm. They have reached a height that does not belong to them, and there is only one outcome, being crushed into pieces."

Having uncovered the secret of the Cangwu Abyss, Li Fan roughly determined the location of the wandering gray Go piece.

Within the ruins of shattered buildings that looked as though they had been chopped apart by countless blades, Li Fan found the fifth gray Go piece.

It was hidden within a majestic stone qilin statue, lying half collapsed upon the ground exactly as it had when the world was destroyed ten thousand years ago.

The statues had originally been a pair. Li Fan examined the other one and found that it was nothing more than an ordinary stone carving.

"It was hidden remarkably well."

Li Fan crushed the statue, restoring it to its original Go piece form before examining the surrounding ruins.

Based on the remains nearby, he reconstructed the world to which it had originally belonged.

"The Seven Fiends Realm. Seven different fiendish energies filled every corner of that world. They could even manifest physically and attack people. Therefore, every building in that world was decorated with all kinds of divine beast statues to absorb and suppress the fiendish energies."

"It was once a cultivation world of considerable scale. Cultivators born there were naturally tainted by the seven fiendish energies. Every technique they used carried the characteristics of the Seven Fiends. The greatest geniuses possessed mastery over all seven..."

"What a pity. Time flows onward. Everything has long since turned to nothing."

Li Fan sighed softly, shook his head, and left the place.

The last remaining gray Go piece within the Xuanhuang Realm was buried beneath Tianyun Prefecture.

Nothing unusual had occurred where it lay.

"It should have originally been inside a fragment of another world. As the Xuanhuang Realm continued absorbing and merging worlds, it eventually became completely incorporated into the Xuanhuang Realm itself."

"Just like those fragments from the Heavenly Law Realm beneath the Congyun Sea. Under normal circumstances, they would gradually become buried beneath the Congyun Mountains."

Without alerting anyone, Li Fan smoothly retrieved the final piece.

At this point, Li Fan had collected six gray Go pieces.

Returning to the Great Qi Dao Lecture Platform, he placed all six pieces together.

Now that nearly half had been gathered, the interaction between them became noticeably stronger.

The speed at which they revolved around one another grew faster and faster.

Li Fan watched as, amid the rapid rotation, the lines representing the principles of the worlds gradually attracted one another and slowly fused together.

Meanwhile, the fragments of Immortal Realm laws drifted closer together, completing portions of the puzzle.

Although only six of the thirteen pieces had been assembled, it was already enough to trigger a qualitative transformation.

The puzzle formed by the Immortal Realm laws resembled a hollow cavity that had suddenly appeared in the middle of a vast ocean.

The worlds frozen in stillness resembled the calm seawater surrounding it.

The moment the hollow appeared, the seawater could no longer restrain itself and rushed violently into it.

The six worlds seemed like soaked paintings upon paper, twisting and distorting as they were drawn into the puzzle of Immortal Realm law fragments like flowing liquid.

According to the template that the puzzle had long ago been designed to form, they gradually assembled into an entirely new world.

Blue skies.

White clouds.

Endless rolling grasslands.

At first glance, it seemed like nothing more than an ordinary mortal prairie.

Yet Li Fan sensed within it a vastness unlike anything that existed between heaven and earth.

Even the tender green grass growing upon the ground contained an unimaginably vigorous vitality.

"The Immortal Realm?!"

The moment Li Fan caught sight of the scene within the fused Go pieces, his heart shook violently.

"No. It is only a fragment that once belonged to the Immortal Realm. Perhaps it would be more accurate to call it a fragment of an Immortal Domain."

"And this Immortal Domain is still incomplete."

Between the immortal grasslands and the heavens above, something was clearly missing.

Because the remaining seven gray Go pieces had yet to be gathered, the complete picture could not yet be revealed.

Li Fan stared blankly at the scene before him as an overwhelming sense of regret suddenly arose within his heart.

It felt as though he had personally shattered an incomparably precious treasure. An uncontrollable urge to restore it immediately emerged from every corner of his mind.

Had Li Fan not possessed the protection of the Immortal Heart Mantra, and had he not already experienced countless similar situations before, he would probably have lost control and immediately gone in pursuit of the remaining Go pieces.

But now, he simply ignored the temptation.

After the fusion was complete, only a single Go piece remained.

It was no longer gray.

Instead, it continuously shimmered with seven-colored radiance.

Even its size had expanded by nearly one circle.

Li Fan reached out, solemnly storing the fused six-in-one Go piece away.

"Hm?"

What Li Fan had not expected was that the instant he stored the Go piece within his body, it felt as though countless towering mountains had suddenly been placed upon his back.

Caught completely off guard, his body abruptly sank downward.

Fortunately, he reacted in time. The power of the Xuanhuang World Destruction Transformation awakened and flowed throughout his body, providing an endless stream of strength. Only then was he barely able to withstand the burden.

"So this is... the weight of the Immortal Realm?"

"Even carrying only a fragment of an incomplete Immortal Domain is already so difficult."

"If all thirteen fragments are gathered and fused into a true Immortal Domain, then with my current cultivation, I would have absolutely no way of bearing its weight."

Once again, Li Fan deeply experienced the terrifying difference between immortals and mortals.

Yet instead of feeling alarmed, he was delighted.

"I was just worrying about how, after the Xuanhuang Realm ascends and undergoes its ultimate sublimation, I would have no suitable anchor capable of supporting that state."

"But now it seems that if this fragment of the Immortal Domain is fused into the Xuanhuang Realm, it will certainly be able to stabilize it and prevent it from easily falling back."

"With this fragment of the Immortal Domain as its core, perhaps the Xuanhuang Realm can ascend even higher."

"Heaven is truly helping me."

Li Fan could not suppress the excitement within his heart.

However, almost instinctively, he also began to question the true origin of these Immortal Domain fragments.

Chapter 1347: Sharing The Fate Of The Immortal Ark

The appearance of these fragments of Immortal Realm laws was simply too coincidental.

Just as he was preparing to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm toward the Immortal Realm, they happened to be discovered.

Given Li Fan's personality, it was impossible for him not to become suspicious. Thus, he began carefully sorting through the logic behind it all.

"The concealment of these Go pieces is truly terrifying. Neither the people of the Immortal Ark nor the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor detected anything unusual, despite having personally come into contact with them more than once over tens of thousands of years."

"The only reason I discovered their strange nature so easily was entirely because of the guidance of [Truth]. Without [Truth], I would have regarded them as nothing more than ordinary objects."

At this thought, Li Fan's heart stirred slightly.

"If viewed from this perspective alone, these Go pieces really could have been bait specifically prepared for [Truth]."

"However, [Truth] reacts to many other things as well. For example, the Eternal Remnant Will. It is simply because [Truth] exists on such a high level that no abnormality can hide from it."

"I cannot reach such a hasty conclusion. Still, remaining cautious is only prudent."

Li Fan observed the seven colored Go piece lying quietly within his body.

It seemed completely independent from him. Spiritual energy, divine sense, and every other form of power flowed through the location where the Go piece rested without encountering the slightest obstruction. It was as though the piece did not exist at all.

Apart from bearing the weight of the fused Immortal Domain fragment, the Go piece had brought Li Fan no other changes.

"The thirteen gray Go pieces were hidden by Sun Piaomiao within the thirteen cultivation worlds he had once visited. He recorded the world coordinates of each in his travel journals and passed them down to later generations."

"But it is obvious that these Go pieces were not created by Sun Piaomiao. They were forged by True Immortals from the upper realm. Perhaps they were contingency plans left behind by certain pessimistic True Immortals during the Dao Annihilation Calamity, hoping to one day revive the Immortal Realm."

"For some unknown reason, they eventually fell into Sun Piaomiao's hands."

Li Fan fell into deep thought as countless ideas surged through his mind.

"In Sun Piaomiao's era, the Immortal Realm had not yet been destroyed, nor had the path to immortality been severed. Most True Immortals were still actively resisting the Dao Annihilation Calamity. Under such circumstances, those pessimistic True Immortals who forged these Go pieces would certainly not have been accepted by the mainstream. They could only work in secret. That must be why they secretly passed them down to the lower realms."

"But for reasons unknown, these contingency plans were never activated. The most likely explanation is that the True Immortals who forged the Go pieces perished during the Dao Annihilation Calamity that eventually destroyed the Immortal Realm."

"Or perhaps..."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes as he recalled the structure of the Myriad Manifestations Yin-Yang Painting aboard the Immortal Ark.

"Throughout the entire Darkest Star Sea, there are no longer any black or white Go pieces remaining upon the board. Only these abandoned gray pieces remain. Perhaps somewhere beyond the High Wall, in some unknown place, those black and white pieces have already fulfilled the mission of completely reconstructing the Immortal Realm."

This was merely Li Fan's speculation. At present, there was no evidence supporting it.

"As for these gray Go pieces, Sun Piaomiao undoubtedly knew much more. Sun Piaomiao himself has vanished without a trace. If there is any place in the Star Sea where clues might still remain, the most likely location is the Medicine King Cauldron he left behind in the Medicine King Sect."

"Anchored for fifteen years, the falling stars return to Xuanhuang, the time will come soon..."

Although these Go pieces might conceal unknown dangers, Li Fan would never abandon his plan of elevating the Xuanhuang Realm simply because of uncertain speculation.

With fragments of the Immortal Domain serving as its foundation, the chances of successfully elevating the Xuanhuang Realm would increase tremendously.

Suppressing his thoughts, Li Fan looked toward Yin Shangren and Hundred Flowers.

They had witnessed the entire process of the gray Go piece's fusion. Neither dared speak and only observed silently.

Li Fan did not tell them that the fusion had created an Immortal Domain fragment.

Even so, they had already guessed that these Go pieces, forged from dead worlds, must play a crucial role in the plan to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm.

"I previously asked you to investigate that location deep within the Star Sea. Did you find anything?" Ever since returning to Great Qi, Li Fan had been constantly traveling in search of the Go pieces. Only now had he finally found a moment to rest. He looked at Hundred Flowers and asked.

According to Li Fan's estimation, investigating that mysterious elevated region should have taken considerable effort.

Yet she had returned not long afterward and later reunited with Yin Shangren near the edge of the Star Sea.

Hundred Flowers gathered her thoughts before explaining.

"Perhaps I was simply incapable. I searched the location you specified for a long time, yet never discovered anything unusual. Since remaining there any longer would only waste time, I ultimately gave up and joined Fellow Daoist Yin in searching for Xu Ke."

"Perhaps that opportunity simply was not destined for me."

She sighed softly.

Li Fan nodded before asking again.

"Then what about Xu Ke? Did you discover any traces?"

Yin Shangren replied.

"We made some progress. We believe Xu Ke may have been drawn into a peculiar region within the Remnant World Great Wall."

"The Remnant World Great Wall is formed from countless destroyed worlds gathered beneath the High Wall. Although composed of innumerable fragments, they seem to faintly connect into a single whole."

"We still do not understand the principle behind its formation. However, it may be viewed as a long rope woven from countless threads."

"The place where Xu Ke disappeared appears to be a knot formed by that rope in order to maintain its own stability."

"We were preparing to investigate that knot further when we received your message calling us back."

There was obvious regret in Yin Shangren's voice.

"A knot..."

Li Fan pondered for a moment before continuing.

"The situation arose unexpectedly. In order to obtain the Go pieces, I had no choice but to ask for your help in staging that performance."

"The people you met that day all came from the Immortal Ark civilization near the edge of the Star Sea."

"In order to avoid exposing the existence of the Xuanhuang Realm, I previously disguised myself as a member of a nonexistent civilization called Great Qi and established contact with them. The Xuan Immortal Ark excels at analyzing the powers left behind by various True Immortal seal script characters scattered throughout the Star Sea. I also exchanged the True Immortal seal script I possess with them several times, and both sides benefited."

"During this latest exchange, I happened to discover the gray Go pieces stored within the Immortal Ark treasury."

"These Go pieces are simply too important to the elevation of the Xuanhuang Realm. They absolutely could not be allowed to slip away. Therefore, I employed a few small tricks..."

Li Fan casually explained the entire sequence of events.

"The Xuan Immortal Ark is still useful to the Xuanhuang Realm for now. Therefore, avoid contacting them so the truth is not exposed. Especially you. The aura of life and death around you is too distinctive. The moment they see it, they will know you were the one who stole the gray Go pieces."

He looked toward Yin Shangren as he spoke.

Naturally, neither Yin Shangren nor Hundred Flowers sided with the Xuan Immortal Ark.

They merely smiled and paid little attention to Li Fan's methods of obtaining the gray Go pieces.

"There are still several Go pieces remaining within the Immortal Ark and the Remnant World Great Wall. Leave them all to me."

"You should continue searching for Xu Ke."

"Once I have collected every Go piece, it will not be long before the Xuanhuang Realm reaches its final transformation."

Li Fan instructed them.

Yin Shangren's expression turned solemn as he nodded.

After giving his instructions, Li Fan first activated the Inch Apart, Worlds Away Grand Formation and arrived at the frontier of the Remnant World Great Wall.

Using the Wooden Sword phantom movement technique to shuttle back and forth continuously, he spent considerable effort before finally obtaining the remaining five gray Go pieces hidden there.

Even with such heaven defying movement techniques, the depths of the Remnant World Great Wall beneath the High Wall remained unimaginably dangerous.

The surging waves of echoing star force constantly rose and fell. Even the Wooden Sword phantom could only barely neutralize most of its force. He still had to resist the omnipresent attraction pulling at him from every direction.

Furthermore, he constantly bore the weight of the Immortal Domain.

As a result, using the Wooden Sword phantom movement technique now consumed nearly two or three times more energy than before.

By the time he had collected all five Go pieces, Li Fan was already physically and mentally exhausted.

Still, the rewards were enormous.

Li Fan looked inward.

Five gray Go pieces floated quietly opposite a single seven colored chess piece that had grown noticeably larger after fusion.

They faced one another from a distance.

Perhaps because there were still too few of them, the five newly acquired Go pieces merely revolved around one another and were unable to resonate with the already fused seven colored Go piece.

"Only two remain."

"The Xuan Immortal Ark, and the Medicine King Sect."

"Once all thirteen Go pieces have returned to their proper places, then if my deductions are correct, a corner of the former Immortal Realm should reappear."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

Then he suddenly raised his palm toward his own chest and struck himself heavily.

He let out a muffled groan.

His already exhausted face turned even paler.

Without using his own spiritual energy to heal his injuries, Li Fan maintained his current appearance and leisurely made his way back toward the Immortal Ark.

As he approached the ark, he made no effort to conceal his aura. The Council of Elders had already sensed his arrival.

Led by Zhong Daogong, they all came out to receive him.

"I have fulfilled my mission." Li Fan coughed lightly, cupped his fists, and spoke calmly.

"You have worked hard, Fellow Daoist." Zhong Daogong's expression turned solemn as he unexpectedly bowed deeply.

Li Fan frowned and stepped aside to avoid the salute.

He let out a cold snort.

"There is no need for these empty formalities. Although the ritual itself was not complicated, concealing it from my master and the various Holy Masters required no small amount of effort."

"I do not know exactly how many people the ritual ultimately covered. But I imagine it should have been enough."

Zhong Daogong smiled and nodded.

"Approximately one hundred million living beings. That is more than enough to bear the backlash of casting the Equal Heaven Divine Art."

"In that case, there is no need to keep it from me any longer, is there?" Li Fan's gaze swept across the assembled elders.

"This is not the place to discuss such matters. Let us return to the Immortal Ark first."

The Immortal Ark elders remained as cautious as ever.

The group arrived at the highest level of the divine art platform, inside the deepest pavilion of the Severed Immortal Tower.

The black profound jade floor had already been engraved with countless mysterious patterns.

Li Fan was no stranger to these symbols.

They were part of the ritual for the Equal Heaven Divine Art.

It seemed the Immortal Ark elders could hardly wait any longer.

The elders took their respective seats.

Li Fan likewise received his own seat.

One hundred million living beings served as his admission token.

In the Xuan Immortal Ark, where survival resources were scarce and life itself had withered away, one hundred million humans was an unimaginably enormous number.

Thus, after completing the ritual, together with all of his previous performances, Li Fan had finally earned the absolute trust of everyone aboard the Immortal Ark.

"Please be patient, Fellow Daoist."

"Take your seat first and personally experience the effects of the Equal Heaven Divine Art." Zhong Daogong pointed toward Li Fan's seat.

Without the slightest hesitation, Li Fan floated over and sat down.

The patterns beneath him immediately emitted faint rays of light.

As soon as he sat down, the scenery in Li Fan's vision changed beneath the illumination.

The positions of the Immortal Ark elders around him underwent strange spatial shifts.

Originally, everyone had been seated upon the same plane.

Yet now, in Li Fan's eyes, they were distributed throughout a three dimensional cubic space.

Perfectly staggered, each occupying a different point within the cube.

Li Fan himself stood at the exact center of the cube, the focus of everyone's gaze.

His expression remained unchanged.

"The vast and boundless heaven and earth. Endless ages in silent obscurity. Once of one body. All living beings share the same measure..."

The chanting voices of the Immortal Ark elders echoed through the chamber.

Ancient.

Desolate.

With an indescribable trace of eeriness.

As the chant continued, every elder slowly raised a hand.

Using a finger as a brush, they began writing into the empty air before them.

What each person wrote was not a complete True Immortal seal script character.

Rather, each wrote only one structural fragment of an incomparably complex character.

In Li Fan's eyes, countless living lines suddenly appeared around him.

These lines surrounded him completely.

As they gradually completed one another, the character [Equal] slowly took shape.

Boom!

In an instant, Li Fan's body trembled slightly.

His viewpoint uncontrollably rose upward until it stopped at a fixed position.

From there, looking downward.

The spell structures written by all the elders across their different planes combined together.

On a single plane, they formed one enormous True Immortal seal script character.

[Equal].

Li Fan's body was suppressed precisely at the very center of the character.

Compared to the characters [Hunger] and [Chaos] that Li Fan had previously seen, the character [Equal] was considerably more complex.

Although it could not compare with [Creation], it possessed its own unique and mysterious profundity.

Under the power of the Equal Heaven Divine Art, Li Fan gradually sensed the changes occurring within his own body.

He also glanced at the [Truth] interface.

His remaining lifespan, which had been reduced to only ten years, was now slowly increasing.

Strands of black hair began to emerge amidst his snow white hair.

Wave after wave of vitality appeared from nowhere, nourishing his body that had been on the verge of decay.

Yet Li Fan did not rejoice over this sudden increase in lifespan.

Instead, he cautiously continued observing [Truth].

Only after the incoming vitality gradually dried up and the Equal Heaven Divine Art ritual came to an end...

Only after [Truth] displayed no reaction whatsoever beyond the change in his displayed biological age...

Did Li Fan finally relax.

"As expected."

"A mere [Equal] character is still far from sufficient to influence [Truth]."

"It only affects the specific target locked onto by the Equal Heaven Divine Art. In my case, that was my lifespan."

"My divine sense, cultivation, and everything else remain completely unchanged."

After carefully inspecting his condition, Li Fan reached his conclusion.

He then looked toward the members of the Immortal Ark Council of Elders.

Compared to before the ritual, they had all clearly aged somewhat.

However, because the loss of lifespan had been evenly distributed among every participant, the change was not especially obvious.

"How does it feel?" Zhong Daogong asked on behalf of the elders.

Hearing this, Li Fan deliberately acted as though he had just awakened from a dream.

He looked down at his rejuvenated body.

Then he bowed deeply toward all the elders, expressing his gratitude for saving his life.

The Immortal Ark elders returned the salute together.

"From this day forward, we are all one family."

Zhong Daogong spoke with complete solemnity.

Chapter 1348: The Immortal Ark’S Seizing Heaven Plan

Zhong Daogong smiled as he looked toward the surrounding elders.

"The fundamental consciousness of the Star Sea!"

"Only by making personal contact with it can one truly understand the vast and boundless might of the Star Sea. "But..."

At the very center of the Star Sea, shining brilliantly like a flawless diamond, was the true essence of the Star Sea's fundamental consciousness.

"The Star Sea consciousness is actually no different from the Heavenly Dao of the cultivation world in ancient times."

"In the past, cultivators achieved unity between man and heaven, allowing them to partially control the Heavenly Dao of their worlds. Now, by joining forces to cast the Equal Heaven Divine Art, there is no reason we cannot jointly wield the power of the Star Sea as well."

Jian Daosheng spoke with unwavering confidence.

Zhong Daogong stroked his beard and smiled.

"If we can equalize ourselves with the power of the Star Sea, then even without relying on the True Immortal seal script characters, crossing the High Wall will only be a matter of time."

Li Fan frowned and fell into deep thought.

After a long while, he slowly nodded.

"The High Wall seals off the Darkest Star Sea, but only against the living beings within it. If one were to borrow the power of the Star Sea itself and raise monstrous tidal waves, then perhaps the droplets carried by those waves could leap over the High Wall."

"Exactly!"

"Only beings at the level of True Immortals can cross the High Wall. But the power of the Star Sea itself has never been inferior to that of the True Immortals."

"In ancient times, countless strange phenomena erupted throughout the Star Sea. Even True Immortals had to avoid them. That alone demonstrates how terrifying the Star Sea's power truly is."

"Although it was affected by the catastrophe of the Immortal Realm and has fallen into ruin, its vitality has not been extinguished."

The elders grew increasingly excited.

"It is the perfect target for the Equal Heaven Divine Art."

"If the technique succeeds, then even if we cannot immediately lift the Immortal Ark across the High Wall, temporarily controlling the Star Sea's power will still allow us to establish an absolutely secure sanctuary within this Darkest Star Sea."

...

After listening to the Immortal Ark elders' entire plan, Li Fan could not help but clap in admiration.

"Brilliant. Truly brilliant."

"This is nothing less than seizing Heaven's authority for one's own benefit."

He suddenly changed the topic, however, and frowned.

"I once made contact with the Star Sea consciousness using the Taijia Divine Art."

"Before It, cultivators like us are no more than ants."

"And now, this swarm of ants actually dreams of stealing Its power and standing as Its equal..."

Li Fan looked at everyone with a solemn expression.

"Heaven has its wrath. The Star Sea also has its wrath. Even if we succeed, we will probably have to face the Star Sea's origin consciousness launching a frenzied retaliation. Not to mention if we fail."

"When that time comes, I am afraid it may not be something our Immortal Ark can withstand."

"If we do not succeed, we perish. Is the risk not a little too great?"

Li Fan perfectly immersed himself in the mindset of someone whose lifespan had increased by five hundred years. His way of thinking and acting was no longer as extreme as before.

Zhong Daogong nodded, agreeing with Li Fan's assessment.

"You are right. The Immortal Ark has not yet reached the point where we must stake everything on a single gamble. That is precisely why you made the journey to Great Qi."

Zhong Daogong spoke with complete confidence.

Li Fan was somewhat puzzled.

"Can merely one hundred million human lives truly calm the Star Sea's wrath?"

Zhong Daogong smiled, his eyes gleaming.

"Not with humans. With a world."

"If it were merely a matter of human numbers, even several times more would probably make no difference to the Star Sea's origin consciousness. But if those one hundred million human lives are used as the foundation and decorated into a world, then in the name of a cultivation world, they can claim a portion of the Star Sea's power."

"The backlash from the Star Sea will be greatly weakened."

Zhong Daogong spoke with absolute certainty.

"This is determined by the Star Sea's own operating principles. Based on the scattered records accumulated by our Immortal Ark over countless years, we are almost completely certain of this."

Li Fan fell silent as he carefully considered the meaning behind Zhong Daogong's words.

"The nurturing and evolution of cultivation worlds are fundamental laws inherent to the Star Sea itself. Even if a cultivation world expands in strength until it becomes powerful enough to influence the Star Sea, the Star Sea will not directly destroy it."

"At most, it will respond through various Star Sea phenomena."

"Compared to the wrath of the Star Sea's origin consciousness, Star Sea phenomena are far easier to deal with."

Jian Daosheng did not give Li Fan any time to think independently before eagerly providing the explanation.

Zhong Daogong's expression was filled with pride.

"Our Immortal Ark possesses records of nearly every Star Sea phenomenon that has ever appeared in history, along with the most basic methods to deal with them. Right now, the Star Sea has only begun recovering after its destruction. It has not yet reached the stage of rebirth and mutation where entirely new Star Sea phenomena could emerge."

"The possibility is not great."

"Even if one does appear by some small chance, it will most likely be related to the residual power of the True Immortals permeating the void. With the True Immortal seal script in our possession, overcoming such disturbances will absolutely not be a problem."

The elders of the Immortal Ark were all filled with confidence.

The hall remained quiet for a while.

Finally, Zhong Daogong spoke again in a deep voice.

"Of course, to avoid the worst possible outcome, when we perform the Taijia Divine Art, we will leave the Xuan Immortal Ark and bring only the necessary supplies with us."

...

If it succeeded, they would enjoy boundless freedom thereafter. By controlling half of the Star Sea's power, even beyond the High Wall, where dangers lurked everywhere, they would possess a place to stand.

If it failed, they would not lose everything.

Compared to their previous plan of throwing the entire Immortal Ark against the High Wall, this was unquestionably a far superior strategy.

And this was precisely the change that the Taijia Divine Art Li Fan had brought to the Immortal Ark.

It had to be said that the Immortal Ark's Council of Elders truly were not stubborn traditionalists.

They could fully accept new knowledge and even quickly adapt and apply it.

"When will we act?"

Li Fan asked.

However, he quickly rejected his own conclusion.

"No. The stronger the Star Sea becomes, the stronger its future retaliation will be. If we become too greedy, we may exceed the limits of what we can endure."

Zhong Daogong nodded approvingly.

"Exactly. Therefore, we must choose the optimal moment."

"The Immortal Ark has already established a dedicated organization. Our elders take turns using the Taijia Divine Art to approach and observe the consciousness of the Star Sea."

"According to our predictions, the best opportunity will arrive within thirty years."

"During this period, the Star Sea's power and the residual power of the True Immortals restrain and influence one another, maintaining a delicate balance."

"After that..."

"The number of ritual sacrifices is of the utmost importance. Every additional doubling increases our chances of success by another ten percent. I will have to trouble you to devote considerable effort to this matter."

Li Fan accepted with a solemn expression, seemingly already contemplating how to accomplish it.

"As for the second matter..."

Zhong Daogong paused briefly.

Li Fan raised an eyebrow.

"The key to the ritual's success lies in disguising ourselves as a cultivation world within the Star Sea."

As he spoke, Zhong Daogong conjured a simulated image through deduction before Li Fan.

"As you know, every cultivation world within the Star Sea has already been destroyed, except for Great Qi."

"But Great Qi's strength is not inferior to our Immortal Ark. Attempting to seize it and use it as a ready-made disguise would inevitably trigger a great war. That would be most unwise."

"Within the Remnant Worlds Great Wall, the remnants of ancient worlds are all connected together. Disturbing one affects the entire structure, making them difficult to obtain. Zhong Daogong pointed toward the distant Remnant Worlds Great Wall.

Li Fan looked somewhat confused.

"What exactly do you mean by traces left behind after the Heavenly Dao perished?"

It resembled amber, yet also looked like white jade.

It appeared completely natural, without the slightest sign of carving.

It was shaped like a wooden umbrella.

"If you search carefully, there should be many similar objects within the Remnant Worlds Great Wall. Your movement techniques are unrivaled, making the search much easier for you than for us."

Zhong Daogong soon put away the white jade umbrella again.

"However, there is no need to force the matter. Our Immortal Ark's treasury still contains several Heavenly Dao Imprints like this."

"They should be sufficient to complete the disguise."

The three pronged divine tree that had caused [Truth] to react.

...

After leaving the Immortal Ark, Li Fan did not immediately return to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Instead, he headed toward the Great Wall of the Remnant Worlds, where Yin Shangren and Hundred Flowers were located.

Along the way, Li Fan took out the three pronged tree.

The strange reaction from [Truth] appeared precisely at that moment.

Suppressing the desire rising within his heart for the time being, Li Fan first carefully examined the ancient creation before him.

The three pronged tree was forged from an unknown material.

It was neither entirely bronze nor entirely wood.

It possessed both the cold hardness of metal and the ancient vitality and weathered aura of primordial trees.

Each of its three branches did not grow ordinary limbs.

Instead, every fork gave birth to an entirely new tree.

Those secondary trees likewise branched again into new sets of three prongs.

Endlessly.

As though there were no limit.

Even with Li Fan's current divine sense, continuously tracing every branch, he could not determine in a short time exactly how many branches the tree truly possessed.

"Truly exquisite."

Li Fan nodded slightly before no longer suppressing [Truth]'s desire.

An indescribable force enveloped the three pronged tree.

A faint radiance surrounded the ancient creation.

It gradually became transparent before completely vanishing into thin air.

Li Fan stared intently at the changes on the [Truth] interface.

However, after waiting for a long time, the fortunate event from last time, when the Virtualization charging progress had instantly risen to four hundred percent, did not occur.

In fact...

Li Fan could not detect any tangible change whatsoever.

"Could it be that [Truth] simply consumed it for nothing?"

The thought flashed through Li Fan's mind.

But he quickly rejected the idea himself.

Based on everything he knew about [Truth], it had always been extremely selective.

Every time it consumed something, it inevitably brought about a substantial change.

This time was no exception.

Li Fan stopped observing the [Truth] interface and instead focused all of his attention on [Truth] itself.

He even halted the Wooden Sword void traversal technique. Standing silently within the void, Li Fan carefully contemplated.

Half a day later, he suddenly opened his eyes.

"But..."

Li Fan once again projected a phantom Wooden Sword.
